papers.title: Non-Hermitian Edge State Endocytosis
papers.abstract: An isolated edge state observed in a finite open chain is usually expected to survive the thermodynamic limit (TDL), with a localization mechanism distinct from non-Hermitian skin accumulation, which localizes the \emph{entire} bulk continuum. We show that scale-sensitive non-Hermitian systems can generically admit a different fate: as we scale up the system size, a detached edge-localized eigenstate can remain sharply visible over a broad window until a critical scale is reached, where it forms an ephemeral bound state in the continuum (BIC) of the open-boundary bulk before being absorbed (entocytosed) at even larger system sizes. We call this phenomenon edge state endocytosis. Its mechanism is fundamentally traced to the Widom expansion of the open-chain characteristic determinant (energy dispersion equation) into contributions corresponding to admissible non-Bloch mode subsets. Each subset contribution factorizes into a boundary-projected Green's function (proj-GF) determinant, which encodes lattice truncation, and a subset-resolved bulk propagation factor, which encodes the system size dependence. We uncover the fundamental distinction: TDL edge states are zeros of the leading-subset proj-GF determinant, whereas endocytosed states are a hitherto-ignored class of hidden proj-GF zeros from subleading subsets that control the spectrum at finite sizes. Due to its fundamental mathematical origin, the endocytosis mechanism is completely platform-independent, occurring generically without fine-tuning when isolated edge states, topological or otherwise, are subject to non-Hermitian couplings that generate the requisite non-locality. Our new framework quantitatively predicts the endocytosis scale and sheds light on how its intricate competitive mechanism can be revealed through experimentally relevant Green's functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We show、mechanism、framework、platform-independent（理论推导与机制分析）。；研究对象：非厄米开链系统中的边缘态行为，具体为一种称为“边缘态内吞”（edge state endocytosis）的尺度敏感现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米开链中，随着系统尺寸增大，原本孤立的边缘态会在达到临界尺度后消失，被吸收（内吞）进体态连续谱中，形成瞬时的束缚态（BIC），这一现象源于子主导子集边界投影格林函数零点的隐藏贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米开链中，随着系统尺寸增大，原本孤立的边缘态会在达到临界尺度后消失，被吸收（内吞）进体态连续谱中，形成瞬时的束缚态（BIC），这一现象源于子主导子集边界投影格林函数零点的隐藏贡献。；创新点：首次揭示并命名了“边缘态内吞”这一非厄米系统中边缘态随尺寸增大而消失的普遍机制，指出其源于子主导子集边界投影格林函数的隐藏零点（此前被忽略），并建立了定量预测内吞临界尺度的框架，且该机制完全平台无关，无需精细调节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Widom展开将开链特征行列式（能量色散方程）分解为不同非布洛赫模式子集的贡献，每个子集贡献分解为边界投影格林函数行列式（编码截断效应）与子集分辨的体传播因子（编码尺寸依赖）。通过分析子集边界投影格林函数的零点行为，区分热力学极限边缘态与有限尺寸内吞态。

papers.title: Decoding magnetic texture
papers.abstract: In magnetically ordered materials, magnetic field and temperature variations modify the magnetic texture through their coupling to the local energy landscape, imprinting distinct fingerprints in the resulting magnetic domain patterns. Retrieving these conditions from the pattern remains challenging, as stochastic nucleation and hysteresis produce a nonlinear, multivariate, and ambiguous relationship between magnetic domain morphology and external stimuli. To decode these fingerprints, we designed a controlled magneto-optical inference experiment that reconstructs magnetic field, temperature, and magnetic history from a single fine-scale, high-contrast, pixel-resolved optical polarization map of feature-rich magnetic domain textures in a bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet film. Deep convolutional neural networks are complemented by feature-based neural-network inference using hand-crafted, physically interpretable descriptors of measured magneto-optical image data, linking the decoded information to material-dependent features and exploring their contributions. Together, these results establish magnetic texture as a high-fidelity record of external conditions enabling accurate single image multiparametric sensing and paving the way for data-driven explorations of complex magnetic states. Uncovering the physically interpretable features that encode this record sheds new light on the physics of magnetic domain formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：controlled magneto-optical inference experiment、measured magneto-optical image data。；研究对象：铋取代钇铁石榴石（bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet）薄膜中的磁畴纹理（magnetic domain textures）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁畴纹理可作为外部条件（磁场、温度、磁历史）的高保真记录，通过深度学习与基于物理可解释特征的神经网络推理，能够从单张高分辨率磁光偏振图像中准确解码这些条件，实现多参数传感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁畴纹理可作为外部条件（磁场、温度、磁历史）的高保真记录，通过深度学习与基于物理可解释特征的神经网络推理，能够从单张高分辨率磁光偏振图像中准确解码这些条件，实现多参数传感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 设计了受控磁光推断实验，获取高对比度、像素分辨的光学偏振图；使用深度卷积神经网络（deep convolutional neural networks）结合基于手工设计、物理可解释描述符的特征神经网络推理（feature-based neural-network inference）对图像数据进行分析。

papers.title: Multistage development of short-range spin correlations and weak magnetic order in the two coupled trillium lattices of K2Fe2(MoO4)(PO4)2
papers.abstract: Trillium lattices, where magnetic ions form a chiral network of corner-sharing triangles, offer a three-dimensional magnetic framework that can host fragile classical spin-liquid states. Herein, we report on the magnetization, specific heat, electron spin resonance (ESR), and muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR) of K$_{2}$Fe$_{2}$(MoO$_{4}$)(PO$_{4}$)$_{2}$ single crystals. Magnetization measurements reveal strong antiferromagnetic interactions coexisting with weak magnetic order at $T_{\rm N} = 5.2$~K, as evidenced by a $λ$-like anomaly observed in the magnetic susceptibility, a critical enhancement of the muon spin relaxation rate and the wipeout of the ESR signal as the temperature approaches $T_{\rm N}$. Above $T_{\rm N}$, two distinct developments of short-range spin correlations are identified at $T_{\rm H} = 34$~K and $T_{\rm L} = 10$~K, supported by magnetic specific heat anomalies and the temperature dependence of the ESR linewidth and $g$-factor. Upon cooling below $T_{\rm N}$, an anomaly appears at $T^{*} = 3.2$~K in thermodynamic observables and the muon spin relaxation rate, indicative of spin reorientation driven by residual interactions. Despite the presence of magnetic order, $μ$SR experiments reveal dynamically fluctuating spins persisting even in the ordered state. Moreover, the suppression of $T_{\rm N}$ under applied magnetic fields ($μ_{0}H \geq 2$~T) suggests that K$_{2}$Fe$_{2}$(MoO$_{4}$)(PO$_{4}$)$_{2}$ constitutes a promising candidate for exploring field-induced spin-liquid behavior in three-dimensionally coupled trillium lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了磁化率、比热、电子自旋共振（ESR）、μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）等实验测量结果。；研究对象：K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂单晶，一种具有两个耦合的三叶草（trillium）晶格的三维磁性材料，研究其中短程自旋关联和弱磁有序的多阶段演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂中，强反铁磁相互作用与弱磁有序共存（T_N=5.2 K），并在T_N以上存在两个不同阶段的短程自旋关联发展（T_H=34 K和T_L=10 K）；即使在有序态下仍存在动态自旋涨落，且外加磁场可抑制磁有序，暗示该材料可能实现场致自旋液体行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂中，强反铁磁相互作用与弱磁有序共存（T_N=5.2 K），并在T_N以上存在两个不同阶段的短程自旋关联发展（T_H=34 K和T_L=10 K）；即使在有序态下仍存在动态自旋涨落，且外加磁场可抑制磁有序，暗示该材料可能实现场致自旋液体行为。；创新点：首次在具有两个耦合三叶草晶格的三维体系中，通过多实验手段揭示了短程自旋关联的多阶段发展（T_H和T_L两个特征温度），并发现即使在磁有序态下仍存在动态自旋涨落，以及磁场可抑制有序态从而可能诱导自旋液体行为。
papers.method_zh: 磁化率测量、比热测量、电子自旋共振（ESR）、μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）实验。

papers.title: Wavelength-resolved small-angle neutron spectroscopy of spin waves in MnSi under pressure
papers.abstract: We report wavelength-resolved spin-wave small-angle neutron scattering (SWSANS) on the time-of-flight SANS instrument BL01 at the China Spallation Neutron Source and extend the method to pressure-cell measurements of MnSi. MnSi is used as a benchmark B20 helimagnet because its helimagnetic order and spin-wave stiffness are well characterized at ambient pressure. In a fixed magnetic field, the time-of-flight measurement provides a spectrum of neutron wavelengths. For each detector branch $s=\pm1$, the intensity profile is recentered relative to the wavelength-dependent Bragg angle $θ_B (λ) = k_s λ/ 2π$, and the cutoff angle $θ_C (λ)$ is extracted in the local branch coordinate. The cutoff-derived spin-wave stiffness $A$ is obtained from a linear fit of $θ_C^2$ as a function of $λ^2$. Ambient-pressure measurements reproduce the known stiffness scale of MnSi. Structural SANS at ambient pressure and at nominal 5 and 11 kbar verifies the magnetic state and provides an internal pressure-state check for the pressure-cell measurements. At nominal 11 kbar, within the present cutoff model, the cutoff-derived stiffness is substantially reduced, whereas the structural field scale $H_{C2}$ remains high. This contrast shows that $A$ cannot be inferred from static structural parameters alone under pressure. To our knowledge, these measurements constitute the first SWSANS implementation on a pulsed neutron source and the first SWSANS determination of spin-wave stiffness under pressure. The experiment also shows that reliable high-pressure SWSANS on a pulsed source requires high source brilliance, stable wavelength-dependent normalization, and sufficient statistics in each wavelength window.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report”、“measurements”、“experiment”、“time-of-flight SANS instrument”。；研究对象：B20型螺旋磁体MnSi在压力下的自旋波行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在名义11 kbar压力下，基于截止角模型提取的自旋波刚度A显著降低，而静态结构场标度H_C2仍保持较高值，表明在压力下不能仅从静态结构参数推断自旋波刚度A。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在名义11 kbar压力下，基于截止角模型提取的自旋波刚度A显著降低，而静态结构场标度H_C2仍保持较高值，表明在压力下不能仅从静态结构参数推断自旋波刚度A。；创新点：首次在脉冲中子源上实现SWSANS测量，并首次利用SWSANS确定压力下的自旋波刚度。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 波长分辨自旋波小角中子散射（SWSANS），在中国散裂中子源BL01飞行时间小角中子散射谱仪上实现，并扩展到高压样品池测量。通过固定磁场下飞行时间测量获得中子波长谱，利用波长依赖的布拉格角重新居中强度分布，提取截止角θ_C，再通过θ_C²对λ²的线性拟合得到自旋波刚度A。

papers.title: Ordering and Defect Dynamics in Passive and Active Nematopolars
papers.abstract: The coexistence of polar and nematic interactions, observed in a broad range of biological and synthetic active systems, gives rise to a rich phenomenology that continues to challenge our theoretical understanding of non-equilibrium collective behaviour. In this paper, we numerically investigate phase ordering and defect dynamics in a newly introduced minimal single-field model for dry nematopolar systems, where competing polar and nematic contributions enter the free energy, and activity is implemented through a self-advection contribution. At optimal balance between the two alignments, the system develops depolarization strings connecting half-integer defects and separating domains with opposite polarization, together with closed depolarization loops. We first characterize the elementary relaxation mechanisms of defect pairs and loops, showing that the interplay between polar and nematic alignment gives rise to non-monotonic string-mediated interactions, finite equilibrium separations and distinct loop-collapse pathways. Large-scale simulations from disordered states instead show dynamic scaling with a characteristic length growing as $\sim(t/\ln t)^{1/2}$, consistent with coarsening in systems with non-conserved order parameters and point-like defects. Upon introducing self-advection, sufficiently strong activity leads to the coexistence of positive integer and negative half-integer defects, which we term motility-induced charge symmetry breaking, and to saturation of the characteristic length scales, ultimately resulting in arrested coarsening. Overall, our results provide a simple unified framework for understanding the ordering and defect dynamics in biological and synthetic nematopolar systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically investigate（数值研究）、single-field model（单场模型）、large-scale simulations（大规模模拟）。；研究对象：干性（dry）向列-极性（nematopolar）活性系统中的相序（phase ordering）与缺陷动力学（defect dynamics），具体为同时存在极性和向列相互作用的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极性与向列相互作用的最优平衡下，系统形成连接半整数缺陷的去极化弦（depolarization strings）和闭合去极化环（depolarization loops）；引入足够强的自平流（self-advection）活性会导致运动性诱导的电荷对称性破缺（motility-induced charge symmetry breaking），使正整数缺陷与负半整数缺陷共存，并最终导致粗化（coarsening）停滞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极性与向列相互作用的最优平衡下，系统形成连接半整数缺陷的去极化弦（depolarization strings）和闭合去极化环（depolarization loops）；引入足够强的自平流（self-advection）活性会导致运动性诱导的电荷对称性破缺（motility-induced charge symmetry breaking），使正整数缺陷与负半整数缺陷共存，并最终导致粗化（coarsening）停滞。；创新点：首次在一个统一的单场模型中系统揭示了极性与向列相互作用竞争所导致的非单调弦介导相互作用、有限平衡分离距离、不同的环塌缩路径，以及活性诱导的电荷对称性破缺和粗化停滞现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用新提出的最小单场模型，自由能中包含竞争性的极性和向列贡献，并通过自平流项实现活性；通过数值模拟研究缺陷对和环的基本弛豫机制，以及从无序态出发的大规模动力学标度行为。

papers.title: Feller diffusion in an interval: Inhomogeneous fluctuation-induced asymmetric escape
papers.abstract: We present an inhomogeneous fluctuation-induced asymmetric escape event of a Feller diffusion confined to a finite interval with two competing absorbing boundaries. The dynamics correspond to an overdamped Brownian motion in a shifted harmonic potential with state-dependent diffusivity. We set two exit points (equal potential energies), equidistant from the potential minima: an extinction site near the origin and an outbreak point. The multiplicative fluctuations are suppressed near the extinction boundary, biasing trajectories toward the outbreak state. The mean exit time exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on the initial condition and the drift-to-noise strength ratio, attaining a maximum when the particle is initialized toward the extinction (low-noise) site. The outbreak possibility is more likely even if the process started with a small initial bias towards the low-noise boundary. The spatial location of the lowest coefficient of variation (CV) is nicely corroborated by the maximum exit time, which is the hallmark of a stochastic escape from an interval. The fluctuation in escape time is found to dominate its mean as a non-trivial function of the drift-to-noise strength and the initial spatial bias. The observed asymmetries in escape also shape the speed-accuracy trade-off in stochastic decision-making events.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述的是随机过程（Feller diffusion）、数学建模（overdamped Brownian motion in a shifted harmonic potential）和解析/数值分析（mean exit time, coefficient of variation）。；研究对象：有限区间内Feller扩散的非均匀涨落诱导的不对称逃逸现象，具体对应一个具有状态依赖扩散系数的过阻尼布朗运动体系，涉及两个竞争吸收边界（灭绝点与爆发点）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在势能对称、但涨落强度空间非均匀的条件下，粒子逃逸行为呈现显著不对称性：即使初始位置略微偏向低噪声（灭绝）边界，爆发（逃逸至另一边界）的可能性仍更高；平均逃逸时间随初始条件和漂移-噪声强度比呈非单调变化，并在粒子初始靠近低噪声边界时达到最大值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在势能对称、但涨落强度空间非均匀的条件下，粒子逃逸行为呈现显著不对称性：即使初始位置略微偏向低噪声（灭绝）边界，爆发（逃逸至另一边界）的可能性仍更高；平均逃逸时间随初始条件和漂移-噪声强度比呈非单调变化，并在粒子初始靠近低噪声边界时达到最大值。；创新点：揭示了在有限区间内，由于涨落强度在空间上的非均匀分布（在灭绝边界附近被抑制），即使势能对称，也能诱导出不对称的逃逸行为，并系统刻画了逃逸时间均值与涨落的非平凡关系及其对随机决策中速度-准确性权衡的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用Feller扩散模型（状态依赖扩散系数的随机微分方程），结合过阻尼布朗运动在偏移谐振子势中的动力学框架，通过解析推导平均逃逸时间、变异系数（CV）等统计量，并分析其随初始偏置和漂移-噪声强度比的变化规律。

papers.title: Are Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials Truly Practical? A Benchmark of 23 Mainstream Models
papers.abstract: Most MLIP benchmarks reward static accuracy while ignoring inference efficiency and hardware scalability -- driving model bloat with unclear real-world value. We benchmark 23 mainstream open-source MLIPs on a low-cost NVIDIA DGX Spark (128 GB native memory, capped at 80 GB to mimic ordinary lab hardware), using a fixed 192-atom system under a unified ASE-based pipeline. We evaluate three dimensions: predictive accuracy, MD simulation throughput, and atomic scalability. Our results expose a sharp accuracy-efficiency trade-off: large SOTA models deliver only 3-5 meV/atom more accuracy than lightweight ones, but lose orders of magnitude in throughput -- in the worst case, becoming only marginally faster than DFT itself. Lightweight MLIPs, by contrast, sit on the Pareto frontier and run on modest hardware. The lesson is that single-dimensional benchmarks mislead the field, and that future MLIP development should value efficiency and scalability alongside accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：benchmark（基准测试）、MLIP（机器学习原子间势）、MD simulation（分子动力学模拟）、ASE-based pipeline（基于ASE的流程）。；研究对象：23种主流开源机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型，在固定192原子体系上的性能表现。摘要未明确说明具体材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 大型最先进（SOTA）MLIP模型相比轻量级模型仅提升3-5 meV/atom的精度，但计算吞吐量损失数个数量级，最差情况下仅比DFT稍快；轻量级MLIP位于帕累托前沿，更适合实际硬件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：大型最先进（SOTA）MLIP模型相比轻量级模型仅提升3-5 meV/atom的精度，但计算吞吐量损失数个数量级，最差情况下仅比DFT稍快；轻量级MLIP位于帕累托前沿，更适合实际硬件。；创新点：揭示了单维度基准测试（仅关注精度）对领域的误导性，强调未来MLIP开发应同时重视效率、可扩展性与精度。摘要未突出说明具体模型名称或体系细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于统一ASE（原子模拟环境）流程，在低成本NVIDIA DGX Spark（原生128 GB内存，限制为80 GB以模拟普通实验室硬件）上，对23种主流开源MLIP进行三维度基准测试：预测精度、MD模拟吞吐量、原子可扩展性。

papers.title: Time-state superposition in non-equilibrium fluidized granular matter
papers.abstract: Despite being intrinsically athermal and strongly driven, granular materials can exhibit remarkably glass-like dynamics. Whether their rheology can be described by the same scaling concepts remains an open question. Here, we investigate the linear viscoelastic response of an air-fluidized granular bed using small-amplitude oscillatory shear over a broad range of fluidization states. We show that the frequency-dependent spectra collapse onto a single master curve when shifted by a state-dependent relaxation time, establishing a time-state superposition principle analogous to time-temperature superposition in molecular glasses. The master curve spans more than five decades in relaxation time and is quantitatively described by a Cole-Davidson relaxation spectrum. By comparison with continuous shear measurements, we identify tribocharging as the origin of history-dependent deviations from universal scaling. Our results demonstrate that fluidization primarily rescales a single structural relaxation time while preserving the underlying relaxation spectrum, establishing a direct connection between the rheology of driven granular matter and molecular glass-forming liquids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate the linear viscoelastic response”和“using small-amplitude oscillatory shear”，属于实验测量。；研究对象：空气流化颗粒床（air-fluidized granular bed）在非平衡态下的流变学行为，具体研究其线性粘弹性响应与玻璃态动力学之间的类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现空气流化颗粒床的线性粘弹性频谱可通过状态依赖的弛豫时间平移，塌缩到一条主曲线上，建立了类似于分子玻璃中“时间-温度叠加”的“时间-状态叠加”原理。该主曲线跨越超过五个数量级的弛豫时间，并可用Cole-Davidson弛豫谱定量描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现空气流化颗粒床的线性粘弹性频谱可通过状态依赖的弛豫时间平移，塌缩到一条主曲线上，建立了类似于分子玻璃中“时间-温度叠加”的“时间-状态叠加”原理。该主曲线跨越超过五个数量级的弛豫时间，并可用Cole-Davidson弛豫谱定量描述。；创新点：首次在非平衡流化颗粒物质中建立了与分子玻璃中时间-温度叠加原理类似的时间-状态叠加原理，并证明流化主要改变单一结构弛豫时间的时间尺度，而弛豫谱本身保持不变，从而建立了驱动颗粒物质流变学与分子玻璃形成液体之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用小振幅振荡剪切实验，在广泛的流化状态范围内测量空气流化颗粒床的线性粘弹性响应；同时结合连续剪切测量，识别摩擦起电（tribocharging）对普适标度偏离的影响。

papers.title: Thermal-response Functions and the Peierls-Boltzmann Equation for Second Sound and Phonon Hydrodynamics in Graphene
papers.abstract: We connect expressions for phonon phase-space distribution functions to microscopic physics of the evolution of heat waves. The role of interference effects that arise as a result of a periodic heating source typically encountered in transient thermal grating (TTG) experiments is then explored. The distribution functions are evaluated as solutions to the Peierls-Boltzmann equation (PBE) in the relaxation-time approximation (RTA). Starting from the PBE, we next develop thermal response functions. The response functions are computed using data from density-functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using this approach, it is shown how solutions to the PBE can be related to the propagation of second phonons as elementary excitations, and within this perspective the necessary conditions for the propagation and observation of second sound is elucidated. The approach developed therefore shows how PBE theory for phonon hydrodynamics and second sound can be modified to properly describe interference and phonon decoherence effects that are likely important at shorter length scales. Finally, we then discuss how many-body theory can be extended to include coupled scattering channels and hence provide a quantitative theory beyond the RTA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论框架（Peierls-Boltzmann方程、弛豫时间近似、响应函数、多体理论），并使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算数据作为输入，未提及任何实验操作。；研究对象：石墨烯中的第二声（second sound）和声子流体动力学（phonon hydrodynamics）现象，特别是热波（heat waves）的传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过求解Peierls-Boltzmann方程（PBE）并建立热响应函数，阐明了第二声作为基本激发传播的必要条件，并揭示了在瞬态热栅（TTG）实验中由周期性热源引起的干涉效应和声子退相干效应的重要性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过求解Peierls-Boltzmann方程（PBE）并建立热响应函数，阐明了第二声作为基本激发传播的必要条件，并揭示了在瞬态热栅（TTG）实验中由周期性热源引起的干涉效应和声子退相干效应的重要性。；创新点：该工作将PBE理论与第二声和声子流体动力学联系起来，并特别强调了在较短长度尺度下，干涉和声子退相干效应的重要性，并展示了如何修改现有理论以正确描述这些效应。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为弛豫时间近似（RTA）下的Peierls-Boltzmann方程（PBE）。具体手段包括：从PBE出发推导热响应函数，并使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的数据来评估这些响应函数。最后讨论了如何将多体理论扩展到包含耦合散射通道，以超越RTA。

papers.title: Acoustic-phonon-driven spin-lattice relaxation of the hBN boron vacancy in the sub-THz regime
papers.abstract: The negatively charged boron vacancy center in hexagonal boron nitride is a premier candidate for quantum sensing, yet its performance is critically limited by longitudinal spin-lattice relaxation time ($T_1$). A microscopic understanding of spin relaxation in the high magnetic field regime remains elusive, as the relevant Zeeman transitions lie far below the optical phonon energies typically invoked to describe the relaxation process. Here, we apply an \textit{ab initio} acoustic mode spin-phonon relaxation theory to this problem and quantitatively reproduce the experimental magnetic field and temperature dependence of $T_1$ without empirical fitting parameters. We demonstrate that the relaxation dynamics are driven by a direct one-phonon emission and absorption process resonant with the Zeeman splitting. Furthermore, we identify the out-of-plane flexural phonon branch which is unique to two-dimensional hosts, as the primary source of decoherence, creating a distinct low-energy spectral function that facilitates spin relaxation. Our results provide a microscopic interpretation of the experimentally observed non-monotonic field and temperature dependence in two-dimensional quantum defect centers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“应用第一性原理声学模式自旋-声子弛豫理论”、“定量重现实验数据”、“无经验拟合参数”，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的带负电硼空位缺陷中心，具体研究其在高磁场（亚太赫兹）条件下的纵向自旋-晶格弛豫时间（T₁）及其微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现hBN硼空位中心的自旋弛豫由直接单声子发射与吸收过程驱动，该过程与塞曼分裂共振；识别出二维材料特有的面外弯曲声子支是导致退相干的主要来源，从而解释了实验观测到的非单调场强与温度依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现hBN硼空位中心的自旋弛豫由直接单声子发射与吸收过程驱动，该过程与塞曼分裂共振；识别出二维材料特有的面外弯曲声子支是导致退相干的主要来源，从而解释了实验观测到的非单调场强与温度依赖关系。；创新点：首次将声学声子驱动的自旋弛豫理论应用于二维缺陷中心的高磁场（亚THz）弛豫问题，并定量重现实验数据；明确指出二维材料特有的面外弯曲声子支在自旋弛豫中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理（ab initio）声学模式自旋-声子弛豫理论，直接计算自旋-晶格弛豫时间T₁的磁场与温度依赖关系，无需经验拟合参数。

papers.title: Raman spectroscopic signature of Kitaev magnetism and complex spin-lattice coupling in S = 1/2 antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO$_6$ double perovskite
papers.abstract: We report a detailed analysis of temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and Co $K$-edge extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) for a pseudospin-$\tilde{S}=1/2$ insulating antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO$_6$, a B-site--ordered double perovskite hosting Co$^{2+}$ ($3d^7$) ions on an {\it f.c.c.} sublattice. Notably, pronounced anomalies in the phonon frequency, linewidth and spectral weight are observed around 60~K, well above the long-range antiferromagnetic transition at $T_{\rm N} \approx 15$~K. These renormalizations indicate a significant coupling between lattice and spin degrees of freedom, although a purely structural contribution cannot be excluded. Additional modifications of both high- and low-energy Raman modes are detected near 160-180 K, including changes in linewidth and intensity, variations of the Fano asymmetry parameter, and the emergence of an additional low-energy feature. The asymmetric Fano line shape of selected low-energy modes, together with a broad low-energy continuum and quasielastic response, suggests coupling between discrete phonons and fluctuating magnetic excitations. Moreover, the EXAFS analysis reveals correlated changes in bond distances and Debye-Waller factors around the Co ions near 60~K and 160~K, evidencing subtle local structural distortions and possible magnetostrictive effects. The persistence of anomalous lattice dynamics far above $T_{\rm N}$, combined with the excitation-energy--independent continuum, is consistent with fluctuating bond-directional interactions and proximate Kitaev-like correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy”和“Co K-edge extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS)”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：B位有序双钙钛矿材料 SrLaCoNbO₆，具体研究其中 Co²⁺ (3d⁷) 离子在面心立方 (f.c.c.) 子晶格上形成的赝自旋-1/2 绝缘反铁磁体中的基塔耶夫磁性及自旋-晶格耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远高于长程反铁磁转变温度 (T_N ≈ 15 K) 的约 60 K 和 160-180 K 处，观察到显著的声子反常和局域结构畸变，表明存在强烈的自旋-晶格耦合和涨落的键方向相互作用，这与近邻的基塔耶夫型关联一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远高于长程反铁磁转变温度 (T_N ≈ 15 K) 的约 60 K 和 160-180 K 处，观察到显著的声子反常和局域结构畸变，表明存在强烈的自旋-晶格耦合和涨落的键方向相互作用，这与近邻的基塔耶夫型关联一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了变温拉曼光谱学（分析声子频率、线宽、谱重及Fano不对称参数）和 Co K边扩展X射线吸收精细结构谱（EXAFS，分析键长和Debye-Waller因子变化）。

papers.title: MLIP Studio: An Open Platform for Interactive Benchmarking and Atomistic Simulations Using Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are foundation AI models transforming atomistic simulations, but their practical use remains hindered by fragmented software ecosystems, dependency conflicts, and the lack of accessible benchmarking tools. These models approach first-principles density functional theory (DFT) accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. We introduce MLIP Studio (available at https://mlipstudio.iisc.ac.in), an open and free platform that brings more than 60 universal MLIPs into a unified interactive interface for molecules and materials. The platform enables end-to-end MLIP-driven workflows, including property prediction, geometry optimization, vibrational and equation-of-state analysis, spin-state determination, custom model deployment, and high-throughput benchmarking against reference data. Automated parity plots and sortable error tables facilitate rapid identification of element-wise outliers and problematic data points. We demonstrate that MLIP-based pre-optimization can reduce subsequent DFT optimization effort by ~33$\times$. Additionally, the application enables benchmarking of computational performance. Through a comprehensive case study involving the 2D magnetic material CrCl$_3$ on a sapphire substrate, we show how cross-model comparisons of various properties and potential-energy landscapes can guide task-specific MLIP selection. Overall, MLIP Studio lowers the barrier to the reliable use of foundation models in end-to-end research workflows, benchmarking, and education in computational chemistry and materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“atomistic simulations”、“first-principles density functional theory (DFT) accuracy”、“benchmarking”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在分子和材料模拟中的应用，并以二维磁性材料CrCl₃在蓝宝石衬底上的体系作为案例研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MLIP Studio平台集成了超过60种通用MLIP，能够实现端到端的原子模拟工作流，并发现基于MLIP的预优化可将后续DFT优化计算量减少约33倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MLIP Studio平台集成了超过60种通用MLIP，能够实现端到端的原子模拟工作流，并发现基于MLIP的预优化可将后续DFT优化计算量减少约33倍。；创新点：该工作提供了一个开放、统一的交互式平台，整合了超过60种通用MLIP，解决了现有软件生态碎片化、依赖冲突和缺乏可访问基准测试工具的问题，并支持跨模型对比以指导特定任务的MLIP选择。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）驱动的计算工作流，包括性质预测、几何优化、振动分析、状态方程分析、自旋态确定、自定义模型部署以及高通量基准测试。平台通过自动生成帕累托图和可排序误差表进行性能评估。

papers.title: Human and LLM Collaboration for Accelerated Materials Synthesis and Discovery
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools have enabled a rapid increase in the generation rate of predicted materials, the rate of new materials discovery has lagged behind. This is due to the challenges associated with designing a sequence of chemical reactions to predictably produce new materials, especially in new structure types. Here, we report a study of human and LLM generated recipes for the synthesis of known and new materials. The success of the recipes is determined through in-lab experimentation, and the results are passed back to the humans and LLMs in a closed-loop process to study the effects of their collaboration. The Ruddlesden-Popper homologous series was selected for all material candidates to provide a materials phase space that is simultaneously well studied and likely to host undiscovered materials. We find that humans (H) and LLM (L) have similar success rates: 83(8)% (H) and 75(9)% (L) [known materials, round one], 17(9)% (H) and 22(10)% (L) [unknown materials, round one], 79(8)% (H) and 71(9)% (L) [known materials, round two], and 22(7)% (H) and 14(6)% (L) [unknown materials, round two]. Through this collaborative human-LLM effort, we discovered Ba3PtO5, a material with a new structural prototype that constitutes the missing 1D member of the herein reported dimensionally tunable Rock-Salt Perovskite (RSP) homologous series of the form (AX)m(ABX3)p, of which the Ruddlesden-Popper series is a subset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/理论辅助）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“in-lab experimentation”（实验室实验）和“closed-loop process”（闭环流程），同时涉及人类与LLM协作生成合成方案，但未提及第一性原理计算或数值模拟方法，因此更偏向实验驱动，辅以AI工具。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper同源系列材料，以及更广义的Rock-Salt Perovskite (RSP) 同源系列（通式 (AX)m(ABX3)p），具体包括已知和未知材料的合成，以及新化合物 Ba3PtO5。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 人类与LLM在已知和未知材料合成方案的成功率上相近（已知材料约80%，未知材料约20%）；通过人机协作，成功合成了具有新结构原型（1D RSP系列缺失成员）的新材料 Ba3PtO5。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：人类与LLM在已知和未知材料合成方案的成功率上相近（已知材料约80%，未知材料约20%）；通过人机协作，成功合成了具有新结构原型（1D RSP系列缺失成员）的新材料 Ba3PtO5。；创新点：首次系统比较人类与LLM在材料合成方案设计中的成功率，并展示人机协作闭环流程可加速发现具有新结构原型的新材料（Ba3PtO5），填补了RSP同源系列中一维成员的缺失。
papers.method_zh: 人类与LLM分别设计合成方案，通过实验室实验验证方案成功率，并将实验结果反馈给人类和LLM进行第二轮迭代（闭环流程）。摘要未明确说明具体合成技术（如固相反应、溶胶-凝胶法等）或表征手段（如XRD、SEM等）。

papers.title: Geometric Interpretation of Sum Photon Blockade
papers.abstract: We present a geometric interpretation of the sum photon blockade effect in multimode quantum optical systems, such as semiconductor microresonators. The blockade condition \(c^{(n)} \cdot v = 0\) reflects the orthogonality of the \(n\)-photon amplitude vector to a target mode vector in an \(N\)-dimensional Hilbert space, visualized as the confinement of the state to a hyperplane. A key result is the calculation of the maximum probability of the system remaining in the blockade subspace under the influence of decoherence processes (in particular, dephasing), which determines the practical feasibility and robustness of the effect. This approach extends to higher-order correlators \(g^{(2)}_Σ\) and cross-correlations, enabling the design of scalable quantum devices. We introduce the concept of "dark-state typicality": as the number of modes \(M\) increases, the dark subspace annihilated by the collective mode operator asymptotically occupies a unit fraction of the \(n\)-boson Hilbert space. This allows the transition from fragile, finely tuned mechanisms to macroscopically robust non-classical light in large multimode bosonic architectures. We consider continuum collective modes, hypotheses on correlation zeros and invariant manifolds, as well as the relationship between blockade and entanglement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“几何解释”“计算最大概率”“引入概念”等，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：多模量子光学系统中的“和光子阻塞”效应，具体体系包括半导体微谐振器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 和光子阻塞条件 \(c^{(n)} \cdot v = 0\) 可几何解释为 \(n\) 光子振幅矢量与目标模式矢量在 \(N\) 维希尔伯特空间中的正交性，系统状态被限制在一个超平面内。随着模式数 \(M\) 增加，被集体模式算符湮灭的暗子空间渐近占据 \(n\) 玻色子希尔伯特空间的单位分数，从而实现从脆弱精细调控到宏观鲁棒非经典光的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：和光子阻塞条件 \(c^{(n)} \cdot v = 0\) 可几何解释为 \(n\) 光子振幅矢量与目标模式矢量在 \(N\) 维希尔伯特空间中的正交性，系统状态被限制在一个超平面内。随着模式数 \(M\) 增加，被集体模式算符湮灭的暗子空间渐近占据 \(n\) 玻色子希尔伯特空间的单位分数，从而实现从脆弱精细调控到宏观鲁棒非经典光的转变。；创新点：首次为和光子阻塞效应提供几何解释，并引入“暗态典型性”概念，揭示多模系统中暗子空间占据渐近优势的统计特性，为设计可扩展的量子器件提供新思路。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何方法在希尔伯特空间中分析多模量子光学系统的阻塞条件；通过计算退相干（特别是退相位）下系统停留在阻塞子空间的最大概率来评估效应的可行性与鲁棒性；引入“暗态典型性”概念，并考虑连续集体模式、关联零点、不变流形以及阻塞与纠缠的关系。

papers.title: Unveiling the Spin-Valley Structure of Dipolar Exciton Ladders in R-stacked WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ Moiré Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in moiré heterobilayers can form dipolar exciton ladders, yet their internal spin-valley structure remains unresolved. Here, we use helicity-resolved magneto-photoluminescence to identify the microscopic origin of the ladder in R-stacked WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ at charge neutrality and one-electron filling of the moiré lattice. At charge neutrality, the first two emission peaks correspond to a spin-triplet interlayer exciton and a triplet-triplet two-exciton state separated by 38 meV, reflecting the on-site dipolar interaction. The opposite Zeeman response of the apparent third rung of the ladder rules out its assignment as a spin-conserving three-exciton state and instead identifies it as a triplet-singlet two-exciton configuration with a 22 meV offset set by the WS$_2$ conduction-band spin splitting. At one-electron filling, the correlated electronic background gives rise to charged one- and two-exciton states and intervalley/intravalley two-exciton configurations, while reducing the effective exciton-exciton interaction. Our results establish a spin-valley-resolved picture of dipolar exciton ladders beyond simple occupation-number physics in moiré heterobilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：helicity-resolved magneto-photoluminescence（螺旋分辨磁光致发光）。；研究对象：R型堆叠WSe₂/WS₂莫尔异质双层中的偶极激子梯级（dipolar exciton ladders）及其自旋-谷结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电荷中性点，偶极激子梯级的前两个发射峰分别对应自旋三重态层间激子和三重态-三重态双激子态（能量间隔38 meV），而第三个梯级并非自旋守恒的三激子态，而是三重态-单重态双激子构型（能量偏移22 meV，由WS₂导带自旋劈裂决定）。在单电子填充时，关联电子背景产生带电单激子和双激子态以及谷间/谷内双激子构型，并降低了有效激子-激子相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电荷中性点，偶极激子梯级的前两个发射峰分别对应自旋三重态层间激子和三重态-三重态双激子态（能量间隔38 meV），而第三个梯级并非自旋守恒的三激子态，而是三重态-单重态双激子构型（能量偏移22 meV，由WS₂导带自旋劈裂决定）。在单电子填充时，关联电子背景产生带电单激子和双激子态以及谷间/谷内双激子构型，并降低了有效激子-激子相互作用。；创新点：揭示了莫尔异质双层中偶极激子梯级超越简单占据数物理的自旋-谷分辨图像，首次明确区分了不同自旋-谷构型的激子态及其能量偏移的微观起源。
papers.method_zh: 螺旋分辨磁光致发光（helicity-resolved magneto-photoluminescence）光谱，结合电荷中性点和单电子填充条件下的测量。

papers.title: Monolithic GaN Systems Combining Non-Volatile Memory and Analog Computing via Area-Ratio-Engineered Ferroelectric AlScN Gate Stacks
papers.abstract: Gallium nitride (GaN) transistors have become the platform of choice for power electronics and radio-frequency power amplifiers. To unlock capabilities beyond those of conventional GaN, integrating ferroelectric heterostructure has been considered toward memory, logic and reconfigurable systems. Here, we demonstrate ferroelectric GaN transistors employing an AlScN-based gate stack in which systematic engineering of the area-ratio (SMIS/SMFM) provides unified control over both memory and analog functionality. Precise modulation of the intermediate electrode length yields a record memory window of 27 V and a forward subthreshold swing of 27 mV/dec, driven by ferroelectric polarization reversal of a robust downward-polarization state pre-induced by two-dimensional electron gas. Low area-ratio devices (SMIS/SMFM = 1, 2) achieve 4-bit multi-level cell operation and excellent spatial uniformity across a fabricated 4 x 4 array, benchmarking favorably against established silicon and oxide ferroelectric architectures. High area-ratio devices (SMIS/SMFM = 4, 8) harness continuously tunable conductance states to demonstrate multi-state inverters and the first GaN-based ferroelectric frequency-to-voltage converter, delivering a linear frequency-voltage response across 0.5 - 500 Hz range with a conversion gain of 1.1 mV/Hz. This work establishes routes towards monolithically integrated GaN systems that combine non-volatile memory and analog signal processing on a platform inherently suited to high-power and radio-frequency applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”、“fabricated”、“measured”等关键词，描述了器件的制备和性能表征。；研究对象：基于铁电AlScN栅叠层的氮化镓（GaN）晶体管，具体研究通过面积比（SMIS/SMFM）工程调控其存储与模拟计算功能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统调控铁电AlScN栅叠层中金属-绝缘体-半导体（MIS）与金属-铁电-金属（MFM）结构的面积比，实现了创纪录的27 V存储窗口和27 mV/dec的亚阈值摆幅，并首次在GaN平台上演示了频率-电压转换器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统调控铁电AlScN栅叠层中金属-绝缘体-半导体（MIS）与金属-铁电-金属（MFM）结构的面积比，实现了创纪录的27 V存储窗口和27 mV/dec的亚阈值摆幅，并首次在GaN平台上演示了频率-电压转换器。；创新点：1. 提出了通过面积比工程统一调控GaN基铁电器件的存储与模拟功能的新策略。2. 首次在GaN平台上实现了铁电频率-电压转换器，展示了其在模拟信号处理中的应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：制备了不同面积比（1, 2, 4, 8）的铁电AlScN栅叠层GaN晶体管；通过电学测量表征了存储窗口、亚阈值摆幅、多级单元（MLC）操作、空间均匀性以及频率-电压转换特性。

papers.title: Pressure-induced Structural Phase Transition, Metallization, and Superconductivity in layered metalloid dichalcogenide 1T-SiTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Layered transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have attracted considerable attention as promising platforms for exploring emergent physics and potential device applications. In contrast, metalloid-based dichalcogenide counterparts remain largely underexplored. Here, we report the pressure-induced structural phase transition, metallization, and superconductivity in the layered metalloid dichalcogenide 1T-SiTe$_2$. At ambient pressure, 1T-SiTe$_2$ crystallizes in a trigonal crystal structure (space group: $P\bar{3}m1$) and exhibits intrinsic semiconducting transport characteristics. Upon pressurization, in concomitant with the suppression of semiconducting behavior in resistance, superconductivity emerges at around 6.7 GPa. The superconducting transition temperature (T$_c$) rises continuously with increasing pressure and finally saturates at approximately 5.5 K for pressures above 30 GPa. During the compression, 1T-SiTe$_2$ experiences three structural phase transitions, and the phase transition pressures are highly consistent with the anomalous transport responses observed experimentally, indicating that the changes of transport behavior of 1T-SiTe$_2$ under pressure are structurally-driven. Our work extends TMD superconductors into the realm of metalloid systems and provides a new platform for exploring novel physics in quasi two-dimensional materials without transition-metal elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、experimentally observed、transport responses、resistance、superconducting transition temperature。；研究对象：层状准金属二硫化物1T-SiTe₂在高压下的结构相变、金属化与超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1T-SiTe₂在约6.7 GPa压力下从半导体转变为超导体，超导转变温度随压力升高而上升，在30 GPa以上饱和于约5.5 K；该过程中伴随三次结构相变，且输运行为的异常变化与结构相变压力高度一致，表明超导与金属化是结构驱动的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1T-SiTe₂在约6.7 GPa压力下从半导体转变为超导体，超导转变温度随压力升高而上升，在30 GPa以上饱和于约5.5 K；该过程中伴随三次结构相变，且输运行为的异常变化与结构相变压力高度一致，表明超导与金属化是结构驱动的。；创新点：将过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）超导体的研究拓展至准金属（metalloid）体系，首次在无过渡金属元素的层状准金属二硫化物1T-SiTe₂中实现压力诱导超导，为探索新型准二维材料中的新奇物理提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 高压电阻测量（输运特性）、高压结构分析（X射线衍射或类似手段，摘要未明确说明具体衍射方法）、压力诱导相变表征。摘要未明确说明是否使用第一性原理计算或光谱学手段。

papers.title: Tunnel-rate controlled local heat distribution in mesoscopic circuits
papers.abstract: Solid-state quantum technologies, including qubits and quantum metrology circuits, demand milli-Kelvin operation to preserve fragile quantum states from classical noise. While the negligible electron-phonon coupling is the major impediment, reaching 50 mK electron temperature is further suffered by the high electrical resistance and sub-micron-scale dimensions of typical devices, limiting conventional heat dissipation. Though the phonons are effectively frozen, thermoelectric techniques could offer a viable path for heat management.This work explores thermally driven electrical transport in a gated quantum dot (QD) on a GaAs-AlGaAs two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), to control heat flow between the source and drain reservoirs.By exploiting the QD's discrete energy spectrum and tuneable tunnel rates, a precise control over the polarity and magnitude of the resulting thermoelectric current is demonstrated. A temperature difference of 650 mK is maintained across the QD, a separation of 400 nm, by tuning the tunnel-rates. An experimental gate pulsing method is also introduced to directly measure the electron temperature differences across the QD, bypassing the need for any theoretical fits. The results presented here show that tuneable tunnel barriers can be used for local heat control, and could lead to advanced quantum refrigerators that work efficiently in mesoscopic circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental gate pulsing method”、“demonstrated”、“measured”等实验性关键词。；研究对象：基于GaAs-AlGaAs二维电子气（2DEG）的栅控量子点（QD）体系，研究其热驱动电荷输运及局域热分布控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节量子点的隧穿速率，可以精确控制热电流的极性和大小，并在400 nm的间距上维持650 mK的温差，从而实现介观电路中的局域热分布调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节量子点的隧穿速率，可以精确控制热电流的极性和大小，并在400 nm的间距上维持650 mK的温差，从而实现介观电路中的局域热分布调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用栅控量子点结构，通过调节隧穿势垒的隧穿速率来控制热电流；引入一种实验性的栅极脉冲方法，直接测量量子点两端的电子温差，无需理论拟合。

papers.title: Entanglement Asymmetry in Random Quantum Automata
papers.abstract: We investigate the subsystem entanglement asymmetry in random quantum automaton ensembles, which are generated by permuting the basis states in the Hilbert space and applying global phase shifts. We compute the ensemble average of the $U(1)$ subsystem asymmetry in different connectivity geometries, showing that the late-time limit of the ensemble associated to a 2-local circuit geometry coincides with the all-to-all ensemble average. By focusing on different subsystem sizes, we demonstrate that, similarly to Haar-random circuits, the system locally symmetrizes. However, in sharp contrast to the Haar-random setting, the scale at which symmetrization happens depends on the initial state, a phenomenon we associate with the interplay of conservation of the participation entropy and the uniform exploration of charge sectors. Additionally, we connect the growth of the subsystem asymmetry to the subsystem coherence and show that their growth is characterized by the same symmetrization scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、compute、ensemble average、theoretical framework。；研究对象：随机量子自动机（random quantum automaton）中的子系统纠缠不对称性（subsystem entanglement asymmetry），具体研究在希尔伯特空间基态置换和全局相位偏移生成的随机量子自动机系综中，不同连通性几何结构下的U(1)子系统不对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2-局域电路几何结构中，系综的晚期时间极限与全连接系综平均一致；与Haar随机电路不同，对称化发生的尺度依赖于初始状态，这一现象与参与熵守恒和电荷扇区的均匀探索之间的相互作用有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2-局域电路几何结构中，系综的晚期时间极限与全连接系综平均一致；与Haar随机电路不同，对称化发生的尺度依赖于初始状态，这一现象与参与熵守恒和电荷扇区的均匀探索之间的相互作用有关。；创新点：揭示了随机量子自动机中对称化尺度对初始状态的依赖性，这一特性与Haar随机电路形成鲜明对比，并将子系统不对称性的增长与子系统相干性联系起来，表明两者由相同的对称化尺度表征。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算随机量子自动机系综的系综平均，分析不同连通性几何结构（包括2-局域电路几何和全连接几何）下的U(1)子系统不对称性，并比较不同子系统尺寸下的对称化行为。

papers.title: Strain-tunable charge localization coupled to complex magnetic orders in EuAl$_4$
papers.abstract: Charge localization is particularly interesting when coupled to antiferromagnetic spin structures. Coupled spin-charge orders are well established in elemental chromium and correlated oxide superconductors, yet the interplay between charge order and more complex magnetic textures -- such as skyrmion lattices and chiral spin structures -- remains largely unexplored. Here we report a comprehensive study of how charge localization couples to the unusually rich sequence of magnetic phases in EuAl$_4$. Using x-ray diffraction under applied magnetic field and uniaxial pressure, we demonstrate a direct coupling between the charge and spin order parameters. In the absence of external stimuli, charge localization is markedly enhanced upon entering the magnetically ordered phases. Strikingly, this effect is highly susceptible to strain: uniaxial pressure applied along the charge-order propagation direction further enhances localization, whereas pressure applied perpendicular to it weakens it. Application of magnetic field reveals both competitive and possible collaborative interactions between spin and charge ordering.This flexible coupling between spin and charge ordering opens a new route to designing symmetry-breaking states. Chiral charge order may for example be patterned from spin structures with that symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“x-ray diffraction under applied magnetic field and uniaxial pressure”（X射线衍射实验，施加磁场和单轴压力）。；研究对象：EuAl₄ 单晶中电荷局域化与复杂磁有序（包括可能的天子格子和手性自旋结构）之间的耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 EuAl₄ 中，电荷局域化与丰富的磁有序相之间存在直接耦合，且这种耦合对单轴应变高度敏感：沿电荷序传播方向施加压力会增强电荷局域化，而垂直方向施加压力则削弱它；磁场可诱导自旋与电荷序之间的竞争或可能的协同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 EuAl₄ 中，电荷局域化与丰富的磁有序相之间存在直接耦合，且这种耦合对单轴应变高度敏感：沿电荷序传播方向施加压力会增强电荷局域化，而垂直方向施加压力则削弱它；磁场可诱导自旋与电荷序之间的竞争或可能的协同作用。；创新点：揭示了在具有复杂磁结构（如手性自旋结构）的材料中，电荷局域化与磁有序之间灵活可调的耦合关系，为设计具有对称性破缺的新奇态（如手性电荷序）提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 在施加磁场和单轴压力的条件下，使用 X 射线衍射（X-ray diffraction）直接探测电荷序与自旋序参量之间的耦合关系。

papers.title: Crossover and Changeover in Spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ Chain with Uniaxial Single-ion Anisotropy
papers.abstract: Recent advances in bond-directional spin chains have revealed extensive emergent phenomena and unconventional criticality. Here we investigate the spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy (SIA) using large-scale density-matrix renormalization group calculations and bosonization analysis. Tuning the SIA strength reveals a crossover from the Kitaev phase to the large-$D$ phase, evidenced by the excitation gap changing from quadratic to linear, the coexistence and smooth evolution of spin-nematic and string order parameters, and the suppression of the double-peak specific heat. For negative SIA, we uncover a changeover from a first-order transition to a continuous one between the dimerized and Haldane phases. The continuous transition belongs to the \textrm{SU(2)$_2$} Wess-Zumino-Witten universality class with central charge $c=3/2$, a rare instance in a system without continuous symmetry. Our results establish the Kitaev-$Γ$ chain as a minimal platform for controlling crossover and changeover phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group calculations（DMRG计算）、bosonization analysis（玻色化分析）。；研究对象：自旋为1的Kitaev-Γ链，并考虑单轴单离子各向异性（SIA）的量子自旋系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节单轴单离子各向异性强度，系统从Kitaev相到大-D相存在交叉（crossover），并在负SIA区域发现从一级相变到连续相变的转变（changeover），后者属于SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类，中心荷c=3/2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节单轴单离子各向异性强度，系统从Kitaev相到大-D相存在交叉（crossover），并在负SIA区域发现从一级相变到连续相变的转变（changeover），后者属于SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类，中心荷c=3/2。；创新点：在Kitaev-Γ链中系统揭示了单轴单离子各向异性驱动的交叉与转变现象，并首次在无连续对称性的系统中实现了中心荷c=3/2的SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类连续相变。
papers.method_zh: 大规模密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值计算，结合玻色化（bosonization）理论分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Hopfion for Frequency Multiplication
papers.abstract: Hopfions, associated with higher-dimensional topology through the Hopf fibration, exhibit {exotic} features like {complex knot} and improved stability compared to skyrmions, enhancing their appeal for innovative applications. In this paper, we study the nonlinear response of magnetic Hopfion to microwave fields. {We observe the emergence of higher-order harmonics of the driving microwave field as it interacts with the Hopfion}. By carefully selecting the {driving frequency, the corresponding harmonic can efficiently excite localized magnon state of a Hopfion. Our results demonstrate the promising potential of hopfions in nonlinear magnonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“研究非线性响应”“观察高阶谐波产生”，属于理论建模与数值模拟范畴。；研究对象：磁性Hopfion（磁霍普夫子）在微波场驱动下的非线性动力学行为，具体关注其频率倍增效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微波场与Hopfion相互作用可产生驱动频率的高阶谐波，通过选择特定驱动频率，相应谐波能高效激发Hopfion的局域磁振子态，展示了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微波场与Hopfion相互作用可产生驱动频率的高阶谐波，通过选择特定驱动频率，相应谐波能高效激发Hopfion的局域磁振子态，展示了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的应用潜力。；创新点：首次揭示磁性Hopfion在微波驱动下的非线性谐波产生机制，并利用谐波选择性激发其局域磁振子模式，拓展了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的功能应用。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如微磁学模拟或解析模型，仅提及“研究非线性响应”）。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian control of helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance
papers.abstract: We study non-Hermitian antiferromagnetic resonance in an antiferromagnetic insulator/nonmagnetic metal junction with sublattice-dependent damping and spin-orbit torque. By formulating the linearized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation as a 2x2 non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem, we derive the complex resonance frequencies, the exceptional-point condition, and the stability-threshold condition. We show that the largest absorption response is maximized by approaching the stability threshold from the stable side. Near the threshold on the stable side, the absorption spectrum exhibits strong enhancement and linewidth narrowing, together with pronounced helicity dependence in the sub-THz regime that can be switched by reversing the spin-orbit torque. We also confirm by solving the full LLG dynamics that crossing the threshold leads to gain and self-oscillation. These results identify the stability threshold as the key control principle for enhancing absorption and achieving polarization selectivity in the sub-THz/THz regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：formulating、derive、eigenvalue problem、solving the full LLG dynamics）；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体/非磁性金属异质结中的非厄米反铁磁共振现象，涉及子晶格依赖的阻尼和自旋轨道矩。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稳定阈值附近（稳定侧），吸收谱出现显著增强和线宽变窄，并表现出强烈的螺旋度选择性，该选择性可通过反转自旋轨道矩进行切换；越过阈值则导致增益和自激振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稳定阈值附近（稳定侧），吸收谱出现显著增强和线宽变窄，并表现出强烈的螺旋度选择性，该选择性可通过反转自旋轨道矩进行切换；越过阈值则导致增益和自激振荡。；创新点：将稳定性阈值识别为增强吸收和实现亚THz/THz波段偏振选择性的关键控制原理。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG)方程，将其构建为2×2非厄米本征值问题，推导复共振频率、奇异点条件和稳定性阈值条件，并通过求解完整LLG动力学进行验证。

papers.title: Stress calculation in linear scaling DFT: convergence and dynamics
papers.abstract: We present the approach needed to calculate stress within density functional theory (DFT) using a localised orbital basis, both for exact diagonalisation and linear scaling approaches, and demonstrate our implementation within the large scale DFT code Conquest. For the linear scaling approach, we test the rate of convergence of stress with density matrix range, and compare it to the convergence of energy and forces for different materials with a range of band gaps. We show that excellent convergence is found for modest cutoffs, and show that large-scale isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics is stable and accurate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、linear scaling approaches、localised orbital basis、molecular dynamics。；研究对象：论文研究在局域轨道基组下、使用线性标度DFT方法计算应力的技术，并测试了该方法在不同带隙材料中的收敛性与动力学稳定性。摘要未明确指定具体材料名称。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在线性标度DFT中，应力随密度矩阵截断半径的收敛性良好，在适中的截断半径下即可达到与能量和力相当的收敛精度；基于此方法的大规模等温等压分子动力学模拟稳定且准确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在线性标度DFT中，应力随密度矩阵截断半径的收敛性良好，在适中的截断半径下即可达到与能量和力相当的收敛精度；基于此方法的大规模等温等压分子动力学模拟稳定且准确。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论（DFT），分别使用精确对角化和线性标度方法计算应力；具体实现在大规模DFT代码Conquest中完成。通过测试应力随密度矩阵范围的收敛速率，并与能量和力的收敛性进行对比。

papers.title: A Multi-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Coupled Chemical, Spin, and Structural Disorder in Alloys
papers.abstract: Understanding the thermodynamic properties of disordered magnetic alloys requires a unified treatment of configurational (chemical, spin, etc.) and structural degrees of freedom, which has remained beyond the scope of existing computational frameworks. Here we present a general framework that integrates machine learning models (such as graph neural networks and machine learning interatomic potentials) and statistical sampling methods (such as Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations) to study the coupled chemical, spin, and structural disorder in alloys. We demonstrate the framework on body-centered-cubic Fe-Co alloys with interstitial carbon dopants, where the Fe-Co host exhibits intrinsic chemical and spin disorder, and the interstitial carbon introduces additional structural disorder through local lattice distortions, making the system a prototypical multi-disorder magnetic alloy. The framework predicts the order-to-disorder phase transition temperature and the melting temperature of Fe-Co alloy to be 1,000 K and 1,690 K, in excellent agreement with the experimentally measured values of 1,006 K and approximately 1,700 K, respectively. It also predicts the tetragonal-to-nearly-cubic structural transitions in Fe-Co-C alloy as temperature increases. These results establish the framework as a reliable tool for studying multi-disorder alloys, with applications to complex disordered systems such as high-entropy alloys, multiferroics, and spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning models, Monte Carlo, molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：多无序磁性合金，具体为体心立方Fe-Co合金及含间隙碳掺杂的Fe-Co-C合金，研究其化学、自旋与结构无序的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架成功预测了Fe-Co合金的有序-无序相变温度（1000 K）和熔化温度（1690 K），与实验值（1006 K和约1700 K）高度吻合；并预测了Fe-Co-C合金随温度升高发生的四方-近立方结构转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架成功预测了Fe-Co合金的有序-无序相变温度（1000 K）和熔化温度（1690 K），与实验值（1006 K和约1700 K）高度吻合；并预测了Fe-Co-C合金随温度升高发生的四方-近立方结构转变。；创新点：首次提出一个统一处理合金中化学、自旋与结构三种无序耦合的通用计算框架，突破了现有方法无法同时描述这些自由度的局限。
papers.method_zh: 集成机器学习模型（如图神经网络、机器学习原子间势）与统计采样方法（蒙特卡洛模拟、分子动力学模拟）的多尺度计算框架。

papers.title: Growth of (111)-textured SrTiO3 thin films on Pt(111)/Al2O3(1-102) substrates by rf magnetron sputter deposition
papers.abstract: SrTiO3 thin films, 20-30nm, with high quality crystal structure and low roughness can be used as growth templates for complex oxides or as the dielectric materials for capacitor structures. In this work, stoichiometric STO thin films were grown by radio frequency magnetron sputtering on Pt (111) templates grown on rAl2O3 substrates, and the effects of growth parameters as well as the underlying Pt templates structural properties on the quality of STO films were studied. A comparison between room temp grown Pt and Pt grown at elevated temps showed that the latter lead to highly ordered Pt and STO films with quasi 2D surface roughness. Xray diffraction showed that the STO thin films had (111) and (222) crystal orientation. A rocking curve full width at half maximum value of 0.2° was achieved, indicating that the STO films are high-quality. The STO films have a roughness less than 1 nm, as measured using atomic force microscopy, comparable to the underlying Pt templates roughness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜生长（rf magnetron sputter deposition）和表征（X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy）等实验过程。；研究对象：在Pt(111)/Al₂O₃(1-102)衬底上生长的SrTiO₃（STO）薄膜，具体研究其作为复杂氧化物生长模板或电容器介电材料的晶体质量和表面形貌。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过射频磁控溅射在高温生长的Pt(111)模板上制备的STO薄膜具有(111)择优取向、高结晶质量（摇摆曲线半高宽0.2°）和极低表面粗糙度（<1 nm）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过射频磁控溅射在高温生长的Pt(111)模板上制备的STO薄膜具有(111)择优取向、高结晶质量（摇摆曲线半高宽0.2°）和极低表面粗糙度（<1 nm）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 射频磁控溅射（rf magnetron sputter deposition）生长薄膜；X射线衍射（XRD）分析晶体取向和结晶质量；原子力显微镜（AFM）测量表面粗糙度；对比室温与高温生长Pt模板对STO薄膜质量的影响。

papers.title: Hyperuniform systems are maximally irreversible
papers.abstract: Hyperuniform systems, defined by the anomalous suppression of large-scale density fluctuations, are a paradigm of non-equilibrium self-assembly. While mechanisms underlying the self-assembly of hyperuniform states have been widely studied, the energetics of this process remain unexplored. This raises a fundamental question: what is the energetic cost of self-assembling a hyperuniform system? Here, we address this question across several noisy particle systems drawn from soft matter and machine learning, in which hyperuniformity can be induced by tuning noise correlations. Despite their distinct microscopic dynamics, we uncover a universal behavior across all systems: hyperuniform states are maximally irreversible, as quantified by the entropy production rate. Further, we develop a path integral formulation of the entropy production rate directly from the microscopic dynamics, which explains our observations. Our work establishes a direct link between emergent long-range structure and time irreversibility and opens a new avenue of probing the energetic cost of hyperuniform self-assembly, ubiquitous across physics, biology, and materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：path integral formulation、entropy production rate、noisy particle systems、machine learning）；研究对象：超均匀系统（hyperuniform systems）在非平衡自组装过程中的不可逆性与能量代价，涉及软物质和机器学习中的噪声粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超均匀态在所有研究的噪声粒子系统中均表现出最大不可逆性，其熵产生率（entropy production rate）达到极大值，从而建立了长程结构与时间不可逆性之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超均匀态在所有研究的噪声粒子系统中均表现出最大不可逆性，其熵产生率（entropy production rate）达到极大值，从而建立了长程结构与时间不可逆性之间的直接联系。；创新点：首次揭示了超均匀自组装过程中的能量代价（熵产生率最大化），并建立了超均匀性与时间不可逆性之间的普适关联，为理解物理、生物和材料科学中广泛存在的超均匀自组装提供了热力学视角。
papers.method_zh: 通过调节噪声关联（noise correlations）诱导超均匀性，并利用路径积分（path integral）方法从微观动力学直接推导熵产生率，对多个软物质和机器学习中的噪声粒子系统进行统一分析。

papers.title: Optimizing high-temperature electron mobility in single-crystal Bi$_2$O$_2$Se based on its unconventional dependence on concentration
papers.abstract: Quasi-2D Bi$_2$O$_2$Se is part of an intensive materials research effort aimed at finding new semiconductors that outperform silicon-based electronics in terms of speed and power consumption. This material exhibits exceptionally high carrier mobility at low temperatures but mediocre mobility at 300 K. Its high mobility is generally associated with its high permittivity ($\varepsilon_r$~500), which is also associated with metallicity persisting down to very low carrier concentrations. This material exhibits a counterintuitive increase in carrier mobility as the concentration increases. The connection between low both carrier concentration and mobility in Se-rich conditions, and both high carrier concentration and mobility in Se-poor conditions suggests that the increase is related to native defects. We demonstrate that these defects can alter the effective mass of charge carriers. Specifically, substitutional Se(Bi) defects, which appear under Se-rich conditions, destroy the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel and compromise charge transport properties. These defects increase the effective mass of charge carriers transforming the original semiconductor into a semimetal and introducing holes into charge transport. Additionally, we show that single crystals are generally inhomogeneous, particularly those grown under Se-rich conditions. Unlike Se-poor conditions, Se-rich conditions induce a higher concentration of dislocations and extraneous phases. These findings suggest that the perfection of the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel is crucial for mobility, particularly at room temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：single-crystal、carrier mobility、native defects、dislocations、extraneous phases）；研究对象：准二维半导体单晶Bi₂O₂Se，重点研究其高温（300 K）电子迁移率与载流子浓度的反常依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi₂O₂Se的载流子迁移率随浓度增加而反常升高，这一现象源于本征缺陷（特别是Se(Bi)替位缺陷）对有效质量的调控：富Se条件下形成的替位缺陷破坏Bi₂O₂通道，增大有效质量并引入空穴，导致迁移率降低；而贫Se条件下缺陷较少，通道更完整，迁移率更高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi₂O₂Se的载流子迁移率随浓度增加而反常升高，这一现象源于本征缺陷（特别是Se(Bi)替位缺陷）对有效质量的调控：富Se条件下形成的替位缺陷破坏Bi₂O₂通道，增大有效质量并引入空穴，导致迁移率降低；而贫Se条件下缺陷较少，通道更完整，迁移率更高。；创新点：揭示了Bi₂O₂Se中迁移率随浓度反常升高的微观机制——本征缺陷（Se(Bi)替位）通过改变有效质量调控输运，并指出单晶均匀性（特别是Bi₂O₂通道的完整性）是决定室温迁移率的关键因素。
papers.method_zh: 通过对比富Se与贫Se条件下生长的单晶样品，分析载流子浓度、迁移率、有效质量的变化，并结合缺陷类型（替位缺陷、位错、杂相）的表征，揭示缺陷对输运性质的影响。

papers.title: Quantitative DFT+DMFT description of spectra and transport in the moderately correlated metal SrVO$_3$
papers.abstract: A quantitative, material-specific account of spectral and transport properties remains a central challenge in the theory of strongly correlated materials. Combining density functional theory with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) has proven to be a powerful approach for treating electron correlation effects and material specificity on an equal footing. Here, we examine the single-particle spectra and the dc and optical conductivity of SrVO$_3$, a prototypical, moderately correlated metal, within this framework. The degenerate $t_{2g}$ active space of SrVO$_3$, together with its well-established Fermi-liquid behavior, admits an effective-mass description governed by a single quasiparticle weight, yielding a nearly universal picture of the low-frequency, low-temperature regime. Employing a computationally efficient, real-frequency multi-orbital iterative perturbation theory (MO-IPT) impurity solver, we find reasonable agreement with experimental measurements of dc resistivity and optical conductivity across the entire experimentally relevant $(ω, T)$ range within a single, unified scheme. The agreement is shown to not depend on specific interaction parameters provided the quasiparticle weight is kept constant. These results indicate that, in SrVO$_3$, the $\mathbf{k}$-dependence of the self-energy may be weak, and vertex corrections may not dominate the dc and optical transport in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT+DMFT、MO-IPT impurity solver、理论计算与实验对比）；研究对象：中等关联金属SrVO₃的单粒子谱、直流电导率和光学电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持准粒子权重不变的条件下，DFT+DMFT结合MO-IPT杂质求解器能在整个实验相关的（ω, T）范围内统一描述SrVO₃的输运性质，且结果不依赖于具体相互作用参数；暗示该材料中自能的k依赖性和顶点修正可能较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持准粒子权重不变的条件下，DFT+DMFT结合MO-IPT杂质求解器能在整个实验相关的（ω, T）范围内统一描述SrVO₃的输运性质，且结果不依赖于具体相互作用参数；暗示该材料中自能的k依赖性和顶点修正可能较弱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场（DFT+DMFT），采用实频多轨道迭代微扰论（MO-IPT）杂质求解器。

papers.title: Force-Isosurface Simulations Probe the Limits of High-Resolution AFM on Three-Dimensional Molecules
papers.abstract: High-resolution atomic force microscopy has transformed molecular imaging by revealing intramolecular structure directly in real space. A major remaining challenge is to extend this capability from largely planar molecules to non-planar molecular systems, where the most important structural information may be distributed across different heights above the surface. Here we use probe-particle-model simulations to predict the constant-force contours expected above molecules with increasing structural complexity. By extracting force isosurfaces from simulated three-dimensional force fields, we compare the molecular information retained in constant-height and constant-force images. For tilted benzene and pyrrole, constant-force images preserve the molecular framework across a range of adsorption angles and allow the molecular orientation to be recovered quantitatively. For larger non-planar and three-dimensional systems, simulations identify characteristic force-isosurface contrast associated with adsorption geometry, lower-lying molecular structure and curved molecular surfaces. These results provide target contrasts for force isosurfaces that could be extracted from three-dimensional force-mapping experiments, evaluating the molecular information retained by ideal force-isosurface imaging across progressively non-planar systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：probe-particle-model simulations、simulated three-dimensional force fields、force isosurfaces。；研究对象：非平面分子体系（如倾斜的苯、吡咯）以及更大尺寸的非平面和三维分子系统，研究高分辨率原子力显微镜（AFM）在三维分子成像中的极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于非平面分子，恒力（force-isosurface）成像相比恒高成像能更好地保留分子骨架信息，并允许定量恢复分子取向；对于更复杂的三维系统，模拟识别出与吸附几何、低层分子结构和弯曲分子表面相关的特征力等值面对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于非平面分子，恒力（force-isosurface）成像相比恒高成像能更好地保留分子骨架信息，并允许定量恢复分子取向；对于更复杂的三维系统，模拟识别出与吸附几何、低层分子结构和弯曲分子表面相关的特征力等值面对比度。；创新点：系统评估了从三维力映射实验中提取的力等值面在逐步非平面分子体系中的成像能力，为理想力等值面成像保留了哪些分子信息提供了目标对比度。摘要未突出说明与已有模拟或实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 使用探针-粒子模型模拟（probe-particle-model simulations），从模拟的三维力场中提取力等值面（force isosurfaces），并比较恒高（constant-height）与恒力（constant-force）成像所保留的分子信息。

papers.title: Competing ferroelectric and smectic order: modulated structures through molecular design
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the balance between polar and positional order can be systematically tuned through molecular engineering, providing direct control over the emergence of polar and modulated liquid-crystalline phases, allowing for versatile strategy for the design of functional ferroelectric soft materials. We show that polar orthogonal smectic phases (SmAF and SmAAF), promoted by the self-segregation of aromatic cores and sufficiently long terminal chains, are readily destabilized by strong longitudinal dipolar interactions that energetically penalize parallel alignment of molecular dipoles within a smectic layer. In contrast, the tilted ferroelectric SmCF phase is remarkably robust across the entire homologous series, indicating that molecular tilt efficiently relieves dipolar frustration within the smectic layers. We further demonstrate that the interplay between microsegregation and electrostatic interactions stabilizes the new modulated SmCM phase, characterized by incommensurate electron-density waves, particularly for compounds with short terminal chains. For longer homologs controlling the spatial distribution of fluorinated molecular fragments and terminal-chain length enabled the targeted formation of broken-layer-type modulated polar phases (2D or 3D).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：molecular engineering, homologous series, compounds, targeted formation）；研究对象：铁电性与近晶相（层状液晶相）相互竞争的液晶体系，具体通过分子工程调控极性（铁电）与位置（层状）有序之间的平衡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子设计（调整末端链长、氟化片段分布等）可以系统性地调控极性液晶相与调制结构的稳定性，其中倾斜铁电相（SmCF）非常稳定，而正交相（SmAF/SmAAF）易被强纵向偶极相互作用去稳定化；此外，微相分离与静电相互作用的竞争稳定了一种新的非公度调制相（SmCM）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子设计（调整末端链长、氟化片段分布等）可以系统性地调控极性液晶相与调制结构的稳定性，其中倾斜铁电相（SmCF）非常稳定，而正交相（SmAF/SmAAF）易被强纵向偶极相互作用去稳定化；此外，微相分离与静电相互作用的竞争稳定了一种新的非公度调制相（SmCM）。；创新点：揭示了通过分子工程（特别是调控末端链长和氟化片段空间分布）来直接控制极性液晶相和调制结构（包括一种新的非公度SmCM相）形成的通用策略，为设计功能性铁电软材料提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 分子工程（合成不同末端链长和氟化片段分布的系列化合物），结合结构表征（推测为X射线衍射等，摘要未明确说明具体表征手段）以确定液晶相结构（SmAF, SmAAF, SmCF, SmCM, 2D/3D调制相）。

papers.title: Ab Initio Investigation of Pressure Effects in the Spin-Liquid Candidate Y-Kapellasite
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experiments showing pressure-induced suppression of magnetic order and the emergence of a dynamical ground state in the anisotropic kagome antiferromagnet Y-kapellasite Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8, we perform ab initio density functional theory (DFT)calculations to investigate the evolution of magnetic exchange interactions under hydrostatic pressure. We show that pressure efficiently tunes the magnetic Hamiltonian by altering the CuOCu bond geometry, thereby driving the system towards a spin-liquid regime. This evolution is governed by a nonlinear dependence of the dominant exchange coupling on the CuOCu bond angle. We further examine the influence of hydrogen positions and find that both the OH bond length and the hydrogen out-of-plane angle strongly affect the magnetic interactions. Our results provide a microscopic explanation for the experimentally observed pressure-induced enhancement of frustration and highlight the key role of hydrogen geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio density functional theory (DFT) calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是Y-kapellasite（Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈），一种各向异性kagome反铁磁体，在压力下可能成为自旋液体候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力通过改变Cu-O-Cu键几何结构，非线性地调控主导磁交换耦合，从而增强磁阻挫，驱动体系进入自旋液体态。氢原子的位置（O-H键长和面外角）对磁相互作用有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力通过改变Cu-O-Cu键几何结构，非线性地调控主导磁交换耦合，从而增强磁阻挫，驱动体系进入自旋液体态。氢原子的位置（O-H键长和面外角）对磁相互作用有显著影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，研究静水压力下磁交换相互作用的演化。

papers.title: Machine Learning Materials Properties by Encoding Orbital-Projected Density of States
papers.abstract: Graph neural networks have become the dominant machine-learning architecture for predicting materials properties from crystal structures. Yet the initialization of atomic node features has received comparatively little attention, and conventional approaches rely on static elemental descriptors that carry no information about the quantum-mechanical electronic environment of each atom in its crystalline host. Here we show that augmenting atomic node representations with site-projected orbital density of states (pDOS) fingerprints, computed directly from density functional theory calculations, yields systematic and substantial improvements in predictive performance.These representations are fused with Pettifor elemental embeddings at each atomic site before message passing. For the superconducting critical temperature $T_c$ and the optical dielectric constant $ε_{\infty}$,the pDOS augmentation reduces prediction errors by 22.9% and 27.9%, respectively, relative to the elemental-descriptor baseline. These improvements are comparable to those achieved by doubling the training-set size. The gains are, however, contingent on training-set size. For the magnetic exchange energies of Heusler compounds, a substantially smaller dataset, the improvement is reduced,indicating that pDOS augmentation is most effective when the training data exceeds the length of the pDOS feature vector. We introduce an interpretable spectral attention-gating mechanism that reveals that the model autonomously learns to prioritize the orbital channels and energy windows most physically relevant to each target property. These results establish pDOS-augmented graph nodes as a broadly applicable strategy for infusing first-principles electronic-structure knowledge into graph networks, opening a practical route to high-accuracy property prediction in data-scarce regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：graph neural networks、density functional theory calculations、machine-learning architecture。；研究对象：材料性质预测，具体包括超导临界温度 \(T_c\)、光学介电常数 \(\varepsilon_{\infty}\) 以及 Heusler 化合物的磁交换能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于密度泛函理论计算的轨道投影态密度（pDOS）指纹作为原子节点特征的增强，可系统性地提升图神经网络对材料性质的预测性能，使超导临界温度和光学介电常数的预测误差分别降低 22.9% 和 27.9%，效果接近将训练集规模翻倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于密度泛函理论计算的轨道投影态密度（pDOS）指纹作为原子节点特征的增强，可系统性地提升图神经网络对材料性质的预测性能，使超导临界温度和光学介电常数的预测误差分别降低 22.9% 和 27.9%，效果接近将训练集规模翻倍。；创新点：首次系统性地将轨道投影态密度（pDOS）作为原子节点特征引入图神经网络，替代传统的静态元素描述符，并证明该方法在数据充足时能显著提升预测精度，同时引入可解释性机制揭示模型自动学习与目标性质最相关的轨道通道和能量窗口。
papers.method_zh: 采用图神经网络（GNN）架构，在原子节点特征中融合从 DFT 计算得到的 site-projected orbital density of states（pDOS）指纹与 Pettifor 元素嵌入，并通过可解释的谱注意力门控机制分析模型学习到的物理相关性。

papers.title: Spin-polarized electron transport for the altermagnet CrSb
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate spin-polarized electron transport for the centrosymmetric altermagnet CrSb, which is known to reveal both altermagnetic and topological features. We demonstrate pronounced first-harmonic anomalous and second-harmonic non-linear Hall effects for a single-crystal CrSb flake with ferromagnetic nickel contacts, while both effects can not be seen for the reference samples with non-magnetic gold ones. For the anomalous Hall effect, we demonstrate bow-tie hysteresis loop in Hall voltage, which is usually ascribed to surface spin textures in magnetic materials. The slope of the Hall curve changes a sign for two orientations of the Hall-bar contact configuration for the same sample, i.e. for the same sign of the charge carriers. We interpret the observed sign inversion and bow-tie hysteresis as the joint effect of the alternating bulk spin splitting and spin-polarized topological surface states in CrSb. The pronounced non-linear Hall effect with hysteresis in magnetic field confirms finite Berry curvature dipole under injection of spin-polarized electrons, i.e. the topological features for the altermagnetic candidate CrSb.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally investigate”“demonstrate”“measurements”等关键词，涉及实际样品制备与电输运测量。；研究对象：中心对称交变磁体CrSb单晶薄片，具体研究其自旋极化电子输运行为，包括反常霍尔效应和非线性霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CrSb单晶薄片与铁磁性镍接触的器件中观测到显著的一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应，而在非磁性金接触的参考样品中未观察到。反常霍尔电压呈现蝴蝶形磁滞回线，且霍尔曲线斜率随霍尔条接触构型方向改变而反转符号，该现象被解释为体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CrSb单晶薄片与铁磁性镍接触的器件中观测到显著的一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应，而在非磁性金接触的参考样品中未观察到。反常霍尔电压呈现蝴蝶形磁滞回线，且霍尔曲线斜率随霍尔条接触构型方向改变而反转符号，该现象被解释为体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合效应。；创新点：首次在交变磁体CrSb中通过自旋极化电子注入实验观测到反常霍尔效应的符号反转和蝴蝶形磁滞回线，并证实有限贝里曲率偶极矩的存在，揭示了交变磁性与拓扑表面态的协同输运特征。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：制备单晶CrSb薄片，分别制作铁磁性镍（Ni）接触和非磁性金（Au）接触的霍尔条器件；测量一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应，分析霍尔电压随磁场的变化行为。

papers.title: Magnetotransport Properties of Iron-Based Ladder Compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under High Pressure
papers.abstract: The magnetotransport properties of the iron-based ladder compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under various pressures were investigated. BaFe2S3 had a T^2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a normal magnetoresistance near an insulator-metal transition. Therefore, it had Fermi-liquid-like properties in the normal phase. However, BaFe2Se3 had a T^3/2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a negative magnetoresistance. This suggested that BaFe2Se3 had non-Fermi-liquid properties near the insulator-metal transition. For both materials, the Hall resistivities indicated a hole-dominant magnetic field dependence. During a pressure-induced insulator-metal transition, BaFe2Se3 had a rapid decrease in electrical resistivity above 15 GPa attributed to an isomorphic structural transition previously reported in X-ray diffraction experiments. This transition had a strong impact on the electronic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magnetotransport properties（磁输运性质）、electrical resistivity（电阻率）、Hall resistivity（霍尔电阻率）、high pressure（高压）。；研究对象：铁基梯状化合物 BaFe₂S₃ 和 BaFe₂Se₃ 在高压下的磁输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BaFe₂S₃ 在绝缘体-金属转变附近表现出费米液体行为（电阻率 T² 依赖、正常磁电阻），而 BaFe₂Se₃ 则表现出非费米液体行为（电阻率 T³/² 依赖、负磁电阻）。此外，BaFe₂Se₃ 在 15 GPa 以上电阻率急剧下降，归因于此前 X 射线衍射实验报道的同构结构相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BaFe₂S₃ 在绝缘体-金属转变附近表现出费米液体行为（电阻率 T² 依赖、正常磁电阻），而 BaFe₂Se₃ 则表现出非费米液体行为（电阻率 T³/² 依赖、负磁电阻）。此外，BaFe₂Se₃ 在 15 GPa 以上电阻率急剧下降，归因于此前 X 射线衍射实验报道的同构结构相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高压下的电阻率测量、磁电阻测量、霍尔电阻率测量。

papers.title: Taming nonlinear energy diffusion: The case of time-crystal energy condensates
papers.abstract: We study a bulk-driven nonlinear variant of the Kipnis-Marchioro-Presutti model of stochastic energy diffusion in which local collisions are biased to induce a net energy flow, resembling the effect of an external field. Starting from the microscopic master equation, we derive the hydrodynamic description of the driven system via a local equilibrium approximation, obtaining explicit expressions for the energy current and the associated diffusivity and mobility transport coefficients, which are nonlinear functions of the local energy density. We test our findings in kinetic Monte Carlo simulations of the model and, as a proof of concept, we demonstrate the versatility of this driving mechanism to control nonlinear energy transport by inducing time-crystalline phases. In particular, we show that appropriately designed packing fields induce the spontaneous formation of traveling energy condensates, exhibiting robust long-range temporal order reminiscent of continuous time crystals. Our results provide a simple yet powerful framework to study bulk-driven nonlinear energy diffusion in stochastic many-body systems, offering a bridge between microscopic dynamics, macroscopic transport, and controlled spatiotemporal order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：推导了流体力学描述（理论），并进行了动力学蒙特卡洛模拟（计算）。；研究对象：受体驱动非线性Kipnis-Marchioro-Presutti（KMP）模型中的能量扩散过程，以及由此产生的连续时间晶体相（时间晶体能量凝聚体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计合适的“打包场”（packing fields），可以在受驱动的非线性KMP模型中诱导出自发形成的行波能量凝聚体，这些凝聚体展现出类似于连续时间晶体的鲁棒长程时间序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计合适的“打包场”（packing fields），可以在受驱动的非线性KMP模型中诱导出自发形成的行波能量凝聚体，这些凝聚体展现出类似于连续时间晶体的鲁棒长程时间序。；创新点：提出了一种通过体驱动（而非边界驱动）控制非线性能量输运的简单而通用的机制，并首次在该随机多体系统中实现了时间晶体能量凝聚体的可控形成，建立了微观动力学、宏观输运与可控时空序之间的桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 从微观主方程出发，采用局域平衡近似推导了受驱动系统的流体力学描述，得到了能量流、扩散率和迁移率等输运系数的显式表达式（理论框架）；并通过动力学蒙特卡洛模拟对理论结果进行了验证（计算方法）。

papers.title: Perspectives on inverse design for AI magnonics
papers.abstract: Inverse design - specifying a desired functionality and letting a computational algorithm find the optimal structure - has emerged as a powerful paradigm for magnonic device engineering. In this article, we survey the rapidly growing field of inverse-design magnonics, organising it along two axes: the design variables (topology, material parameters, and magnetic field landscape) and the algorithmic toolbox (gradient-free, gradient-based, and neural-network-based methods) together with the differentiable micromagnetic solvers that enable them. We then identify open frontiers that we consider most promising for the next phase of the field: sensitivity analysis and robust design to bridge the gap between simulation and experiment; input shaping and transducer optimisation; the incorporation of nonlinear spin-wave effects as an explicit design resource; spatially structured amplification; self-adapting media and machine-learning-based design; and the long-term vision of a universal, reconfigurable magnonic platform. We argue that magnonics and artificial intelligence are converging from two directions - machine-learning tools for designing magnonic devices, and magnonic devices as hardware for neuromorphic computation - and propose the term AI magnonics to describe this emerging paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。关键词：survey（综述）、inverse design（逆设计）、algorithmic toolbox（算法工具箱）、differentiable micromagnetic solvers（可微分微磁求解器）。；研究对象：磁子学器件（magnonic devices），具体涉及拓扑结构、材料参数、磁场分布等设计变量，以及自旋波（spin-wave）的非线性效应、空间结构放大、自适应介质等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 逆设计（通过指定功能由算法自动寻找最优结构）已成为磁子学器件工程的有力范式；磁子学与人工智能正从两个方向融合——用机器学习工具设计磁子器件，以及用磁子器件作为神经形态计算的硬件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：逆设计（通过指定功能由算法自动寻找最优结构）已成为磁子学器件工程的有力范式；磁子学与人工智能正从两个方向融合——用机器学习工具设计磁子器件，以及用磁子器件作为神经形态计算的硬件。；创新点：提出了“AI magnonics”（人工智能磁子学）这一新兴范式，并系统梳理了该领域的前沿方向：灵敏度分析与鲁棒设计、输入整形与换能器优化、非线性自旋波效应作为设计资源、空间结构放大、自适应介质与机器学习设计、以及通用可重构磁子平台的长期愿景。
papers.method_zh: 综述了逆设计磁子学的两类工具：设计变量（拓扑、材料参数、磁场分布）和算法工具箱（无梯度方法、基于梯度的方法、基于神经网络的方法），并提及可微分微磁求解器作为使能技术。

papers.title: Thermodynamic description of worldwide distribution of energy and carbon emission
papers.abstract: Based on public data, we analyze the distributions of energy and carbon emission over world countries on a scale of the last 40-50 years using their presentation via Lorenz and Pareto curves. These curves in rescaled format remain remarkably stable on this time period being characterized by high values of the Gini coefficient indicating a strong inequality of energy distribution. To explain these distributions, we introduce the ENergy Thermalization Hypothesis (ENTH) according to which these distributions result from the Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation of agents representing different countries. We show that this hypothesis provides an excellent description of Lorenz and Pareto curves obtained from data on the above time period. It also gives natural grounds for inequality relating it to the RJ condensation at low energy states. We additionally trace parallels with the wealth inequality in the world.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：ENergy Thermalization Hypothesis (ENTH)、Rayleigh-Jeans thermalization、理论模型解释数据。；研究对象：全球各国能源消耗与碳排放的分布规律，以及其与热力学中瑞利-金斯热化及凝聚过程的类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全球能源与碳排放分布可用瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚过程精确描述，该机制自然解释了分布的高度不平等性（高基尼系数），并将其与低能态的凝聚联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全球能源与碳排放分布可用瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚过程精确描述，该机制自然解释了分布的高度不平等性（高基尼系数），并将其与低能态的凝聚联系起来。；创新点：将全球能源分布的不平等性归因于瑞利-金斯热化与低能态凝聚过程，为能源与碳排放分布提供了热力学层面的理论解释，并类比了财富不平等现象。
papers.method_zh: 基于公开数据，使用洛伦兹曲线和帕累托曲线对过去40-50年全球各国能源与碳排放分布进行统计分析，并引入“能量热化假说”（ENTH）进行理论建模。

papers.title: Pressure-induced PT Symmetry Breaking in LaMnSi
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetotransport properties of the antiferromagnetic metal LaMnSi, in which the collinear magnetic order breaks both spatial inversion (P) and time-reversal (T) symmetry yet preserves their combined PT symmetry. High pressure is found to suppress this PT-symmetric antiferromagnetic phase, inducing a transition into a PT-broken state characterized by a large anomalous Hall effect. Based on symmetry analysis, we propose a candidate magnetic structure for the high-pressure phase. Subsequent band calculations for this structure reveal the emergence of band splitting and orbital-dependent spin polarization. Our results establish LaMnSi as an ideal platform for controlling PT symmetry breaking via external parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“磁输运性质测量”（实验）、“对称性分析”和“能带计算”（计算）。；研究对象：反铁磁金属LaMnSi，具体研究其共线磁有序破坏空间反演（P）和时间反演（T）对称性但保持PT联合对称性的相，以及压力诱导的PT对称性破缺相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高压可抑制LaMnSi的PT对称反铁磁相，诱导进入PT破缺态，该态表现出巨大的反常霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高压可抑制LaMnSi的PT对称反铁磁相，诱导进入PT破缺态，该态表现出巨大的反常霍尔效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁输运性质测量（实验手段）；对称性分析（理论框架）；能带计算（计算方法，摘要未明确具体计算级别如DFT+U等）。

papers.title: Magnetocaloric properties of centered molecular quantum spin systems
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetocaloric properties of a class of centered magnetic molecules that are very similar in their magnetic properties.
