In particular, we study the magnetocaloric response of these molecules in the space of two exchange parameters and as function of the spin quantum numbers. Major figures of merit such as adiabatic temperature change and isothermal entropy change as well as theoretically achievable low temperatures show that overall ferromagnetic interactions are preferential as long as this does not lead to dipolar ordering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、magnetocaloric properties、theoretically achievable。；研究对象：一类中心型分子量子自旋系统（centered molecular quantum spin systems），其磁性性质非常相似。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交换参数空间和自旋量子数变化下，只要不导致偶极有序，总体上的铁磁相互作用对磁热效应更有利，表现为更大的绝热温度变化、等温熵变以及理论上可达到的更低温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交换参数空间和自旋量子数变化下，只要不导致偶极有序，总体上的铁磁相互作用对磁热效应更有利，表现为更大的绝热温度变化、等温熵变以及理论上可达到的更低温度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论分析，在交换参数空间和自旋量子数函数下，计算磁热效应的主要性能指标（绝热温度变化、等温熵变、理论可达到的最低温度）。

papers.title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via proximitized Dirac semimetal
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, which combine antiferromagnetic-like magnetic compensation with ferromagnetic-like broken time-reversal symmetry, hold great promise for high-density and ultrafast spintronic applications. However, the detection and switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order are fundamentally constrained by magnetic symmetry, restricting both fundamental studies and practical implementation. We realize robust electrical reading and deterministic switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order by designing a Dirac semimetal/altermagnet heterostructure of PtTe2/CrSb. This engineered interface enables anomalous Hall readout via altermagnetic proximity effect and delivers efficient spin-orbit torque for manipulating the epitaxial perpendicular Neel vector in CrSb. These findings significantly broaden the functional scope of altermagnetic heterostructures and pave the way for highly scalable altermagnetic memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：realize、designing、enables、delivers。；研究对象：Dirac半金属/交变磁体异质结（PtTe₂/CrSb），具体研究垂直取向的交变磁有序的电学操控与探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计PtTe₂/CrSb异质结，实现了对CrSb中垂直取向交变磁有序（Néel矢量）的鲁棒电学读取和确定性翻转，为可扩展的交变磁存储器件铺平了道路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计PtTe₂/CrSb异质结，实现了对CrSb中垂直取向交变磁有序（Néel矢量）的鲁棒电学读取和确定性翻转，为可扩展的交变磁存储器件铺平了道路。；创新点：首次通过Dirac半金属/交变磁体异质结设计，克服了垂直交变磁有序在磁对称性上的探测与翻转限制，实现了其电学读取和确定性切换。
papers.method_zh: 利用交变磁邻近效应实现反常霍尔读出，并通过自旋轨道矩（spin-orbit torque）对CrSb外延垂直Néel矢量进行电学操控。具体材料体系为PtTe₂/CrSb异质结。

papers.title: A Topotactic Phase Transition in the Uranium Oxide System
papers.abstract: A topotactic phase transition involves the transformation of one crystalline solid to another, which may include the loss or gain of material, where the orientation of the parent crystal determines the orientation of the daughter. We set out an experimental approach, based on polyepitaxial thin film deposition, where the precise transformation mechanism in important physico-chemical processes can be revealed in brilliant detail. Here, we find a reversible topotactic transition from (001) cubic UO2 to a (130) orthorhombic U3O8 structure; a >35% expansion/contraction. This remarkable result solves a puzzle that has eluded researchers for decades, and presents a method for determining the mechanism of crystallographic transformation in many other compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：polyepitaxial thin film deposition（多晶外延薄膜沉积）、experimental approach。；研究对象：铀氧化物体系中的拓扑相变，具体为从立方相UO₂到正交相U₃O₈的结构转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种可逆的拓扑相变：从(001)取向的立方UO₂转变为(130)取向的正交U₃O₈结构，伴随超过35%的体积膨胀/收缩，解决了困扰研究者数十年的晶体学转变机制谜题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种可逆的拓扑相变：从(001)取向的立方UO₂转变为(130)取向的正交U₃O₈结构，伴随超过35%的体积膨胀/收缩，解决了困扰研究者数十年的晶体学转变机制谜题。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于多晶外延薄膜沉积的实验方法，通过控制薄膜取向来揭示相变过程中母相与子相之间的晶体取向关系。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization of Genetic Algorithm Hyperparameters in a Multi-Fidelity Framework for Efficient Lattice Material Design
papers.abstract: This study presents a multi-fidelity framework for the systematic optimization of genetic algorithm (GA) hyperparameters. The framework integrates three fidelity levels: high-fidelity Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) homogenization for validation, a medium-fidelity 3D convolutional neural network surrogate for rapid property evaluation, and a low-fidelity Gaussian process (GP) surrogate within a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework to guide the hyperparameter search. Various acquisition functions are evaluated, with logNEI achieving the best performance by effectively accounting for the noise inherent in GA evaluations. The proposed framework identifies hyperparameter configurations that enable a 25-generation GA run to achieve elastic modulus values comparable to those obtained in a full 75-generation optimization. Furthermore, introducing a penalized BO objective significantly reduces the number of required lattices with only minor decreases in absolute achieved elastic modulus, revealing a practical trade-off between performance and the number of structures that must be evaluated. High-fidelity FFT validation verifies the effectiveness of the surrogate-driven optimization strategy. The optimized hyperparameters allow for rapid convergence, eliminate the need for lattice mutation, and reduce the overall computational cost by 24% (from 225 to 171 hours) while preserving mechanical performance. These results demonstrate the potential of multi-fidelity optimization as an efficient and practical approach for GA hyperparameter tuning and future experimental lattice design studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：多保真度框架、遗传算法超参数优化、贝叶斯优化、FFT均匀化、卷积神经网络代理模型。；研究对象：晶格材料（lattice material）的设计与优化，具体关注其弹性模量性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多保真度框架优化遗传算法超参数，可使25代遗传算法运行达到与完整75代优化相当的弹性模量值，同时将计算成本降低24%（从225小时降至171小时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多保真度框架优化遗传算法超参数，可使25代遗传算法运行达到与完整75代优化相当的弹性模量值，同时将计算成本降低24%（从225小时降至171小时）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三保真度框架：高保真度使用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）均匀化进行验证；中保真度使用3D卷积神经网络代理模型进行快速性能评估；低保真度使用高斯过程（GP）代理模型，并在贝叶斯优化（BO）框架内引导超参数搜索。评估了多种采集函数，其中logNEI表现最佳。

papers.title: Improving feature resolution and pore back effect in focused ion beam tomography of porous GaN thin films
papers.abstract: Porous gallium nitride (GaN) is a mesoporous crystalline material, typically in the form of a thin film on an unlike substrate, prepared by electrochemically etching conductive GaN. The use of porous GaN in electronics and optoelectronics is rapidly expanding, but is held back significantly by a lack of structural control and understanding of the principles of pore formation from underlying electrochemical mechanisms, where high-quality characterisation of pore morphology is essential to understanding these principles. Focused ion beam (FIB) tomography is an invaluable tool for such characterisation, but is hindered greatly by the pore back effect, where unwanted contrast appears in an image due to electrons scattering out from the back wall of a pore. No major attempts to formally quantify or assess the extent of the effect for different tomography experiments has been demonstrated. In this work, we demonstrate an advanced methodology for performing FIB tomography on porous GaN thin films, where the experiment is rotated to image pores perpendicular to the surface of the sample, and introduce new voxel intensity-based formalisms for assessing the impact of the pore back effect based on voxel intensities for individual features and the whole dataset. The new approach, which requires more complex preliminary setup, is found to significantly mitigate the pore back effect in porous GaN thin films with a range of pore morphologies without increasing the total experimental duration. The pore back effect can thus be quantified and mitigated in FIB tomography of porous GaN and similar mesoporous thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：FIB tomography（聚焦离子束断层扫描）、electrochemical etching（电化学刻蚀）、voxel intensity-based formalisms（基于体素强度的形式化方法）。；研究对象：多孔氮化镓（porous GaN）薄膜，具体为通过电化学刻蚀导电GaN制备的介孔晶体薄膜，以及其孔隙形态的表征问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将实验旋转至垂直于样品表面成像孔隙，并引入基于体素强度的新形式化方法，可显著减轻多孔GaN薄膜FIB断层扫描中的“孔隙背壁效应”（pore back effect），且不增加总实验时长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将实验旋转至垂直于样品表面成像孔隙，并引入基于体素强度的新形式化方法，可显著减轻多孔GaN薄膜FIB断层扫描中的“孔隙背壁效应”（pore back effect），且不增加总实验时长。；创新点：首次对多孔GaN薄膜FIB断层扫描中的孔隙背壁效应进行正式量化与评估，并提出了无需延长实验时间即可有效缓解该效应的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 聚焦离子束（FIB）断层扫描技术，采用旋转样品使成像方向垂直于样品表面的改进实验设置，并开发了基于体素强度（voxel intensity）的定量评估形式化方法，用于分析单个特征及整个数据集的孔隙背壁效应影响。

papers.title: Critical SO(5) scaling of entanglement entropy at honeycomb lattice deconfined criticality
papers.abstract: The deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) in square lattice S=1/2 quantum antiferromagnets has been extensively studied with a large body of evidence pointing to a weakly first-order transition scenario. Recent studies, which focused on entanglement at this nearly continuous DQCP in square lattice J-Q models, have observed conflicting bipartite entanglement entropy (EE) scaling behavior. One bipartition choice gave scaling coefficients in remarkable agreement with predictions from the unitary CFT corresponding to the putative DQCP. While another equally natural choice gave scaling coefficients in complete violation of unitary CFT that may be attributed to lack of scale invariance at the known weakly first-order behavior of the model. This motivates the exploration of DQCP behavior via entanglement measures in lattice models with distinct crystalline symmetries. Here we study a S=1/2 honeycomb model that hosts a nearly continuous transition between Néel and valence-bond-solid ground states relevant to probing DQCP. Using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we compute the Rényi EE for a variety of bipartitions and test the CFT based description of the DQCP on the honeycomb lattice. For smooth bipartitions, we find no evidence of logarithmic corrections, in accordance with CFT, thereby essentially ruling out contributions from Goldstone modes. For subsystems with corners, CFT predicts universal logarithmic contributions, which we extract for corners with 60 and 120 degree angles and find close agreement with an emergent SO(5) CFT. While we observe scaling consistent with a critical system in the majority of cases, we also demonstrate an intriguing counterexample of the hexagon subsystem that exhibits a subtle period three oscillation. This results in three separate finite-size series, where the sign of the logarithmic term apparently changes depending on the series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo simulations、Rényi entanglement entropy、CFT scaling。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格（honeycomb lattice）上的S=1/2量子反铁磁体，具体研究其从Néel序到价键固体（VBS）的近似连续相变，即去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于光滑边界划分，未发现对数修正项，符合共形场论（CFT）预期，排除了Goldstone模贡献；对于含角点的子系统，提取了60°和120°角点的对数项，与SO(5) CFT的预言吻合。但六边形子系统的纠缠熵表现出微妙的周期三振荡，导致对数项符号随有限尺寸序列变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于光滑边界划分，未发现对数修正项，符合共形场论（CFT）预期，排除了Goldstone模贡献；对于含角点的子系统，提取了60°和120°角点的对数项，与SO(5) CFT的预言吻合。但六边形子系统的纠缠熵表现出微妙的周期三振荡，导致对数项符号随有限尺寸序列变化。；创新点：首次在蜂窝晶格DQCP模型中系统研究纠缠熵的标度行为，验证了SO(5) CFT的普适性预言，同时揭示了六边形子系统这一反例，表明晶格对称性可能影响纠缠标度的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 大规模量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟，计算不同边界划分下的Rényi纠缠熵，并基于CFT标度理论分析对数修正项。

papers.title: Understanding surface potential dynamics of passivated perovskites via Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
papers.abstract: Molecular passivation has become central to reducing photovoltage losses in metal-halide perovskite solar cells, but its electronic action is still often inferred from device-level metrics rather than directly resolved at the nanoscale. Here, we use amplitude-modulated Kelvin probe force microscopy to examine how [3-(2-aminoethylamino)propyl]trimethoxysilane (AEAPTMS) modifies the surface potential and photovoltage dynamics of mixed-cation, mixed-halide perovskite thin films. AEAPTMS homogenises the dark contact potential difference (CPD), narrowing its distribution from ~45.7 to ~14.6 mV without obvious morphological changes. Under illumination, passivated films show a larger steady-state surface photovoltage (SPV) and faster stabilisation, with the SPV increasing from ~345 to ~417 mV and the stabilisation time constant decreasing from ~840 to ~470 s. Wavelength-dependent SPV further indicates reduced sub-bandgap electronic disorder. By separating grain-boundary and grain-interior contributions, we show that AEAPTMS suppresses grain-boundary potential barriers, linking amino-silane passivation to a more homogeneous and stable carrier landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜（amplitude-modulated Kelvin probe force microscopy）等实验手段，并给出了具体的实验测量数据（如CPD分布、SPV数值等）。；研究对象：混合阳离子、混合卤化物钙钛矿薄膜（mixed-cation, mixed-halide perovskite thin films），以及其表面经[3-(2-氨基乙基氨基)丙基]三甲氧基硅烷（AEAPTMS）分子钝化后的表面电势与光电压动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AEAPTMS分子钝化使钙钛矿薄膜的暗态接触电势差（CPD）分布从约45.7 mV收窄至约14.6 mV，同时稳态表面光电压（SPV）从约345 mV提升至约417 mV，稳定时间常数从约840 s缩短至约470 s，表明钝化抑制了晶界势垒，实现了更均匀、更稳定的载流子分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AEAPTMS分子钝化使钙钛矿薄膜的暗态接触电势差（CPD）分布从约45.7 mV收窄至约14.6 mV，同时稳态表面光电压（SPV）从约345 mV提升至约417 mV，稳定时间常数从约840 s缩短至约470 s，表明钝化抑制了晶界势垒，实现了更均匀、更稳定的载流子分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜（amplitude-modulated KPFM），用于测量暗态CPD、光照下SPV及其动力学，以及波长依赖的SPV分析；通过分离晶界与晶粒内部贡献，分析钝化对晶界势垒的影响。

papers.title: Terahertz Phase Inversion via Field-Free Spin-Orbit Torque Switching in an Antenna-Integrated Spintronic Heterostructure
papers.abstract: We demonstrate microsecond-timescale electrical control of the terahertz (THz) emission phase in broadband field-free spintronic THz emitters, enabling megahertz-rate phase inversion while overcoming the kilohertz limitations of conventional mechanical and field-driven approaches. Our device integrates an H-dipole antenna with a spintronic heterostructure exhibiting uniaxial magnetic anisotropy, enabling deterministic spin-orbit torque induced in-plane magnetization switching without external magnetic fields. The corresponding THz phase inversion is directly observed in the time domain signal, by applying $1\,μ\mathrm{s}$ electrical pulses on the bias striplines of the H-dipole. This field-free operation reduces system complexity while significantly extending modulation bandwidth. Our results establish electrically programmable spintronic THz emitters that could be used to develop a compact and scalable platform for integrated on-chip THz devices and ultrafast applications, including phase-sensitive spectroscopy and near-field imaging, where high-speed and precise control of THz waveforms is essential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件制备、电脉冲施加、时域信号观测等实验操作（如“demonstrate”、“device integrates”、“directly observed”）。；研究对象：天线集成自旋电子异质结构中的太赫兹发射相位调控。具体体系为具有单轴磁各向异性的自旋电子异质结，集成了H-偶极天线。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无外磁场的自旋轨道矩（SOT）实现微秒级电控太赫兹发射相位反转，将调制带宽从千赫兹提升至兆赫兹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无外磁场的自旋轨道矩（SOT）实现微秒级电控太赫兹发射相位反转，将调制带宽从千赫兹提升至兆赫兹。；创新点：实现了无需外部磁场的太赫兹相位电控反转，克服了传统机械或磁场驱动方法在调制速度（千赫兹级）和系统复杂度上的限制，显著扩展了调制带宽。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：H-偶极天线与自旋电子异质结构集成；在偏置带状线上施加1微秒电脉冲；通过时域太赫兹信号直接观测相位反转。物理机制：利用单轴磁各向异性实现无外磁场下的确定性面内磁化翻转（自旋轨道矩驱动）。

papers.title: Nucleation and Enhancement of Superconductivity under Tip-Induced Strain Fields
papers.abstract: A metallic point contact formed on a non-superconducting or weakly superconducting material often nucleates or enhances superconductivity confined under the contact. However, no unified theoretical description of the phenomenon exists. We show that the spatially inhomogeneous, predominantly uniaxial nature of the stress field under a point contact is fundamental for such tip-induced and tip-enhanced superconductivity (TISC/TESC). We also show that the coupling of such a stress field to the electronic structure can be estimated through an experimentally measurable uniaxial coupling scale $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$. Combining Hertzian contact mechanics with a Ginzburg-Landau variational analysis, we derive a criterion for the nucleation of TISC/TESC and determine $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$ for twenty-one materials. For topological semimetals with ungapped band crossings, the framework explains observed critical temperatures with no free parameters and for all others, $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$ provides a direct experimental determination of the uniaxial strain sensitivity and a target scale for microscopic theories.The work predicts TISC in elemental Sb and Y with $T_c \approx 2.8$\,K and $T_c \approx 12$\,K respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Ginzburg-Landau variational analysis”、“Hertzian contact mechanics”等理论框架，且未提及实验数据采集或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：针尖诱导/增强超导电性（TISC/TESC）现象，即金属点接触在非超导或弱超导材料下局域成核或增强超导的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了针尖下应力场的空间非均匀且以单轴为主的特性是TISC/TESC的关键；通过赫兹接触力学与金兹堡-朗道变分分析，推导出超导成核判据，并预言元素Sb和Y在针尖下可分别实现约2.8 K和约12 K的超导转变温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了针尖下应力场的空间非均匀且以单轴为主的特性是TISC/TESC的关键；通过赫兹接触力学与金兹堡-朗道变分分析，推导出超导成核判据，并预言元素Sb和Y在针尖下可分别实现约2.8 K和约12 K的超导转变温度。；创新点：首次提出针尖下非均匀单轴应力场是TISC/TESC的普适物理起源，并建立了无需自由参数即可解释拓扑半金属中观测临界温度的理论框架；同时给出了通过实验直接测定单轴应变敏感性的方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：赫兹接触力学（描述针尖应力场）结合金兹堡-朗道变分分析（描述超导序参量）；引入实验可测量的单轴耦合标度 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\) 来估计应力场与电子结构的耦合强度；对21种材料计算了 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\) 值。

papers.title: Wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate: Effects of quantum fluctuations and finite-range interactions
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of quantum fluctuations (QFs) and finite-range interatomic interactions on the ground state and wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) at zero temperature by means of modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations. The QFs are shown to stiffen the condensate near the hard wall, narrowing the density profile and raising the wall tension above its mean-field value by an amount proportional to square-root of the gas parameter. Finite-range corrections always reduces the wall tension relative to the QFs correction value regardless of the effective range. We find the ordering $γ_0 < γ_{\rm II} < γ_{\rm I}$ in the dilute regime and identify a crossover condition under which the two beyond-mean-field contributions mutually cancel. These results provide an experimentally accessible way for probing beyond-LHY physics through precision measurements of the wall tension in ultracold Bose gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations、mean-field value、beyond-mean-field contributions。；研究对象：零温下玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的基态性质及其与硬壁接触时的壁张力（wall tension），特别关注量子涨落和有限程相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子涨落使凝聚体在硬壁附近变硬，密度分布变窄，壁张力高于平均场值，增加量与气体参数的平方根成正比；有限程修正总是降低壁张力，且在稀薄区域存在一个交叉条件，使两种超越平均场贡献相互抵消。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子涨落使凝聚体在硬壁附近变硬，密度分布变窄，壁张力高于平均场值，增加量与气体参数的平方根成正比；有限程修正总是降低壁张力，且在稀薄区域存在一个交叉条件，使两种超越平均场贡献相互抵消。；创新点：揭示了量子涨落与有限程相互作用对壁张力的竞争效应，并找到了两者相互抵消的交叉条件，为通过精密测量超冷玻色气体壁张力来探测超越Lee-Huang-Yang（LHY）物理提供了实验上可行的途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用修正的Gross-Pitaevskii方程，在平均场理论基础上纳入量子涨落和有限程相互作用的修正，通过解析和数值计算分析基态密度分布和壁张力。

papers.title: Floquet-Weyl states at one-photon resonances in three-dimensional topological insulators
papers.abstract: Quantum materials exhibit exotic phases and electronic responses under irradiation by circularly polarized light, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and generates Floquet replica bands. Recently, Floquet topological states arising from direct resonances have attracted much attention, e.g., the emergence of Floquet-Weyl points at a one-photon resonance, rather than topological features within the modulated original bands via high-frequency expansion. In this study, we investigate the effects of a one-photon resonance in a representative three-dimensional topological insulator, Bi$_2$Se$_3$, applying Floquet theory under circularly polarized light. We find that four pairs of Floquet-Weyl points emerge in the intermediate-frequency regime, mediated by hybridization between the original and one-photon-resonant Floquet bands, preserving the threefold rotational symmetry of the crystalline structure. Our numerical calculations demonstrate that tuning the chemical potential via hole doping yields a large anomalous Hall conductivity, directly associated with these Floquet-Weyl points. This work provides a highly accessible route toward the experimental realization of one-photon-resonant Floquet-Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。依据关键词：“Floquet theory”、“numerical calculations”、“anomalous Hall conductivity”。；研究对象：三维拓扑绝缘体 Bi₂Se₃ 在圆偏振光照射下的一光子共振效应，以及由此产生的 Floquet-Weyl 态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等频率的圆偏振光照射下，Bi₂Se₃ 的原始能带与一光子共振 Floquet 复制带之间发生杂化，产生四对 Floquet-Weyl 点，且这些点保持晶体结构的三重旋转对称性。通过空穴掺杂调节化学势，可获得与这些 Weyl 点直接相关的大反常霍尔电导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等频率的圆偏振光照射下，Bi₂Se₃ 的原始能带与一光子共振 Floquet 复制带之间发生杂化，产生四对 Floquet-Weyl 点，且这些点保持晶体结构的三重旋转对称性。通过空穴掺杂调节化学势，可获得与这些 Weyl 点直接相关的大反常霍尔电导。；创新点：聚焦于直接一光子共振（而非高频展开下的能带修饰）所诱导的 Floquet-Weyl 点，并指出通过空穴掺杂即可实现可观测的大反常霍尔效应，为实验实现一光子共振 Floquet-Weyl 半金属提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Floquet 理论框架，对三维拓扑绝缘体 Bi₂Se₃ 在圆偏振光下的电子结构进行理论建模与数值计算。

papers.title: Emergent superconductivity upon disordering a topological insulator
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of superconductivity in a quantum spin Hall insulator and identify a disorder-driven enhancement of pairing arising from quantum geometry. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the attractive Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) Hubbard model, we obtain a quantum phase transition as a function of interaction strength for different impurity densities. In the clean limit, the system develops bulk superconductivity for Hubbard interaction $\vert U \vert$ above a finite critical strength. Interestingly, strong impurities significantly reduce such $\vert U \vert$ required for the onset of superconductivity. Our calculations indicate that Cooper pairing first nucleates in subgap ring states surrounding the impurities and then evolves into a globally coherent superconducting phase. Our results demonstrate that impurity-generated bound states can promote superconductivity in systems with strong quantum geometry. This mechanism is expected to be relevant in nearly flat-band systems like moiré materials where quantum geometry plays a dominant role.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用 sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations（无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（quantum spin Hall insulator）中由无序诱导的超导电性，具体基于吸引型 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) Hubbard 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强杂质可以显著降低超导所需的 Hubbard 相互作用临界强度 |U|，超导首先在杂质周围的亚能隙环态（subgap ring states）中成核，随后演变为全局相干超导相。该机制源于量子几何（quantum geometry）对配对的增强作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强杂质可以显著降低超导所需的 Hubbard 相互作用临界强度 |U|，超导首先在杂质周围的亚能隙环态（subgap ring states）中成核，随后演变为全局相干超导相。该机制源于量子几何（quantum geometry）对配对的增强作用。；创新点：揭示了杂质生成的束缚态（impurity-generated bound states）在强量子几何系统中可促进超导电性，并指出该机制在近平带系统（如莫尔材料）中具有普适性。
papers.method_zh: 采用无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟，对吸引型 BHZ Hubbard 模型在不同杂质密度下，研究超导相变随相互作用强度的变化。

papers.title: Interplay of Umklapp scattering and Sb-Au hybridization in surface-reconstructed Sb/Au(111)
papers.abstract: Surface reconstructions induced by atomic adsorption can strongly reshape metallic surface states, providing a direct pathway to tune their electronic structure. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we investigate the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) during the coverage-driven evolution from the clean Au(111) surface to the $(14\times14)$ and Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phases. In the Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phase, triangular Fermi pockets emerge at the Brillouin-zone boundary. Their momentum positions are consistent with a reciprocal-space folding construction, but their reduced size near the Fermi level indicates a modification of the Au-derived $sp$ dispersion. The substantial modifications of deeper Au $d$-derived bands observed in ARPES further indicate significant mixing between Sb $p$ orbitals and Au $d$ states. These results show that the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) is governed by the interplay between reconstruction-induced Umklapp scattering and interfacial orbital hybridization, highlighting adsorbate-substrate hybridization as a key mechanism for tuning and engineering surface electronic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy（ARPES）。；研究对象：Sb/Au(111)表面重构体系，具体研究从清洁Au(111)表面到(14×14)相和Rec(3×√3)相的覆盖度驱动演化过程中的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Rec(3×√3)相中，布里渊区边界出现三角形费米口袋，其动量位置符合倒空间折叠构造，但费米面附近尺寸减小表明Au的sp色散被修饰；同时Au的d带发生显著变化，表明Sb p轨道与Au d态之间存在显著杂化。电子结构由重构诱导的Umklapp散射与界面轨道杂化共同主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Rec(3×√3)相中，布里渊区边界出现三角形费米口袋，其动量位置符合倒空间折叠构造，但费米面附近尺寸减小表明Au的sp色散被修饰；同时Au的d带发生显著变化，表明Sb p轨道与Au d态之间存在显著杂化。电子结构由重构诱导的Umklapp散射与界面轨道杂化共同主导。；创新点：揭示了吸附物-衬底杂化（Sb-Au轨道杂化）作为调控表面电子结构的关键机制，并与重构诱导的Umklapp散射效应相互竞争/协同。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。

papers.title: Density-Induced Reentrant Coarsening in a Two-Temperature System
papers.abstract: Understanding how nonequilibrium driving modifies phase-separation kinetics remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that phase separation in a two-temperature system exhibits a striking density-induced reentrant coarsening behavior. Using Brownian dynamics simulations and a coarse-grained field-theoretic model, we find that the characteristic domain size grows as $L(t)\sim t^{1/z}$, displaying a reentrant sequence $(t^{1/3} \rightarrow t^{1/4}\rightarrow t^{1/3})$ with increasing density. While the low- and high-density regimes are governed by classical curvature-driven bulk diffusion, the intermediate-density regime exhibits anomalously slow growth. We show that this slowdown originates from a transport bottleneck arising from the interplay of particle diffusivity, particle availability, and attachment kinetics, which suppresses the effective mass flux between domains. Unlike equilibrium phase separation, where density primarily affects morphology and crossover scales, the two-temperature drive renders density a key control parameter for coarsening pathways. Our results uncover a nonequilibrium mechanism for anomalous domain growth in two-temperature systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：Brownian dynamics simulations（布朗动力学模拟）、coarse-grained field-theoretic model（粗粒化场论模型）。；研究对象：双温度系统中的相分离动力学，具体研究密度如何调控粗化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双温度系统中的相分离表现出密度诱导的重入粗化行为：随着密度增加，畴尺寸生长指数呈现 \(t^{1/3} \rightarrow t^{1/4} \rightarrow t^{1/3}\) 的重入序列，中间密度区域出现异常缓慢的生长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双温度系统中的相分离表现出密度诱导的重入粗化行为：随着密度增加，畴尺寸生长指数呈现 \(t^{1/3} \rightarrow t^{1/4} \rightarrow t^{1/3}\) 的重入序列，中间密度区域出现异常缓慢的生长。；创新点：揭示了在双温度非平衡驱动下，密度成为控制粗化路径的关键参数，而非像平衡相分离中主要影响形貌和交叉尺度；发现了由输运瓶颈导致的异常慢速粗化机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用布朗动力学模拟和粗粒化场论模型，分析畴尺寸随时间演化的标度律 \(L(t)\sim t^{1/z}\)，并研究粒子扩散率、粒子可用性及附着动力学之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Unveiling Nanoscale Surface Damage Dynamics in Swift Heavy Ion Irradiated Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: This work systematically unveils the nanoscale surface damage dynamics in gallium nitride by investigating the atomistic mechanisms of hillock formation. The results identify two distinct hillock morphologies dependent on electronic energy loss (Se) values. Bell-shaped hillocks form under 18.2 keV/nm Kr irradiation, whereas crater-rim hillocks with central holes emerge under 40.2 keV/nm Ta irradiation. Microstructural analysis reveals that Ga-rich hillocks are accompanied by the generation of metastable zincblende nanodomains. These nanodomains preferentially aggregate around the periphery or sidewalls of the hillocks and exhibit a high spatial correlation with screw dislocations. Further temperature-dependent studies indicate that elevated temperatures significantly enlarge the overall dimensions of the hillock structures without altering their fundamental morphologies. Notably, under Ta irradiation above 1200 K, the high temperatures drastically reduce the viscosity and surface tension of liquid gallium. This enhanced fluidity of the transient molten phase promotes the formation of penetrating nanochannels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“microstructural analysis”“temperature-dependent studies”等实验手段，以及具体辐照条件（Kr、Ta离子）和温度参数。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）在快重离子辐照下的纳米尺度表面损伤动力学，特别是hillock（小丘）结构的形成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现两种依赖于电子能量损失（Se）值的不同hillock形貌：低Se（18.2 keV/nm Kr辐照）下形成钟形hillock，高Se（40.2 keV/nm Ta辐照）下形成带有中心孔的环形hillock。高温（>1200 K）下液态镓的流动性增强，促进穿透性纳米通道的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现两种依赖于电子能量损失（Se）值的不同hillock形貌：低Se（18.2 keV/nm Kr辐照）下形成钟形hillock，高Se（40.2 keV/nm Ta辐照）下形成带有中心孔的环形hillock。高温（>1200 K）下液态镓的流动性增强，促进穿透性纳米通道的形成。；创新点：系统揭示了GaN中hillock形貌对电子能量损失的依赖性，并首次发现高温下液态镓的流动性增强可诱导形成穿透性纳米通道。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用快重离子辐照实验（Kr和Ta离子），结合微观结构分析（可能包括透射电子显微镜等）研究hillock形貌与微结构；通过变温实验（最高>1200 K）研究温度对hillock尺寸和形貌的影响。

papers.title: Ethaline deep eutectic solvent under nanoconfinement: Unveiling structural and dynamical changes
papers.abstract: Hybrid nanomaterials incorporating deep eutectic solvents (DES) in porous hosts or at solid interfaces are gaining increasing attention for their potential interest across a wide range of applications. Under these conditions, the performances of DESs may be influenced by interfacial effects and spatial restrictions. In this study, we examined the effects of nanoconfinement on both the structure and molecular dynamics of the prototypical DES ethaline (a mixture of choline chloride and ethylene glycol) when confined within the cylindrical mesopores of SBA-15 (Dp $\approx$ 8.1 nm) and MCM-41 (Dp $\approx$ 3.5 nm) silicas, using neutron diffraction and quasielastic neutron scattering. It demonstrates that ethaline remains structurally homogeneous under confinement, showing no evidence of core-shell segregation within the pore cross-section. The molecular dynamics of the confined ethaline preserve the key characteristics observed in its bulk state. Translational diffusion follows a jump-diffusion mechanism, with diffusion coefficients that remain remarkably close to the bulk values, showing only a modest reduction in MCM-41. A more pronounced increase in the residence time t0 between translational molecular jumps is observed. It corresponds to roughly a factor of 3-8 under confinement in SBA-15, and reaches up to a tenfold enhancement in MCM-41 relative to bulk. Similarly, the characteristic relaxation time, tL, associated with the localized in-cage motion of ethaline, increases by approximately 20% in SBA-15 and up to 50% in MCM-41. However, the molecular trajectories, modeled from the elastic incoherent structure factor, remain largely preserved under confinement, showing only a marginal reduction in intra-basin motional amplitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了中子衍射和准弹性中子散射实验手段。；研究对象：低共熔溶剂（DES）Ethaline（氯化胆碱与乙二醇的混合物）在纳米限域下的结构与分子动力学，具体限域介质为SBA-15（孔径约8.1 nm）和MCM-41（孔径约3.5 nm）介孔二氧化硅。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ethaline在纳米限域下保持结构均匀性，未出现核-壳分离；其分子动力学保留体相关键特征，但分子跳跃的停留时间和局域笼内运动的弛豫时间显著增加，且孔径越小增强越明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ethaline在纳米限域下保持结构均匀性，未出现核-壳分离；其分子动力学保留体相关键特征，但分子跳跃的停留时间和局域笼内运动的弛豫时间显著增加，且孔径越小增强越明显。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（Neutron diffraction）和准弹性中子散射（Quasielastic neutron scattering, QENS），并结合弹性非相干结构因子（EISF）建模分析分子轨迹。

papers.title: Phonon scattering mechanisms in WTe$_2$ observed by ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Revealing the mechanisms of phonon scattering is crucial for understanding material properties such as transport characteristics and optical responses. It can be discussed by measuring the temperature dependence of the phonon energy and lifetime. To gain insight into these mechanisms in Weyl semimetal T$_d$-WTe$_2$, we investigated coherent phonons using time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy in a wide temperature range from 4.6 to 300 K. The temperature dependence of the frequency and decay rate of the two high-frequency optical modes was described by the conventional anharmonic phonon-phonon scattering model. In contrast, the low-frequency mode at 2.4 THz exhibited anomalous behavior, which can be interpreted as the contribution of phonon-electron scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy”（时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱）这一实验手段。；研究对象：Weyl半金属T_d相WTe₂中的声子散射机制，特别是不同频率光学声子的温度依赖行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高频光学声子的频率和衰减率随温度的变化符合常规的非谐声子-声子散射模型，而2.4 THz的低频声子表现出反常行为，可归因于声子-电子散射的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高频光学声子的频率和衰减率随温度的变化符合常规的非谐声子-声子散射模型，而2.4 THz的低频声子表现出反常行为，可归因于声子-电子散射的贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用超快相干声子光谱（即时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱），在4.6 K至300 K的宽温区内测量相干声子的频率和寿命随温度的变化。

papers.title: A modified Moss rule highlights underexplored classes of high refractive index materials
papers.abstract: High refractive index dielectrics are central to photonic applications, yet the empirical Moss rule imposes a fundamental trade-off between refractive index and optical transparency. We introduce a modified Moss rule anchored to the optical absorption edge rather than the fundamental bandgap, capturing materials where various physical mechanisms suppress absorption well above the electronic gap. Screening the Materials Project database with this metric reveals recurring chemical compositions and structural prototypes in the materials with the most promising refractive index/transparency trade-offs. These materials include chalcopyrites, Zintl pnictides, and early transition metal multi-anion chalconitrides and oxychalcogenides compounds. Hybrid density functional theory calculations reveal that the chalconitride (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 family can achieve a combination of ultra-high refractive indices, low effective masses and transparency windows extending deep into the UV, surpassing state-of-the-art TiO2 and SiC. Our results establish (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 compounds as a unique and largely unexplored material family for next-generation photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：screening the Materials Project database、hybrid density functional theory calculations）；研究对象：高折射率介电材料，特别是(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂家族化合物，以及chalcopyrites、Zintl pnictides、早期过渡金属多阴离子chalconitrides和oxychalcogenides等材料类别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种修正的Moss规则，基于光学吸收边而非基本带隙来评估折射率与透明度的权衡，并发现(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂家族材料可实现超高折射率、低有效质量以及深紫外透明窗口，性能超越TiO₂和SiC。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种修正的Moss规则，基于光学吸收边而非基本带隙来评估折射率与透明度的权衡，并发现(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂家族材料可实现超高折射率、低有效质量以及深紫外透明窗口，性能超越TiO₂和SiC。；创新点：修正了传统Moss规则，使其能捕捉因多种物理机制而在远高于电子带隙处仍保持透明的材料，从而识别出此前被忽视的高折射率/透明度权衡优异的材料类别。
papers.method_zh: 基于Materials Project数据库的材料筛选，结合修正Moss规则进行度量；采用混合密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）计算电子结构和光学性质。

papers.title: Ab initio thermodynamic statistical modeling of the miscibility gap and the metal-insulator phase transition in SrTi$_{1-x}$V$_x$O$_{3}$
papers.abstract: The substitutional alloy SrTi$_{1-x}$V$_x$O$_3$ interpolates between the band insulator SrTiO$_3$ and the correlated metal SrVO$_3$, exhibiting a composition-driven metal--insulator transition whose origin combines Mott physics with local chemical disorder. Previous first-principles studies relied on individual supercells, which cannot capture the thermally disordered solid solution, since configurations of identical composition can display very different electronic properties. Here we treat the alloy within a generalized quasi-chemical approximation, a thermodynamically consistent statistical framework in which every property is obtained as an ensemble average over all symmetry-inequivalent clusters, weighted by occurrence probabilities that minimize the Gibbs mixing free energy. This provides a well-defined procedure to average over different supercells, and places the structural and electronic descriptions on an equal footing. From the mixing thermodynamics we obtain a miscibility gap with a critical temperature of 1443 K, consistent with experimental evidence. Combining the cluster ensemble with dynamical mean-field theory, we track the density of states at the Fermi level across the full composition range: whereas density-functional theory alone predicts a metal for all $x>0$, the correlated spectral function reproduces the transition, evolving from insulating below $x\approx0.3$ to metallic near $x=1$. Finally, classifying clusters as metallic or insulating and performing site percolation on a simple cubic lattice yields a sharp onset of system-spanning conduction near $x\approx0.4$. These results establish a thermodynamically consistent, configuration--averaged framework applicable to the broader class of correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：generalized quasi-chemical approximation, dynamical mean-field theory, 统计框架）；研究对象：SrTi₁₋ₓVₓO₃ 替代合金中的混溶隙（miscibility gap）和金属-绝缘体相变
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该合金在约 x≈0.3 以下为绝缘体，在 x≈1 附近变为金属；混溶隙的临界温度为 1443 K，与实验一致；基于团簇的渗流分析显示在 x≈0.4 附近出现系统范围的导电通路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该合金在约 x≈0.3 以下为绝缘体，在 x≈1 附近变为金属；混溶隙的临界温度为 1443 K，与实验一致；基于团簇的渗流分析显示在 x≈0.4 附近出现系统范围的导电通路。；创新点：提出了一个热力学自洽的构型平均框架，将结构描述与电子描述置于同等地位，克服了以往基于单个超胞方法无法捕捉热无序固溶体的问题。
papers.method_zh: 广义准化学近似（generalized quasi-chemical approximation）进行热力学统计建模，结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）计算态密度，并采用简单立方格点上的位点渗流（site percolation）分析。

papers.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Gradients Unlock Topological Dimensional Reduction in Magnetic Hopfions
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional magnetic solitons retain topological protection only while their spin field remains continuous. Here we show that chemical inhomogeneity can break this protection in a controlled way, converting a hopfion-like toroidal texture into an effectively two-dimensional skyrmion string. Tilt-dependent Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and micromagnetic simulations of pristine, uniformly Y-doped, and nonuniformly Y-doped disordered TiO2 nanoparticles embedded in a FeCrNiMn host reveal two regimes. Uniform Y doping enriches Ti3+/oxygen-vacancy localization centers and stabilizes closed rings with Hopf invariant QH approximately 1. Nonuniform Y doping forms a Ti4+-rich, vacancy-depleted boundary that creates a sharp q=D/(2A) gradient and a weak-moment leakage channel. This coupled mismatch torque and continuity leakage split the ring, leaving a skyrmion-string remnant and a field-sensitive helicity texture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, electron energy-loss spectroscopy”等实验手段，以及“micromagnetic simulations”计算模拟。；研究对象：嵌入FeCrNiMn基体中的无序TiO₂纳米颗粒，具体研究其内部磁涡旋（hopfion-like toroidal texture）在化学不均匀性下的拓扑降维行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非均匀Y掺杂在TiO₂纳米颗粒中形成尖锐的q=D/(2A)梯度，产生弱磁矩泄漏通道，将原本具有Hopf不变量QH≈1的闭合环状磁结构转化为有效二维斯格明子弦（skyrmion string）和场敏感螺旋度纹理，实现拓扑维度的可控降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非均匀Y掺杂在TiO₂纳米颗粒中形成尖锐的q=D/(2A)梯度，产生弱磁矩泄漏通道，将原本具有Hopf不变量QH≈1的闭合环状磁结构转化为有效二维斯格明子弦（skyrmion string）和场敏感螺旋度纹理，实现拓扑维度的可控降低。；创新点：首次通过化学不均匀性（非均匀Y掺杂）在三维磁孤子中引入可控的拓扑保护破缺，实现从三维hopfion到二维skyrmion弦的拓扑维度降级，并揭示了q梯度与弱磁矩泄漏通道的耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 倾斜依赖洛伦兹透射电子显微镜（tilt-dependent Lorentz TEM）、电子能量损失谱（EELS）、微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）。样品包括原始、均匀Y掺杂和非均匀Y掺杂三种状态的TiO₂纳米颗粒。

papers.title: A low-energy effective Hamiltonian for Landau quasiparticles: II Application to the contact Fermi gas
papers.abstract: This article follows up on arxiv:2511.15938, in which we developed a new renormalization scheme to construct a quantized theory of Fermi liquids. Here, we apply this formalism to a low-temperature atomic Fermi gas where the short-range interactions are fully parametrized by the s-wave scattering length $a$. We benchmark our renormalized theory by recovering known perturbative results on the static properties of the Fermi gas, such as the Lee-Huang-Yang expansion of the equation of state, the Galitskii expansion of the momentum distribution, and the Gor'kov- Melik Barkhudarov preexponential correction to the critical temperature. We then turn to the transport dynamics and demonstrate the presence of a preexponential correction to the speed of zero sound when including corrections of second order in $a$. Finally, we develop an efficient numerical method to solve the transport equation exactly, and we apply to study the crossover from the collisionless to the hydrodynamic regime in the density and polarisation response functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a new renormalization scheme”、“construct a quantized theory”、“develop an efficient numerical method”，属于理论推导与数值方法开发。；研究对象：低温原子费米气体，其中短程相互作用完全由s波散射长度a参数化。具体研究其静态性质（状态方程、动量分布、临界温度）和输运动力学（零声速、碰撞到流体动力学区间的交叉）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1. 通过恢复已知微扰结果（如Lee-Huang-Yang状态方程展开、Galitskii动量分布展开、Gor'kov-Melik Barkhudarov临界温度预指数修正）验证了重整化理论的有效性。2. 发现包含a的二阶修正时，零声速存在预指数修正。3. 开发了精确求解输运方程的数值方法，并应用于密度和极化响应函数中从无碰撞到流体动力学区间的交叉研究。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1. 通过恢复已知微扰结果（如Lee-Huang-Yang状态方程展开、Galitskii动量分布展开、Gor'kov-Melik Barkhudarov临界温度预指数修正）验证了重整化理论的有效性。2. 发现包含a的二阶修正时，零声速存在预指数修正。3. 开发了精确求解输运方程的数值方法，并应用于密度和极化响应函数中从无碰撞到流体动力学区间的交叉研究。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用新发展的重整化方案（基于arXiv:2511.15938）构建费米液体的量子化理论，并将其应用于原子费米气体。具体包括：解析推导静态性质（如Lee-Huang-Yang展开、Galitskii展开、临界温度修正）和输运方程中的零声速修正；开发数值方法精确求解输运方程。

papers.title: Minimizing propagated density errors of atomic core-electron for simultaneously accurate bandgaps and lattice constants in closed-shell Copper semiconductors
papers.abstract: Density functional theory struggles to accurately determine electron density of atoms, whose error is inevitably encoded into the pseudopotential and propagated into solid-state calculations. However, little is known about how this affects accuracy nor how to remedy it. In this work, through a systematic study of the effect of Cu atomic density on bandgap and lattice constants of over 50 Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors, we find that core-electron density can drastically affect nuclear attraction to valence electrons and subsequent charge distribution and energy position of Cu 3$d$ electrons. The error can be eliminated at its source by employing modified Hartree-Fock pseudopotentials for Cu core while retaining (semi-)local functionals for valence electrons. This real-space partitioning approach leads to simultaneous high-accuracy in bandgap and lattice constants across the entire material class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、pseudopotential、Hartree-Fock、solid-state calculations。；研究对象：含铜的闭壳层半导体（超过50种Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors），具体研究其晶格常数和带隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过修改Cu原子的芯电子赝势（采用修正的Hartree-Fock赝势），同时保留价电子的（半）局域泛函，可以在整个材料类别中同时实现带隙和晶格常数的高精度计算，从而从源头消除芯电子密度误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过修改Cu原子的芯电子赝势（采用修正的Hartree-Fock赝势），同时保留价电子的（半）局域泛函，可以在整个材料类别中同时实现带隙和晶格常数的高精度计算，从而从源头消除芯电子密度误差。；创新点：揭示了Cu原子芯电子密度误差如何通过赝势传播到固体计算中，并首次提出通过修改芯电子赝势（而非修改价电子泛函）来同时提升带隙和晶格常数精度的策略。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，系统研究Cu原子密度对带隙和晶格常数的影响；采用修正的Hartree-Fock赝势处理Cu芯电子，价电子部分保留（半）局域泛函（如LDA或GGA），实现实空间分区处理。

papers.title: Size focusing in core-shell precipitates: A phase-field study
papers.abstract: Due to their enhanced resistance to coarsening and/or creep, aluminium alloys with precipitates of two distinct phases in a core-shell morphology are of great contemporary interest. In this paper, we focus on the curious observation in two recent studies on Al-Sc-Li and Al-Yb-Li alloys that growth of the shell phase leads to a narrowing of the size distribution. We have studied this phenomenon, known as size focusing, using a theoretical framework (which extends Zener's theory of diffusional growth to a core-shell precipitate) and multi-precipitate simulations based on a phase field model. Our results yield key theoretical insights as well as conclusions with practical significance. (a) On the theoretical front, we show clearly that size focusing is a growth phenomenon: it ends when shell growth ends, and coarsening begins. (b) On the practical front, our results offer guidelines for designing alloys with narrower size distributions: size focusing is promoted in alloys with greater shell volume fractions and greater inter-precipitate spacing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据关键词：“phase-field study”（相场研究）、“theoretical framework”（理论框架）、“multi-precipitate simulations”（多析出相模拟）。；研究对象：具有核-壳形态双相析出物的铝合金（如Al-Sc-Li和Al-Yb-Li合金）中，壳层相生长导致的尺寸分布窄化现象（即“尺寸聚焦”）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尺寸聚焦是一个生长现象，当壳层生长结束、粗化开始时，该现象即终止。合金中壳层体积分数越大、析出物间距越大，越有利于促进尺寸聚焦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尺寸聚焦是一个生长现象，当壳层生长结束、粗化开始时，该现象即终止。合金中壳层体积分数越大、析出物间距越大，越有利于促进尺寸聚焦。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩展的Zener扩散生长理论（针对核-壳析出物）和基于相场模型的多析出相模拟。

papers.title: Surface-Reconstruction-Driven Insulating Behavior in Metallic Charge-Density-Wave 1T-TaSe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: Bulk 1T-TaSe$_2$ is metallic, yet its surface consistently exhibits an insulating gap -- a dichotomy long attributed to a surface Mott insulator driven by enhanced electron correlations. Here, using density functional theory calculations, we show that this insulating surface instead originates from a charge-density-wave (CDW) stacking reconstruction. Whereas the bulk stabilizes a single-layer CDW stacking that supports metallic transport, the surface energetically favors a bilayer stacking, in which interlayer hybridization of Ta $5d_{z^2}$ orbitals opens a $\sim$0.4 eV gap -- a band insulator requiring no on-site Coulomb repulsion. This reconstruction is the thermodynamic ground state for slab thicknesses from two to eight layers, and the calculated surface density of states quantitatively reproduces scanning tunneling spectra for both insulating and metallic domains. Our results establish CDW surface reconstruction, rather than Mott physics, as the mechanism governing the surface electronic structure of 1T-TaSe$_2$ and provide a unified explanation for the experimentally observed coexistence of metallic and insulating domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：density functional theory calculations、calculated surface density of states。；研究对象：1T-TaSe₂ 的表面电子结构，具体研究其表面绝缘性起源与电荷密度波（CDW）堆叠重构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1T-TaSe₂ 表面的绝缘能隙并非源于传统认为的 Mott 绝缘体机制，而是由表面 CDW 堆叠重构导致的能带绝缘体，该重构在从两层到八层的薄层中均为热力学基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1T-TaSe₂ 表面的绝缘能隙并非源于传统认为的 Mott 绝缘体机制，而是由表面 CDW 堆叠重构导致的能带绝缘体，该重构在从两层到八层的薄层中均为热力学基态。；创新点：推翻了长期以来将 1T-TaSe₂ 表面绝缘行为归因于增强电子关联驱动的表面 Mott 绝缘体的观点，首次提出并证明了 CDW 表面重构（而非 Mott 物理）是控制其表面电子结构的关键机制，并统一解释了实验中金属性与绝缘性畴区共存的现象。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于分析不同 CDW 堆叠方式下的电子结构、能带间隙以及表面态密度，并与扫描隧道谱（STS）实验数据进行定量对比。

papers.title: AI2Pot: A scalable and unified framework for machine-learning interatomic potential development and large-scale molecular dynamic simulations
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) bridge the accuracy of first-principles calculations and the efficiency required for large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. However, existing MLIP software remains fragmented across different model architectures, making it difficult to establish unified workflows that support flexible model development, efficient training, and scalable MD deployment. Here, we present AI2Pot, a scalable and unified MLIP framework that seamlessly integrates model training, evaluation, and large-scale MD simulations with PyTorch-compatible ecosystem. Instead of relying on generic automatic differentiation for expensive atomistic operators, AI2Pot re-engineers the core computations of Moment tensor potential (MTP) and Neuroevolution potential (NEP) for both training and inference using hand-crafted C++/CUDA code. These specialized operators constitute a unified computational backend shared by training and inference, improving training-inference consistency and reducing memory usage by avoiding large intermediate caches. As a result, AI2Pot enables fast inference for large-scale atomic systems containing millions of atoms on a single GPU, while retaining the flexibility of PyTorch for model construction, training, and evaluation. Trained models can be deployed in ASE and LAMMPS for MD simulations. Furthermore, AI2Pot provides a companion command-line toolkit (AI2Pot-cli) and Python APIs to facilitate practical MLIP workflows. By unifying high-performance atomistic computing with modern machine-learning ecosystems, AI2Pot offers an user-friendly end-to-end framework for the developing, training, and deploying MLIPs for large scale MD.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、large-scale molecular dynamics simulations、PyTorch-compatible ecosystem、hand-crafted C++/CUDA code。；研究对象：论文研究的是机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的通用开发框架，具体涉及Moment tensor potential (MTP) 和 Neuroevolution potential (NEP) 两种模型架构，以及大规模分子动力学（MD）模拟的部署。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AI2Pot框架通过重新设计MTP和NEP的核心计算算子（使用手写C++/CUDA代码），实现了训练与推理的统一高性能后端，从而在单GPU上支持百万原子级系统的快速推理，同时保持PyTorch生态的灵活性和一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AI2Pot框架通过重新设计MTP和NEP的核心计算算子（使用手写C++/CUDA代码），实现了训练与推理的统一高性能后端，从而在单GPU上支持百万原子级系统的快速推理，同时保持PyTorch生态的灵活性和一致性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统MLIP软件相比的具体创新点，但可归纳为：1）通过手写高性能算子统一训练与推理的计算后端，避免大型中间缓存，降低内存占用并提升训练-推理一致性；2）将MTP和NEP两种不同架构集成到同一PyTorch兼容框架中，实现可扩展的统一工作流。
papers.method_zh: 采用手写C++/CUDA代码重新实现MTP和NEP的原子级算子，替代通用的自动微分方法；基于PyTorch构建模型训练、评估和部署的统一框架；通过ASE和LAMMPS接口实现MD模拟；提供命令行工具（AI2Pot-cli）和Python API辅助工作流。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall and Nernst effects driven by static and fluctuating spin chiralities on Kagome lattice
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the anomalous Hall and Nernst effects (AHE and ANE) in a two dimensional Kagome lattice to uncover the distinct roles of static and fluctuating scalar spin chi ralities. Employing Monte Carlo simulations incorporating with a tight binding Hamiltonian via the s-d exchange interaction, we explicitly evaluate the anomalous transport coefficients. A key finding is the systematic disentanglement of the macroscopic responses into an intrinsic contribu tion, governed by momentum space Berry curvature induced by static chirality, and an extrinsic skew scattering contribution driven by real space dynamical spin fluctuations. We demonstrate a pronounced mechanistic crossover: deep in magnetically ordered phases like the skyrmion crystal, the intrinsic Berry curvature dictates the transport behavior. However, approaching the magnetic order-disorder critical regime, strong thermal fluctuations disrupt static noncoplanar spin configu rations, drastically suppressing intrinsic responses. Here, dynamical chiral fluctuations emerge as the dominant driving force. By delineating the phase regimes governed by static versus fluctuating chiralities, this work elucidates the distinct microscopic mechanisms dictating anomalous transport in frustrated magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、tight binding Hamiltonian、theoretically investigate。；研究对象：二维Kagome晶格中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），特别是静态与涨落标量自旋手性对这两种输运现象的驱动作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统区分了反常输运的两种贡献：由静态手性诱导的动量空间贝里曲率贡献（内禀机制），以及由实空间动态自旋涨落驱动的外禀斜散射贡献。在磁有序相（如斯格明子晶体）中，内禀贝里曲率主导输运；而在磁有序-无序临界区，热涨落抑制静态非共面自旋构型，动态手性涨落成为主导驱动力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统区分了反常输运的两种贡献：由静态手性诱导的动量空间贝里曲率贡献（内禀机制），以及由实空间动态自旋涨落驱动的外禀斜散射贡献。在磁有序相（如斯格明子晶体）中，内禀贝里曲率主导输运；而在磁有序-无序临界区，热涨落抑制静态非共面自旋构型，动态手性涨落成为主导驱动力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用结合s-d交换相互作用的紧束缚哈密顿量，并利用蒙特卡洛模拟进行数值计算，直接评估反常输运系数。

papers.title: Visualizing modified spin-wave wavefronts near magnetic defects and domains using nitrogen-vacancy centers
papers.abstract: Direct, real-space imaging of spin-wave propagation and wavefronts in magnetic materials is crucial for advancing both fundamental understanding of spin dynamics and the development of functional devices. This, however, remains a significant challenge, especially in materials with complex magnetic characteristics at the nanoscale. Here, we employ scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy to achieve visualization of spin waves in two archetypical magnetic films: yttrium-iron-garnet and lanthanum strontium manganese oxide. We reveal a wavelength-dependent spin-wave filtering effect near point-like magnetic scatterers and a modified spin wavefront in antiferromagnetically coupled stripe domains. The spin-wave characteristics are explained using micromagnetic simulations and analytical calculations. These findings point to possible fine control of spin-wave propagation near complex magnetic structures and extend the scope of spin-wave imaging based on nitrogen-vacancy centers beyond uniform magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy、visualization、micromagnetic simulations）；研究对象：两种典型磁性薄膜中的自旋波传播与波前：钇铁石榴石（yttrium-iron-garnet）和镧锶锰氧化物（lanthanum strontium manganese oxide），以及点状磁散射体和反铁磁耦合条状畴附近的波前畸变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在点状磁散射体附近观察到波长依赖的自旋波滤波效应，在反铁磁耦合条状畴中观察到自旋波前被修改。这些效应表明可通过复杂磁结构精细调控自旋波传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在点状磁散射体附近观察到波长依赖的自旋波滤波效应，在反铁磁耦合条状畴中观察到自旋波前被修改。这些效应表明可通过复杂磁结构精细调控自旋波传播。；创新点：将基于氮-空位中心的自旋波成像从均匀磁体扩展到具有复杂纳米尺度磁特性的材料，并首次在实空间揭示了点状散射体附近的波长滤波效应和反铁磁畴中的波前修改。
papers.method_zh: 扫描氮-空位中心光谱学（scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy）实现实空间成像，辅以微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）和解析计算解释自旋波特性。

papers.title: Negative and Zero Linear Compressibility in MCN (M = Ag, Au, Cu): A First-Principles Study
papers.abstract: Negative linear compressibility (NLC) is the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a crystallographic axis expands under hydrostatic pressure. A related phenomenon, zero linear compressibility (ZLC), occurs when an axis shows no length change under pressure. Both responses are rare and arise in materials with highly anisotropic mechanical properties. Motivated by recent reports of anomalous behavior in metal cyanides - including negative thermal expansion and NLC - we use first-principles calculations to investigate the potential of the MCN family (M = Ag, Au, Cu) to exhibit ZLC or NLC. Our simulations reveal three main findings. First, we predict the existence of previously unreported phases: the P6mm phase for AgCN and CuCN, and the R3m phase for AuCN. Second, all six members of the MCN family studied exhibit extreme elastic anisotropy, which indeed leads to ZLC or NLC in each case. Third, we identify a mechanism for these responses distinct from previously reported ones. The mechanism arises from the unique "bamboo forest" geometry of the material: weakly interacting rigid rods whose sparse packing allows pressure to be accommodated through changes in packing density rather than rod compression. This mechanism enables the anomalous response to persist over a wide pressure range, contrasting favorably with other materials that exhibit similar behavior. Our findings expand the relatively small family of materials known to exhibit ZLC or NLC and provide deeper insight into the microscopic origin of these unusual mechanical responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“simulations”（模拟）。；研究对象：MCN（M = Ag, Au, Cu）金属氰化物家族，具体研究其负线性压缩性（NLC）和零线性压缩性（ZLC）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相以及AuCN的R3m相；发现该家族所有六种材料均表现出极端弹性各向异性，并因此均具有ZLC或NLC行为；揭示了一种基于“竹林”几何结构的新机制，使异常响应能在宽压力范围内持续。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相以及AuCN的R3m相；发现该家族所有六种材料均表现出极端弹性各向异性，并因此均具有ZLC或NLC行为；揭示了一种基于“竹林”几何结构的新机制，使异常响应能在宽压力范围内持续。；创新点：发现了MCN家族中此前未报道的新相（P6mm相和R3m相）；提出了一种区别于以往报道的、源于材料独特“竹林”几何结构的NLC/ZLC新机制，该机制通过改变堆积密度而非杆状单元压缩来容纳压力。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体为基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的模拟。

papers.title: Connecting Microseismicity to Lithology via a Model of Slip Avalanches
papers.abstract: Fluid injection into the earth's crust can induce small and frequent earthquakes in the subsurface. Predicting their sizes and temporal occurrences via statistical analysis is crucial for safe operations in unconventional oil and gas recovery, enhanced geothermal systems, and geologic carbon storage. Here we show that a simple micromechanical model of slip avalanches in slowly deforming solids predicts the slip statistics observed over drastically different spatial scales, namely meter-scale microseismic observations and nanometer- to micrometer-scale nanoindentation experiments can be described with this model. Microseismic catalogs extracted from high-pressure fluid injection operations into geological basins with various lithologies and nanoindentation experiments on shale across a wide range of temperatures and mineral compositions yield statistics consistent with model predictions. This universality across materials, temperatures, and scales is consistent with the prediction that the slip statistics result from only a few basic properties. Previously debated deviations of the statistics in layered sedimentary formations are explained by finite-size and stress-integrative effects resulting from mechanically weak bedding planes. The slip statistics therefore provide important information about the structure and scales of the bedding planes. Conversely, the basin structure can also be used to predict the probability distribution for the sizes of triggered microseismic events.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论模型 + 实验数据分析）。判断依据：摘要中提出了一个“滑移雪崩的微观力学模型”，并用该模型预测了统计规律，同时将预测结果与“微震目录”和“纳米压痕实验”数据进行了对比验证。；研究对象：流体注入地壳诱发的小型微地震（微震活动），以及不同岩性（lithology）地质层中的滑移统计行为。具体材料包括页岩等沉积岩，以及纳米压痕实验中的多种矿物成分样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个描述缓慢变形固体中滑移雪崩的简单微观力学模型，能够统一解释从纳米/微米尺度（纳米压痕）到米尺度（微震观测）的滑移统计规律，且该统计规律在不同材料、温度和尺度下具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个描述缓慢变形固体中滑移雪崩的简单微观力学模型，能够统一解释从纳米/微米尺度（纳米压痕）到米尺度（微震观测）的滑移统计规律，且该统计规律在不同材料、温度和尺度下具有普适性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）用一个简单模型统一了跨越多个数量级空间尺度的滑移统计行为；2）解释了先前在层状沉积地层中统计规律的争议性偏差，并将其归因于弱层理面的有限尺寸和应力积分效应；3）建立了滑移统计与地质结构（层理面）之间的双向预测关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模（滑移雪崩的微观力学模型）结合实验数据分析。实验数据来源包括：高压流体注入作业中提取的微震目录（涵盖不同岩性的地质盆地），以及在不同温度和矿物成分下对页岩进行的纳米压痕实验。

papers.title: Scanning tunneling microscopy of resonant-impurity in altermagnets: dual Fano resonance and Landau-quantization-induced nodal spin contrast
papers.abstract: Using a Green's-function formalism, we study the spin-resolved local spectral function of a resonant impurity coupled to a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnetic substrate. It is found that the interplay between the direct impurity-STM tip tunneling and altermagnet-mediated tunneling leads to dual Fano resonance in the absence of external magnetic field. Moreover, the anisotropic spin-dependent oscillation of the local density of states and/or Fano factor provide the information of the altermagnetic splitting strength from the local/global perspective. In addition, spin-selective tunneling can be achieved by tuning the Fermi energy and the tip position. In the presence of strong magnetic field with Landau level quantization, the dominant STS signature becomes a spin-dependent nodal structure of the real-space pattern: the nodal mismatch between opposite spin channels produces a large local spin contrast. These results establish resonant-impurity STM/STS as a phase-sensitive local probe of altermagnetic band anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用Green's-function formalism（格林函数形式）进行理论计算，研究自旋分辨局域谱函数。；研究对象：二维d波交变磁体（altermagnet）衬底上的共振杂质（resonant impurity），具体研究该体系在扫描隧道显微镜（STM）下的自旋分辨局域谱函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无外磁场时，直接杂质-STM针尖隧穿与交变磁体介导隧穿的相互作用导致双Fano共振；在强磁场下，朗道能级量子化产生自旋依赖的节点结构，导致大的局域自旋对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无外磁场时，直接杂质-STM针尖隧穿与交变磁体介导隧穿的相互作用导致双Fano共振；在强磁场下，朗道能级量子化产生自旋依赖的节点结构，导致大的局域自旋对比度。；创新点：首次提出将共振杂质STM/STS作为交变磁体能带各向异性的相位敏感局域探针，揭示了通过Fano共振和朗道量子化节点自旋对比度探测交变磁体分裂强度的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数形式（Green's-function formalism）计算自旋分辨局域态密度（LDOS）和Fano因子，分析共振杂质与d波交变磁体衬底的耦合效应。

papers.title: Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties in Doped Fe$_2$VAl within a Bipolar Random Anderson Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermoelectric and magnetic properties of Si-substituted $n$-type and Ti-substituted $p$-type Heusler alloy Fe$_2$VAl using the bipolar random Anderson model, which has been introduced recently to study antisite-defect effects associated with the sign change of the Seebeck coefficient in thermally quenched Fe$_2$VAl. Based on the electronic states of both $n$-type and $p$-type compounds, with the rigid-band shift of the Fermi energy and a temperature-dependent scattering rate taken into account, we elucidate how antisite defects simultaneously influence thermoelectric transport and local magnetic moments. We find that the magnetic moments are enhanced in $n$-type Fe$_2$VAl, whereas they are suppressed in $p$-type Fe$_2$VAl compared with the undoped compound. These contrasting magnetic responses highlight the impact of antisite spin polarization on thermoelectric properties and demonstrate the crucial role of antisite defects in realizing magneto-thermoelectric functionalities in Heusler-type alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：bipolar random Anderson model（双极随机安德森模型）、rigid-band shift（刚带移动）、temperature-dependent scattering rate（温度依赖散射率）。；研究对象：Si取代的n型与Ti取代的p型Heusler合金Fe₂VAl的热电与磁性质，以及其中反位缺陷对塞贝克系数符号变化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反位缺陷在n型Fe₂VAl中增强磁矩，在p型Fe₂VAl中抑制磁矩；这种相反的磁响应揭示了反位缺陷的自旋极化对热电输运的影响，并表明反位缺陷在实现Heusler合金磁热电功能中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反位缺陷在n型Fe₂VAl中增强磁矩，在p型Fe₂VAl中抑制磁矩；这种相反的磁响应揭示了反位缺陷的自旋极化对热电输运的影响，并表明反位缺陷在实现Heusler合金磁热电功能中起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双极随机安德森模型（bipolar random Anderson model），结合费米能的刚带移动和温度依赖的散射率，对n型和p型化合物的电子态进行计算分析。

papers.title: Disorder signatures in coherent electronic waveguides
papers.abstract: Microscopic disorder in a coherent conductor is encoded in the magnitude of the transmitted current and in the energy- and channel-resolved structure of the scattering response. We develop a conductance-balanced learning framework for identifying microscopic disorder mechanisms from coherent quantum-transport spectra. Using armchair graphene nanoribbons as controlled multichannel tight-binding waveguides, we generate ensembles in which distinct disorder classes occupy the same intervals of integrated transmission, removing the dominant shortcut associated with average conductance. Within this constrained setting, we compare scalar transmission spectra with transmission-eigenvalue spectra, and use supervised classification, scale-normalizing controls, plateau-resolved tests, and principal-component analysis to identify the spectral structures that remain informative. The learned distinctions persist after normalization of the conductance envelope and are strongest in multichannel energy windows, where mode mixing and channel redistribution shape the scattering response. Principal components provide interpretable transport coordinates whose loadings identify the energy and eigenchannel sectors responsible for the dominant spectral deformations. The results establish a controlled AI-assisted protocol for learning disorder signatures from nonlinear quantum-scattering data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“紧束缚模型”、“监督分类”、“主成分分析”等计算和数据分析方法，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：相干电子波导中的微观无序机制。具体体系为扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带，作为多通道紧束缚波导模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在去除平均电导这一主导捷径后，通过电导平衡学习框架，可以从相干量子输运谱中识别出不同微观无序类别的特征信号。这些特征在多通道能量窗口中最为显著，主成分分析可提取出主导谱形变的关键能量和本征通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在去除平均电导这一主导捷径后，通过电导平衡学习框架，可以从相干量子输运谱中识别出不同微观无序类别的特征信号。这些特征在多通道能量窗口中最为显著，主成分分析可提取出主导谱形变的关键能量和本征通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：提出了一种受控的、基于人工智能的协议，用于从非线性量子散射数据中学习无序指纹，并成功区分了在平均电导上表现相同的不同无序类别。
papers.method_zh: 1. 构建电导平衡学习框架，生成不同无序类别但具有相同积分透射区间的系综；2. 比较标量透射谱与透射本征值谱；3. 使用监督分类、尺度归一化控制、平台分辨测试和主成分分析等机器学习与统计方法。

papers.title: Large-scale pseudopotential density functional theory calculations using orthogonalized enriched finite element basis
papers.abstract: We present an efficient and scalable computational framework for pseudopotential Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) calculations using an enriched finite element (EFE) basis. The EFE basis is formed by augmenting the classical finite element (CFE) basis with compact atom-centered functions, which we term enrichment functions. The key idea is to combine the completeness of a finite element basis with the efficiency of an atom-centered basis. We orthogonalize the enrichment functions with respect to the underlying CFE basis to simultaneously improve the conditioning of the EFE basis and the efficiency of evaluating the inverse of the overlap matrix. To efficiently solve the Kohn-Sham eigenvalue problem, we employ a residual-based Chebyshev subspace iteration approach that is tolerant to approximations in the evaluation of the inverse of the overlap matrix. We demonstrate the accuracy of the framework as compared to the widely available DFT packages. For benchmark non-periodic calculations, ranging up to 39,083 electrons, the EFE basis offers a $5-7\times$ reduction in degrees of freedom over the CFE basis. As a result of this, EFE achieves a $5-9\times$ reduction in computational cost over the CFE basis. The EFE basis also provides a $4-5\times$ reduction in the required memory compared to the CFE basis, thus allowing for optimal utilization of computational resources. Finally, we demonstrate that the EFE basis affords good parallel scalability. Overall, the EFE basis offers a systematically convergent, fast, scalable, resource-efficient basis for pseudopotential DFT calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：pseudopotential Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) calculations、computational framework、enriched finite element (EFE) basis。；研究对象：论文研究的是用于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的一种新型基组方法，而非特定材料或物理现象。研究对象是计算框架本身，即如何更高效地进行大尺度赝势DFT计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将经典有限元（CFE）基组与紧凑的原子中心函数（富集函数）结合，并对其进行正交化处理，所构建的富集有限元（EFE）基组在保持系统收敛性的同时，相比CFE基组可将自由度减少5-7倍，计算成本降低5-9倍，内存需求减少4-5倍，并具有良好的并行可扩展性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将经典有限元（CFE）基组与紧凑的原子中心函数（富集函数）结合，并对其进行正交化处理，所构建的富集有限元（EFE）基组在保持系统收敛性的同时，相比CFE基组可将自由度减少5-7倍，计算成本降低5-9倍，内存需求减少4-5倍，并具有良好的并行可扩展性。；创新点：提出并实现了一种将有限元基组的完备性与原子中心基组的效率相结合的EFE基组，并通过正交化策略解决了混合基组可能带来的条件数问题，从而在大规模非周期性DFT计算中实现了显著的资源节约和性能提升。
papers.method_zh: 采用富集有限元（EFE）基组进行赝势Kohn-Sham DFT计算。具体方法包括：用原子中心函数（富集函数）增强经典有限元（CFE）基组；对富集函数相对于CFE基组进行正交化以改善基组条件数和重叠矩阵求逆效率；使用基于残差的Chebyshev子空间迭代法求解Kohn-Sham特征值问题，该方法对重叠矩阵求逆的近似具有容忍性。

papers.title: High-frequency nonlinear conductivity of a Wigner crystal
papers.abstract: Electrons trapped above the surface of superfluid helium are a disorder-free platform for investigating the formation and dynamics of low-dimensional Wigner crystals. A characteristic nonlinear transport feature of this electronic solid suspended above the helium surface is the Bragg-Cherenkov effect, in which the mobility of the smoothly moving crystal is limited by the coherent emission of helium surface waves (ripplons). The effect has been understood in the conventional Cherenkov setting in which the crystal moves at a constant speed. Here we report on transport measurements of electrons on helium confined in a microchannel geometry to investigate the non-equilibrium response of the Wigner solid when it is subjected to a high-frequency driving field. Surprisingly, the experiments reveal a strongly nonlinear transport response of the confined Wigner solid at frequencies nearly an order of magnitude larger than the ripplon frequencies contributing to the conventional Bragg-Cherenkov effect. We relate this observation to the coupling of the Wigner solid to ripplons with higher-order Bragg vectors, which gives rise to a dynamical friction that provides a mechanism for the observed high-frequency pinning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“transport measurements”、“experiments reveal”。；研究对象：悬浮于超流氦表面的电子形成的维格纳晶体（Wigner crystal），特别是微通道几何结构中的受限维格纳固体及其在高频驱动下的非线性输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验发现，受限维格纳固体在频率比传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应中涉及的里普朗频率高近一个数量级时，仍表现出强非线性输运响应。该现象归因于维格纳固体与高阶布拉格矢量的里普朗耦合，产生了一种动态摩擦，从而解释了高频钉扎机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验发现，受限维格纳固体在频率比传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应中涉及的里普朗频率高近一个数量级时，仍表现出强非线性输运响应。该现象归因于维格纳固体与高阶布拉格矢量的里普朗耦合，产生了一种动态摩擦，从而解释了高频钉扎机制。；创新点：发现了在远高于传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应特征频率的高频区域，维格纳晶体仍存在强非线性输运行为，并提出了与高阶布拉格矢量里普朗耦合相关的动态摩擦机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用微通道几何结构中的电子在氦表面上的输运测量，施加高频驱动场，观测非线性输运响应。

papers.title: A neural-network Maxwell's demon learns cold damping for work extraction
papers.abstract: We train a neural-network Maxwell's demon to extract work from a model of an underdamped micromechanical cantilever subject to thermal noise. The demon, which periodically adjusts the position of a harmonic trap, is trained to maximize the power extracted under steady-state operation. When the demon is given the cantilever position and trap position as inputs it learns a refined version of an existing hand-designed protocol, yielding a substantial improvement in performance. When the demon receives the oscillator velocity as input it discovers a qualitatively different strategy that extracts substantially more work, close to the theoretical power bound. Analysis of the protocol shows that it implements {\em cold damping}: the trap position is displaced approximately linearly with velocity, producing an effective increase of the oscillator's damping coefficient and a reduction of its effective temperature. Thus a neural-network Maxwell's demon rediscovers a well-known cooling strategy from optomechanics, revealing a simple physical mechanism underlying near-optimal work extraction from thermal fluctuations in an underdamped system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural-network Maxwell's demon（神经网络麦克斯韦妖）、training（训练）、analysis of the protocol（协议分析）。；研究对象：受热噪声驱动的欠阻尼微机械悬臂梁（underdamped micromechanical cantilever）模型，以及通过周期性调节谐振阱（harmonic trap）位置从热涨落中提取功的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经网络麦克斯韦妖在仅输入振子速度时，自主发现了一种接近理论功率上限的“冷阻尼”（cold damping）策略：通过将阱位近似线性地随速度位移，有效增加振子阻尼系数并降低其有效温度，从而从热涨落中近乎最优地提取功。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经网络麦克斯韦妖在仅输入振子速度时，自主发现了一种接近理论功率上限的“冷阻尼”（cold damping）策略：通过将阱位近似线性地随速度位移，有效增加振子阻尼系数并降低其有效温度，从而从热涨落中近乎最优地提取功。；创新点：神经网络自主重新发现了光力学中已知的冷阻尼冷却策略，揭示了在欠阻尼系统中从热涨落近最优提取功的简单物理机制，且当输入为速度时性能显著优于已有手工设计的协议。
papers.method_zh: 使用神经网络作为麦克斯韦妖，以最大化稳态下提取的功率为目标进行训练。输入变量为悬臂梁位置、阱位置或振子速度，输出为谐振阱的周期性调节策略。

papers.title: Synthesis of Bulk Superconducting LiNbO$_2$ Crystals through CaH$_2$ Reduction
papers.abstract: We have synthesized layered superconducting LiNbO$_2$ crystals through a bulk phase transformation from LiNbO$_3$ single crystals via CaH$_2$ reduction. As the Nb valence is reduced from 5+ to 3+, the material undergoes a structural transformation to the resulting product, LiNbO$_2$, which is accompanied by metallic behavior and a superconducting transition, Tc onset, as high as 14.4 K. Secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) show that the resulting phase is hole-doped through de-lithiation during the reduction. Magnetization and AC susceptibility measurements from a tunnel diode resonator confirm the bulk nature of superconductivity with a superconducting volume fraction of approximately 77% and an upper critical field approaching 26 T. Our study demonstrates extreme hydride reduction as an effective method to induce phase transformations with non-topotactic pathways and can be used to synthesize bulk materials with exotic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesized、measurements、SIMS、XPS、magnetization、AC susceptibility。；研究对象：层状超导材料LiNbO₂晶体，通过CaH₂还原从LiNbO₃单晶转变而来，研究其超导转变及体超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过CaH₂还原将LiNbO₃单晶转变为LiNbO₂，该材料表现出金属行为和高达14.4 K的超导转变起始温度，且超导体积分数约77%，上临界场接近26 T，证实了体超导性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过CaH₂还原将LiNbO₃单晶转变为LiNbO₂，该材料表现出金属行为和高达14.4 K的超导转变起始温度，且超导体积分数约77%，上临界场接近26 T，证实了体超导性。；创新点：展示了极端氢化物还原作为一种非拓扑路径诱导相变的有效方法，可用于合成具有奇异性质的体材料。摘要未突出说明与已有LiNbO₂合成方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用CaH₂还原法进行体相转变合成；使用二次离子质谱（SIMS）和X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析元素价态与脱锂掺杂；通过磁化强度测量和隧道二极管谐振器的交流磁化率测量确认体超导性质。

papers.title: Microscopic Dynamical Entropy II: Statistical and Stochastic Thermodynamics of Hamiltonian Systems
papers.abstract: The Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE) introduced in Ref. [1] describes irreversible relaxation of selected variables x within a finite closed Hamiltonian system of fixed total energy E. Here we extend the framework to arbitrary total-energy distributions and time-dependent Hamiltonians. This allows work interactions with external agents or protocols, crucial in stochastic and classical thermodynamics, and driven systems more generally, to be addressed directly. The central step is to reduce the full microscopic description in terms of selected variables x and unmonitored variables y to one in terms of the selected variables and the instantaneous total energy (x,E). The unmonitored degrees of freedom y in Y enter through their conditional phase-space volume (CPV) $Ω_Y(x,E,t)$. This construction allows work and heat to be defined directly for finite Hamiltonian composites, including cases where Y is so small that its temperature is not well defined. We demonstrate monotonic MDE growth, corresponding to the macroscopic second law, under mixing and time-scale separation even for driven systems with arbitrary energy distributions. At trajectory level, we derive detailed and integral fluctuation relations for the MDE, generalising standard large-bath results. We verify these numerically in a driven few-particle Hamiltonian system, showing the emergence of stochastic thermodynamics for collective coordinates, such as the centre-of-mass position, even in closed systems with only ten or twenty degrees of freedom. Physically, these fluctuation relations connect irreversibility to the change in the number of unmonitored microstates compatible with initial and final data for the observed coordinates. Together, our results provide a finite-system Hamiltonian foundation for the emergence of classical and stochastic thermodynamics and extend their applicability to surprisingly small heat baths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：extend the framework、derive fluctuation relations、numerically verify）；研究对象：有限封闭哈密顿系统中选定变量的不可逆弛豫，以及经典与随机热力学在有限小热浴中的涌现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将微观描述约化为选定变量与瞬时总能量（x,E），定义了有限哈密顿复合体系中的功与热，证明了驱动系统在混合与时间尺度分离下微观动力学熵（MDE）的单调增长（对应宏观第二定律），并在轨迹层面推导了MDE的细致与积分涨落关系，推广了标准大热浴结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将微观描述约化为选定变量与瞬时总能量（x,E），定义了有限哈密顿复合体系中的功与热，证明了驱动系统在混合与时间尺度分离下微观动力学熵（MDE）的单调增长（对应宏观第二定律），并在轨迹层面推导了MDE的细致与积分涨落关系，推广了标准大热浴结果。；创新点：将MDE框架从固定总能量推广到任意能量分布与含时哈密顿量，使得可直接处理功与热；证明了即使在热浴极小的封闭系统中，随机热力学仍可涌现，并建立了不可逆性与未监测微观态数目变化之间的涨落关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于条件相空间体积Ω_Y(x,E,t)的微观动力学熵（MDE）形式体系，处理任意总能量分布与含时哈密顿量；数值验证：在仅含十到二十个自由度的驱动少粒子哈密顿系统中，对集体坐标（如质心位置）进行模拟。

papers.title: Driven square lattice of quantum dots in a magnetic field coupled to a cylindrical FIR-photon cavity
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive computational study of driven quantum dot arrays in a square lattice configuration, subject to an external magnetic field and coupled to a cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity. The driving is introduced through a harmonic modulation of the full electron-photon interaction, therefore including both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions. The electron-electron Coulomb interactions are treated within density functional theory, while the electron-photon coupling is modeled using a many-body configuration interaction approach at each iteration of the density functional. By exploiting the unique properties of the cylindrical TE$_{011}$ cavity mode, we demonstrate selective enhancement of diamagnetic two-photon transitions. Our results reveal that the effectiveness of harmonic modulation of the electron-photon interaction is strongly dependent on both the driving frequency and the electron occupation number per dot. When the driving frequency approaches twice the cavity photon frequency, the system exhibits resonant behavior characterized by efficient photon pumping, occupation of higher-order photon replicas, and activation of collective radial Coulomb breathing modes. These findings establish a controllable mechanism for manipulating photon states in coupled quantum dot-cavity systems and provide insights into the interplay among harmonic modulation, photonic excitations, magnetic confinement, and many-body electron correlations in dimensionally reduced nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“computational study”、“density functional theory”、“many-body configuration interaction approach”。；研究对象：受驱动量子点阵列，具体为置于外磁场中并与圆柱形远红外光子腔耦合的方形晶格量子点阵列。研究涉及电子-光子相互作用、电子-电子库仑相互作用以及驱动调制下的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过谐波调制电子-光子相互作用，当驱动频率接近腔光子频率的两倍时，系统出现共振行为，表现为高效光子泵浦、高阶光子副本占据以及集体径向库仑呼吸模式的激活。同时，该调制效果强烈依赖于驱动频率和每个量子点的电子占据数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过谐波调制电子-光子相互作用，当驱动频率接近腔光子频率的两倍时，系统出现共振行为，表现为高效光子泵浦、高阶光子副本占据以及集体径向库仑呼吸模式的激活。同时，该调制效果强烈依赖于驱动频率和每个量子点的电子占据数。；创新点：利用圆柱形TE₀₁₁腔模的独特性质，实现了对抗磁双光子跃迁的选择性增强，并揭示了谐波调制频率与腔光子频率之间的共振条件对光子态操控的关键作用。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）处理电子-电子库仑相互作用，并在DFT的每次迭代中结合多体组态相互作用（CI）方法对电子-光子耦合进行建模。驱动通过谐波调制完整的电子-光子相互作用（包括顺磁和抗磁贡献）引入。

papers.title: Evaporation-Driven Nanowire Self-Assembly in an Elongated Droplet
papers.abstract: Drying of nanowire-laden elongated droplets is a ubiquitous process in printed electronics fabrication, where the resulting deposition pattern critically determines device performance by controlling nanowire alignment, connectivity, and percolating charge-transport pathways. However, the physical understanding of evaporation-driven deposition is still largely derived from studies of spherical droplets on homogeneous substrates. This gap limits the ability to predict and control deposit morphology in realistic printing scenarios. Here, we use mesoscale lattice Boltzmann simulations to investigate the drying of nanowire-laden elongated droplets on wettability-patterned substrates, focusing on the effects of droplet geometry, nanowire interactions, and nanowire length. The elongated droplet geometry is found to intrinsically induce distinct axial and transverse inhomogeneities in the final deposit. Increasing the effective attraction between nanowires, which mimics changes in surface chemistry or solvent conditions, can improve electrical connectivity but also promotes clustering and local ordering, reducing structural uniformity. In contrast, increasing nanowire length yields a dual benefit by improving long-range connectivity while simultaneously enhancing deposit homogeneity. Our findings provide design guidance for balancing electrical transport and structural uniformity in evaporation-driven printed electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“mesoscale lattice Boltzmann simulations”（介观尺度格子玻尔兹曼模拟）。；研究对象：纳米线负载的细长液滴在图案化润湿性基底上的蒸发驱动自组装过程，具体关注液滴几何形状、纳米线间相互作用及纳米线长度对最终沉积形貌和电学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细长液滴的几何形状会内在导致最终沉积物在轴向和横向上产生不均匀性。增加纳米线间的有效吸引力虽能改善电学连通性，但会促进团簇和局部有序化，降低结构均匀性；而增加纳米线长度则能同时改善长程连通性和沉积均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细长液滴的几何形状会内在导致最终沉积物在轴向和横向上产生不均匀性。增加纳米线间的有效吸引力虽能改善电学连通性，但会促进团簇和局部有序化，降低结构均匀性；而增加纳米线长度则能同时改善长程连通性和沉积均匀性。；创新点：将蒸发驱动沉积的研究从传统的球形液滴/均匀基底体系拓展到更贴近实际印刷场景的细长液滴/图案化润湿性基底体系，系统揭示了液滴几何形状、纳米线相互作用和长度对沉积形貌与电学性能的耦合影响，为平衡电输运与结构均匀性提供了设计指导。
papers.method_zh: 采用介观尺度的格子玻尔兹曼方法（Lattice Boltzmann Method）进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Chiral Phonons in Altermagnets via Magnon-Phonon Coupling
papers.abstract: Chiral phonons are attractive for spintronics applications, however, their zero-field generation in conventional antiferromagnets is forbidden by combined parity and time-reversal ($\mathcal{PT}$) symmetry. Here we demonstrate the emergence of chiral phonons in $\mathcal{PT}$-breaking altermagnetic systems at zero field arising from relativistic magnon-phonon coupling. Focusing on the prototypical altermagnet CrSb, we utilize first-principles methods to calculate the hybridized magnon-polarons across the complete Brillouin zone. We show that this coupling imprints an altermagnetic $g$-wave symmetry directly onto the phonon angular momentum. Furthermore, we demonstrate anomalous spin and phonon angular momentum Nernst responses arising from finite Berry curvatures. These findings establish that chiral lattice dynamics can arise in compensated magnetic ground states without requiring external fields, positioning bulk altermagnets as material candidates for zero-field spin caloritronics and chiral phononics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：first-principles methods（第一性原理计算）、计算混合磁振子-极化子。；研究对象：研究在零磁场下，通过相对论性磁振子-声子耦合在破坏PT对称性的交错磁体（altermagnet）中产生手性声子的现象。具体材料为原型交错磁体CrSb。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零磁场下，交错磁体中的磁振子-声子耦合能够将交错磁体的g波对称性直接印刻到声子角动量上，从而产生手性声子，并导致反常的自旋和声子角动量能斯特响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零磁场下，交错磁体中的磁振子-声子耦合能够将交错磁体的g波对称性直接印刻到声子角动量上，从而产生手性声子，并导致反常的自旋和声子角动量能斯特响应。；创新点：首次证明在无需外加磁场的补偿磁有序基态（如交错磁体）中，可以通过磁振子-声子耦合实现手性晶格动力学，为在零场下实现自旋热电子学和手性声子学提供了新的材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算方法，在全布里渊区内计算了CrSb中混合的磁振子-极化子（magnon-polarons）的能带和性质。

papers.title: Microscopic Dynamical Entropy I: Quantifying Hamiltonian Irreversibility in Large and Small Systems
