papers.abstract: We introduce a Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE) for Hamiltonian systems, defined with respect to a chosen partition of degrees of freedom into a system X and its environment Y. The construction is based on the conditional phase-space volume (CPV), or conditional Boltzmann entropy, associated with the unmonitored degrees of freedom Y. The MDE is a microscopically defined entropy functional of the marginal distribution $ρ_X(t)$, obtained by discarding conditional microscopic information associated with Y from the Gibbs entropy of the joint XY system, while retaining exact Hamiltonian dynamics. This construction clarifies the microscopic origin of thermal entropy. The dependence of MDE solely on $ρ_X(t)$ is consistent with the thermodynamic assumption that the entropy increment of a heat bath Y depends on its heat content and temperature, not on details of its probability distribution. Indeed, the MDE recovers dS = dQ/T connecting entropy increments to heat flow between system and environment. More generally, it provides a consistent description of irreversible relaxation under exact Hamiltonian dynamics, while permitting transient entropy decreases in small systems and in spin-echo type protocols. Under time-scale separation between X and Y, the MDE becomes strictly monotonic in time, recovering the familiar structure of irreversible thermodynamics. The MDE can foreshadow thermodynamics even in a small isolated Hamiltonian system, if X is a well chosen subset of its degrees of freedom. An example is the centre of mass of interacting particles confined to a box. Even for as few as N=10 particles, the MDE increases during relaxation towards a maximum at equilibrium, with increasing monotonicity at larger N. Taken together, our results show that the MDE offers a microscopic interpretation of nonequilibrium thermal entropy and its time dependence within exact Hamiltonian dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“introduce a Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE)”、“construction”、“definition”、“theoretical framework”。；研究对象：哈密顿系统的不可逆性与热力学熵的微观起源，具体包括大系统和小系统中系统（X）与环境（Y）的划分，以及孤立小系统（如N=10个粒子）的质心弛豫过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种微观动力学熵（MDE），它仅依赖于系统X的边缘分布ρ_X(t)，能在精确哈密顿动力学下定量描述不可逆弛豫，并恢复热力学关系dS = dQ/T，同时允许小系统或自旋回波协议中出现瞬态熵减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种微观动力学熵（MDE），它仅依赖于系统X的边缘分布ρ_X(t)，能在精确哈密顿动力学下定量描述不可逆弛豫，并恢复热力学关系dS = dQ/T，同时允许小系统或自旋回波协议中出现瞬态熵减。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有熵定义（如玻尔兹曼熵、吉布斯熵、粗粒化熵）的具体区别，但核心创新在于MDE通过条件相空间体积直接关联微观动力学与宏观热力学熵，且不依赖随机性或粗粒化近似，能在精确哈密顿动力学下同时处理大系统和小系统的不可逆性。
papers.method_zh: 基于条件相空间体积（CPV）或条件玻尔兹曼熵，从联合XY系统的吉布斯熵中丢弃与环境Y相关的条件微观信息，保留精确哈密顿动力学，构建MDE作为ρ_X(t)的熵泛函。通过时间尺度分离分析恢复不可逆热力学结构，并以N=10个粒子在盒子中相互作用的质心运动为例进行数值验证。

papers.title: Topological charge, helicity and vorticity conservation and the reverse spin-current model in the II-nd type multifferoics
papers.abstract: The topological charge and its density are related to the spin vorticity, while the spin vorticity is a part of full vorticity of the medium. The full vorticity is related to an integral of motion called the hydrodynamic helicity. Relation between two integrals of motion (the topological charge and the hydrodynamic helicity) is traced. The role of the spin-current model of the electric polarization formation due to the specific spin distribution in the helicity conservation is demonstrated. The reverse spin-current model is suggested to demonstrate the contribution of the polarization in the spin evolution equation, its importance for the helicity conservation is shown as well. Spin-field model of the electric polarization is the second model for the electric polarization (the deformation, firstly) formation due to the specific spin distribution, which appears from the same principles, but it has nonstationary origin. Moreover, the reverse spin-current model gives a mechanism for the spin structure formation due to the electric polarization in the system. It also appears as the requirement for the conservation of the helicity and the topological charge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论拓扑荷、螺旋度、涡度等物理量的守恒关系，提出“反向自旋流模型”等理论模型，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：II型多铁性材料中与自旋分布相关的电极化形成机制，以及拓扑荷、螺旋度、涡度之间的守恒关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了拓扑荷与流体动力学螺旋度这两个运动积分之间的关联，并提出了“反向自旋流模型”，说明电极化如何反过来影响自旋演化，并满足螺旋度与拓扑荷的守恒要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了拓扑荷与流体动力学螺旋度这两个运动积分之间的关联，并提出了“反向自旋流模型”，说明电极化如何反过来影响自旋演化，并满足螺旋度与拓扑荷的守恒要求。；创新点：提出了“反向自旋流模型”，首次将电极化视为自旋结构形成的驱动因素，而不仅仅是自旋分布的结果，并论证该模型是螺旋度与拓扑荷守恒的必要条件。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型构建：基于自旋涡度与全涡度的关系，分析拓扑荷密度与螺旋度的联系；提出自旋流模型和反向自旋流模型，以及自旋-场模型（非稳态起源）来解释电极化的形成。

papers.title: Majorana physics in a Luttinger liquid with attractive interactions
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes are the hallmark of topological superconductivity. In one-dimensional systems, these zero modes are usually introduced in the context of gapped, mean-field models that do not conserve particle number, such as the Kitaev chain. By non-locally encoding a conventional fermion across spatially separated Majorana zero modes, these systems become inherently immune to local decoherence. In this work, we show that signatures of Majorana edge physics persist in a number-conserving, gapless Luttinger liquid of spinless fermions with short-range attractive interactions. We identify the two-point correlator as a sharp diagnostic, revealing an edge-to-edge revival whose sign depends on the fermion-number parity. This revival is robust in the thermodynamic limit, and persists in the excited states of the system and at different fillings. A simple particle-hole ansatz for the ground state of the system with an odd number of fermions captures the physics of the system for a wide range of interaction strengths, interpolating between the free-fermion limit and the strongly interacting Majorana regime. Finally, we propose a concrete protocol to realize this model with ultracold dipolar molecules or atoms in an optical lattice, and to detect the revival via beam-splitter interferometry, opening an experimental route to Majorana physics beyond the conventional gapped-superconductor paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：number-conserving, gapless Luttinger liquid, particle-hole ansatz, propose a concrete protocol）；研究对象：一维自旋less费米子构成的Luttinger液体，具有短程吸引相互作用，以及其中可能存在的马约拉纳边缘物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，马约拉纳边缘物理的迹象依然存在：两点关联函数表现出边缘到边缘的复兴（revival），其符号依赖于费米子数的奇偶性，且在热力学极限下鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，马约拉纳边缘物理的迹象依然存在：两点关联函数表现出边缘到边缘的复兴（revival），其符号依赖于费米子数的奇偶性，且在热力学极限下鲁棒。；创新点：将马约拉纳零模的研究从传统的能隙、平均场、不守恒粒子数的模型（如Kitaev链）拓展到粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，并提出了超越常规有隙超导范式的实验实现路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过两点关联函数作为诊断工具；采用粒子-空穴变分波函数描述奇数个费米子的基态；并提出了在超冷偶极分子或原子光晶格中实现该模型及通过分束器干涉测量检测复兴信号的实验方案。

papers.title: First-Principles Investigation of the Al-V Phase Diagram
papers.abstract: The Al-V alloy system contains a number of phases including several with complex structures and at least two exhibiting sites of partial occupation. Through electronic density functional theory-based total energy calculations combined with methods of statistical mechanics, we examine the relative stability of phases at finite temperatures. We construct composition-continuous free energy models for the V-rich solid solution and for one of the complex intermetallic phases. In the V-rich region, we identify three ground states that transform to the solid solution at elevated temperatures. We also suggest that \phase{Al}{V_3} takes the Al15 structure as an intermediate-temperature phase stabilized by anharmonic vibrational free energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：基于电子密度泛函理论（DFT）的总能量计算，并结合统计力学方法。；研究对象：Al-V合金体系的相图，特别是富V固溶体及复杂金属间化合物（如AlV₃）的相对稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在富V区域识别出三个基态，它们在高温下转变为固溶体；提出AlV₃相可能采取Al15结构，作为一种由非简谐振动自由能稳定的中温相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在富V区域识别出三个基态，它们在高温下转变为固溶体；提出AlV₃相可能采取Al15结构，作为一种由非简谐振动自由能稳定的中温相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 电子密度泛函理论（DFT）总能量计算，结合统计力学方法；构建了富V固溶体及一种复杂金属间化合物的成分连续自由能模型。

papers.title: Spin-orbit magnetism in altermagnets
papers.abstract: The mechanism enabling antiferromagnets, including altermagnets, to exhibit a prominent anomalous Hall effect despite a vanishingly small net magnetization has long remained elusive. Here, by employing oriented spin group theory and spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion, we systematically disentangle the perturbative behaviors of orbital and spin magnetizations with respect to spin-orbit coupling. Remarkably, we find that only if the opposite-spin sublattices are connected through a fourfold rotation, the orbital and spin magnetizations exhibit distinct perturbative orders. In these altermagnets, we further discover a coaxial Hall effect characterized by the induced spin and orbital magnetizations aligning parallel to the Néel vector, which we further demonstrate by first-principles calculations in the altermagnet KV$_{2}$Se$_{2}$O. This effect holds great promise for achieving deterministic switching of the Néel order under weak external fields. Our work provides a systematic symmetry approach to identify potential altermagnetic candidates combining a large anomalous Hall effect with minimal net magnetization, paving the way for high-performance, stray-field-free spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算）。判断依据：采用群论和自旋-轨道耦合张量展开的理论框架，并结合第一性原理计算进行验证。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的自旋-轨道磁性，具体以KV₂Se₂O为计算示例，研究其反常霍尔效应与净磁化强度极小的矛盾机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现只有当相反自旋的子格通过四重旋转对称性连接时，轨道磁化与自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下的微扰行为才会出现不同阶数；在此类交变磁体中进一步发现一种共轴霍尔效应，即诱导的自旋和轨道磁化平行于奈尔矢量排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现只有当相反自旋的子格通过四重旋转对称性连接时，轨道磁化与自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下的微扰行为才会出现不同阶数；在此类交变磁体中进一步发现一种共轴霍尔效应，即诱导的自旋和轨道磁化平行于奈尔矢量排列。；创新点：首次系统区分了轨道磁化与自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下的不同微扰阶数，并揭示了四重旋转对称性在其中的关键作用；发现了共轴霍尔效应，为实现弱外场下奈尔序的确定性翻转提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用定向自旋群理论（oriented spin group theory）和自旋-轨道耦合张量展开（spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion）进行对称性分析，并结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）在交变磁体KV₂Se₂O中进行验证。

papers.title: Physical exact conditions as regularizers for exchange-correlation in solids and surface chemistry
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) often is the method of choice for simulating the electronic properties of extended solids and surfaces from first principles due to a favorable compromise between accuracy and computational cost. In the field of heterogeneous catalysis, DFT is indispensable for deriving mechanistic insights and understanding trends in surface reactivity. The accuracy of DFT for surface reaction energetics depends strongly on the exchange-correlation (XC) approximation. We show here that optimization of such XC functionals for surface binding energies can lead to a worse description of surface reaction barriers, unless important physical exact conditions are fulfilled.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、exchange-correlation (XC) approximation、first principles。；研究对象：固体和表面化学中的电子性质，特别是异相催化中的表面反应能学（表面结合能、表面反应势垒）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 优化交换关联泛函以提高表面结合能的准确性，可能导致表面反应势垒的描述变差，除非该泛函满足重要的物理精确条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：优化交换关联泛函以提高表面结合能的准确性，可能导致表面反应势垒的描述变差，除非该泛函满足重要的物理精确条件。；创新点：揭示了在固体和表面化学中，仅以表面结合能为目标优化泛函会损害反应势垒的准确性，并强调必须将物理精确条件作为正则化约束纳入泛函构造。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT），具体涉及交换关联（XC）泛函的优化与评估。

papers.title: Mesoscopic routers and single-pole double-throw switches for electronic heat
papers.abstract: The unavoidable dissipation of heat in electronic nanostructures is a crucial problem, specially when their operation requires low temperatures. It demands finding devices able to control and redirect the excess heat, ideally without perturbing the electrostatic environment. We propose three-terminal junctions working either as thermal routers or as thermal single-pole double-throw switches controlled by a single external knob. Two models are discussed based on resonant tunneling energy filters and different couplings to the heat source: (i) Phase-coherent contact via a scanning tip modulates the relative amount of the two output currents via position-dependent quantum interference; (ii) Coupling via a gate voltage tunable filter selectively switches one of the currents in the presence of dephasing. In the later case, we find that the heat flow using ideal filtering is bounded by fourth the open conductor current.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、models are discussed（讨论模型）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：电子热流在纳米结构中的控制与重定向，具体为三端结（three-terminal junctions）作为热路由器（thermal routers）或热单刀双掷开关（thermal single-pole double-throw switches）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单个外部控制旋钮（如扫描针尖位置或栅极电压），三端结可实现电子热流的定向路由或选择性开关；在存在退相干的情况下，理想滤波下的热流受限于开路导体电流的四分之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单个外部控制旋钮（如扫描针尖位置或栅极电压），三端结可实现电子热流的定向路由或选择性开关；在存在退相干的情况下，理想滤波下的热流受限于开路导体电流的四分之一。；创新点：提出了利用单个外部控制参数（而非多个独立调控）实现电子热流路由与开关的机制，并对比了相位相干与退相干两种不同物理场景下的工作模式。
papers.method_zh: 基于共振隧穿能量滤波器（resonant tunneling energy filters）和不同耦合方式的理论模型：（i）通过扫描针尖实现相位相干接触，利用位置依赖的量子干涉调节两路输出热流的相对大小；（ii）通过栅极电压可调滤波器实现耦合，在存在退相干的条件下选择性开关其中一路热流。

papers.title: Moiré Phonon Condensation in Magic-Angle Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Twisted bilayer graphene reconstructs from weak breathing corrugation to large common bending near the magic angle, but the origin of this collective crossover has remained unclear. Here we show that the crossover is a soft-mode condensation of layer-symmetric $A_1$ moiré flexural phonons: these modes soften on the breathing branch, lose stiffness near the magic angle, and freeze into the bending morphology. We call this mechanism Moiré Phonon Condensation (MPC). At $θ=1.08^\circ$, it is extremely surprising that displacements of all 11164 atoms in the moiré supercell, with a maximum atomic position shift of 2.30 Angstrom, is captured by only two $A_1$ phonon modes at more than $99.5\%$ spectral weight. A first-harmonic continuum theory identifies a dimensionless control parameter of the phenomenon, showing that as the twist approaches the magic angle, the growing moiré length scale amplifies a smooth stress-bending competition until the flexural stiffness changes sign. Mode-resolved tight-binding calculations further show that the condensed phonon coordinates are electronically active. This work identifies MPC as a twist-controlled structural order parameter for moiré reconstruction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“continuum theory”、“mode-resolved tight-binding calculations”，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene）中的莫尔重构（moiré reconstruction）现象，具体为从弱呼吸型褶皱（weak breathing corrugation）到大弯曲（large common bending）的集体结构转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 魔角附近的莫尔重构本质上是一种软模凝聚（soft-mode condensation），即层对称的A₁莫尔弯曲声子模在魔角附近软化、失去刚度并冻结为弯曲形态，作者将此机制命名为“莫尔声子凝聚”（Moiré Phonon Condensation, MPC）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：魔角附近的莫尔重构本质上是一种软模凝聚（soft-mode condensation），即层对称的A₁莫尔弯曲声子模在魔角附近软化、失去刚度并冻结为弯曲形态，作者将此机制命名为“莫尔声子凝聚”（Moiré Phonon Condensation, MPC）。；创新点：首次将魔角双层石墨烯的结构重构识别为一种由转角控制的声子凝聚现象，并发现整个莫尔超胞中11164个原子的位移（最大位移2.30 Å）可由仅两个A₁声子模式以超过99.5%的谱权重描述，揭示了该结构相变的集体性和低维性。
papers.method_zh: 连续介质理论（first-harmonic continuum theory）推导无量纲控制参数；模式分辨的紧束缚计算（mode-resolved tight-binding calculations）分析凝聚声子坐标的电子活性；通过声子谱分析识别软模行为。

papers.title: Fluctuation-Driven Enhancement of Spin-Orbit Torque near the Curie Temperature of Ultrathin Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: We investigate how magnetic fluctuations influence spin-orbit torque in ultrathin-film magnetic heterostructures whose Curie temperature $T_C$ is suppressed by confinement. Above $T_C$, the damping-like contribution to spin-orbit field is significantly enhanced while the field-like contribution is suppressed, with the two contributions exhibiting opposite field dependencies. We show that these behaviors are consistent with fluctuation driven mixing between the longitudinal and transverse interfacial spin conductances, which enhances absorption of transversely polarized spin current by the ferromagnet. This mechanism can be activated below $T_C$ by engineering the microscopic magnetic state and by harnessing spin current-generated short-wavelength magnons, suggesting a spintronic analog of heat-assisted magnetic recording.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”“We show that”“consistent with”等理论分析表述，未提及具体实验或计算手段。；研究对象：超薄铁磁薄膜异质结中的自旋轨道矩（spin-orbit torque），特别是居里温度（\( T_C \)）附近磁涨落（magnetic fluctuations）对该效应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在居里温度以上，阻尼类（damping-like）自旋轨道场显著增强，而场类（field-like）贡献被抑制，两者表现出相反的场依赖性。这一行为源于涨落驱动的纵向与横向界面自旋电导混合，增强了铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在居里温度以上，阻尼类（damping-like）自旋轨道场显著增强，而场类（field-like）贡献被抑制，两者表现出相反的场依赖性。这一行为源于涨落驱动的纵向与横向界面自旋电导混合，增强了铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收。；创新点：提出了一种涨落驱动的自旋轨道矩增强机制，并指出该机制可在居里温度以下通过调控微观磁态或利用自旋流产生的短波长磁子来激活，从而类比于热辅助磁记录（heat-assisted magnetic recording）的自旋电子学方案。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法，仅提及基于自旋电导（spin conductances）的界面输运分析。

papers.title: Local Markov Order and Global Inference in Many-Body Dynamics
papers.abstract: We consider how the presence of conserved charges affects memory in a classical stochastic process, the symmetric exclusion process, with an observer constantly measuring a single site. We find that the observer's measurement record becomes Markovian (i.e., loses memory) on a timescale that depends on their knowledge of the global charge, namely the total particle number. In particular, when the global charge is unknown a priori, the observer's time series Markovianizes on a timescale constrained by their ability to learn it from their measurement record. Augmenting the observer's record with bulk measurements drives a charge-learnability transition between charge-fuzzy and -sharp phases. We show that the memory timescale tracks the learnability timescale, diverging in the fuzzy phase and remaining finite in the sharp phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“经典随机过程”、“对称排斥过程”、“马尔可夫化”、“可学习性相变”，属于统计物理与随机过程理论分析。；研究对象：经典多体动力学中的记忆效应，具体体系为对称排斥过程（symmetric exclusion process），关注守恒荷（总粒子数）对观测者测量记录中记忆时间尺度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 观测者的测量记录在依赖于其对全局电荷（总粒子数）认知的时间尺度上变得马尔可夫化（失去记忆）；当全局电荷未知时，记忆时间尺度受限于观测者从测量记录中学习到该电荷的能力，且通过引入体测量可驱动电荷可学习性相变，记忆时间尺度在“模糊相”发散、在“锐利相”有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：观测者的测量记录在依赖于其对全局电荷（总粒子数）认知的时间尺度上变得马尔可夫化（失去记忆）；当全局电荷未知时，记忆时间尺度受限于观测者从测量记录中学习到该电荷的能力，且通过引入体测量可驱动电荷可学习性相变，记忆时间尺度在“模糊相”发散、在“锐利相”有限。；创新点：揭示了守恒荷的全局知识对局部测量记录记忆时间尺度的决定性影响，并发现电荷可学习性相变与记忆时间尺度发散之间的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于经典随机过程（对称排斥过程）的测量记录统计，研究记忆时间尺度与全局电荷可学习性之间的关系，并引入体测量来调控电荷可学习性相变。

papers.title: Origin of the reaction temperature in solid-state materials synthesis
papers.abstract: Temperature plays a crucial role in solid-state materials synthesis, but there is currently no mechanistic theory to explain or predict which temperature is best to conduct a solid-state reaction. Reactions between powder precursors are conventionally assumed to be slow diffusion-limited processes; however, recent in situ experiments show that solid-state reactions can complete in minutes above a critical onset temperature. Here, we present evidence that a transient liquid phase forms above the metastable eutectic temperature, and that this non-equilibrium liquid serves as a fast diffusion medium to intermix precursors and initiate a solid-state reaction. This thermodynamic principle is agnostic to the structure or chemistry of the reactants, and can be applied towards the synthesis and manufacturing of a wide range of complex materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mechanistic theory、thermodynamic principle、evidence）；研究对象：固态材料合成中的反应温度起源，具体涉及粉末前驱体之间的固态反应机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 固态反应在临界起始温度以上会形成瞬态液相（非平衡液体），该液相作为快速扩散介质混合前驱体并引发反应，这一机制由亚稳共晶温度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：固态反应在临界起始温度以上会形成瞬态液相（非平衡液体），该液相作为快速扩散介质混合前驱体并引发反应，这一机制由亚稳共晶温度决定。；创新点：提出了一个与反应物结构或化学性质无关的普适热力学原理，用于解释和预测固态反应的最佳温度，挑战了传统认为固态反应是缓慢扩散限制过程的假设。
papers.method_zh: 基于热力学原理分析，结合近期原位实验观察（摘要提及“recent in situ experiments”但未给出具体技术名称，如原位X射线衍射等）。

papers.title: BatteryMat: a hierarchical machine-learning and DFT framework for average-voltage screening of lithium-ion cathode materials
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) predicts cathode voltages accurately but does not scale to the combinatorial chemical spaces of modern materials databases, while pure machine-learning surrogates are fast but cannot guarantee thermodynamic consistency. We introduce BatteryMat, a three-tier framework that promotes single-pass average-voltage prediction with the Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network (ALIGNN) as the primary screening signal across JARVIS-DFT, then validates survivors with ALIGNN-FF force-field delithiation profiles and automated PBE+U or optB88-vdW+U supercell DFT. The exchange-correlation functional is selected automatically by spacegroup, and the lithium metal reference is recomputed in the same plane-wave basis as the cathode runs, removing a systematic offset of about 1 V present in tabulated values. Trained on 7,610 ALIGNN-FF delithiation voltages, the ALIGNN predictor reproduces the force-field labels with a mean absolute error of 0.17 V and a coefficient of determination of 0.94; this measures distillation fidelity to the force-field protocol, not agreement with DFT or experiment. On four commercial chemistries (LiFePO4, LiMnPO4, LiMn2O4, LiCoO2) the DFT tier reproduces the experimental average voltage to within 0.3 V and the theoretical volumetric capacity to within 5%; a fifth, non-stoichiometric layered entry is carried as an edge case. The pipeline prioritises, rather than generates, existing structures: it ranks the lithium-containing JARVIS-DFT pool into 71 candidates and a scan of about 4.49 million Alexandria structures into 213, all surrogate-level leads awaiting DFT validation rather than confirmed cathodes. BatteryMat is available at https://github.com/atomgptlab/batterymat with a demo at https://atomgpt.org/battery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning、DFT、force-field、supercell DFT。；研究对象：锂离子电池正极材料的平均电压筛选。具体材料包括LiFePO4、LiMnPO4、LiMn2O4、LiCoO2等商业化学体系，以及非化学计量层状化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个三级分层框架BatteryMat，结合机器学习（ALIGNN）与DFT（PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U），能够高效筛选锂离子正极材料的平均电压，在四个商业化学体系中DFT层级复现实验平均电压误差在0.3 V以内，理论体积容量误差在5%以内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个三级分层框架BatteryMat，结合机器学习（ALIGNN）与DFT（PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U），能够高效筛选锂离子正极材料的平均电压，在四个商业化学体系中DFT层级复现实验平均电压误差在0.3 V以内，理论体积容量误差在5%以内。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三级计算框架：第一级用ALIGNN（原子线图神经网络）对JARVIS-DFT数据库进行单次平均电压预测作为初筛；第二级用ALIGNN-FF力场进行脱锂轮廓模拟；第三级用自动选择的PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U进行超胞DFT计算。锂金属参考电极在同一平面波基组下重新计算，以消除约1 V的系统偏移。

papers.title: Irregular Metamaterial Networks
papers.abstract: Metamaterials can achieve exceptional functionality through careful engineering of their mesoscale structure. Although appropriately introduced irregularities can be advantageous, current approaches largely conform to regular structures to preserve tractability. Here, we contend that network theory, enriched with geometry and physics, provides a natural framework for designing metamaterials with controlled irregularities at relevant scales, thereby enabling the discovery of new property-enhancing structures. We examine how this augmented network theory can facilitate the creation of irregular metamaterials with enhanced or novel properties and how metamaterial research, in turn, is opening new directions in network science. Supported by machine learning and advanced self-assembly, the emerging field of irregular metamaterial networks is poised to transform inverse design and scalable manufacturing of novel materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：network theory, machine learning, inverse design）；研究对象：非规则超材料网络（irregular metamaterial networks），即通过引入可控非规则性来设计具有增强或新颖性能的超材料结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将网络理论结合几何与物理学，为在相关尺度上设计具有可控非规则性的超材料提供了自然框架，有望发现新的性能增强结构，并推动超材料逆向设计与可规模化制造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将网络理论结合几何与物理学，为在相关尺度上设计具有可控非规则性的超材料提供了自然框架，有望发现新的性能增强结构，并推动超材料逆向设计与可规模化制造。；创新点：提出将网络理论扩展（augmented network theory）用于超材料设计，突破传统超材料依赖规则结构以保持可处理性的局限，并指出超材料研究反过来也为网络科学开辟新方向。摘要未突出说明具体算法或实验验证细节。
papers.method_zh: 网络理论（network theory）结合几何与物理分析，辅以机器学习（machine learning）和先进自组装（advanced self-assembly）方法。

papers.title: Semilocal exchange functionals from the exact-exchange condition for the hydrogen atom: Hydrogenic exactness and recovery of Rydberg-like bound states
papers.abstract: In semilocal density functionals the exchange potential decays too rapidly outside atoms and molecules and lacks the correct $-1/r$ tail; as a consequence, functionals from PBE to modern meta-GGAs such as SCAN support no bound Rydberg-like state of an atom. We revisit the gradient-corrected exchange functional that Gill and Pople (GP93) constructed to reproduce the exact exchange potential of the hydrogen atom, solve their equation as an inverse problem, and use the resulting enhancement factor -- the GP93 factor -- as a tail-generating ingredient of a switched semilocal functional. The GP93 factor is exact on the hydrogen $1s$ density and, by uniform coordinate scaling, on hydrogenic $1s$ ions, where it yields the eigenvalue $-Z^2/2$ exactly (hydrogenic exactness). Its large-gradient growth has the hydrogen-exact form $O[s(\ln s)^{2/3}]$, distinct from the $s\ln s$ form of Armiento and Kümmel. The factor is combined with a kinetic-energy-density indicator so that its divergent branch acts only in one-electron-like regions; the GP93 ingredient is nonempirical, while a few switching parameters are calibrated to balance tail recovery against self-consistent-field stability. The resulting functional produces Rydberg-like series of bound virtual Kohn--Sham states in systems whose outermost shell is a one-electron-like $s$ shell -- all-electron H and He, and Li, Na, and K with large-core pseudopotentials -- and moves the highest-occupied eigenvalue toward the experimental ionization energy. For $p$-shell atoms (Ne, Ar) the switch closes, so the domain of applicability is fixed by design. Fixed-density tests indicate that a reduced-Laplacian switch distinguishes atomic tails from covalent bond centers, and that a density-only kinetic-energy functional renders the entire switch orbital-independent, so that no generalized Kohn--Sham solver is required.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“semilocal density functionals”、“exchange functional”、“inverse problem”、“enhancement factor”、“fixed-density tests”等，属于密度泛函理论（DFT）的泛函构造与测试。；研究对象：氢原子及其类氢离子（如H、He、Li、Na、K等）的交换势和Rydberg-like束缚态，以及半局域交换泛函在原子尾区的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过重新求解Gill和Pople（GP93）的方程，得到一种在氢原子1s密度上精确的增强因子（GP93因子），该因子具有氢原子精确的渐近行为，能够恢复传统半局域泛函（如PBE、SCAN）无法支持的Rydberg-like束缚态，并提高最高占据轨道本征值使其接近实验电离能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过重新求解Gill和Pople（GP93）的方程，得到一种在氢原子1s密度上精确的增强因子（GP93因子），该因子具有氢原子精确的渐近行为，能够恢复传统半局域泛函（如PBE、SCAN）无法支持的Rydberg-like束缚态，并提高最高占据轨道本征值使其接近实验电离能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用逆问题方法求解Gill和Pople的方程，构造基于GP93增强因子的交换泛函；结合动能密度指示器实现开关机制，使泛函仅在类单电子区域激活发散分支；通过均匀坐标缩放验证氢原子精确性；进行固定密度测试，使用约化拉普拉斯开关区分原子尾区和共价键中心，并引入纯密度动能泛函使开关不依赖轨道。

papers.title: DNA handles bias force-dependent looping times
papers.abstract: DNA loop formation is a key mechanism in gene regulation, and looping kinetics are sensitive to mechanical tension acting on the DNA. In both single-molecule experiments and biological settings, this tension is typically transmitted through DNA segments flanking the looping region, rather than acting directly at the looping sites. How this indirect force transmission affects the looping time has not been systematically investigated. Using molecular dynamics simulations of a wormlike chain, we show that such flanking segments significantly steepen the force dependence of the looping time, an effect that is insensitive to their length once it exceeds the persistence length, and vanishes when the junction to the looping region is made flexible. We develop an analytical framework that accounts for this effect through a force-dependent shift in the effective free energy landscape of the looping segment. In the limit of small forces, this shift reduces to a zero-force equilibrium average, after which the entire force dependence of the looping time follows analytically. Applying this framework using a coarse-grained DNA model that treats individual bases as rigid bodies, we obtain predictions in quantitative agreement with experimental looping data. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of force transmission has a significant and predictable effect on looping kinetics, with direct implications for the interpretation of tension-dependent looping in both single-molecule experiments and gene regulatory contexts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）、分析框架（analytical framework）、粗粒化DNA模型（coarse-grained DNA model）。；研究对象：DNA环形成动力学（DNA looping kinetics），特别是机械张力通过DNA侧翼片段间接传递对成环时间的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 侧翼DNA片段会显著增强成环时间对力的依赖性，且该效应在侧翼长度超过持久长度后不再敏感；当连接区域变得柔性时，该效应消失。通过力依赖的有效自由能景观偏移，可定量解释该效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：侧翼DNA片段会显著增强成环时间对力的依赖性，且该效应在侧翼长度超过持久长度后不再敏感；当连接区域变得柔性时，该效应消失。通过力依赖的有效自由能景观偏移，可定量解释该效应。；创新点：系统研究了间接力传递（而非直接作用于成环位点）对DNA成环时间的影响，揭示了侧翼片段几何结构对成环动力学的显著且可预测的作用，并建立了可定量解释实验数据的分析理论。
papers.method_zh: 蠕虫链模型（wormlike chain）的分子动力学模拟；基于力依赖有效自由能景观的分析理论框架；将单个碱基视为刚体的粗粒化DNA模型（coarse-grained DNA model）进行定量预测。

papers.title: Variational Learning with Sparse Long-range Entangling Gates
papers.abstract: The performance of variational quantum algorithms depends in general on the structure of the parametrized quantum circuit, but the most common ansätze are typically based on local couplings. Motivated by the extended connectivity available with neutral atoms and trapped ions, we examine when structured long-range connectivity provides a useful resource, focusing on sparse power-of-two (PWR2) coupling graphs. Using dynamical Lie-algebra analysis, approximate unitary-design diagnostics, and finite-depth measures of expressibility and entanglement, we examine how these geometries enlarge the accessible operator space. This enlarged space alone is not sufficient to ensure trainability of the parameterized circuit for given target problems, and we explore performance across example problems with and without long-range coupling, identifying where sparse coupling graphs are or are not likely to provide an advantage. We also introduce a variational scheme that maps hierarchical long-range Hamiltonians to geometrically local ones that can be optimized with short-range circuits. Together, these results identify circuit geometry and qubit reconfigurability as task-dependent resources for variational algorithms, relevant to ongoing developments in quantum hardware with long-range connectivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“dynamical Lie-algebra analysis”、“approximate unitary-design diagnostics”、“finite-depth measures”等理论分析工具，以及“variational scheme”等算法设计。；研究对象：变分量子算法（VQA）中参数化量子电路的几何结构，特别是稀疏长程纠缠门（如PWR2耦合图）对算法性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稀疏的长程连接（如PWR2图）可以扩大变分电路可访问的算子空间，但这本身并不保证电路的可训练性；长程连接是否提供优势取决于具体的目标问题。此外，作者提出了一种将层级长程哈密顿量映射为几何局域哈密顿量的变分方案，从而可用短程电路进行优化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稀疏的长程连接（如PWR2图）可以扩大变分电路可访问的算子空间，但这本身并不保证电路的可训练性；长程连接是否提供优势取决于具体的目标问题。此外，作者提出了一种将层级长程哈密顿量映射为几何局域哈密顿量的变分方案，从而可用短程电路进行优化。；创新点：系统性地识别了电路几何结构和量子比特可重构性作为变分算法的任务依赖性资源，并针对具有长程连接能力的量子硬件（如中性原子、离子阱）提供了具体的电路设计指导。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 使用动力学李代数分析、近似酉设计诊断、以及有限深度下的表达能力和纠缠度量等理论工具，系统比较了不同耦合图（包括长程和短程）的算子空间大小和电路性能。同时，引入了一种变分映射方案。

papers.title: Spin Textures and Eigenstate Evolution of Isospectrally Patterned Lattices
papers.abstract: Isospectrally patterned lattices exhibit a composite band structure with a tunable ratio of localized versus delocalized eigenstates that is controlled by the underlying phase gradient. We show that the lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field which is allowed to hop with a spin-flip across the lattice. In the low- and high-energy part of the band the localized states show an envelope of oscillatory character separated by quasi-nodes. Spin peaks occur at the locations of these quasi-nodes and provide a unique spin texture to the eigenstates which becomes increasingly complex with increasing degree of excitation. The crossover from localization to delocalization and vice versa leaves its fingerprints in the Fourier spectrum of the eigenstates: the original bimodal frequency distribution widens with increasing degree of excitation, moves across the spectral window and finally culminates in an extremely narrow frequency peak. In the course of this evolution the spin texture undergoes a rearrangement transition involving different characteristic (ir)regular patterns which we quantify by considering the total variation of the local spin fluctuations. Our results demonstrate the variety of the spectral properties of isospectrally patterned lattices which holds great prospect in particular when considering higher lattice or cell dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field”，并讨论能谱、本征态演化等理论分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：等谱图案化晶格（isospectrally patterned lattices）中的自旋织构与本征态演化，具体关注局域态与扩展态的比例可调性及其对应的自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等谱图案化晶格的本征态在低能和高能部分呈现振荡包络与准节点结构，自旋峰出现在准节点位置，形成独特的自旋织构；随着激发程度增加，本征态的傅里叶谱从双峰分布演化为极窄单峰，自旋织构经历从规则到不规则图案的重排转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等谱图案化晶格的本征态在低能和高能部分呈现振荡包络与准节点结构，自旋峰出现在准节点位置，形成独特的自旋织构；随着激发程度增加，本征态的傅里叶谱从双峰分布演化为极窄单峰，自旋织构经历从规则到不规则图案的重排转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将晶格哈密顿量映射为在旋转磁场中允许自旋翻转跳跃的单自旋模型，通过分析本征态的傅里叶谱和局部自旋波动的总变差来量化自旋织构的演化。

papers.title: Bayesian Learning of Distance Metrics Beyond RMSD for Biomolecule Alignment, Clustering, and Domain Identification
papers.abstract: Root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) is the standard metric of structural comparison in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. In its conventional form, RMSD assigns equal weight to all atoms regardless of mobility. Hence, flexible loops and disordered regions can dominate a global RMSD, while the rigid functional core contributes negligibly to the overall metric. To address this issue, we introduce the Bayes-optimal RMSD (BRMSD), which optimizes per-atom weights jointly with structural averages by maximizing a Bayesian posterior. In a trade-off between low RMSD and weight uniformity, a position-fluctuation parameter $σ$ controls the transition from classical RMSD ($σ\to \infty$) to a progressive focus on a rigid core ($σ\to 0$). The BRMSD framework supports analysis modules for structural alignment, focused alignment onto a user-specified domain, trajectory smoothing, soft $K$-means conformational clustering, and rigid-domain identification. These modules are implemented in the open-source Python package BRMSD (https://github.com/bio-phys/BRMSD) and benchmarked on two MD systems, the endoplasmic reticulum translocon-associated protein SND3 and the phosphotransferase adenylate kinase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian learning、maximizing a Bayesian posterior、open-source Python package。；研究对象：生物分子动力学（MD）模拟中的结构比较与对齐问题，具体体系为内质网转位子相关蛋白SND3和磷酸转移酶腺苷酸激酶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出贝叶斯最优RMSD（BRMSD）方法，通过优化每个原子的权重，解决了传统RMSD因对柔性区域和刚性核心赋予相同权重而导致的比对失真问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出贝叶斯最优RMSD（BRMSD）方法，通过优化每个原子的权重，解决了传统RMSD因对柔性区域和刚性核心赋予相同权重而导致的比对失真问题。；创新点：将贝叶斯学习引入生物分子结构比对的距离度量优化，实现了对刚性功能核心与柔性无序区域的差异化权重分配，克服了传统RMSD的固有缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 贝叶斯后验最大化方法，联合优化原子权重与结构平均；引入位置涨落参数σ控制从经典RMSD到刚性核心聚焦的过渡；开发了结构对齐、聚焦对齐、轨迹平滑、软K均值构象聚类和刚性域识别等分析模块，并在开源Python包BRMSD中实现。

papers.title: Rayleigh Bound States in the Continuum
papers.abstract: We predict a class of bound states in the continuum (BICs) in non-subwavelength periodic metasurfaces -- Rayleigh BICs -- that emerge precisely at Rayleigh anomalies, where diffraction channels open. In contrast to conventional symmetry-protected and accidental BICs, which are typically engineered in the subwavelength regime with only a few radiation channels, Rayleigh BICs remain nonradiating far beyond this limit, even when multiple diffraction channels are open. Their formation originates from the interplay between collective lattice resonances, Rayleigh anomalies, and anapole states of the constituent metaatoms. We show that Rayleigh BICs are characterized by an unusual cubic scaling of the quality factor in reciprocal space, ($Q \propto 1/k^3$), an asymptotic behavior that is not characteristic of either symmetry-protected or accidental BICs. Our results establish a constructive route for engineering nonradiating states in metasurfaces beyond the subwavelength regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：predict、formation originates from、show that、establish a constructive route。；研究对象：非亚波长周期性超表面中的连续谱束缚态（BIC），具体为一种新型的“瑞利BIC”，其出现在瑞利异常（衍射通道打开）处。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了一类在非亚波长周期性超表面中出现的瑞利BIC，其形成源于集体晶格共振、瑞利异常和组成超原子的环形偶极态之间的相互作用，且其品质因子在倒空间中呈现独特的立方标度（Q ∝ 1/k³）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了一类在非亚波长周期性超表面中出现的瑞利BIC，其形成源于集体晶格共振、瑞利异常和组成超原子的环形偶极态之间的相互作用，且其品质因子在倒空间中呈现独特的立方标度（Q ∝ 1/k³）。；创新点：首次提出并命名了“瑞利BIC”，揭示了其在多个衍射通道打开时仍能保持非辐射特性的机制，并发现了其不同于传统对称保护型或偶然型BIC的立方标度行为，为在亚波长极限之外设计超表面中的非辐射态提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与预测。通过分析集体晶格共振、瑞利异常与超原子环形偶极态的耦合机制，推导了瑞利BIC的形成条件及其品质因子的渐近标度行为。

papers.title: Scalar-Wave Dispersion in Vectorial Photonic Crystals via Site-Adapted p Orbitals
papers.abstract: Electromagnetic waves are intrinsically vectorial and require description via polarization, unlike scalar fields such as acoustic pressure or electronic wavefunctions. In three dimensions, the transversality constraint further prevents any globally smooth transverse-polarization frame at the $Γ$ point, which would apparently rule out a simple scalar band structure for three-dimensional (3D) photonic crystals. We show here that site-adapted $p$-orbitals can realize scalar-wave dispersion: the induced band representation is isomorphic to the scalar elementary band representation up to a one-dimensional character twist, so the symmetry-enforced degeneracies and compatibility relations are the same. We demonstrate this mechanism experimentally in 3D photonic meta-crystals, where the local $p$-orbital axes adapt from site to site according to symmetry. In contrast to a fixed-polarization reduction (e.g., in 2D), our construction preserves site-polarization textures while simultaneously supporting a scalar network with one amplitude per site. Thus, it offers a pathway from vectorial photonic degrees of freedom to scalar band engineering, keeping polarization as an active design knob.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论分析（“induced band representation is isomorphic...”），也有实验验证（“demonstrate this mechanism experimentally in 3D photonic meta-crystals”）。；研究对象：三维光子晶体中的电磁波传播，特别是矢量电磁波在光子晶体中实现标量波色散的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过使用位点适配的p轨道，可以在三维光子晶体中实现标量波色散，其诱导的能带表示与标量基本能带表示同构（仅差一维特征标扭转），从而具有相同的对称性强制简并和相容性关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过使用位点适配的p轨道，可以在三维光子晶体中实现标量波色散，其诱导的能带表示与标量基本能带表示同构（仅差一维特征标扭转），从而具有相同的对称性强制简并和相容性关系。；创新点：与固定偏振约化（如二维情况）不同，该构造在保持位点偏振织构的同时，支持每个位点单一振幅的标量网络，从而为从矢量光子自由度到标量能带工程提供了一条路径，并将偏振作为主动设计旋钮。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析采用能带表示理论（诱导能带表示与标量基本能带表示的对比）；实验上构建三维光子超晶体，其中局域p轨道轴根据对称性在位点间自适应排列。

papers.title: Interaction of vortex rings generated by two unsynchronised drop impacts
papers.abstract: A liquid drop falling into a deep pool can create a vortex ring at the right impact conditions. Such drop-formed vortex rings are of importance in nature and technology and the dynamics of rings created by single and synchronised double drop impacts have been extensively studied. In practice, two neighbouring drops rarely impact a liquid surface exactly at the same time, yet the interaction of two unsynchronised vortex rings have not been studied. Here, we have performed experiments with two water drops impacting a water pool at varying time differences $Δt$. By using particle image velocimetry, we have quantified the time-evolution of the resulting vortex rings. We find four distinct categories of vortex ring evolution depending on $Δt$. At $Δt<0.5$ ms, fully symmetric merging of the vortex rings occur. An unsynchronisation larger than this drastically influences the collision and merging, which either becomes asymmetric and incomplete ($0.5 < Δt<7$ ms) or does not happen at all ($Δt \geq 7$ ms). At $7 \leq Δt<80$ ms, the creation of the second vortex ring is impaired, whereas at $Δt\geq 80$ ms, the first impact no longer affects the formation of the second ring and eventually the two rings evolve without influencing each other. We show that these different regimes can be explained by the capillary waves created by the first droplet. Our results demonstrate the importance of the time difference between drop impacts in the creation and subsequent interaction of two adjacent drop-formed vortex rings, which is important for achieving uniform and controlled mixing in high-throughput applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experiments、particle image velocimetry、quantified。；研究对象：两个非同步液滴撞击水面后产生的涡环之间的相互作用，具体为水滴落入水池形成的涡环在不同时间差下的演化与合并行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个涡环的相互作用取决于撞击时间差Δt：Δt<0.5 ms时发生完全对称合并；0.5<Δt<7 ms时合并不对称且不完全；Δt≥7 ms时合并不发生；Δt≥80 ms时两个涡环互不影响。这些不同行为可由第一个液滴产生的毛细波解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个涡环的相互作用取决于撞击时间差Δt：Δt<0.5 ms时发生完全对称合并；0.5<Δt<7 ms时合并不对称且不完全；Δt≥7 ms时合并不发生；Δt≥80 ms时两个涡环互不影响。这些不同行为可由第一个液滴产生的毛细波解释。；创新点：首次系统研究了两个非同步液滴撞击产生的涡环之间的相互作用，揭示了时间差对涡环合并、形成及相互影响的决定性作用，并指出毛细波是导致不同演化模式的关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用两个水滴以不同时间差Δt撞击水池，利用粒子图像测速技术（PIV）定量测量涡环的时间演化。

papers.title: Reconnection diagnostics for vortex tangles in Bose-condensed and superfluid dark matter halos
papers.abstract: Bose-Einstein-condensed (BEC) and superfluid dark-matter (SFDM) halos can contain coherent, wave-supported cores whose angular momentum is carried by quantized vortices. When vortices form a tangle, reconnections convert part of the vortex kinetic energy into dark phonons, density waves, Kelvin waves, and vortex loops, providing a microscopic channel by which SFDM vortex structure can affect halo-core evolution. We estimate the dynamical importance of this channel by combining the local Gross-Pitaevskii reconnection law with a halo-scale vortex-line density calibrated against Schrödinger-Poisson simulations. In the minimal model the released energy stays in the dark sector, and standard-model luminosity requires additional portal physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“结合局域Gross-Pitaevskii重连定律与标度涡线密度”、“Schrödinger-Poisson模拟”等理论推导与数值模拟方法，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）暗物质晕与超流暗物质（SFDM）晕中的涡旋缠结及其重连动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 涡旋缠结中的重连过程可将部分涡旋动能转化为暗声子、密度波、开尔文波和涡旋环，为超流暗物质涡旋结构影响晕核演化提供微观能量耗散通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：涡旋缠结中的重连过程可将部分涡旋动能转化为暗声子、密度波、开尔文波和涡旋环，为超流暗物质涡旋结构影响晕核演化提供微观能量耗散通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合局域Gross-Pitaevskii重连定律与基于Schrödinger-Poisson模拟标定的晕尺度涡线密度，构建最小模型估算该能量通道的动力学重要性。

papers.title: Spontaneous patterning of cell size on curved surfaces
papers.abstract: Tissue surfaces exhibit complex curvature during embryogenesis and oncogenesis. Evidence shows that cells can actively sense curvature to regulate behavior and fate, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here, we develop a vertex model for arbitrary curved surfaces and uncover spontaneous cell size patterning on ellipsoidal surfaces: cells in high-curvature regions are consistently larger than those in low-curvature regions. This non-uniformity arises from a mechanical competition encoded in Riemannian geometry: positive Gaussian curvature reduces the perimeter-to-area ratio of polygonal cells, relaxing cell-edge tension in high-curvature regions, which is compensated by area expansion to maintain global force balance. This area pattern is robust against variations in model parameters and matches observations in biological systems. The perimeter pattern, in contrast, is governed by competition between the intrinsic geometric tendency and the deformation required by force balance, and undergoes reversal beyond a critical shape index. Together, these findings establish self-organized spatial variations in cell size as a potential physical mechanism for curvature sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：vertex model、Riemannian geometry、mechanical competition、force balance）；研究对象：弯曲表面上细胞尺寸的自发图案化，具体为椭球面上细胞大小随曲率变化的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在椭球曲面上，高曲率区域的细胞尺寸一致大于低曲率区域；这种非均匀性源于黎曼几何编码的力学竞争：正高斯曲率降低多边形细胞的周长-面积比，从而松弛高曲率区域的细胞边缘张力，并通过面积扩张补偿以维持全局力平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在椭球曲面上，高曲率区域的细胞尺寸一致大于低曲率区域；这种非均匀性源于黎曼几何编码的力学竞争：正高斯曲率降低多边形细胞的周长-面积比，从而松弛高曲率区域的细胞边缘张力，并通过面积扩张补偿以维持全局力平衡。；创新点：首次从几何-力学耦合角度（而非化学信号）提出细胞尺寸自组织图案作为曲率感知的潜在物理机制，并揭示了周长图案在临界形状指数处发生反转的竞争行为。
papers.method_zh: 发展了适用于任意弯曲表面的顶点模型（vertex model），结合黎曼几何分析细胞周长-面积比与曲率的关系，并通过力平衡条件推导细胞尺寸分布。

papers.title: Radiation Damage Cascades in Fullerite Using Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics is used to study radiation cascades in solid C60 under ambient conditions. Simulations are performed for Primary Knock-On Atom (PKA) energies from 0.1 to 1 keV, and cascades are sampled over many PKA directions to collect statistics. Energies and forces are described using the Environment Dependent Interaction Potential for carbon paired with the Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark potential for short-range interactions, and cascade behaviour is characterized by tracking kinetic energy, hybridization and bond connectivity as a function of time. Compared to most materials, fullerite exhibits an unusual radiation response due to weak thermal transfer between C60 molecules leading to a thermalization phase lasting hundreds of picoseconds. The cascades damage the C60 molecules and link them together, and a linear relation is found between the number of cross-linked molecules and the number of new sp3 atoms. The threshold displacement energy computed is 18 eV, in agreement with experiments
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Molecular dynamics（分子动力学）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：固体C60（富勒烯固体）在环境条件下的辐射损伤级联过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 富勒烯固体因C60分子间热传递弱，导致热化阶段持续数百皮秒；辐射损伤会破坏C60分子并使其交联，且交联分子数与新生成的sp3碳原子数呈线性关系；计算得到的位移阈值能为18 eV，与实验一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：富勒烯固体因C60分子间热传递弱，导致热化阶段持续数百皮秒；辐射损伤会破坏C60分子并使其交联，且交联分子数与新生成的sp3碳原子数呈线性关系；计算得到的位移阈值能为18 eV，与实验一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟，结合环境依赖相互作用势（EDIP）和Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark（ZBL）短程势描述碳原子间的能量与力；模拟初级撞击原子（PKA）能量范围为0.1至1 keV，并对多个PKA方向进行采样以收集统计；通过追踪动能、杂化状态和键连通性随时间的变化来表征级联行为。

papers.title: Invariant Measures for Soliton Systems Generated by Mealy Automata
papers.abstract: We study invariant measures for soliton systems described by Mealy automata. Motivated by recently introduced soliton models associated with 2-letter, 3-state Mealy automata, we formulate the time evolution induced by Mealy automata on bi-infinite configuration spaces. We provide sufficient conditions for the invariance of Bernoulli product measures and derive a criterion for the invariance of two-sided space-homogeneous Markov distributions. We then apply these general results to three soliton models, which can be interpreted as variants of the box-ball system (BBS). For two of these models, BBS-S(2) and BBS-V(2), we prove that Bernoulli product measures are invariant. For the remaining model, BBS-C(2), we establish a more general result: the invariance of two-sided space-homogeneous Markov distributions, which include Bernoulli product measures as a special case. Furthermore, for all three models, we compute the phase shift associated with the interaction of two solitons, as well as the velocity of an isolated soliton. Although the latter has already been studied previously, both quantities constitute fundamental characteristics for understanding the generalized hydrodynamics of these systems. These results provide a foundation for the study of invariant measures, generalized Gibbs ensembles, and generalized hydrodynamic behavior in Mealy-automaton soliton systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究不变测度”“推导判据”“计算相移和速度”等理论分析内容，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：由Mealy自动机生成的孤子系统，特别是与盒-球系统（BBS）相关的三种变体模型：BBS-S(2)、BBS-V(2)和BBS-C(2)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于BBS-S(2)和BBS-V(2)模型，证明了伯努利乘积测度是时间演化下的不变测度；对于BBS-C(2)模型，证明了更一般的双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布（包含伯努利乘积测度作为特例）是不变测度。此外，计算了所有三种模型中两个孤子相互作用的相移以及孤立孤子的速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于BBS-S(2)和BBS-V(2)模型，证明了伯努利乘积测度是时间演化下的不变测度；对于BBS-C(2)模型，证明了更一般的双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布（包含伯努利乘积测度作为特例）是不变测度。此外，计算了所有三种模型中两个孤子相互作用的相移以及孤立孤子的速度。；创新点：将不变测度理论系统性地推广到由Mealy自动机生成的孤子系统中，为理解这类系统的广义吉布斯系综和广义流体动力学行为提供了数学基础。摘要未突出说明与已有BBS模型不变测度研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用Mealy自动机描述孤子系统的时间演化，在双无限位形空间上定义动力学。通过数学推导给出伯努利乘积测度不变性的充分条件，以及双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布不变性的判据，并将这些一般结果应用于三个具体的孤子模型。

papers.title: Anyon-induced non-Hermitian topological phases
papers.abstract: We show that anyonic exchange statistics can activate non-Hermitian point-gap topology in models that are topologically trivial in its absence. The emergent topology oscillates more rapidly with the statistical phase as the anyon number increases, and exhibits a parity dependence on the particle number. A perturbative analysis reveals the mechanism: fractional statistics induces a mismatch between momentum terms that, combined with sublattice-dependent dissipation, produces particle-number-dependent non-reciprocity and complex spectral winding. As these effects rely on the formation and exchange of interaction-bound anyons, our results establish exchange statistics as a resource for enabling non-Hermitian topology under programmed dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、analysis、reveals、establish。；研究对象：任意子（anyon）交换统计诱导的非厄米拓扑相，具体涉及任意子统计相位、非厄米点隙拓扑、粒子数依赖的拓扑行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任意子交换统计可以激活原本拓扑平庸模型中的非厄米点隙拓扑，且该拓扑随统计相位振荡的频率随任意子数增加而加快，并表现出对粒子数的奇偶依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任意子交换统计可以激活原本拓扑平庸模型中的非厄米点隙拓扑，且该拓扑随统计相位振荡的频率随任意子数增加而加快，并表现出对粒子数的奇偶依赖。；创新点：首次提出交换统计可作为在程序化耗散下实现非厄米拓扑的物理资源，而非仅依赖传统非厄米哈密顿量设计。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰分析方法，揭示分数统计导致动量项失配，结合子格依赖的耗散，产生粒子数依赖的非互易性和复能谱缠绕。

papers.title: Explaining the magnitude of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity via electron-electron exchange
papers.abstract: Chiral molecular structure can couple to electron spin, leading to unexpected spin polarization effects. This Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) was first reported for DNA molecules adsorbed on gold but its microscopic origin remains unclear. We demonstrated though simulation that the exchange arising from electron-electron Coulomb interactions within the self-consistent mean field (Hartree--Fock) approximation can yield significant ($\sim 2\%$) spin polarisation for $3$-methylcyclohexanone adsorbed on Cu(111) amplifying a much smaller ($\sim 0.0014\%$) initial bias, consistent with experiment. Symmetry considerations ensure the result is physically meaningful, while its ab-initio nature ensures all parameters are physically realistic. This amplification is connected to existing studies on spin-symmetry breaking in Hartree--Fock, providing a new pathway for understanding the magnitude of CISS as an emergent phenomenon of interacting electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：simulation、Hartree--Fock approximation、ab-initio。；研究对象：手性分子吸附体系：3-甲基环己酮（3-methylcyclohexanone）吸附在Cu(111)表面，以及其中由手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应产生的自旋极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自洽平均场（Hartree-Fock）近似中的电子-电子库仑交换相互作用，可以将初始极小的自旋偏置（约0.0014%）放大为显著的自旋极化（约2%），从而解释CISS效应的量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自洽平均场（Hartree-Fock）近似中的电子-电子库仑交换相互作用，可以将初始极小的自旋偏置（约0.0014%）放大为显著的自旋极化（约2%），从而解释CISS效应的量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于自洽平均场近似的Hartree-Fock方法进行从头算（ab-initio）模拟，通过电子-电子库仑交换相互作用模拟自旋极化的放大过程。

papers.title: A "squeezed polaron" variational wavefunction for the spin boson model
papers.abstract: The localization transition of the sub-Ohmic spin-boson model generates boson bath correlations that are, at low frequencies, analytically inaccessible to standard coherent-state-polaron variational ansatzes. In this paper, we introduce a ``squeezed polaron'' wavefunction incorporating generic Gaussian boson-boson correlations induced by the spin impurity. This gives the correct critical power-law scaling of bath observables near the localization transition together with a systematically improved ground state energy and a more accurate determination of the critical coupling. Our wavefunction captures the correct mean-field nature of the transition in the deep sub-Ohmic region. It also displays non-mean-field critical exponents in the shallow sub-Ohmic regime. Using the squeezed polaron as a starting point, we derive scattering phase shifts for bosons, and show how they encode the emergent energy scale that vanishes at the localization transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“变分波函数”、“推导散射相移”等理论方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型中的局域化相变，以及该相变过程中玻色子浴产生的关联效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文提出的“压缩极化子”变分波函数能够正确捕捉亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型在局域化相变附近的临界幂律标度行为，并给出更精确的临界耦合强度，同时在浅亚欧姆区域展现出非平均场的临界指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文提出的“压缩极化子”变分波函数能够正确捕捉亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型在局域化相变附近的临界幂律标度行为，并给出更精确的临界耦合强度，同时在浅亚欧姆区域展现出非平均场的临界指数。；创新点：该工作引入的“压缩极化子”波函数超越了标准相干态极化子变分法，能够解析地处理亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型在低频下产生的玻色子浴关联，从而正确描述局域化相变的临界行为。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个包含由自旋杂质诱导的通用高斯型玻色子-玻色子关联的“压缩极化子”变分波函数。以此为基础，推导了玻色子的散射相移，并分析了相变中消失的涌现能量标度。

papers.title: Universal spin-squeezing dynamics in spinor condensates
papers.abstract: The production of large-scale entangled states is one of the main goals of next-generation quantum technologies, with an immediate potential for applications in the context of entanglement-assisted quantum sensing. A very promising platform to achieve this goal is offered by ultracold spinor gases, made of atoms with a large internal spin sensitive to magnetic fields. Here we show that the native spin-changing collisions in a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate, combined with an arbitrary quadratic Zeeman shift, can generate scalable spin squeezing in the collective spin of the ensemble, following the universal paradigm of the celebrated one-axis-twisting model. Squeezing dynamics is driven by the quadratic Zeeman shift when this shift is small; and by the spin-changing collisions for large shifts, in the form of stroboscopic squeezing. Turning off the Zeeman shift freezes out the collective-spin dynamics, so that the ensuing collective spin dynamics can be uniquely governed by an external field to be sensed. Our theoretical results pave the way for the use of spinor Bose gases with a large spin in fundamental studies of entanglement, as well as in advanced metrological applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Here we show”、“Our theoretical results”等表述，未提及具体实验操作或数值计算，主要进行理论推导和预测。；研究对象：旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（spinor Bose-Einstein condensate）中的集体自旋压缩动力学。具体体系为由具有大内禀自旋的原子组成的超冷旋量气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋改变碰撞与任意二次塞曼位移相结合，可以遵循单轴扭曲模型的普适范式，产生可扩展的集体自旋压缩。压缩动力学由二次塞曼位移（小位移时）或自旋改变碰撞（大位移时，以频闪压缩形式）驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋改变碰撞与任意二次塞曼位移相结合，可以遵循单轴扭曲模型的普适范式，产生可扩展的集体自旋压缩。压缩动力学由二次塞曼位移（小位移时）或自旋改变碰撞（大位移时，以频闪压缩形式）驱动。；创新点：揭示了旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋压缩动力学遵循单轴扭曲模型的普适范式，并阐明了二次塞曼位移在驱动压缩（小位移）和冻结动力学（关闭位移）中的双重作用，为利用大自旋旋量玻色气体进行纠缠研究和精密测量铺平了道路。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中本征的自旋改变碰撞，并结合二次塞曼位移，利用单轴扭曲模型（one-axis-twisting model）这一普适理论框架进行分析。

papers.title: Hydrogen-Bond Donor-Acceptor Imbalance in Low-Frequency Terahertz Water Spectra
papers.abstract: The low-frequency dielectric response of liquid water is commonly described by a dominant Debye relaxation together with additional faster contributions whose microscopic origin remains debated. Here we show that the dielectric function of water between 0.14 and 1.21 THz can be represented by a collective Debye relaxation plus a Drude-Smith term constrained to the zero-dc-conductivity limit. The Drude-Smith spectral weight increases upon heating pure H2O from 20 C to 50 C and decreases upon isotopic substitution (D2O at 20 C vs. H2O at 20 C). Molecular dynamics simulations including nuclear quantum effects show correlated changes in the population of water molecules with unequal numbers of donated and accepted hydrogen-bonds. Ab-initio-based spectra calculations further indicate that the ~0.1-1 THz response contains both nuclear-motion and explicit electronic-polarisation/charge-redistribution contributions. We therefore interpret the excess low-frequency THz response as a localised, mixed nuclear-electronic dielectric response correlated with transient donor-acceptor imbalance in the hydrogen-bond network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：实验测量（介电函数）、分子动力学模拟、基于第一性原理的谱计算。；研究对象：液态水在0.14–1.21 THz低频太赫兹波段的介电响应，特别是氢键网络中供体-受体不平衡相关的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水的低频太赫兹介电响应可由一个集体德拜弛豫加上一个受限于零直流电导极限的Drude-Smith项描述，该额外响应与氢键网络中瞬时的供体-受体不平衡相关，是一种局域的混合核-电子介电响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水的低频太赫兹介电响应可由一个集体德拜弛豫加上一个受限于零直流电导极限的Drude-Smith项描述，该额外响应与氢键网络中瞬时的供体-受体不平衡相关，是一种局域的混合核-电子介电响应。；创新点：将低频太赫兹响应中的额外贡献归因于氢键供体-受体不平衡导致的局域混合核-电子极化，而非传统认为的单一弛豫过程。摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹介电函数测量（0.14–1.21 THz）、分子动力学模拟（包含核量子效应）、基于第一性原理的谱计算。

papers.title: Universal purification dynamics of monitored Clifford circuits
papers.abstract: Quantum circuits under sufficiently weak monitoring purify on a timescale $T_P$ exponentially long in the system size. This slowness underlies a universal purification dynamics, whose quantitative description has so far required the replica trick, with a delicate analytic continuation. We show that monitored Clifford circuits on $L$ qudits of prime dimension $q$ bypass this construction entirely: in the scaling limit at fixed $x = t/T_P(L)$, purification reduces to the Markovian decay of the density-matrix rank, an exactly solvable death process descending from infinity. We compute the full scaling functions in compact form: all Rényi entropies collapse onto a universal curve $\langle S(x) \rangle$. Exact stabilizer simulations at $q=2,3,5$ confirm the predictions, with no fitting parameter for the global model and $T_P$ as the only fitted scale for local brick-wall circuits. Also, the replica problem amounts to a tilted version of the same Markov process, in agreement with exact computations from the Clifford commutant. Finally, the quantization of the rank leaves two hallmarks that distinguish Clifford dynamics from generic monitored circuits: the entropy fluctuations saturate at short scaled times $x\to0$ to an $O(1)$ variance, instead of vanishing, and observables develop a temporal modulation periodic in $\log_q x$, which cannot be captured by the replica approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“bypass this construction entirely”“exactly solvable death process”“exact stabilizer simulations”等理论推导与数值验证关键词。；研究对象：受监测的Clifford量子电路（monitored Clifford circuits）在系统尺寸L下的纯化动力学（purification dynamics），具体为qudit（素数维度q）上的随机Clifford电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标度极限下，纯化过程退化为密度矩阵秩的马尔可夫衰变（一种从无穷远处开始的精确可解死亡过程），所有Rényi熵坍缩到一条普适曲线⟨S(x)⟩上。此外，秩的量子化导致两个区别于一般监测电路的标志性特征：熵涨落在短标度时间下饱和为O(1)方差，以及可观测量出现周期为log_q x的时间调制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标度极限下，纯化过程退化为密度矩阵秩的马尔可夫衰变（一种从无穷远处开始的精确可解死亡过程），所有Rényi熵坍缩到一条普适曲线⟨S(x)⟩上。此外，秩的量子化导致两个区别于一般监测电路的标志性特征：熵涨落在短标度时间下饱和为O(1)方差，以及可观测量出现周期为log_q x的时间调制。；创新点：首次绕过复制品方法中复杂的解析延拓，直接证明Clifford电路的纯化动力学可简化为一个精确可解的马尔可夫死亡过程，并给出所有Rényi熵的完整标度函数。同时揭示了秩量子化带来的两个无法被复制品方法捕捉的独特现象（熵涨落饱和与对数周期调制）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析采用标度极限下的马尔可夫死亡过程模型；数值模拟采用精确稳定子模拟（exact stabilizer simulations），针对q=2,3,5的Clifford电路进行验证，全局模型无拟合参数，局域砖墙电路仅拟合T_P一个标度。同时利用Clifford交换子（Clifford commutant）进行精确计算，并与复制品方法（replica trick）的结果进行对比。

papers.title: Spin singlets are useful
papers.abstract: We evaluate the utility of the spin-zero manifold of an exchange-coupled array of $N$ spins for tasks in quantum computation and quantum simulation. Since pairs of electrons can be readily initialized into a product state of singlets in semiconducting quantum dot arrays, the full spin-zero manifold is available with exchange-only control, providing a Hilbert space of approximate dimension $2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}$, asymptotically close to the $2^N$ dimension of the full spin Hilbert space. Leveraging the spin-zero manifold enables larger computational space in a given array compared to traditional exchange-only control, in which spin arrays are organized into modular units of $n$ spins comprising $N/n$ encoded qubits, limiting to the exponentially smaller Hilbert dimension $2^{N/n}$. Here we focus on benchmarking metrics for this resource utilization by generalizing cross-entropy benchmarking, mirror benchmarking, and out-of-time-ordered correlators to this system. We show that operating in the spin-zero manifold can accelerate the realization of computational quantum advantage applications in semiconductor-based spin qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“evaluate the utility”“generalizing cross-entropy benchmarking”等理论分析术语，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：半导体量子点阵列中自旋单态流形（spin-zero manifold）在量子计算与量子模拟中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用自旋单态流形进行交换控制，可在给定自旋阵列中获得接近全自旋希尔伯特空间维度的计算空间（渐近维度约 \(2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}\)），相比传统交换控制（仅编码 \(N/n\) 个量子比特，维度 \(2^{N/n}\)）显著提升资源利用率，从而加速半导体自旋量子比特实现计算量子优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用自旋单态流形进行交换控制，可在给定自旋阵列中获得接近全自旋希尔伯特空间维度的计算空间（渐近维度约 \(2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}\)），相比传统交换控制（仅编码 \(N/n\) 个量子比特，维度 \(2^{N/n}\)）显著提升资源利用率，从而加速半导体自旋量子比特实现计算量子优势。；创新点：提出并量化了在自旋阵列中直接利用整个自旋零流形（而非将其分割为模块化编码量子比特）进行量子计算的优势，并为此类非传统编码方式建立了基准测试框架。
papers.method_zh: 通过推广交叉熵基准测试（cross-entropy benchmarking）、镜像基准测试（mirror benchmarking）以及时序外关联函数（out-of-time-ordered correlators）来评估自旋单态流形的资源利用指标。

papers.title: Localized Thermometry via Dayem Bridges Integrated on Superconducting Qubit Chips
papers.abstract: Accurate knowledge of the on-chip temperature is essential for understanding and optimizing the performance of superconducting qubits, yet direct thermometry at millikelvin temperatures remains challenging. While qubits themselves are sensitive to the temperature of their environment, other factors may affect the qubits` effective temperature, and using them as thermometers with any accuracy requires specialized measurement protocols and qubit designs, limiting their practicality for routine diagnostics and adding complex infrastructure to any hardware testing apparatus. Here we demonstrate a complementary on-chip thermometry method based on superconducting Dayem bridges that are integrated on the same chip as transmon qubits. By extracting the critical current of the Dayem bridge from I-V measurements, we obtain a local, quantitative measure of the chip temperature without the need for microwave calibration or qubit-specific control sequences. To demonstrate the utility of the Dayem bridges as thermometers, we fabricate them in-situ with qubits on the same chip, calibrate the Dayem bridge critical current as a function of temperature, and characterize its resolution and stability at cryogenic temperatures. We additionally perform simultaneous measurements of the Dayem bridge thermometer and qubit excited-state population, and show agreement over the relevant temperature range, validating the method against established qubit thermometry. Furthermore, we correlate the independently measured chip temperature with qubit energy relaxation and dephasing times, demonstrating the utility of this approach for diagnosing temperature-dependent decoherence mechanisms. These results establish integrated Dayem bridges as a simple, non-invasive, and scalable tool for cryogenic hardware development, and on chip thermometry in superconducting quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件制备、I-V测量、校准、同时测量等实验操作。；研究对象：集成在超导量子比特芯片上的Dayem桥（Dayem bridges），用于芯片局部温度测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量Dayem桥的临界电流，可以在无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列的情况下，获得芯片上局部的、定量的温度信息，并与量子比特激发态布居数测量结果一致，验证了该方法的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量Dayem桥的临界电流，可以在无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列的情况下，获得芯片上局部的、定量的温度信息，并与量子比特激发态布居数测量结果一致，验证了该方法的有效性。；创新点：提出并验证了一种基于Dayem桥的片上温度测量方法，该方法简单、非侵入、可扩展，无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列，适用于超导量子电路的常规诊断和低温硬件开发。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：在芯片上原位制备Dayem桥与transmon量子比特；通过I-V特性曲线提取Dayem桥的临界电流；校准临界电流随温度的变化关系；同时测量Dayem桥温度计与量子比特激发态布居数；将独立测量的芯片温度与量子比特能量弛豫时间（T1）和退相干时间（T2）进行关联分析。

papers.title: Monodromy defects in Chern-Simons theory and Holography
papers.abstract: Wilson loop operators in Chern-Simons theory have revealed profound links between quantum field theory, the fractional quantum Hall effect, topology, conformal field theory, and string theory. In Chern-Simons theories with charge conjugation symmetry, we construct a new class of observables: codimension-two monodromy defects around which fields return to themselves up to charge conjugation. Whereas Wilson loops are labeled by integrable representations of an untwisted affine Lie algebra, monodromy defects are labeled by those of the corresponding twisted affine algebra. The modular and fusion data of these two algebras determine the exact correlation functions of Wilson lines and monodromy defects, which together furnish a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-crossed braided tensor category. The spectrum of line defects in Chern-Simons theory thus gives a physical realization of every algebra in Kac's classification of affine Lie algebras: untwisted for Wilson loops, twisted for monodromy defects. We also determine the exact 't Hooft expansion of monodromy defects in $SU(N)_k$ Chern-Simons theory and identify their holographic duals in topological string theory. The insertion of the lightest monodromy defect has a striking effect: it replaces the resolved conifold background of the Gopakumar-Vafa duality by a specific orientifold of the resolved conifold, transmuting the dual theory of oriented strings into one of unoriented strings. Each excited monodromy defect is then realized as a collection of branes in the orientifold background, with the brane content determined by the representation of the twisted affine algebra that labels the defect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Chern-Simons theory, holography, topological string theory, 代数分类。；研究对象：Chern-Simons理论中的单值性缺陷（monodromy defects），及其与全息对偶、拓扑弦理论的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有电荷共轭对称性的Chern-Simons理论中，构造了一类新的可观测对象——余维二单值性缺陷，其由扭仿射李代数的可积表示标记，与Wilson环（由未扭仿射李代数标记）共同构成Z₂交叉辫张量范畴。最轻单值性缺陷的插入将Gopakumar-Vafa对偶中的解构锥背景替换为其特定定向化，使对偶理论从定向弦转变为非定向弦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有电荷共轭对称性的Chern-Simons理论中，构造了一类新的可观测对象——余维二单值性缺陷，其由扭仿射李代数的可积表示标记，与Wilson环（由未扭仿射李代数标记）共同构成Z₂交叉辫张量范畴。最轻单值性缺陷的插入将Gopakumar-Vafa对偶中的解构锥背景替换为其特定定向化，使对偶理论从定向弦转变为非定向弦。；创新点：首次在Chern-Simons理论中引入并系统构造了由电荷共轭对称性定义的单值性缺陷，揭示了其与扭仿射李代数的一一对应关系，并建立了该缺陷在拓扑弦全息对偶中的具体几何实现（将解构锥替换为其定向化）。
papers.method_zh: 利用共形场论中的模与融合数据精确计算Wilson线和单值性缺陷的关联函数；通过SU(N)_k Chern-Simons理论的't Hooft展开确定单值性缺陷的精确展开式；在全息对偶框架下，将缺陷映射为拓扑弦理论中的定向化背景和膜构型。

papers.title: Effective Field Theories for Material Media
papers.abstract: We review recent progress in understanding certain aspects of condensed matter systems from a high energy theory perspective. We discuss effective field theories that describe collective bulk and localized excitations in a variety of solid and fluid systems. Particular emphasis is placed on the role played by spacetime symmetries and their spontaneous breaking. The resulting Goldstone dynamics can be seen as underlying a wide variety of phenomena. We attempt to bridge the language gap between subfields while underscoring the numerous conceptual similarities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review、effective field theories、high energy theory perspective、spacetime symmetries、Goldstone dynamics。；研究对象：凝聚态物质系统，包括固体和流体中的集体体激发与局域激发，以及相关的有效场论描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时空对称性及其自发破缺在凝聚态系统的有效场论中起核心作用，由此产生的戈德斯通动力学可解释多种物理现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时空对称性及其自发破缺在凝聚态系统的有效场论中起核心作用，由此产生的戈德斯通动力学可解释多种物理现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用高能理论视角，构建有效场论框架，分析固体和流体系统中集体激发与局域激发的对称性破缺与戈德斯通模式。

papers.title: Fingerprint, Not Blueprint: How Positional Schemes Set the Default Spectral Algebra of Attention
papers.abstract: The pre-softmax score of an attention head is a bilinear form $score(i,j) = x_i^T M x_j$ in a learned operator $M = W_q^T W_k$. Because M is generally non-symmetric, hence non-normal, it has a complex eigenspectrum and non-orthogonal eigenvectors, the regime where non-Hermitian and random-matrix tools apply. We ask what this spectrum encodes, at three levels for previous-token and induction circuits. Statically, across seven pretrained models spanning three positional schemes, the strongest previous-token heads are spectrally rotational under RoPE and non-rotational, or content-like, where position enters outside QK (learned-absolute and ALiBi); the model-level separation is perfect at every top-k examined (exact permutation $p=0.029$), and zeroing the per-frequency RoPE phase $Im(M_t)$ eliminates induction on a pre-identified previous-token head in all three RoPE models. Dynamically, over public Pythia checkpoints every head originates at the random-matrix (Ginibre) null; the rotational signature emerges with the behavior, not before it, and the population-median suppression that yields the final profile follows circuit formation, so the profile is a consolidated fingerprint, not a precursor. Causally, and at toy scale, no spectral channel is necessary: constrained two-layer training reroutes around every ban with capability intact, albeit at a significant formation delay (four pre-registered contrasts, $q_BH <= 0.016$). The cost structure exposes each scheme's default: imposing symmetry slows learned-absolute models by a factor of 2.9, whereas a RoPE head with a fully symmetric static M still routes directionally via the phase channel, impossible under absolute positions. Within the settings examined, the positional scheme sets the default spectral algebra of an attention head's solution: a fingerprint sculpted after function, not a hard constraint upon it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“随机矩阵工具”、“谱分析”、“因果干预”、“玩具模型训练”等关键词，主要依赖理论分析和数值模拟，而非实验测量。；研究对象：论文研究的是Transformer注意力机制中，**位置编码方案**（如RoPE、绝对位置编码、ALiBi）如何影响注意力头（attention head）的**谱代数性质**（即QK矩阵M的特征谱与特征向量结构），以及这种影响与注意力头功能（如前词元回溯、归纳头）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位置编码方案设定了注意力头解决方案的“默认谱代数”，即注意力头的谱特征（如旋转性）是功能形成后留下的“指纹”，而非功能形成的“蓝图”（硬性约束）。具体而言，RoPE下的强前词元回溯头呈现谱旋转性，而绝对位置编码和ALiBi下的则不然；且没有任何一个谱通道是功能所必需的，模型可以通过重新路由绕过对特定谱通道的抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位置编码方案设定了注意力头解决方案的“默认谱代数”，即注意力头的谱特征（如旋转性）是功能形成后留下的“指纹”，而非功能形成的“蓝图”（硬性约束）。具体而言，RoPE下的强前词元回溯头呈现谱旋转性，而绝对位置编码和ALiBi下的则不然；且没有任何一个谱通道是功能所必需的，模型可以通过重新路由绕过对特定谱通道的抑制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：1. 将非厄米矩阵和随机矩阵理论系统性地应用于分析注意力机制的谱性质。2. 揭示了位置编码方案是决定注意力头“默认”谱代数的关键因素，并区分了“指纹”（功能形成后的结果）与“蓝图”（功能形成的先决条件）的概念。3. 通过因果干预和受控训练，证明了谱结构的功能可塑性，即模型可以绕过特定的谱约束。
papers.method_zh: 1. **谱分析**：计算并分析不同位置编码方案下，预训练模型中注意力头QK矩阵M的特征值谱和特征向量非正交性。2. **随机矩阵理论**：将注意力头初始状态与Ginibre系综（随机矩阵）的零假设进行对比。3. **因果干预**：通过将特定频率的RoPE相位（Im(M_t)）置零，观察对归纳头功能的影响。4. **受控训练实验**：在玩具尺度下，通过预先设定的对比实验（如禁止特定谱通道），训练两层Transformer，观察模型是否以及如何绕过这些约束。

papers.title: Polyconvexity does not imply true-stress-true-strain monotonicity in the incompressible three-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We study constitutive conditions of hyperelastic potentials for incompressible material behavior in three dimensions. By means of a counterexample, we show that polyconvexity does not imply true-stress-true-strain monotonicity. Thus, polyconvexity alone is not strong enough to guarantee a physically reasonable response for idealized elasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“constitutive conditions”、“counterexample”、“polyconvexity”、“true-stress-true-strain monotonicity”。；研究对象：不可压缩超弹性材料在三维情况下的本构关系，具体研究多凸性（polyconvexity）与真实应力-真实应变单调性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过反例证明，在三维不可压缩情况下，超弹性势的多凸性并不蕴含真实应力-真实应变单调性。因此，仅凭多凸性不足以保证理想弹性材料的物理合理性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过反例证明，在三维不可压缩情况下，超弹性势的多凸性并不蕴含真实应力-真实应变单调性。因此，仅凭多凸性不足以保证理想弹性材料的物理合理性响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过构造反例（counterexample）进行逻辑论证，未涉及具体实验或数值计算手段。

papers.title: 2D Transport in an in-plane magnetic field
papers.abstract: A parallel in-plane magnetic field could, in principle, distinguish between two competing physical scenarios for the experimentally observed density-tuned 2D metal-insulator transition (where decreasing the carrier density leads to a crossover from an effective metal to an effective insulator): Wigner crystallization or Anderson localization. Since the main scattering mechanism in 2D doped semiconductors arises from screened random charged impurities and screening in turn depends on the electronic density of states, the in-plane magnetic field could distinguish between the two by decreasing screening through spin polarization and this enhances the effective critical density for Anderson localization compared with Wigner crystallization. We give the general theory and provide results for the quantitative magnitudes of the spin polarization effect on the transition density by focusing on two recent experiments [Z. Ge, et al, arXiv:2510.12009, T. Han, et al, arXiv:2604.00113], noting that the critical density may actually decrease if the dominant scattering is by short-ranged defects instead of long-ranged charged impurities. The difference between the two cases arises from whether spin polarization dominates screening (enhanced critical density) or the Fermi surface (suppressed critical density).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“general theory”、“provide results for the quantitative magnitudes”、“focusing on two recent experiments”（理论分析结合实验数据）。；研究对象：二维掺杂半导体中由载流子密度调控的金属-绝缘体转变（2D metal-insulator transition），具体涉及维格纳结晶（Wigner crystallization）与安德森局域化（Anderson localization）两种竞争物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 面内磁场可通过自旋极化降低屏蔽效应，从而增强安德森局域化的临界密度，这与维格纳结晶的临界密度变化趋势不同，因此可用于区分两种机制。但若主导散射为短程缺陷而非长程带电杂质，临界密度可能反而下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：面内磁场可通过自旋极化降低屏蔽效应，从而增强安德森局域化的临界密度，这与维格纳结晶的临界密度变化趋势不同，因此可用于区分两种机制。但若主导散射为短程缺陷而非长程带电杂质，临界密度可能反而下降。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于屏蔽随机带电杂质散射理论，分析自旋极化对电子态密度和屏蔽效应的影响，定量计算自旋极化对转变密度的修正，并对比两个近期实验（arXiv:2510.12009 和 arXiv:2604.00113）的数据。

papers.title: Half state at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2 and its transition in Decoupled Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: The origin of the fractional state at $ν$ = 1/2 observed in double-layer quantum Hall systems has been under debate for decades. Because of the variation of bilayer charge distribution and interlayer tunneling strength, the half-filling state can be attributed to a two-component(2C) or a one-component(1C) origin, which corresponds to Halperin state and Pffafian state, respectively. Here we report the magnetotransport measurement in decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene(TDBG), which has been proved to be a promising platform for double quantum Hall system. Fractional quantum hall states in both odd and even denominator fillings are observed. We also found that the half-filling state occurs at zero displacement field at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2, which is theoretically consistent with two-component Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331) state. Moreover, we report the transition from two-component state at zero D field to one-component non-Abelian state by tunning displacement field. Our observation of the half filling state and its transition from 2C to 1C state provides the tunability of decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene and shed light on the understanding of the ground states at half-filling factor in the double quantum Hall system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magnetotransport measurement（磁输运测量）、observed（观测）、report（报告）。；研究对象：解耦扭曲双层石墨烯（decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene, TDBG）中的半填充分数量子霍尔态，具体为总填充因子ν_tot = -1/2处的态及其电场调控下的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零位移场下，ν_tot = -1/2处的半填充态为双组分Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331)态；通过调节位移场，该态可转变为单组分的非阿贝尔态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零位移场下，ν_tot = -1/2处的半填充态为双组分Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331)态；通过调节位移场，该态可转变为单组分的非阿贝尔态。；创新点：在解耦扭曲双层石墨烯这一双量子霍尔系统平台中，首次实验观测到半填充态从双组分到单组分的电场可调转变，为理解双层量子霍尔系统中半填充基态的本质提供了新的可调谐实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 磁输运测量（magnetotransport measurement），通过调节位移场（displacement field）研究分数量子霍尔态及其转变。

papers.title: Multi-Knob Switchable Chiral Superconductivity Quartet in Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: Chiral superconductors break orbital time-reversal symmetry and may host topological quasiparticles with non-Abelian statistics. In rhombohedral graphene, superconductivity develops from a spin-valley-polarized quarter-metal (QM) parent state and features unique magnetic hysteresis of resistance that indicates orbital time-reversal-symmetry-breaking. Exploring and controlling the full spin-valley flavors of such superconductivity could enable novel superconducting and topological devices, but have remained unexplored. Here we report transport measurements on rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (R6G), which reveal a new superconducting state (SCH) that is induced by an out-of-plane magnetic field, in addition to chiral superconductivity (CSC) similar to those observed in thinner layers. This SCH state emerges above 0.8 T, persists up to 1.6 T and can be switched on/off by magnetic field $H_\perp$, carrier density $n$, and gate displacement field $D$. Quantum oscillations and anomalous Hall measurements show that SCH stems from a field-induced quarter-metal (QM$'$) parent phase, which carries orbital magnetization opposite to that of the zero-field QM. Across the full $(n, D, H_\perp)$ parameter space, superconductivity can be realized from all four spin-valley isospin flavors, establishing a switchable chiral-superconductor quartet in R6G. We interpret the parent-state switching as arising from competition between a Kane-Mele-like spin-valley splitting and magnetic-field coupling to spin-valley-dependent magnetic moments. Our work establishes rhombohedral graphene as a multi-knob platform for different isospin-polarized superconductivities, which enables programmable superconducting networks with possible Majorana modes along domain walls.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we report transport measurements”（我们报告输运测量），并描述了量子振荡和反常霍尔测量等具体实验手段。；研究对象：菱方六层石墨烯（R6G）中的可调控手性超导态。具体研究了由不同自旋-谷极化（isospin）的母体相（quarter-metal）诱导的超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方六层石墨烯中，除了零场下的手性超导态（CSC），还发现了一个由垂直磁场诱导的新超导态（SCH）。通过调节磁场、载流子密度和栅极位移场，可以实现四种不同自旋-谷极化（isospin）的超导态，构成了一个可切换的手性超导四重态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方六层石墨烯中，除了零场下的手性超导态（CSC），还发现了一个由垂直磁场诱导的新超导态（SCH）。通过调节磁场、载流子密度和栅极位移场，可以实现四种不同自旋-谷极化（isospin）的超导态，构成了一个可切换的手性超导四重态。；创新点：首次在菱方石墨烯中实现了对全部四种自旋-谷极化（isospin）超导态的电学和磁学调控，建立了可切换的手性超导四重态。这为构建可编程的超导网络和探索畴壁上的马约拉纳模提供了多旋钮（multi-knob）平台。摘要未明确说明与更薄层菱方石墨烯工作的具体差异，但强调了在六层体系中实现了更丰富的超导态调控。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量。具体包括：在不同垂直磁场（H⊥）、载流子密度（n）和栅极位移场（D）下的电阻测量；通过量子振荡和反常霍尔效应来表征母体相的轨道磁化性质。

papers.title: Static vacancies as parametrized conformal defects in the critical $J_1$--$J_2$ transverse-field Ising chain
papers.abstract: We revisit the problem of two static nonmagnetic vacancies in the transverse-field Ising chain with first- and second-neighbor couplings $J_1$ and $J_2$, now on the critical line, using density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG) calculations in open chains of up to $N=300$ sites. In contrast to the gapped regime studied previously, where the vacancy-vacancy interaction decays exponentially, along the entire quantum critical line the interaction becomes algebraic, $|Δ_b(r)|\sim r^{-α}$, with $α$ close to the universal Casimir value of unity and a weak but systematic dependence on the second-neighbor coupling, $α_\infty \simeq 1.070 + 0.091\, J_2/J_1)$ across $J_2/J_1\in[0.1,1.0]$. The transmission ratio of the spin correlator across a vacancy approaches a $J_2$-dependent plateau $T_\infty(J_2)$ that grows from $0.11$ to $0.33$ over the same range, and the Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy is small and approximately constant, $\log g_\infty \approx -0.073$, well above the Ising fixed-BC value $-\ln\sqrt{2}$ and close to the free-boundary value. The three observables vary smoothly and monotonically with $J_2$, consistent with a one-parameter family of partially transmissive conformal defects controlled by $J_2$. Throughout, the critical line is located using the bulk spin-correlator exponent $η=1/4$, the order-parameter exponent of the Ising universality class, which provides a robust criterion in this open geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG) calculations（密度矩阵重正化群计算）。；研究对象：具有第一近邻（J₁）和第二近邻（J₂）耦合的横场伊辛链中的静态非磁性空位缺陷，重点研究其量子临界线上的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿整个量子临界线，两个静态空位之间的相互作用从指数衰减变为代数衰减，衰减指数α接近普适卡西米尔值1，且随J₂/J₁有弱系统依赖（α∞ ≈ 1.070 + 0.091 J₂/J₁）。自旋关联函数穿过空位的透射比呈现J₂依赖的平台（从0.11增长至0.33），而Affleck-Ludwig边界熵很小且近似常数（log g∞ ≈ -0.073），接近自由边界值。
