papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沿整个量子临界线，两个静态空位之间的相互作用从指数衰减变为代数衰减，衰减指数α接近普适卡西米尔值1，且随J₂/J₁有弱系统依赖（α∞ ≈ 1.070 + 0.091 J₂/J₁）。自旋关联函数穿过空位的透射比呈现J₂依赖的平台（从0.11增长至0.33），而Affleck-Ludwig边界熵很小且近似常数（log g∞ ≈ -0.073），接近自由边界值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算，在最多N=300个格点的开链中进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Sedimentation equilibrium and gravity dependent stiffness coefficients of colloidal hard-spheres
papers.abstract: Spherical colloids with harsh repulsive forces have long been used as experimental analogs of the hard sphere model, with demonstrated good agreement with computer simulations for bulk and structural properties of the fluid, glass and crystal phases. However, an enigmatic discrepancy remains for the crystal-melt stiffness coefficient. Here we perform computer simulations of colloidal hard spheres under tunable buoyant mass and show that the long-standing discrepancy can be traced to a hitherto unrecognized gravity dependent contribution of the stiffness coefficient. This effect is one practical realization of a more general result for the external field dependence of stiffness coefficients of arbitrary interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computer simulations、tunable buoyant mass）；研究对象：胶体硬球体系在可调浮力质量下的沉降平衡，以及晶体-熔体界面刚度系数对重力的依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长期存在的胶体硬球晶体-熔体界面刚度系数与计算机模拟之间的差异，可归因于此前未被认识的刚度系数对重力的依赖贡献；这一效应是外场影响任意界面刚度系数的更一般结果的具体实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长期存在的胶体硬球晶体-熔体界面刚度系数与计算机模拟之间的差异，可归因于此前未被认识的刚度系数对重力的依赖贡献；这一效应是外场影响任意界面刚度系数的更一般结果的具体实现。；创新点：首次揭示重力对胶体硬球晶体-熔体界面刚度系数的贡献，解释了长期存在的实验与模拟之间的差异，并指出这是外场依赖界面刚度系数的一般性结果。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算机模拟（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如蒙特卡洛或分子动力学等）对胶体硬球体系在可调浮力质量条件下进行模拟，研究沉降平衡和界面刚度系数。

papers.title: Correlated Insulating States in Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene Enhanced by Interfacial Effect on CrOCl
papers.abstract: Interaction between different two dimensional materials can give rise to many exotic physical phenomena which are rarely observed in intrinsic materials. Recently, several theoretical and experimental works have revealed that magnetic proximity effect between pristine graphene and magnetic substrates can lead to the emergence of quantum anomalous Hall states and quantum spin Hall states. However, interplay between correlated states in graphene-based systems and magnetic materials has seldom been studied. Here we perform the transport measurement at ultrahigh magnetic field of twisted double bilayer graphene (TDBG) on CrOCl (COC) substrate, which is an antiferromagnetic material. Instead of a magnetic-exchange effect on graphene, we observe an enhanced correlated insulating state at half-filling factor of TDBG as a result of the charge-transfer process between TDBG and COC. The temperature and magnetic field dependence of this enhanced state are further studied. Our results demonstrate the influence of charge-related effect at the interface, and shed a light on a new route for manipulating the correlated states in graphene-based moiré systems using interfacial engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“transport measurement”（输运测量）、“ultrahigh magnetic field”（超高磁场）。；研究对象：扭曲双层石墨烯（TDBG）与反铁磁材料CrOCl（COC）构成的异质结，具体研究其关联绝缘态及界面效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TDBG/COC异质结中，观察到TDBG半填充因子处的关联绝缘态因TDBG与COC之间的电荷转移过程而增强，而非磁交换效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TDBG/COC异质结中，观察到TDBG半填充因子处的关联绝缘态因TDBG与COC之间的电荷转移过程而增强，而非磁交换效应。；创新点：首次在石墨烯基莫尔体系中通过界面工程（电荷转移效应而非磁近邻效应）调控关联绝缘态，揭示了界面电荷相关效应的影响。
papers.method_zh: 在超高磁场下进行输运测量，研究增强态的温度和磁场依赖性。

papers.title: Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Understanding phonon-mediated heat transport in structurally complex materials remains a central challenge for next-generation electronic and nanomechanical devices, where grain boundaries and interfacial disorder strongly limit thermal dissipation. Although classical interatomic potentials enable large-scale simulations, their limited transferability can lead to inaccuracies in vibrational properties and interfacial phonon scattering. In this work, we develop a machine-learning based framework for modeling thermal transport in bulk and nanocrystalline silicon by combining Gaussian approximation potential (GAP) and multi-atomic cluster expansion (MACE) models with lattice-dynamical calculations and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD). Harmonic and anharmonic force constants derived from machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are used within a unified Phonopy/Phono3py workflow to compute phonon dispersions, lifetimes, and lattice thermal conductivity, providing an internally consistent description of vibrational properties. In nanocrystalline silicon, NEMD simulations directly quantify the thermal boundary resistance associated with grain boundaries and reveal its sensitivity to interfacial roughness and the underlying interatomic description. Compared with the Stillinger-Weber and Tersoff potentials, the MLIPs provide a more accurate and internally consistent description of bulk and interfacial phonon transport, enabling more predictive modeling of nanoscale thermal transport in low-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、lattice-dynamical calculations、non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD)。；研究对象：体相和纳米晶硅（bulk and nanocrystalline silicon）中的声子介导热输运，重点关注晶界（grain boundaries）对热传导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的框架能比传统经典势（Stillinger-Weber、Tersoff）更准确且自洽地描述体相和界面声子输运，从而实现对纳米晶硅中热边界电阻及其对界面粗糙度敏感性的可预测建模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的框架能比传统经典势（Stillinger-Weber、Tersoff）更准确且自洽地描述体相和界面声子输运，从而实现对纳米晶硅中热边界电阻及其对界面粗糙度敏感性的可预测建模。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合高斯近似势（GAP）和多原子团簇展开（MACE）模型，利用统一Phonopy/Phono3py工作流计算声子色散、寿命和晶格热导率，并通过非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）直接量化纳米晶硅中的热边界电阻。

papers.title: Eclipsing Kitaev: off-diagonal exchange governs the correlated high-field phases of $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$
papers.abstract: We report a high-field thermodynamic study of the hyperhoneycomb Kitaev material $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$, using magnetotropic susceptibility to resolve its low-temperature field-angle phase diagram across the principal crystallographic planes in magnetic fields up to $60$ T. Rather than evolving directly from the low-field incommensurate state into a polarized regime, the system exhibits a strongly direction-dependent sequence of correlated phases. Most notably, for fields in the $ac$-plane, we identify an additional high-field phase that is absent in the other principal planes and exists only within a restricted region of field-angle space. This phase structure is naturally explained by the competition between magnetic field and bond-directional exchange interactions. Using a symmetry-based description supported by microscopic calculations within the $J$-$K$-$Γ$ model, we show that off-diagonal $Γ$ exchange couples the ferromagnetic and staggered magnetic orders and thereby stabilizes the observed correlated high-field phases. The measured angular dependence of the critical fields is quantitatively captured by this theory, identifying $Γ$ exchange as the key interaction controlling the high-field response. These results clarify why the promise of a field-induced spin liquid -- the notion that suppressing magnetic order might reveal the underlying Kitaev physics -- remains unfulfilled in candidate materials: even when the Kitaev interaction is large, off-diagonal exchange stabilizes symmetry-constrained correlated phases that instead preempt the polarized state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：thermodynamic study, magnetotropic susceptibility, field-angle phase diagram）；研究对象：β-Li₂IrO₃ 超蜂窝Kitaev材料的高场相图与磁有序行为
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高达60 T的磁场中，β-Li₂IrO₃并未直接从低场非公度态进入极化态，而是出现一系列强方向依赖的关联相；其中在ac面内存在一个其他晶面缺失的高场相，该相结构由非对角Γ交换相互作用稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高达60 T的磁场中，β-Li₂IrO₃并未直接从低场非公度态进入极化态，而是出现一系列强方向依赖的关联相；其中在ac面内存在一个其他晶面缺失的高场相，该相结构由非对角Γ交换相互作用稳定。；创新点：通过高分辨场角相图实验，首次揭示非对角Γ交换耦合是控制β-Li₂IrO₃高场响应的关键相互作用，并解释了为何场致自旋液体的预期在候选材料中未能实现——即使Kitaev相互作用很强，非对角交换仍会稳定对称性约束的关联相，从而抢先于极化态出现。
papers.method_zh: 磁致磁化率（magnetotropic susceptibility）测量，结合基于J-K-Γ模型的微观计算与对称性分析。

papers.title: Charge-transfer gap size and oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c$ in the Emery model
papers.abstract: Investigating the drivers of superconducting critical temperature trends in cuprates is crucial for uncovering the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity. Here we study this problem in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane, the Emery model, with cellular dynamical mean-field theory. Using the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen diagram as a guiding framework, we systematically quantify how the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ depends on the copper-oxygen energy distance and on the local repulsion on the copper orbital. Unexpectedly, $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized not only near the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, consistent with previous findings, but also deep in the charge-transfer regime, revealing an unexplored mechanism. Then we link model parameters to physical observables, identifying the charge-transfer gap size and the oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c^{\rm max}$. $T_c^{\rm max}$ increases monotonically as the oxygen hole content increases and the charge gap size decreases. The oxygen hole content is the dominant variable in varying $T_c^{\rm max}$. Our work provides predictions for proposed realizations of the Emery model with ultracold atoms and a theoretical framework for understanding key experimental trends in hole-doped cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用 cellular dynamical mean-field theory（细胞动力学平均场理论）进行系统性量化分析。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中的铜氧平面，具体为 Emery 模型（铜氧平面规范模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最大超导临界温度 \(T_c^{\rm max}\) 不仅如以往研究所知在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近被优化，还会在电荷转移区深处被优化，揭示了一个此前未被探索的机制。\(T_c^{\rm max}\) 由电荷转移能隙大小和氧空穴含量两个机制共同控制，且氧空穴含量是主导变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最大超导临界温度 \(T_c^{\rm max}\) 不仅如以往研究所知在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近被优化，还会在电荷转移区深处被优化，揭示了一个此前未被探索的机制。\(T_c^{\rm max}\) 由电荷转移能隙大小和氧空穴含量两个机制共同控制，且氧空穴含量是主导变量。；创新点：发现 \(T_c^{\rm max}\) 在电荷转移区深处也存在优化峰，突破了以往仅关注电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界的认知；明确区分并量化了电荷转移能隙大小与氧空穴含量这两个控制 \(T_c^{\rm max}\) 的独立机制，并指出氧空穴含量是更主导的因素。
papers.method_zh: 采用细胞动力学平均场理论（cellular dynamical mean-field theory, CDMFT）对 Emery 模型进行数值计算，并以 Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen 相图作为指导框架，系统扫描铜氧能量差和铜轨道上的局域排斥作用等参数。

papers.title: Correlation of maximum superconducting critical temperature with copper-oxygen energy distance and oxygen hole content in the Emery model
papers.abstract: Identifying microscopic parameters that optimize the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane of cuprates, the Emery model, remains challenging. Using cellular dynamical mean-field theory at finite temperature, we find that for a fixed charge gap size in the parent charge-transfer insulating state, $T_c^{\rm max}$ unexpectedly increases with increasing the copper-oxygen energy distance, as this favors the transfer of electrons from oxygen to copper orbitals. We show that these findings emerge naturally in the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen scheme and capture observed trends in hole-doped cuprates. Overall, our study uncovers that $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized in the Emery model under three conditions: upon doping a charge-transfer insulator, close to the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, and deep into the charge-transfer regime. This finding indicates new paths for optimizing $T_c^{\rm max}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了“cellular dynamical mean-field theory”（细胞动力学平均场理论）进行数值计算。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体的Emery模型（铜氧平面三带模型）。具体研究该模型中，最大超导临界温度（$T_c^{\rm max}$）与微观参数（铜氧能量距离、氧空穴含量）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在母体为电荷转移绝缘体的前提下，增大铜-氧轨道间的能量差（即更深的电荷转移区）反而会意外地提高$T_c^{\rm max}$，因为这促进了电子从氧轨道向铜轨道的转移。$T_c^{\rm max}$在满足以下三个条件时达到最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近电荷转移绝缘体-金属相变边界、以及处于深电荷转移区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在母体为电荷转移绝缘体的前提下，增大铜-氧轨道间的能量差（即更深的电荷转移区）反而会意外地提高$T_c^{\rm max}$，因为这促进了电子从氧轨道向铜轨道的转移。$T_c^{\rm max}$在满足以下三个条件时达到最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近电荷转移绝缘体-金属相变边界、以及处于深电荷转移区。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次在Emery模型中系统揭示了$T_c^{\rm max}$与铜氧能量距离之间的正相关关系，并基于Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen（ZSA）能带方案给出了物理解释，为优化$T_c^{\rm max}$指明了新的微观参数路径。
papers.method_zh: 有限温度下的细胞动力学平均场理论（cellular dynamical mean-field theory, CDMFT）。

papers.title: Dimensional Crossover of Thermal Transport in Nanoconfined Liquids Driven by the Interplay of Quasi-One-Dimensional Structure and Wall Dissipation
papers.abstract: Heat transport in nanoconfined liquids can deviate from ordinary Fourier behavior because confinement alters liquid structure and interfacial dissipation. Although such changes may lead to quasi-one-dimensional transport or overdamped sound relaxation, the conditions under which length-dependent transport persists remain unclear. Here we use molecular dynamics simulations of monatomic liquid argon confined in carbon nanotubes with systematically varied radii and lengths. We find a radius-controlled crossover: length-dependent axial thermal conductivity persists over long tube lengths in single-file and single-shell states, but is strongly truncated or nearly saturated once mixed-shell or multilayer packing develops. This crossover is accompanied by the loss of clear acoustic-like axial modes and enhanced wall--liquid friction. Thus, tube radius controls whether length-dependent heat transport persists or is truncated by coupling confined-liquid structure to wall-induced dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular dynamics simulations）；研究对象：纳米限域液体（单原子液态氩）在碳纳米管中的热输运行为，具体研究准一维结构与壁面耗散对热传导的维度交叉效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现管径控制的维度交叉：在单列和单壳层状态下，轴向热导率随管长持续变化（长度依赖）；一旦出现混合壳层或多层堆积，长度依赖的热输运被强烈抑制或接近饱和，伴随声学轴向模式消失和壁-液摩擦增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现管径控制的维度交叉：在单列和单壳层状态下，轴向热导率随管长持续变化（长度依赖）；一旦出现混合壳层或多层堆积，长度依赖的热输运被强烈抑制或接近饱和，伴随声学轴向模式消失和壁-液摩擦增强。；创新点：揭示了管径通过调控受限液体结构（单列/单壳层 vs. 混合壳层/多层）与壁面耗散的耦合，决定长度依赖热输运是否持续存在，阐明了准一维结构与界面耗散竞争导致热输运维度交叉的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations），系统改变碳纳米管的半径和长度，模拟单原子液态氩的受限体系。

papers.title: Instabilities of Fermi Liquids with Arbitrary Forward Scattering: Exact Approach
papers.abstract: In this work, we consider $N$-fold degenerate $D$-dimensional electron gas with spherical Fermi surface and arbitrary forward-scattering density-density interaction transferring small momentum compared to the Fermi momentum $k_{\mathrm{F}}$. The dimensional reduction that is mathematically equivalent to the Haldane patch construction and similar multidimensional bosonization techniques, provides a natural map of two-point $D$-dimensional correlation functions (fermion Green function, susceptibilities etc.) onto effective one-dimensional (1D) correlators with the same diagrammatic structure, which can be evaluated exactly within a 1D bosonizable (Gaussian) theory. We then apply this formalism to evaluate the fermion Green function, pair and charge/flavor susceptibilities, as well as the composite correlation functions for the case of a finite-range interaction, where the interaction range $R_{\mathrm{s}} \gg 1/k_{\mathrm{F}}$ is large compared to the Fermi wavelength. First, we find that the single-particle spectral function remains Fermi-liquid-like which is fully consistent with the previous research. In contrast to the single-particle sector, the many-body channels are efficiently dressed by finite-range interactions, and this dressing is fully equivalent to the one-loop renormalization group (RG), which is also in line with previous multidimensional bosonization results. Within the forward-scattering model, stable long-range order is not possible, and relevant susceptibilities demonstrate singular power-law scaling with temperature $T$ at $T \to 0$. The rest of the abstract is in the PDF.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact approach、dimensional reduction、bosonization、renormalization group。；研究对象：具有球形费米面的N重简并D维电子气，以及任意前向散射密度-密度相互作用（相互作用范围远大于费米波长）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单粒子谱函数保持费米液体行为，但多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整，其重整化效果与单圈重整化群完全等价；在前向散射模型下，系统无法形成稳定的长程有序，相关磁化率在温度趋近零时呈现奇异幂律标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单粒子谱函数保持费米液体行为，但多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整，其重整化效果与单圈重整化群完全等价；在前向散射模型下，系统无法形成稳定的长程有序，相关磁化率在温度趋近零时呈现奇异幂律标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用维度约化方法（数学上等价于Haldane补丁构造和多维玻色化技术），将D维两点关联函数映射到具有相同图结构的有效一维关联函数，并在可玻色化（高斯）理论中精确求解。

papers.title: Skyrmion Phase Control by Magnetic Dipole-Dipole Interaction and Electric Field in Centrosymmetric Materials
papers.abstract: Establishing precise control over the helicity and spatial configuration of magnetic skyrmions will be essential to realize their promise in classical, analog and quantum computation applications. In this work, we explore the role of magnetic dipole-dipole interactions, external electric fields, and magnetic fields in controlling these parameters within a triangular lattice centrosymmetric skyrmion host. We demonstrate that dipole-dipole interactions strongly favor Bloch helicity. Notably, a zero magnetic field skyrmion phase appears upon raising the dipole-dipole coupling strength, with substantial potential for cost-effective quantum device applications. We also report the emergence of a meron/antimeron lattice phase, in the absence of any Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In contrast, applied electric fields stabilize high density Néel skyrmion crystals. The interplay between dipole-dipole interactions and external electric fields creates a continuous transition between the two skyrmion types, rather than an abrupt switch. Applied electric fields can therefore be used as a continuous tuning mechanism for skyrmion helicity, and hence a control handle for tuning two-level systems in skyrmion qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：explore、demonstrate、report（理论建模与数值计算）。；研究对象：中心对称三角晶格材料中的磁性斯格明子（skyrmion），具体研究磁偶极-偶极相互作用、外电场和外磁场对斯格明子螺旋性（helicity）及空间构型的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁偶极-偶极相互作用强烈倾向于稳定布洛赫（Bloch）型螺旋性，且增强该相互作用可在零外磁场下诱导出斯格明子相；外加电场则能稳定高密度的奈尔（Néel）型斯格明子晶格，并实现两种斯格明子类型之间的连续转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁偶极-偶极相互作用强烈倾向于稳定布洛赫（Bloch）型螺旋性，且增强该相互作用可在零外磁场下诱导出斯格明子相；外加电场则能稳定高密度的奈尔（Néel）型斯格明子晶格，并实现两种斯格明子类型之间的连续转变。；创新点：首次在中心对称材料中系统揭示了磁偶极-偶极相互作用可独立于Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）产生meron/antimeron晶格相，并发现外电场可作为连续调控斯格明子螺旋性的手段，为斯格明子量子比特中二能级系统的调谐提供了新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：在三角晶格中心对称斯格明子宿主中引入磁偶极-偶极相互作用、外电场和外磁场的哈密顿量，通过能量计算和相图分析研究斯格明子螺旋性与构型的调控机制。摘要未明确提及具体计算方法（如蒙特卡洛、微磁学模拟等）。

papers.title: Spontaneous emission of light by non-equilibrium phonons
papers.abstract: When a system is brought out of equilibrium by an external excitation, its relaxation to thermodynamic equilibrium generates phonons. These non-equilibrium phonons degrade via cascaded anharmonic decay processes, progressively leading to a thermal population of phonons following a Bose-Einstein distribution at the system temperature. Preceding heat dissipation by convection, conduction and incandescence, this early phase of the relaxation dynamics is commonly assumed to be exclusively non-radiative. Here, we demonstrate that the radiative emission by phonons can be an efficient relaxation pathway competing with the intrinsic anharmonic decay. Optical spectroscopy under femtosecond two-photon excitation in boron nitride unveils a photoluminescence signal in the mid-infrared spectral range, stemming from the spontaneous emission of light by non-equilibrium phonons. This observation of non-thermal radiation from phonons introduces a new paradigm for out-of-equilibrium physics, mid-infrared optics, and thermal management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：optical spectroscopy、unveils、observation。；研究对象：非平衡声子的自发辐射现象，具体材料为氮化硼（boron nitride）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在飞秒双光子激发下，氮化硼中的非平衡声子可通过自发辐射光的方式释放能量，这一辐射过程可与固有的非谐衰减过程竞争，成为一种有效的弛豫通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在飞秒双光子激发下，氮化硼中的非平衡声子可通过自发辐射光的方式释放能量，这一辐射过程可与固有的非谐衰减过程竞争，成为一种有效的弛豫通道。；创新点：首次实验观察到非平衡声子产生的非热辐射，打破了传统认为声子弛豫早期阶段完全非辐射的假设，为理解非平衡物理、中红外光学及热管理提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒双光子激发光学光谱（femtosecond two-photon excitation optical spectroscopy），探测中红外波段的光致发光信号。

papers.title: Effect of charge-imbalance potential relaxation on the high-frequency vortex dynamics and kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: We show that relaxation of the charge-imbalance potential plays a key role in the retarded dynamics of Abrikosov vortices in a type-II superconducting sample carrying a microwave current. Starting from the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations we derive the vortex equation of motion accounting both the dissipation and retardation effects. The retardation is governed by the dynamics of the charge-imbalance potential and reveals itself at characteristic timescales diverging near the superconducting critical temperature $T_{c}$. These retardation effects in vortex dynamics strongly affect the kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits being, thus, responsible for the magnetic field dependence of characteristics of different superconducting devices in the high frequency range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Starting from the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations we derive the vortex equation of motion”（从含时金兹堡-朗道方程出发推导涡旋运动方程），属于理论推导。；研究对象：II类超导体中承载微波电流时，Abrikosov涡旋的高频动力学行为，以及电荷不平衡势弛豫对涡旋动力学和超导电路动感电感的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷不平衡势的弛豫在涡旋的延迟动力学中起关键作用，该延迟效应在接近超导临界温度Tc时特征时间尺度发散，并显著影响超导电路的高频动感电感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷不平衡势的弛豫在涡旋的延迟动力学中起关键作用，该延迟效应在接近超导临界温度Tc时特征时间尺度发散，并显著影响超导电路的高频动感电感。；创新点：揭示了电荷不平衡势弛豫是导致涡旋动力学延迟效应的核心机制，并指出该延迟效应是超导器件高频特性随磁场变化的原因。摘要未突出说明与以往模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时金兹堡-朗道方程（TDGL），推导了同时包含耗散和延迟效应的涡旋运动方程。

papers.title: Dynamical Simulation of Membrane Bending by Flexible Protein Assemblies
papers.abstract: Membrane-deforming protein lattices play a key role in essential and pathogenic biological processes, including endocytosis and viral budding. Attaining the necessary length- and time-scales in simulation can be difficult for such large-scale membrane remodeling events. We present a model of a flexible protein lattice coupled to a Helfrich membrane propagated in Fourier space in the over-damped regime. We focus primarily on membrane-bound clathrin lattices, an essential part of the endocytic machinery. We quantify the material properties of our clathrin model lattices using buckling methods to measure the flexural rigidity as it varies with force constants of the coarse-grained potential energy function. By comparing this flexural rigidity to the effective rigidity observed when modeling the bending energy of a spherical clathrin coat using a Helfrich-like bending energy term, we show how the interpretation of the bending rigidity changes with the structure of the protein coat, resulting in an effective stiffening as the coat grows. This relatively common approximation thus must be applied with care, as it can over-estimate the stiffness of assembled lattices depending on the interpretation assumed. We validate our model by verifying that the tension of our simulated membrane results in changes to the geometry of the clathrin coat consistent with theoretical expectations. We conclude by demonstrating our newly available code for transferring structures assembled via rigid-body reaction-diffusion (using the NERDSS simulation package) into our flexible membrane-coupled dynamical framework, applying it to the membrane-bound HIV-1 immature Gag lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：simulation、model、Fourier space、over-damped regime、coarse-grained potential energy function。；研究对象：柔性蛋白质晶格（特别是网格蛋白晶格）与Helfrich膜耦合的动力学体系，涉及膜弯曲变形过程（如内吞作用和病毒出芽）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质外壳的结构会影响弯曲刚度的解释，导致随着外壳生长出现有效硬化效应；若采用类似Helfrich弯曲能项近似模拟球形网格蛋白外壳，可能会高估组装晶格的刚度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质外壳的结构会影响弯曲刚度的解释，导致随着外壳生长出现有效硬化效应；若采用类似Helfrich弯曲能项近似模拟球形网格蛋白外壳，可能会高估组装晶格的刚度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用在傅里叶空间中传播的过阻尼Helfrich膜模型，耦合柔性蛋白质晶格；使用屈曲方法测量粗粒化势能函数力常数变化下的抗弯刚度；通过刚体反应扩散（NERDSS模拟包）组装结构，并将其转移到柔性膜耦合动力学框架中。

papers.title: Radio frequency readout and control of Ge/SiGe hole spin qubits with a global accumulation gate
papers.abstract: Hole spin qubits in undoped Ge/SiGe quantum well structures have advanced rapidly in performance and scalability. However, stringent multi-layer patterning and overlay requirements of conventional overlapping-gate devices create a bottleneck for academic proof-of-concept experiments involving few-qubit devices. Here we present fabrication and measurements of Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices with a global accumulation gate and single-layer depletion fine gates, which substantially reduce fabrication complexity. With careful design of the gate-2DHG capacitance, we demonstrate RF-based single-shot spin readout and coherent control of two single-spin qubits. We also characterize the spin coherence times and exchange tunability, which are similar to those reported in recent overlapping-gate Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices. By simplifying fabrication without sacrificing performance, our approach offers a more accessible device design for spin-based quantum technology research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabrication and measurements、RF-based single-shot spin readout、coherent control。；研究对象：Ge/SiGe量子阱中的空穴自旋量子比特，具体为采用全局积累栅极和单层耗尽精细栅极的器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简化器件制造工艺（使用全局积累栅极和单层耗尽栅极），实现了与复杂重叠栅极器件性能相当的射频单次自旋读出和相干控制，且自旋相干时间和交换可调性相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简化器件制造工艺（使用全局积累栅极和单层耗尽栅极），实现了与复杂重叠栅极器件性能相当的射频单次自旋读出和相干控制，且自旋相干时间和交换可调性相似。；创新点：大幅降低了Ge/SiGe自旋量子比特器件的制造复杂度（无需多层图形化和套刻对准），同时保持了与高性能重叠栅极器件相当的自旋量子比特性能，为自旋量子技术研究提供了更易实现的器件设计方案。
papers.method_zh: 器件制备（全局积累栅极+单层耗尽精细栅极）、射频（RF）反射测量技术进行单次自旋读出、相干控制实验（如拉比振荡等）、自旋相干时间表征、交换耦合可调性测量。

papers.title: Anomalously high quasiparticle thermal conductivity in the underdoped cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$
papers.abstract: The single-layer cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$ (Hg1201) is an ideal candidate for investigating many properties of cuprates with minimal disorder and without the complication of multiple CuO$_2$ layers. Here we measure the in-plane longitudinal thermal conductivity $κ$ of underdoped Hg1201 ($T_c$ = 76 K, $p$ = 0.11) at dilution refrigerator temperatures to extract the nodal quasiparticle velocity ratio $v_F/v_Δ$. Assuming contributions from only a single line node per quadrant on the Fermi surface leads to a value of $v_F/v_Δ$ = $23 \pm 3$, anomalously large compared to other cuprates at similar dopings. In conjunction with the anomalously high quasiparticle specific heat of Hg1201 in the normal state reported previously at a similar doping, this points to more than one Fermi surface sheet crossing the nodal line, suggesting the presence of more than the single small electron pocket detected by quantum oscillations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了在稀释制冷机温度下测量热导率（κ）的实验，并提取了准粒子速度比。；研究对象：欠掺杂的单层铜氧化物超导体 HgBa₂CuO₄₊δ (Hg1201)，具体研究其准粒子热导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欠掺杂 Hg1201 中，节点准粒子速度比 v_F/v_Δ 异常大（23 ± 3），远高于其他类似掺杂水平的铜氧化物。结合此前报道的类似掺杂下正常态异常高的准粒子比热，该结果暗示费米面上存在多于一个穿过节点线的费米面条带，即存在除量子振荡探测到的小电子口袋之外的费米面结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欠掺杂 Hg1201 中，节点准粒子速度比 v_F/v_Δ 异常大（23 ± 3），远高于其他类似掺杂水平的铜氧化物。结合此前报道的类似掺杂下正常态异常高的准粒子比热，该结果暗示费米面上存在多于一个穿过节点线的费米面条带，即存在除量子振荡探测到的小电子口袋之外的费米面结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在稀释制冷机温度下测量面内纵向热导率 κ，通过分析提取节点准粒子速度比 v_F/v_Δ。

papers.title: Robust q-negative Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient
papers.abstract: The multifractal detrended cross-correlation coefficient $ρ_q(n)$ is widely used to investigate scale-dependent interactions, but its application to negative fluctuation orders is affected by numerical instabilities, unbounded values, and interpretational difficulties. We propose a Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient, $ρ_{\mathrm{SMFDCCA}}(n,q)$, an amplitude-conditioned correlation observable for multifractal detrended analysis, based on locally normalized detrended correlations and regularized fluctuation amplitudes. The proposed coefficient preserves the sign of local interactions, remains strictly bounded within $[-1,1]$ for both positive and negative values of $q$, and eliminates the corrective procedures required by previous approaches. Validation using independent fractional Gaussian noise confirms the absence of spurious cross-correlations and the numerical stability of the method. Applications demonstrate that the proposed observable resolves how cross-correlations evolve jointly with temporal scale and fluctuation amplitude, revealing scale- and amplitude-dependent correlation structures, including stronger synchronization during large fluctuations in stock-market indices and heterogeneous coupling patterns in temperature records.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：提出新的统计物理量（Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient）并进行了数值验证和应用演示。；研究对象：多重分形去趋势交叉相关分析（MFDCCA）方法中的交叉相关系数，特别是其在负波动阶数（q<0）下的数值稳定性问题。研究对象是该方法本身，而非特定材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的“有符号多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数”ρ_SMFDCCA(n,q)，该系数在正负q值下均严格有界于[-1,1]，消除了传统方法在负q值下的数值不稳定性和无界问题，并能揭示尺度与振幅依赖的相关结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的“有符号多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数”ρ_SMFDCCA(n,q)，该系数在正负q值下均严格有界于[-1,1]，消除了传统方法在负q值下的数值不稳定性和无界问题，并能揭示尺度与振幅依赖的相关结构。；创新点：提出了一种新的、鲁棒的交叉相关系数定义，解决了传统多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数ρ_q(n)在负波动阶数（q<0）时存在的数值不稳定、值无界和解释困难等根本性问题，无需先前方法所需的修正程序。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个基于局部归一化去趋势相关性和正则化波动振幅的振幅条件相关观测量的新定义。通过独立分数高斯噪声的数值模拟验证了其无虚假交叉相关性和数值稳定性，并应用于股票市场指数和温度记录等实际数据。

papers.title: Decoupling Josephson Coupling and Supercurrent Nonreciprocity in Twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 van der Waals Junctions
papers.abstract: The microscopic origin of supercurrent nonreciprocity in van der Waals Josephson junctions remains under active debate, particularly regarding the role of twist-angle engineering in layered superconductors. Here, we investigate superconducting transport in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 vertical Josephson junctions fabricated by dry transfer with controlled crystallographic alignment and chemically clean interfaces. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy is employed to directly determine the twist angle and assess interface quality. While the Josephson coupling strength exhibits a pronounced dependence on twist angle, with characteristic voltages maximized near crystallographically equivalent orientations and suppressed at intermediate angles, the supercurrent diode efficiency remains negligibly small and shows no systematic twist-angle dependence. In contrast, enhanced diode-like responses emerge only in weakly coupled junctions exhibiting interfacial disorder and reduced transparency. Deliberate interface degradation further amplifies the apparent nonreciprocity, yielding diode efficiencies approaching 30% together with an irregular magnetic-field-strength dependence. These results establish a clear decoupling between Josephson coupling and supercurrent nonreciprocity in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 junctions. Our findings identify interface disorder, rather than twist-angle-controlled momentum matching, as the dominant origin of the observed diode response and provide a critical benchmark for interpreting nonreciprocal superconducting transport in van der Waals Josephson devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：investigate, fabricated, High-resolution transmission electron microscopy, measurements。；研究对象：扭曲双层二硒化铌（NbSe₂/NbSe₂）范德华垂直约瑟夫森结中的超导输运现象，特别是超流非互易性（超导二极管效应）的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂约瑟夫森结中，约瑟夫森耦合强度与超流非互易性被明确解耦：耦合强度显著依赖于扭转角，但超导二极管效率极小且无系统扭转角依赖；而增强的二极管响应仅出现在具有界面无序和低透明度的弱耦合结中。因此，界面无序（而非扭转角控制的动量匹配）是观测到的二极管响应的主导起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂约瑟夫森结中，约瑟夫森耦合强度与超流非互易性被明确解耦：耦合强度显著依赖于扭转角，但超导二极管效率极小且无系统扭转角依赖；而增强的二极管响应仅出现在具有界面无序和低透明度的弱耦合结中。因此，界面无序（而非扭转角控制的动量匹配）是观测到的二极管响应的主导起源。；创新点：通过系统实验，明确区分了扭转角工程与界面无序对超流非互易性的不同贡献，揭示了界面无序而非扭转角动量匹配是超导二极管效应的主导机制，为理解范德华约瑟夫森器件中的非互易超导输运提供了关键基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用干法转移制备具有可控晶向对准和化学洁净界面的扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂垂直约瑟夫森结；利用高分辨率透射电子显微镜直接测定扭转角并评估界面质量；通过输运测量表征约瑟夫森耦合强度（特征电压）和超导二极管效率。

papers.title: From Valley Filtering to Superconducting Diode Effect in Spin-Orbit Coupled Graphene Junctions
papers.abstract: We study the transport properties of proximitized graphene, which can acquire a spin-orbit coupling by the proximity effect with a substrate. We focus on the ballistic and zero temperature limits, making use of a tight-binding procedure based on the KWANT Python package. We first find key results on valley-filtering properties and asymmetric edge transport in spin-orbit coupled graphene single junctions, and then move to the analysis of the superconducting transport in a graphene Josephson junction, in the short junction limit. We study the relative contribution of edge modes for different edge terminations and some degree of edge disorder, and also analyze the magnetic interference pattern that arises when threading the junction with a perpendicular magnetic field. We find residual supercurrent at high magnetic fluxes, due to the localized nature of transport in the junction, and a strong non-reciprocal transport that leads to a significant Josephson diode effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“tight-binding procedure based on the KWANT Python package”、“ballistic and zero temperature limits”。；研究对象：近邻化石墨烯（proximitized graphene）及其与基底耦合产生的自旋-轨道耦合效应，具体研究单结中的谷滤波和边缘输运，以及石墨烯约瑟夫森结中的超导输运和约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋-轨道耦合石墨烯约瑟夫森结中，由于边缘模式的局域化输运，在高磁通下仍存在剩余超电流，并观测到显著的非互易输运，即约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋-轨道耦合石墨烯约瑟夫森结中，由于边缘模式的局域化输运，在高磁通下仍存在剩余超电流，并观测到显著的非互易输运，即约瑟夫森二极管效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于KWANT Python包的紧束缚模型（tight-binding）计算，在弹道输运和零温极限下进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Composite-Fermion Study of Cavity-Modified Fractional Quantum Hall Excitation Gaps
papers.abstract: We investigate how cavity-mediated attractive electron-electron interactions modify the excitation gaps of fractional quantum Hall states within the composite-fermion framework. We compute both the neutral magnetoroton excitation spectrum and the charged excitation gap relevant to transport experiments for the Laughlin $ν=1/3$ and $ν=1/5$ states. We consider a spin-polarized lowest-Landau-level model in which the interaction is mediated by a cavity mode with a spatially uniform vacuum-field gradient and a finite interaction range controlled by a long-distance cutoff. Finite-size scaling reveals that the transport gap is consistently enhanced by the cavity-induced interaction, with the gap enhancement scaling quadratically with the electron number and with the fourth power of the vacuum-field gradient. By contrast, the magnetoroton spectrum exhibits a richer dependence on the interaction range. The high-$k$ magnetoroton gap is enhanced for all interaction ranges considered, consistent with its close connection to the charged excitation gap, even with the long-range character of the interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：composite-fermion framework（复合费米子框架）、compute（计算）、finite-size scaling（有限尺寸标度）。；研究对象：腔修饰的分数量子霍尔态，具体为Laughlin ν=1/3和ν=1/5态的中性磁激子激发谱和带电激发能隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔诱导的吸引性电子-电子相互作用可以一致地增强输运能隙，其增强幅度与电子数的平方及真空场梯度的四次方成正比；而磁激子谱对相互作用范围有更丰富的依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔诱导的吸引性电子-电子相互作用可以一致地增强输运能隙，其增强幅度与电子数的平方及真空场梯度的四次方成正比；而磁激子谱对相互作用范围有更丰富的依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用复合费米子理论框架，在自旋极化的最低朗道能级模型中，考虑由腔模介导的相互作用（具有空间均匀的真空场梯度和由长程截断控制的有限相互作用范围），并通过有限尺寸标度分析计算激发能隙。

papers.title: Bockstein Braiding Statistics Versus Three-Loop Braiding
papers.abstract: Braiding statistics of $p$- and $q$-dimensional topological excitations is conventionally defined in $p+q+2$ spatial dimensions. We find a novel statistical process $W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N$ for two order-$N$ excitations in $p+q+1$ dimensions, detecting the Bockstein response $A\smile β(B)$. This new statistics and fermionic loop statistics exhaust all loop statistics in three dimensions whose fusion rules form an Abelian group $G$, classified by $H^5(B^2G,U(1))$. Surprisingly, conventional three-loop braiding goes beyond this classification, so it must have non-Abelian fusion rules. We suggest viewing three-loop braiding as particle-loop braiding together with exotic fusion rules between loops and point-like defects. We also try to clarify the relationship between statistics and symmetry anomaly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：braiding statistics、topological excitations、classification、symmetry anomaly。；研究对象：拓扑激发（p维和q维激发）的编织统计，特别是三维空间中环状激发的编织统计，以及Bockstein编织统计与三环编织之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在p+q+1维空间中，发现了一种针对阶数为N的激发的新型统计过程W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N，该过程可探测Bockstein响应A∪β(B)。同时发现，传统三环编织的融合规则必须是非阿贝尔的，因为它超出了由H^5(B^2G,U(1))分类的阿贝尔群G的环统计范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在p+q+1维空间中，发现了一种针对阶数为N的激发的新型统计过程W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N，该过程可探测Bockstein响应A∪β(B)。同时发现，传统三环编织的融合规则必须是非阿贝尔的，因为它超出了由H^5(B^2G,U(1))分类的阿贝尔群G的环统计范围。；创新点：发现了Bockstein编织统计这一新型统计过程，并指出传统三环编织统计必须具有非阿贝尔融合规则，建议将三环编织理解为粒子-环编织与环和点缺陷之间奇异融合规则的结合。摘要未突出说明与对称性反常关系的具体推导细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用拓扑量子场论和上同调分类理论，具体通过分析H^5(B^2G,U(1))对阿贝尔群G的环统计进行分类，并对比传统三环编织的统计行为。

papers.title: Chiral Graviton Modes in Non-Abelian lattice Fractional Quantum Hall states
papers.abstract: Synthetic quantum matter provides a highly tunable route to fractional quantum Hall physics beyond the constraints of conventional electronic materials. However, previous theoretical studies have mostly focused on their ground state properties. It remains unclear to what extent such platforms could reveal key excitation properties of fractional quantum Hall states. Here, we study charge-neutral collective excitations in a non-abelian lattice fractional quantum Hall state realized in the bosonic Harper-Hofstadter model at unity filling factior, realizing a Moore-Read ground state. Combining full exact diagonalization, band-projected exact diagonalization, and matrix-product-state simulations, we demonstrate the existence of a long-lived chiral graviton mode, probed by chiral 3-body correlators, for the first time on lattice non-Abelian states. The graviton signal is topological sector-independent and could be observed via geometric quenches in small open droplets directly relevant to current cold-atom experiments, while other neutral modes, such as the magnetoroton and neutral fermion, are less resolved at presently achievable volumes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：full exact diagonalization, band-projected exact diagonalization, matrix-product-state simulations）；研究对象：非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中的手性引力子模式，具体为玻色子Harper-Hofstadter模型在填充因子ν=1时实现的Moore-Read基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中证明了长寿命手性引力子模式的存在，该模式可通过手性三体关联函数探测，且与拓扑扇区无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中证明了长寿命手性引力子模式的存在，该模式可通过手性三体关联函数探测，且与拓扑扇区无关。；创新点：首次在非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中识别出手性引力子模式，并指出该信号可通过当前冷原子实验中的几何淬火直接观测，而其他中性模式（如磁旋子和中性费米子）在现有可达到的体系体积下分辨率较低。
papers.method_zh: 结合全精确对角化、能带投影精确对角化以及矩阵乘积态模拟，通过计算手性三体关联函数来表征引力子模式，并探讨了几何淬火在小型开放液滴中的可观测性。

papers.title: Uncovering Collective Modes Underlying the Giant Dielectric Response of Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) are polar fluids in which spontaneous polarization coexists with nematic orientational order, giving rise to unusual dielectric and electromechanical responses. However, the collective modes underlying their giant dielectric response remain unclear. Here, we show that this response originates from the superposition of two distinct relaxation modes rather than a single process. Dielectric spectroscopy reveals that the low-frequency mode exhibits soft-mode-like behavior associated with short-axis molecular rotation, whereas the high-frequency mode corresponds to a Goldstone-like phase displacement of an effective transverse polarization component rotating around the director. These assignments are supported by systematic analyses of temperature, electric-field, cell-thickness, and alignment-layer dependences. Our results demonstrate that the giant dielectric response of ferroelectric nematics reflects multiple collective polarization dynamics with different symmetries and restoring forces, providing a framework for interpreting dielectric spectra in polar nematic fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Dielectric spectroscopy”（介电谱）作为主要研究手段，并进行了系统的温度、电场、厚度和取向层依赖性分析。；研究对象：铁电向列型液晶（FNLCs）中的集体极化动力学模式，特别是其巨介电响应的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电向列型液晶的巨介电响应并非源于单一弛豫过程，而是由两种不同对称性和恢复力的集体模式叠加产生：低频模式表现为与短轴分子旋转相关的软模行为，高频模式则对应于有效横向极化分量绕指向矢旋转的类Goldstone相位位移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电向列型液晶的巨介电响应并非源于单一弛豫过程，而是由两种不同对称性和恢复力的集体模式叠加产生：低频模式表现为与短轴分子旋转相关的软模行为，高频模式则对应于有效横向极化分量绕指向矢旋转的类Goldstone相位位移。；创新点：首次揭示了铁电向列型液晶巨介电响应由两种不同物理起源的集体模式（软模和类Goldstone模）共同贡献，而非此前认为的单一弛豫过程，为理解极性向列流体的介电谱提供了新的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 介电谱（Dielectric spectroscopy）测量，并结合对温度、外加电场、样品厚度和取向层材料的系统性依赖关系分析。

papers.title: Local spin magnetization in itinerant non-collinear magnets: The local spin Berry curvature
papers.abstract: Conventionally, the local spin magnetization in itinerant magnets is determined from the equilibrium local spin density. Here, we propose a thermodynamic approach in which the local spin magnetization is defined from the response of the system to an infinitesimal external magnetic field. The predictions of the two theories are identical for collinear magnets, but differ qualitatively and quantitatively for non-collinear magnets. In the present thermodynamic approach, the spin coherences determine an alternative distribution of local spin magnetization due to the field-induced deformation of the energy eigenstates. This effect is captured by a Berry-curvature-like contribution reminiscent of orbital magnetization and has several distinct observable consequences. We explore the differences between the conventional and thermodynamic approaches in several test cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“thermodynamic approach”（热力学方法），并引入“Berry-curvature-like contribution”（类似贝里曲率的贡献），属于理论推导和概念提出，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：巡游非共线磁体中的局域自旋磁化现象。具体涉及非共线磁体中自旋磁化的定义与响应机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统上局域自旋磁化由平衡态局域自旋密度决定，但本文提出的热力学方法（通过系统对无穷小外磁场的响应定义）在非共线磁体中给出与常规方法定性且定量不同的结果。该差异源于自旋相干性导致的能级变形，并由类似贝里曲率的贡献所描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统上局域自旋磁化由平衡态局域自旋密度决定，但本文提出的热力学方法（通过系统对无穷小外磁场的响应定义）在非共线磁体中给出与常规方法定性且定量不同的结果。该差异源于自旋相干性导致的能级变形，并由类似贝里曲率的贡献所描述。；创新点：提出了一种不同于传统局域自旋密度定义的局域自旋磁化热力学定义，并揭示了非共线磁体中自旋相干性导致的场致能级变形效应，该效应由类似贝里曲率的贡献描述，具有可观测的物理后果。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于热力学响应理论，通过系统对无穷小外磁场的响应定义局域自旋磁化，并引入“局域自旋贝里曲率”概念来捕捉场致能级变形效应。与传统的平衡态局域自旋密度方法进行对比。

papers.title: Classical Reversible Computation by Quantum Coherence
papers.abstract: Rising energy demand from data-centre and AI applications has renewed interest in reversible computation, where logic need not dissipate heat at every step if information is uncomputed. Implementations have so far been classical: adiabatic CMOS reduces dissipation by slowing charge motion but is still limited by the threshold physics of transistors. Here we propose classical reversible logic implemented by coherent spin dynamics in a spin quantum-dot array, with inputs and outputs in classical basis states and no algorithmic use of superposition. The same spin stores, transports, and computes, with unitary rotation replacing irreversible switching. The universal building block is an iToffoli gate driven by DC voltage pulses and anisotropic exchange in Ge/Si hole spins. Simulations with experimental parameters reproduce the Toffoli truth table and yield a testable error landscape. Because shuttling transports the bit without measurement, logic and data movement remain reversible until readout. Millivolt pulses on femtofarad gates yield a gate energy below the 4~K Landauer scale, about five (eight) orders of magnitude below a room-temperature CMOS Toffoli with (without) 4 K cooling overhead. The same semiconductor hardware is therefore dual-use, supporting quantum algorithms when superposition is used and classical reversible logic otherwise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、simulations、theoretical framework）；研究对象：基于自旋量子点阵列的经典可逆逻辑门，具体为Ge/Si空穴自旋体系中的iToffoli门。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用相干自旋动力学（而非传统晶体管开关）实现经典可逆计算，其单门能耗低于4 K温度下的朗道尔极限，比室温CMOS Toffoli门低约5-8个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用相干自旋动力学（而非传统晶体管开关）实现经典可逆计算，其单门能耗低于4 K温度下的朗道尔极限，比室温CMOS Toffoli门低约5-8个数量级。；创新点：提出同一半导体硬件（自旋量子点阵列）可双重使用：利用叠加态时支持量子算法，不使用叠加态时实现经典可逆逻辑，且无需测量即可通过自旋输运完成比特移动，保持逻辑与数据移动的可逆性直至读出。
papers.method_zh: 通过DC电压脉冲和Ge/Si空穴自旋的各向异性交换作用驱动iToffoli门，利用实验参数进行数值模拟，复现Toffoli真值表并生成可检验的误差图景。

papers.title: Piezoaxial coupling for strain-selected ferroaxial domain control
papers.abstract: We formulate a symmetry-based hierarchy of strain-derived conjugate fields for ferroaxial order, and demonstrate strain-selected ferroaxial domain control using first-principles calculations. Since ferroaxial order is even under both spatial inversion and time reversal, ordinary electric and magnetic fields cannot serve as universal linear conjugate fields. Homogeneous strain, however, can generate symmetry-allowed piezoaxial fields whose leading order is determined by the parent point group and by the chosen ferroaxial-axis component. For basal-plane strain, the leading field is linear in orthorhombic systems, quadratic in tetragonal systems, and cubic in trigonal and hexagonal systems. Cubic parent groups further split into two classes: cubic-I groups, $23$ and $m\bar{3}$, allow linear full-strain fields for selected axes, whereas cubic-II groups, $432$, $\bar{4}3m$, and $m\bar{3}m$, forbid linear fields and require quadratic or cubic strain combinations depending on the selected axis. In trigonal systems, the basal-plane deviatoric strain with signed amplitude $\varepsilon_{\rm u}$ and principal-axis angle $θ$ gives the single-axis field $h\propto\varepsilon_{\rm u}^3\sin6θ$. First-principles calculations for the trigonal ferroaxial compound Na$_2$BaMg(PO$_4$)$_2$ verify both the predicted angular dependence and cubic strain scaling of the ferroaxial domain splitting, and fixed-strain atomic relaxations show strain-selected evolution from the para-axial structure. These results establish static homogeneous strain as a symmetry-allowed conjugate field for ferroaxial order and suggest a route to ferroaxial domain control through strain-field cooling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+计算文章。判断依据：formulate a symmetry-based hierarchy（理论推导）、first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：铁轴向序（ferroaxial order）及其在应变下的畴控制，具体材料为三角晶系铁轴向化合物 Na₂BaMg(PO₄)₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀静应变可作为铁轴向序的对称性允许共轭场，通过应变场冷却实现铁轴向畴的选择性控制；在三角晶系中，畴分裂与应变振幅的三次方及角度六倍正弦成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀静应变可作为铁轴向序的对称性允许共轭场，通过应变场冷却实现铁轴向畴的选择性控制；在三角晶系中，畴分裂与应变振幅的三次方及角度六倍正弦成正比。；创新点：首次系统建立了应变作为铁轴向序共轭场的对称性层级，并利用第一性原理计算验证了三角晶系中应变三次方标度的畴控制机制。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于母点群分类应变诱导的压电轴向场阶次）、第一性原理计算（固定应变下的原子弛豫，验证畴分裂的应变标度与角度依赖）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic phase transitions in lattice spin systems with severe kinetic constraints: Numerical simulation results
papers.abstract: The Fredrickson-Andersen model with hyperparameter $K=1$ is a severely constrained kinetic lattice spin system, such that any site is temporarily blocked from changing its packing state (empty or occupied) if there is one or more occupied nearest neighbors. Starting from a completely random initial configuration with a fraction $ρ$ of sites being occupied, some of the sites may be permanently frozen to their initial state under this severe kinetic constraint. The remaining sites can switch states at least occasionally, and they form the unfrozen subsystem associated with the given initial configuration. In the present work we investigate thermodynamic phase transitions in such unfrozen subsystems of the two-dimensional square lattice and the three-dimensional cubic lattice by extensive numerical simulations. We demonstrate that the giant connected component of the unfrozen subsystem collapses at certain critical value $ρ_{c}$ of initial packing density, with $ρ_c = 0.2475$ for the square lattice and $ρ_c = 0.2809$ for the cubic lattice. This phase transition belongs to the same universality class of the conventional site percolation. We also observe that the ground states (densest packing configurations) experience a continuous crystal-to-glass phase transition at the critical value $ρ^* = 0.1423$ of initial packing density for the cubic lattice. For the two-dimensional square lattice we argue that long-range crystalline order is destroyed in the ground states as long as the initial packing density $ρ$ is positive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：关键词“extensive numerical simulations”、“numerical simulation results”。；研究对象：具有严重动力学约束的晶格自旋系统，具体为Fredrickson-Andersen模型（超参数K=1）在二维正方晶格和三维立方晶格中的“未冻结子系统”的热力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未冻结子系统的巨大连通分量在初始填充密度ρ达到临界值ρ_c时发生坍塌（二维ρ_c=0.2475，三维ρ_c=0.2809），该相变属于常规格点逾渗的普适类。此外，三维立方晶格的基态（最密堆积构型）在初始填充密度ρ*=0.1423处经历连续晶体-玻璃相变；二维正方晶格中，只要初始填充密度ρ>0，长程晶体序即被破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未冻结子系统的巨大连通分量在初始填充密度ρ达到临界值ρ_c时发生坍塌（二维ρ_c=0.2475，三维ρ_c=0.2809），该相变属于常规格点逾渗的普适类。此外，三维立方晶格的基态（最密堆积构型）在初始填充密度ρ*=0.1423处经历连续晶体-玻璃相变；二维正方晶格中，只要初始填充密度ρ>0，长程晶体序即被破坏。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模数值模拟，研究二维正方晶格和三维立方晶格中未冻结子系统的热力学相变行为。具体分析了未冻结子系统的巨大连通分量随初始填充密度ρ的变化，并确定了临界密度ρ_c及相变普适类。

papers.title: Robust Topologically Protected Edge Transport in Doubly Chiral Active Particles
papers.abstract: Using theory, simulation, and experiment, we introduce a new class of active particle which we term doubly chiral active Brownian particles (dcABPs), which show robust topologically protected transport along boundaries without backscattering at corners. Their double chirality stems from the coexistence of an intrinsic angular velocity, which can cause rotation independently of translation, and a translation-rotation coupling inducing cross-alignment to the instantaneous velocity, which causes rotation only concomitantly with translation. A mechanically detailed model shows that the latter effect can arise from an asymmetric friction distribution in the direction perpendicular to the self-propulsion direction. We show that topologically protected modes emerge when the two sources of chirality have opposite sign and the intrinsic rotation is weaker than the translation-rotation coupling. In the deterministic limit, we characterize the emergence of these modes not only along straight boundaries, but also along curved boundaries and during interparticle interactions. We provide a proof-of-principle experimental realization by building a doubly chiral vibrobot. While setting the work into context, we moreover show that the topologically protected boundary-induced transport of dcABPs stands in contrast to the edge currents observed for simple chiral ABPs, which we demonstrate are not associated with boundary-induced transport, as well as to those observed for chiral active rods or self-aligning chiral ABPs, which we show to be associated with boundary-induced transport but to backscatter at corners, implying lack of topological protection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论、模拟与实验结合）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“theory, simulation, and experiment”。；研究对象：双手性活性布朗粒子（doubly chiral active Brownian particles, dcABPs）及其边界拓扑保护输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两种手性来源符号相反且内禀旋转弱于平移-旋转耦合时，dcABPs沿边界（包括弯曲边界）出现拓扑保护的无背散射边缘输运模式，与简单手性ABP及手性活性杆等体系的边缘电流形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两种手性来源符号相反且内禀旋转弱于平移-旋转耦合时，dcABPs沿边界（包括弯曲边界）出现拓扑保护的无背散射边缘输运模式，与简单手性ABP及手性活性杆等体系的边缘电流形成对比。；创新点：首次提出并实现“双”手性活性粒子概念，揭示其拓扑保护边界输运的独特机制，并实验证明该输运在拐角处无背散射，区别于已有手性活性粒子体系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模（含机械细节模型，指出不对称摩擦分布可产生平移-旋转耦合）、数值模拟、以及实验构建双手机器人（vibrobot）进行原理验证。

papers.title: Uncertainty relations for arbitrary currents in coherent transport
papers.abstract: We derive thermodynamic and kinetic uncertainty relations valid for arbitrary currents in coherent, strongly coupled, linear systems out of equilibrium. Exploiting properties of the transport statistics, in particular fluctuation theorems, we identify the relevant entropy production and activity that determine the cost of precision at the level of individual scattering events. The resulting bounds include higher-order fluctuations and remain valid far from equilibrium. We illustrate our results in normal and superconducting hybrid structures, and show that their predictiveness and validity range exceeds existing formulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“推导”（derive）不确定性关系，并利用“输运统计性质”和“涨落定理”进行分析，属于理论推导与模型分析。；研究对象：相干输运中任意电流的量子系统，具体包括正常导体和超导混合结构中的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相干、强耦合、线性的非平衡系统中，存在适用于任意电流的热力学和动力学不确定性关系，其精度成本由熵产生和活性（activity）决定，且包含高阶涨落，适用范围超越现有理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相干、强耦合、线性的非平衡系统中，存在适用于任意电流的热力学和动力学不确定性关系，其精度成本由熵产生和活性（activity）决定，且包含高阶涨落，适用范围超越现有理论。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用输运统计性质（特别是涨落定理）推导不确定性关系，并在正常导体和超导混合结构中进行理论验证。

papers.title: On the capacitance gradient description in Heterodyne Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
papers.abstract: Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) probes local surface-potential variations through the electrostatic force between a conductive tip and a surface, which depends on the potential difference and the tip-surface capacitance gradient (CG). In heterodyne KPFM, the oscillating tip is usually treated by combining a bias-modulated electric field with a first-order truncated Taylor-series expansion of the CG. Although convenient, this treatment is limited to a poorly defined small-amplitude regime and leaves the convergence of the series unresolved. Here, we establish a rigorous spectral description of the CG dynamics and of the resulting electrostatic force beyond this approximation. We formulate a non-truncated Taylor-series description of the CG and prove its convergence for a realistic Hudlet-based capacitance model in both monomodal and bimodal motion. In the monomodal case, we show the equivalence between Fourier-series and Taylor-series descriptions, derive explicit expressions for the dominant Fourier coefficients, and introduce order-truncation criteria that replace the usual qualitative notion of a small-amplitude regime. We then extend the formalism to bimodal motion and derive the effective CG coefficients governing the static, first-eigenmode, and second-eigenmode components of the electrostatic interaction. Numerical simulations confirm the convergence of the Taylor-based coefficients toward the Fourier coefficients and support the truncation-regime hierarchy in both configurations. This work establishes the formal basis for describing electrostatic force components and AFM observables in open-loop heterodyne experiments and provides a general framework for CG dynamics in multimode force microscopy involving nonlinear electromechanical coupling and frequency conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：建立严格描述、推导表达式、数值模拟、理论框架。；研究对象：异质外差开尔文探针力显微镜（Heterodyne KPFM）中，导电针尖与样品表面之间的电容梯度（CG）动力学行为及由此产生的静电力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了超越传统一阶泰勒展开近似的电容梯度严格谱描述，证明了基于Hudlet电容模型的泰勒级数在单模态和双模态运动下的收敛性，并给出了替代“小振幅”定性概念的截断判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了超越传统一阶泰勒展开近似的电容梯度严格谱描述，证明了基于Hudlet电容模型的泰勒级数在单模态和双模态运动下的收敛性，并给出了替代“小振幅”定性概念的截断判据。；创新点：首次严格证明了电容梯度泰勒级数在真实电容模型下的收敛性，并提出了量化的阶数截断判据，取代了传统“小振幅”的模糊假设；将形式化描述从单模态推广至双模态运动，推导出控制静电相互作用各模态分量的有效电容梯度系数。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：非截断泰勒级数展开与傅里叶级数展开的等价性证明；数值模拟：验证泰勒系数向傅里叶系数的收敛性及截断层次。

papers.title: Layer-selective chirality switch in bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers
papers.abstract: We predict that intercalating bilayer graphene with nonmagnetic WSSe or magnetic MnSSe Janus monolayers induces a layer-selective switch of the in-plane Rashba spin texture, resulting in opposite spin current directions in the top and bottom graphene layers. First-principles calculations reveal that both Janus monolayers decouple the two graphene layers while simultaneously inducing opposite signs of the proximity-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling in each. Tight-binding modeling of the proximitized layers, combined with Rashba-Edelstein charge-to-spin conversion calculations, confirms that the spin current direction can be independently controlled by gating the top or bottom graphene layer. Bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers thus represents a promising platform for gate-tunable, layer-selective spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。判断依据：关键词“First-principles calculations”、“Tight-binding modeling”、“predict”。；研究对象：双层石墨烯中插入非磁性WSSe或磁性MnSSe Janus单层的异质结构，以及其中由近邻效应诱导的层选择性Rashba自旋织构和自旋电流方向。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 插入Janus单层后，上下两层石墨烯被解耦，并分别被诱导出符号相反的近邻Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，从而在顶层和底层产生相反方向的自旋电流，实现层选择性的自旋方向开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：插入Janus单层后，上下两层石墨烯被解耦，并分别被诱导出符号相反的近邻Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，从而在顶层和底层产生相反方向的自旋电流，实现层选择性的自旋方向开关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）和紧束缚模型（Tight-binding modeling），并结合Rashba-Edelstein电荷-自旋转换计算。

papers.title: Quantum Density of States and Integer Partitions: A Semiclassical Approach
papers.abstract: In this review we discuss semi-classical methods that are traditionally used to describe many-body systems in physics, but may also be used to describe partitions of integers in analytic number theory. Specifically, we explore the connection between the methods of statistical mechanics and number partitions. Though the two fields appear very different, their fundamental issues bear a close resemblance. In the former case it is the distribution of a given amount of energy among the particles in an ensemble at a given temperature with well defined properties, while in the latter case it is the way an integer is partitioned into other integers, with or without restrictions. We begin with a discussion of the single-particle quantum density of states, also called the level density, in which we illustrate the connection between the density of states and the classical periodic orbits through the semiclassical trace formula. This is then extended to many particle systems. We show that the asymptotic number partition is reproduced by the average (smooth) part of the level density at discrete integer values of the argument. In the especially interesting case of distinct square partitions, pronounced oscillations are well reproduced by the periodic orbit theory in terms of a few orbits characterised by Pythagorean number triples. We speculate on the connection to Fermat's theorem as to why such regular oscillations (though vanishing asymptotically) exist only in this special case. Finally, we discuss some new results for integer partitions of primes, both unrestricted and distinct.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：semi-classical methods、review、analytic number theory、trace formula、periodic orbit theory）；研究对象：整数分划（integer partitions）与多体系统态密度之间的半经典对应关系，特别关注无限制分划、不同平方数分划以及素数分划。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 整数分划的渐近计数可由单粒子能级密度的平滑部分在离散整数自变量处重现；不同平方数分划中的显著振荡可由毕达哥拉斯三元数表征的少数经典周期轨道通过周期轨道理论精确再现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：整数分划的渐近计数可由单粒子能级密度的平滑部分在离散整数自变量处重现；不同平方数分划中的显著振荡可由毕达哥拉斯三元数表征的少数经典周期轨道通过周期轨道理论精确再现。；创新点：将传统用于多体物理的半经典方法系统应用于解析数论中的整数分划问题，并首次用周期轨道理论解释了不同平方数分划中特有的振荡现象，同时探讨了该振荡与费马大定理的可能联系。
papers.method_zh: 半经典迹公式（semiclassical trace formula）、周期轨道理论（periodic orbit theory）、统计力学方法（如能级密度分析）。

papers.title: Inverse heterodyne effect in bimodal Kelvin probe force microscopy
papers.abstract: Heterodyne Kelvin probe force microscopy (He-KPFM) enables high-sensitivity electrostatic measurements by converting a bias-modulated interaction into a resonant response at a higher cantilever eigenmode. While the "direct" heterodyne actuation of the second eigenmode is well established, the dynamical back-action of this heterodyne-driven motion on the fundamental eigenmode has remained largely unexplored, particularly in open-loop operation where the second mode is excited to a finite amplitude. Here, we demonstrate an inverse heterodyne effect: a force component generated by heterodyne frequency conversion acts back on the first eigenmode and produces measurable inter-mode energy exchange. The analysis combines a bimodal virial and power-balance framework with a non-truncated description of the tip-surface capacitance-gradient dynamics developed and validated in a companion manuscript submitted concurrently to the same journal. On this basis, we derive closed-form expressions linking inverse heterodyne coupling to the experimentally accessible observables of non-contact AFM open-loop amplitude-modulated He-KPFM. The theory predicts that inverse heterodyne coupling appears predominantly in the dissipation channel, with a sharply resonant dependence on the demodulation frequency near the second-eigenmode resonance, while its conservative contribution to the frequency shift remains comparatively weaker under typical conditions. Ultrahigh-vacuum experiments validate these predictions and isolate the inverse heterodyne signature through frequency- and voltage-dependent measurements. Beyond KPFM, this work connects heterodyne force microscopy to a broader class of driven multimode systems in which nonlinear coupling and frequency conversion produce inter-mode energy transfer, back-action, and dissipation-based observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。判断依据：理论框架推导（bimodal virial and power-balance framework、closed-form expressions）结合实验验证（ultrahigh-vacuum experiments）。；研究对象：双模态开尔文探针力显微镜（bimodal Kelvin probe force microscopy）中的逆外差效应（inverse heterodyne effect），即外差驱动第二本征模对第一本征模产生的动力学反作用及模间能量交换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在开环振幅调制外差KPFM中，外差频率转换产生的力分量会反作用于第一本征模，产生可测量的模间能量交换；该效应主要出现在耗散通道中，且对解调频率具有尖锐的共振依赖性，而其对频移的保守贡献相对较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在开环振幅调制外差KPFM中，外差频率转换产生的力分量会反作用于第一本征模，产生可测量的模间能量交换；该效应主要出现在耗散通道中，且对解调频率具有尖锐的共振依赖性，而其对频移的保守贡献相对较弱。；创新点：首次揭示并理论描述了外差KPFM中第二本征模对第一本征模的动力学反作用（逆外差效应），建立了该效应与实验可观测量的闭合解析表达式，并将外差力显微镜与更广泛的驱动多模系统中的非线性耦合、频率转换及耗散可观测量联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：双模态维里与功率平衡框架（bimodal virial and power-balance framework），结合非截断的针尖-表面电容梯度动力学描述（non-truncated description of tip-surface capacitance-gradient dynamics）。实验手段：超高真空（UHV）环境下的频率依赖和电压依赖测量。

papers.title: Hidden Entropy Production at Mechanical Stall: Exact Reconstruction in a Reciprocal Brownian Motor
papers.abstract: We show that in a reciprocal Brownian motor the entropy production hidden behind a mechanically stalled coordinate can be reconstructed exactly from measurements of that coordinate alone. We introduce a minimal, analytically solvable Langevin motor in which an observed translational coordinate is coupled reciprocally to a hidden internal rotor: a single periodic potential $V(x-\ellθ)$ generates both the force on the observed coordinate and the reaction torque on the hidden one, so that $τ_{\rm int}=-\ell F_x$ holds identically. Force--torque reciprocity together with translational symmetry produces a local current identity that closes the hidden thermodynamic bookkeeping. From it we prove that the Harada--Sasa heat measured through the observed coordinate equals the positive current-square dissipation of that coordinate, with the information-flow correction vanishing identically. eciprocal class. ries in that it requires no separation of time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We show”“We introduce”“We prove”等理论推导表述，并构建了可解析求解的Langevin模型，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：倒易布朗马达（reciprocal Brownian motor）中机械卡死（mechanical stall）状态下隐藏的熵产生。具体体系为一个可观测的平移坐标与一个隐藏的内部转子通过单一周期势V(x-ℓθ)耦合的Langevin马达。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在倒易布朗马达中，机械卡死坐标背后隐藏的熵产生可以仅通过该坐标的测量精确重构。证明Harada-Sasa热测量等于该坐标的正电流平方耗散，且信息流修正项恒为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在倒易布朗马达中，机械卡死坐标背后隐藏的熵产生可以仅通过该坐标的测量精确重构。证明Harada-Sasa热测量等于该坐标的正电流平方耗散，且信息流修正项恒为零。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但指出该方法不需要时间尺度分离，且适用于整个倒易类系统。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个最小化、可解析求解的Langevin马达模型，利用力-扭矩倒易关系（τ_int = -ℓF_x）和平移对称性推导出局域流恒等式，从而闭合隐藏的热力学记账。

papers.title: Self-Bound Droplets of Ultracold Dipolar Molecules under Tunable Double Microwave Shielding
papers.abstract: We use the Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method to study a Bose-Einstein condensate of strongly interacting NaCs polar molecules under the action of a fully anisotropic double microwave shielding potential characterized by a linear and an elliptical polarization field. In particular, we analyze the ground state of the system and its structure as a function of the ellipticity angle $ξ$. While for the circularly polarized case ($ξ=0$) a gas phase is realized, one or more self-bound droplets are observed for small $|ξ|$'s above a threshold value near $3^\circ$. With increasing $ξ$, the observed droplets rapidly become tightly bound and are estimated to form a superfluid array. Our results compare favorably to the experimental observations in [Zhang et al., Nature \textbf{651}, 601 (2026)] for positive $ξ$, while moderate differences show up for $ξ<0$ where our simulations conform to the expected symmetries of the intermolecular potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method（基态路径积分蒙特卡洛方法）。；研究对象：超冷NaCs极性分子在双微波屏蔽势作用下的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，具体研究其自束缚液滴的形成与结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双微波屏蔽势的椭圆极化角度ξ接近零时，系统呈现气相；当|ξ|超过约3°的阈值后，会形成一个或多个自束缚液滴，且随ξ增大液滴迅速变得紧密束缚，可能形成超流阵列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双微波屏蔽势的椭圆极化角度ξ接近零时，系统呈现气相；当|ξ|超过约3°的阈值后，会形成一个或多个自束缚液滴，且随ξ增大液滴迅速变得紧密束缚，可能形成超流阵列。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基态路径积分蒙特卡洛方法（Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method），用于模拟全各向异性双微波屏蔽势（包含线性和椭圆极化场）下的强相互作用极性分子体系。

papers.title: Multiscale modelling of diffusion and retention of hydrogen in multi-occupancy traps in irradiated bcc metals
papers.abstract: We use molecular dynamics simulations to directly compute the effective diffusivity of hydrogen gas atoms in homogeneous distributions of monovacancies in tungsten and vanadium, and voids in tungsten. Rather than fitting the results to an Arrhenius law, we compare to an analytic approximation for the effective diffusivity recently derived for multi-occupancy traps [Kaur et al (2025), Phys. Rev. Mater. 9:125404]. We find good agreement between full atomistic simulation and our theory, validating the analytic model for diffusivity for materials containing nanoscale defects characteristic of radiation damage. There are no parameters fitted, only physically motivated quantities that can be computed with static density functional or atomistic potential calculations. In this study we prove rapid convergence of hydrogen trap occupation to the steady state using lattice kinetic Monte Carlo, the spontaneous emergence of voids in tungsten using atomistic simulation with empirical potentials, and molecular hydrogen formation in voids using molecular dynamics. We conclude with a prediction for diffusion and retention of hydrogen in voids in tungsten starting from first principles. This work shows that not only is the analytic form for diffusivity and retention in multi-occupancy traps a practical scheme for making predictive simulations of hydrogen isotope diffusion and retention in irradiated microstructures, derived and parameterized from first principles, it is superior to existing single-occupancy trap formalisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular dynamics simulations、lattice kinetic Monte Carlo、atomistic simulation、first principles）；研究对象：氢原子在辐照体心立方金属（钨和钒）中的扩散与滞留行为，具体涉及单空位和空洞中的多占据陷阱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于多占据陷阱模型推导的有效扩散率解析近似与全原子模拟结果吻合良好，验证了该解析模型在含纳米级辐照缺陷材料中的有效性；该模型优于现有的单占据陷阱形式，且无需拟合参数，仅依赖第一性原理或原子势计算得到的物理量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于多占据陷阱模型推导的有效扩散率解析近似与全原子模拟结果吻合良好，验证了该解析模型在含纳米级辐照缺陷材料中的有效性；该模型优于现有的单占据陷阱形式，且无需拟合参数，仅依赖第一性原理或原子势计算得到的物理量。；创新点：首次将多占据陷阱解析扩散模型与全原子模拟直接对比验证，并证明该模型可完全基于第一性原理参数化，无需经验拟合，且优于传统单占据陷阱模型。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（直接计算有效扩散率）、晶格动力学蒙特卡洛（验证陷阱占据快速达到稳态）、经验势原子模拟（自发形成空洞）、第一性原理计算（预测氢在钨空洞中的扩散与滞留）。

papers.title: Conditional Residence Times and Sequential Transition Dynamics of an Overdamped Dimere
papers.abstract: We investigate the completion dynamics of an overdamped dimer moving in a bistable potential under thermal fluctuations and a weak periodic force. Both monomers start in one of the two wells separated by a barrier. The transition is initiated when the monomer closer to the barrier makes a jump across it. The completion dynamics refers to the next part of the dynamics where the second monomer has to wait for some time before it can follow up. We use the Conditional Residence Time (CRT) to study the delay between the successive barrier crossing of the two monomers. The CRT distributions highlight qualitatively different regimes formed by the competition between the escape times of the lagging monomer and the time period of the external drive. The effect is strongest in the weak coupling regime where the delayed completion is spread across multiple forcing cycles. By partitioning this process into three windows, i.e. the immediate, first cycle and later cycles, we show that the probability that the lagging monomer will make a transition in the said cycle is redistributed among these pathways as we change the frequency of the drive. This leads to a non-monotonic dependence of the mean CRT on the frequency of the drive. Our results demonstrate that transition initiation and completion in a coupled system are two separate processes and establish CRT as a useful measure to quantify the sequential barrier crossing dynamics in coupled stochastic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“use”“show”“demonstrate”等理论分析动词，未提及实验或计算模拟方法，属于随机动力学理论分析。；研究对象：过阻尼二聚体（overdamped dimer）在双稳势阱中的顺序跃迁动力学，具体关注两个单体先后跨越势垒的完成过程（completion dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耦合系统中跃迁的“启动”与“完成”是两个独立过程；条件停留时间（CRT）分布揭示了滞后单体逃逸时间与外部驱动周期之间的竞争，导致平均CRT随驱动频率呈非单调变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耦合系统中跃迁的“启动”与“完成”是两个独立过程；条件停留时间（CRT）分布揭示了滞后单体逃逸时间与外部驱动周期之间的竞争，导致平均CRT随驱动频率呈非单调变化。；创新点：首次将条件停留时间（CRT）引入耦合随机系统的顺序势垒穿越动力学研究，明确区分了跃迁的“启动”与“完成”两个过程，并揭示了弱耦合下延迟完成可跨越多个驱动周期的现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用条件停留时间（Conditional Residence Time, CRT）作为量化工具，分析热涨落下弱周期力驱动的过阻尼二聚体在双稳势阱中的顺序跃迁动力学，通过将完成过程划分为“立即”、“第一周期”和“后续周期”三个窗口来研究概率重分布。

papers.title: Weak-coupling altermagnetism and chiral magnetic excitations in a checkerboard lattice
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, characterized by spin-split electronic bands with compensated magnetic moments, have emerged as a new class of magnetic materials garnering attention in recent years. Here, using a minimal one-band Hubbard model, we show that the checkerboard lattice serves as a natural platform for altermagnetism for electrons. The instability towards altermagnetic order is denoted by diverging altermagnetic susceptibility at weak-coupling. Carrying out mean-field treatment of the Hubbard repulsion, we show phase transitions from the nonmagnetic to altermagnetic semimetal and then to altermagnetic insulating phase, allowing clear identification of spin-split states. We then examine magnetic excitations in the altermagnetic phases using a random-phase approximation treatment of the dynamical spin susceptibility. The altermagnetic order is found to be stable against spin-fluctuations with the excitation spectra showing well-defined magnon excitations, which decay into single-particle excitations with decreasing interaction strength. Remarkably, the magnetic excitations exhibit strong dependence on both chirality and direction, showing an alternating chirality splitting, similar to the alternating spin splitting of the electronic bands, which serves as a salient feature of altermagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“Hubbard model”、“mean-field treatment”、“random-phase approximation”，均为理论计算和模型分析方法。；研究对象：棋盘晶格（checkerboard lattice）中的弱耦合交变磁性（altermagnetism）及其手性磁激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 棋盘晶格是产生交变磁性的天然平台，其交变磁性相中的磁激发表现出与电子能带类似的手性交替劈裂现象，这是交变磁性的一个显著特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：棋盘晶格是产生交变磁性的天然平台，其交变磁性相中的磁激发表现出与电子能带类似的手性交替劈裂现象，这是交变磁性的一个显著特征。；创新点：首次在棋盘晶格这一具体晶格模型中，从弱耦合极限出发，系统论证了交变磁性的不稳定性、相变过程，并揭示了磁激发中与电子能带结构相对应的手性交替劈裂这一新特征。
papers.method_zh: 使用最小单带哈伯德模型（one-band Hubbard model）描述电子相互作用；通过平均场理论（mean-field treatment）处理哈伯德排斥项，分析相变；利用随机相位近似（random-phase approximation, RPA）处理动力学自旋磁化率，研究磁激发。

papers.title: Universal self-similar evolution of two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates in the acoustic regime
papers.abstract: When driven out of equilibrium, a Bose-Einstein condensate develops nonlinearly interacting density waves that trigger a turbulent cascade, transferring energy toward small scales. In this article, we investigate the nonstationary evolution of solutions to the two-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation. Through numerical simulations of both the GPE and the corresponding Wave Kinetic Equation, we identify self-similar solutions relevant to atomic and polariton Bose-Einstein Condensates. These solutions exhibit characteristics of both first and second kind self-similarity. In particular, we show that the dynamics of the propagating front is universal, governed by a dimensionless universal constant $β$, which we determine numerically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：numerical simulations、Wave Kinetic Equation、self-similar solutions。；研究对象：二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates）在声学区（acoustic regime）的非平衡演化，具体涉及原子和极化激元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在非平衡演化中表现出自相似解，其传播前沿的动力学是普适的，由一个无量纲普适常数β决定，该常数通过数值计算确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在非平衡演化中表现出自相似解，其传播前沿的动力学是普适的，由一个无量纲普适常数β决定，该常数通过数值计算确定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟二维Gross-Pitaevskii方程（GPE）以及对应的波动力学方程（Wave Kinetic Equation），识别自相似解。

papers.title: Stabilization of Stone-Wales Defects in Metal-supported Graphene
papers.abstract: The characteristics of graphene-metal interfaces play a decisive role in their electronic, optoelectronic, and mechanical applications. Properties such as charge transfer across the interface become particularly significant in the presence of topological defects. The stability of Stone Wales (SW) defects in graphene is governed by the balance between three energy descriptors, the activation energy, formation energy, and restoration energy. By comparing the energy parameters obtained from first-principles density functional theory calculations, we show that SW defect formation is energetically more favorable on metal-supported graphene. Our calculations for SW defects in graphene/Cu(111) and graphene/Al(111) systems indicate only a little dependence of energy profile on the type of metal. The presence of the metal substrate leads to a $\sim$ 12\% increase in the formation energy and a $\sim$ 20\% reduction in the activation energy, which together favor the formation of Stone Wales defects. Although the restoration energy decreases by about $\sim$ 35\% in metal-supported graphene, it remains significantly higher to prevent self-healing. As a result, once formed, the Stone Wales defects are likely to remain stable, suggesting the possibility of terminal SW defect formation in metal-supported graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles density functional theory calculations（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：金属支撑石墨烯中的Stone-Wales（SW）拓扑缺陷的稳定性，具体体系为石墨烯/Cu(111)和石墨烯/Al(111)界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属衬底的存在使SW缺陷的形成能增加约12%，激活能降低约20%，从而在能量上更有利于SW缺陷的形成；同时，恢复能降低约35%，但仍足够高以阻止自愈合，因此一旦形成，SW缺陷在金属支撑石墨烯中可能保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属衬底的存在使SW缺陷的形成能增加约12%，激活能降低约20%，从而在能量上更有利于SW缺陷的形成；同时，恢复能降低约35%，但仍足够高以阻止自愈合，因此一旦形成，SW缺陷在金属支撑石墨烯中可能保持稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，通过比较激活能、形成能和恢复能三个能量参数来分析SW缺陷的稳定性。

papers.title: Deep-learning Hamiltonian reveals twist-tunable flat bands and nonlinear photocurrents in SrTiO3 moire bilayers
papers.abstract: The extension of moire physics to complex oxides offers new ways to manipulate electronic states, but the large oxide moire supercells make systematic first-principles calculations demanding. Here, we combine density functional theory with the E(3)-equivariant deep-learning Hamiltonian framework DeepH-E3 to investigate the twist-angle-dependent electronic structure and optical responses of twisted bilayer SrTiO3. The model is trained on untwisted bilayers with different interlayer-sliding configurations and then applied to commensurate twisted bilayers with twist angles from 8.80 degrees to 53.13 degrees. Compared with the untwisted bilayer, decreasing twist angle systematically flattens the valence bands and leads to nearly dispersionless bands at the smallest angles studied. Based on the predicted Hamiltonians, we evaluate the dielectric response, second-harmonic generation (SHG), shift current, and spin Hall conductivity. The dielectric response and spin Hall conductivity remain close to those of the untwisted bilayer, whereas the nonlinear optical responses are more strongly affected by twisting. SHG is strongly enhanced relative to the weak untwisted response, and the shift current shows a clear twist-angle dependence within the response-calculation range (53.13 degrees-22.62 degrees). These results show that twist engineering can control electronic and optoelectronic responses in oxide moire systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine density functional theory with the E(3)-equivariant deep-learning Hamiltonian framework DeepH-E3”，属于第一性原理计算与深度学习模型相结合的计算研究。；研究对象：扭曲双层钛酸锶（twisted bilayer SrTiO₃）的电子结构与光学响应，具体包括转角依赖的能带、介电响应、二次谐波产生（SHG）、位移电流（shift current）和自旋霍尔电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 减小转角会使价带系统性地变平，在最小转角下出现近乎无色散的平带；非线性光学响应（如SHG和位移电流）对转角变化敏感，而介电响应和自旋霍尔电导率则与未扭曲双层接近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：减小转角会使价带系统性地变平，在最小转角下出现近乎无色散的平带；非线性光学响应（如SHG和位移电流）对转角变化敏感，而介电响应和自旋霍尔电导率则与未扭曲双层接近。；创新点：将深度学习哈密顿量方法（DeepH-E3）应用于氧化物莫尔超晶格体系，实现了对超大原胞扭曲双层SrTiO₃的高效第一性原理计算，并揭示了转角可调谐的平带与非线性光电流效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合E(3)等变深度学习哈密顿量框架DeepH-E3。模型在未扭曲但具有不同层间滑移构型的双层上训练，然后应用于转角为8.80°至53.13°的共格扭曲双层。

papers.title: From Active to Odd to Smart Matter
papers.abstract: The study of active matter has reshaped our understanding of collective states of matter far from equilibrium by proving that energy pumped into the microscopic scale leads to order on the macroscopic scale, collective motion, and anomalous mechanical responses. More recently, the discovery of odd elasticity and nonreciprocal mechanical couplings has extended these ideas to solid-like active systems, revealing materials with nonconservative elastic response. Simultaneously, innovative developments in swarm robotics , programmable metamaterials , and learning algorithms have led to the emergence of a new frontier in which collective behavior and mechanical response are no longer fixed by design, but adapted, optimized, and learned toward functional goals. This Perspective proposes a unifying trajectory, from active to odd to smart matter, organized along two intertwined axes: the traditional gas--liquid--solid progression of condensed matter, and the more recentparadigm shift from spontaneous collective dynamics to task-driven functionality. We try to highlight emerging principles, conceptual shifts, and open challenges that come along this trajectory, and argue that learning may play the role of a specific form of emergence, which could advantageously replace the more traditional view of control, at least in the realm of physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章/综述（Perspective）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“This Perspective proposes...”，且内容为对领域发展轨迹的梳理和未来方向的展望，而非具体实验或计算。；研究对象：论文研究的是一类广义的“非平衡凝聚态物质”，具体包括：活性物质（Active matter）、奇弹性物质（Odd matter）以及智能物质（Smart matter）。物理现象涵盖集体运动、非互易力学耦合、非保守弹性响应以及由任务驱动的自适应集体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出了一条从“活性物质”到“奇弹性物质”再到“智能物质”的统一发展轨迹，并指出学习（learning）可能作为一种特殊的涌现形式，在物理框架内替代传统的控制范式，从而实现从自发集体动力学到任务驱动功能性的范式转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出了一条从“活性物质”到“奇弹性物质”再到“智能物质”的统一发展轨迹，并指出学习（learning）可能作为一种特殊的涌现形式，在物理框架内替代传统的控制范式，从而实现从自发集体动力学到任务驱动功能性的范式转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体的单一创新点，但本文的核心新意在于：首次将活性物质、奇弹性物质和智能物质这三个看似独立的前沿领域，沿着“气-液-固”凝聚态物质演化和“自发动力学到任务驱动功能”这两条轴线进行统一的概念化梳理，并提出了“学习作为涌现的一种形式”这一新颖观点。
papers.method_zh: 本文为前瞻性综述（Perspective），未采用具体的实验或计算手段。其理论框架基于对活性物质、奇弹性（odd elasticity）以及群体机器人学、可编程超材料和学习算法等领域最新进展的整合与概念性分析。

papers.title: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium
papers.abstract: We develop a general method, based on the construction of a kinetic potential acting as a Lyapunov function, to establish when diffusion necessarily equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems, under arbitrary driving by autonomous homogeneous chemostats. Using this method, we generalize the results of J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024) by relaxing some of the underlying assumptions.
