Specifically, we show that diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled by the stoichiometry of reactants and products, or complex balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled only by the stoichiometry of the reactants. The different constraints on the reaction fluxes are shown to originate from the distinct stoichiometric properties of the two classes of networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lyapunov function、general method、theoretical framework。；研究对象：非理想反应-扩散系统（non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems），具体研究在自主均匀化学恒化器驱动下，扩散过程是否必然导致系统达到平衡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于化学反应网络满足伪细致平衡（pseudo-detailed balanced）或复平衡（complex balanced）的非理想反应-扩散系统，扩散过程必然导致系统平衡化，无法维持非平衡扩散态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于化学反应网络满足伪细致平衡（pseudo-detailed balanced）或复平衡（complex balanced）的非理想反应-扩散系统，扩散过程必然导致系统平衡化，无法维持非平衡扩散态。；创新点：在更宽松的假设下（如非理想性、任意自主均匀化学恒化器驱动），建立了判断反应-扩散系统能否维持非平衡扩散的通用判据，并明确了伪细致平衡与复平衡两类网络在反应通量约束上的化学计量起源差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于构造作为Lyapunov函数的动力学势（kinetic potential）的通用方法，推广了J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024)的结果，放松了部分原始假设。通过分析两类反应网络（伪细致平衡与复平衡）的化学计量特性，揭示了反应通量受控于反应物与产物化学计量（伪细致平衡）或仅受控于反应物化学计量（复平衡）的不同约束来源。

papers.title: Bose Einstein Condensation of Magnons in BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$: An experimental perspective
papers.abstract: Han Purple, a pigment first obtained in ancient China, is one of the earliest known synthetic pigments. Also naturally occurring, as a mineral, it is known as colinowensite (Cwn). Its chemical formula is BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$, and its structure is a layered cyclosilicate in which magnetic Cu$^{2+}$ ions (S = 1/2) form dimers arranged on a square lattice, making it also the first known synthetic metal dimer compound. Most interesting magnetic properties arise from a strong intradimer spin coupling, accompanied by weaker interdimer interactions within and between Cu-dimer layers. In zero or small magnetic fields, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ remains a quantum paramagnet. However, under high magnetic fields between 23 and 49 Tesla -- about a million times stronger than Earth's magnetic field -- it undergoes magnetic ordering at subliquid Helium temperatures into an almost ideal easy-plane (XY) antiferromagnetic state regarded as a realization of a Bose-Einstein condensate of magnons. Within this experimentally accessible field range, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ serves as an extraordinary playground for testing predictions of quantum many-body physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要标题明确标注“An experimental perspective”，内容聚焦于实验观测到的磁有序和相变行为。；研究对象：BaCuSi₂O₆（硅酸铜钡，即“汉紫”颜料）中的磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）现象。具体体系为Cu²⁺（S=1/2）二聚体构成的准二维方形晶格量子磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在23至49特斯拉的高磁场和亚液氦温度下，BaCuSi₂O₆从量子顺磁态转变为近乎理想的易平面（XY型）反铁磁有序态，该有序态被解释为磁振子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在23至49特斯拉的高磁场和亚液氦温度下，BaCuSi₂O₆从量子顺磁态转变为近乎理想的易平面（XY型）反铁磁有序态，该有序态被解释为磁振子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：该工作从实验角度系统展示了BaCuSi₂O₆作为首个合成金属二聚体化合物，在宽且可实验达到的磁场范围内实现磁振子BEC，为检验量子多体物理预言提供了理想平台。
papers.method_zh: 高磁场（23–49 T）下的低温磁化或磁有序测量（摘要未明确具体实验技术，如中子散射或磁化率测量，但明确提及“实验视角”和“磁场与温度条件”）。

papers.title: High temperature ferromagnetism in epitaxial monolayers of Co-doped Fe5GeTe2
papers.abstract: Magnetic van der Waals materials have mainly been investigated in their bulk form or as few-layers flakes. Due to the challenges in producing atomically thin films, only a few have been isolated as monolayers, which typically exhibit long-range magnetic order below 150 K. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize Co-doped Fe5GeTe2, achieving precise control over both thickness and composition. We demonstrate ferromagnetism well above room temperature in multilayer samples and present clear evidence of ferromagnetic ordering in monolayers up to $\sim$200 K. The changes in Curie temperature and magnetic anisotropy with composition exhibit similar trends in both monolayers and thicker films, indicating that the magnetic properties are primarily governed by intralayer magnetic interactions. Through element-specific X-ray magnetic circular dichroism and density functional theory, we identify the substitution site of Co dopants and reveal the mechanism behind the Curie temperature enhancement induced by Co doping. Our findings suggest that, despite their weak magnetic moment, Co dopants strengthen the magnetic moments on neighboring Fe atoms and enhance the intralayer ferromagnetic exchange interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：分子束外延合成、X射线磁圆二色性、实验表征）；研究对象：Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂单层薄膜的室温以上铁磁性
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延成功制备Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂单层，在约200 K以下仍保持铁磁有序，且居里温度增强机制源于Co掺杂增强邻近Fe原子磁矩及层内铁磁交换作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延成功制备Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂单层，在约200 K以下仍保持铁磁有序，且居里温度增强机制源于Co掺杂增强邻近Fe原子磁矩及层内铁磁交换作用。；创新点：首次在单层极限下实现Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂的室温以上铁磁性（多层样品），并明确单层中磁有序温度可达~200 K，且磁性质主要由层内相互作用主导。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）精确控制厚度与组分；元素特异性X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）确定Co掺杂位点；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算揭示居里温度增强机制。

papers.title: The Ramsey community number as a renormalization-group crossing
papers.abstract: The Ramsey community number $r_k$ is the smallest size at which a network is better described by communities than by none, under a Bayesian detection rule. On the diamond hierarchical lattice we show that $r_k$ is an exact renormalization-group crossing: the block-model sufficient statistics obey a linear map with eigenvalues $\{bs,b\}$, the degree-corrected evidence density flows to $\ln K$ at a community fixed point, and $r_k$ is the generation at which the running evidence clears the detection threshold. Degree correction advances detection by two generations. We derive $r_k(b,s;q)$ in closed form for the whole family. Finally, placing on the lattice the Reichardt--Bornholdt community Hamiltonian -- whose ground state is the partition itself -- we find an exact community-ordered phase: below the ferromagnetic critical temperature the two hubs lock into opposite communities for any resolution $γ>0$, a staggered order that persists as $n\to\infty$. Allowing each nested sub-community its own label, the optimal partition is a hierarchy of $q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}$ communities, so the number of Potts states that best describes the network grows with the network. This hierarchy orders thermally level by level, through a cascade of first-order transitions whose temperatures fall as $1/\ln q$, so every stable level persists as $n\to\infty$: the emergent partition is detectable, optimal, and thermodynamically ordered.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group crossing（重整化群交叉）、Bayesian detection rule（贝叶斯检测规则）、exact community-ordered phase（精确社区有序相）。；研究对象：网络中的社区检测问题，具体在菱形层级晶格（diamond hierarchical lattice）上研究Ramsey社区数（Ramsey community number）作为重整化群交叉点的行为，以及Reichardt–Bornholdt社区哈密顿量在该晶格上的精确社区有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ramsey社区数在菱形层级晶格上表现为精确的重整化群交叉点，其闭式解可解析推导；在该晶格上，Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量存在精确的社区有序相，且最优分区中的社区数随网络规模增长（\(q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}\)），并通过一系列一级相变在热力学上逐层有序化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ramsey社区数在菱形层级晶格上表现为精确的重整化群交叉点，其闭式解可解析推导；在该晶格上，Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量存在精确的社区有序相，且最优分区中的社区数随网络规模增长（\(q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}\)），并通过一系列一级相变在热力学上逐层有序化。；创新点：首次将Ramsey社区数解释为重整化群交叉点，并给出其在层级晶格上的精确解析解；发现社区有序相在热力学极限下稳定存在，且最优社区数随系统规模增长，揭示了层级社区结构的可检测性与热力学有序性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用重整化群方法分析块模型充分统计量的线性映射（特征值为\(\{bs,b\}\)），计算度修正后的证据密度流，并解析推导Ramsey社区数\(r_k(b,s;q)\)的闭式解；同时通过统计力学分析Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量的基态和热力学相变行为。

papers.title: Electron-Phonon Dephasing in Ultrathin Disordered Films: From Power Laws to Diagnostic Maps
papers.abstract: Electron-phonon dephasing in ultrathin disordered metallic films is often summarized by a power law, $τ_{e-ph}^{-1}=AT^p$. However, thin metals, alloys, and superconducting films exhibit effective exponents close to 2, 3, and 4, as well as intermediate nonuniversal values. We argue that in ultrathin supported films, the exponent should be treated not as a universal material constant, but as a crossover observable. Its interpretation requires several coordinates: the clean-to-dirty parameter $q_T l$, phonon confinement and film-substrate acoustic coupling, and the microscopic character of disorder. The diagnostic picture is illustrated using Ar-ion-irradiated Au films as a controlled-disorder series. In these films, the fitted electron-phonon exponent remains near $p\simeq 2$ for low values of the pure-dirty crossover temperature $T_{tr}\simeq \hbar s/(k_B l)$ and increases toward $p\simeq 2.8$ as disorder increases. At the same time, the prefactor trend indicates suppression of electron-phonon scattering with decreasing mean free path, consistent with dirty-limit weakening rather than static-disorder enhancement. The persistence of $p<4$ points to the role of thin-film or film-substrate phonon effects. The resulting diagnostic map provides a compact framework for comparing electron-phonon dephasing data in ultrathin disordered films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：argue, treat as crossover observable, diagnostic picture, framework）；研究对象：超薄无序金属薄膜中的电子-声子退相干过程，特别是其幂律指数p的物理含义与影响因素。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄支撑膜中电子-声子退相干的幂律指数p并非普适材料常数，而是随无序程度、声子受限及薄膜-衬底声学耦合变化的交叉行为；随着无序增强，p从约2增至约2.8，且散射强度被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄支撑膜中电子-声子退相干的幂律指数p并非普适材料常数，而是随无序程度、声子受限及薄膜-衬底声学耦合变化的交叉行为；随着无序增强，p从约2增至约2.8，且散射强度被抑制。；创新点：提出将电子-声子退相干指数p视为交叉可观测量（crossover observable），并引入清洁-脏乱参数q_T l、声子受限及薄膜-衬底耦合等多坐标诊断框架，而非简单归因于单一幂律。
papers.method_zh: 基于理论分析构建诊断图（diagnostic map），并结合Ar离子辐照Au薄膜作为受控无序系列进行实验数据对比验证。

papers.title: CE-antiferromagnetic electronic structure in LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ revealed by micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and tight-binding models
papers.abstract: We have investigated the electronic structure of LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ in the CE-type antiferromagnetic (CE-AFM) state below the Néel temperature using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy ($μ$-ARPES) and tight-binding models. In agreement with the tight-binding calculations, we found a dispersive intensity around the X point in the $μ$-ARPES spectra, where the A-type antiferromagnetic (A-AFM) phase has no bands experimentally and theoretically, demonstrating that we have successfully captured the signatures of the CE-AFM band structure for the first time. Many observed features can be explained by the CE-AFM tight-binding bands, although some of them and the overall near-Fermi level intensity mapping can be explained by the A-AFM band structure. This indicates that the CE-AFM domain size would be no larger than the beam footprint size of a $\sim\!20$~{\textmu}m scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (μ-ARPES) 实验测量，并结合 tight-binding models 计算对比。；研究对象：双层锰氧化物 LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ 在尼尔温度以下的 CE 型反铁磁（CE-AFM）态的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次成功捕捉到 CE-AFM 态的能带结构特征，在 X 点附近观测到色散强度（而 A 型反铁磁相在该处无能带），同时部分特征和近费米能级强度分布可由 A-AFM 能带解释，表明 CE-AFM 畴区尺寸不超过约 20 微米的束斑大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次成功捕捉到 CE-AFM 态的能带结构特征，在 X 点附近观测到色散强度（而 A 型反铁磁相在该处无能带），同时部分特征和近费米能级强度分布可由 A-AFM 能带解释，表明 CE-AFM 畴区尺寸不超过约 20 微米的束斑大小。；创新点：首次通过 μ-ARPES 实验直接观测到 CE-AFM 态的能带结构特征，并利用束斑尺寸与畴区尺寸的对比解释了混合能带特征的来源。
papers.method_zh: 微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（μ-ARPES）实验测量，结合紧束缚模型（tight-binding models）能带计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Modelling the mean inner potential of alloyed and strained materials
papers.abstract: In this publication, we study the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential (MIP) using density functional theory (DFT) within an augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set. Two major effects have been identified allowing to model the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential with a reasonable accuracy. First, alloying for constant volume results in a linear relationship between the MIP and the concentration. Second, the MIP scales with changes in volume as we already pointed out in an earlier publication (M. Schowalter, D. Lamoen, A. Rosenauer, P. Kruse, and D. Gerthsen, Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938-4940 (2004)). Specifically, a linear relationship between MIP and concentration x was found for AlGaAs (nearly no change in lattice parameter), whereas InGaP and GeSi (volume changes with concentration x) exhibits a clear bowing. The bowing can be modeled by taking the rescaling of the MIP with the varying volume additionally into account. The rescaling could be also used to model the dependence of the MIP on strained binary cells and the density dependence of e.g. amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、modelling、augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set。；研究对象：合金化与应变对材料平均内势（mean inner potential, MIP）的影响。具体体系包括AlGaAs、InGaP、GeSi以及应变二元晶胞和非晶材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合金化在恒定体积下导致MIP与浓度呈线性关系；MIP随体积变化而缩放，这一缩放效应可解释InGaP和GeSi中MIP随浓度变化的弯曲（bowing）行为，并可用于建模应变二元晶胞及非晶材料的密度依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合金化在恒定体积下导致MIP与浓度呈线性关系；MIP随体积变化而缩放，这一缩放效应可解释InGaP和GeSi中MIP随浓度变化的弯曲（bowing）行为，并可用于建模应变二元晶胞及非晶材料的密度依赖性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于增强平面波加局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算。

papers.title: Orientation-resolved ultrafast spin reorientation dynamics in ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$
papers.abstract: Under quasi-static conditions, ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$ thin films exhibit a thermally induced spin-reorientation transition, in which the equilibrium magnetization changes from an out-of-plane to an in-plane orientation, mostly as a result of the competing magnetic anisotropy contributions of the Dy $4f$ rare-earth and Co $3d$ transition-metal sublattices. While this equilibrium transition has been studied, it remains an open question whether such a reorientation can be triggered on ultrafast timescales using femtosecond laser excitation. In this work, we investigate the ultrafast spin-reorientation dynamics in DyCo$_5$. The time-dependent orientation of the magnetization vector following femtosecond laser excitation is quantified by combining polar with transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements in the extreme ultraviolet spectral range, which are sensitive to the out-of-plane and in-plane magnetization component, respectively. Both techniques are implemented at the Co M$_{3,2}$ resonance and are complemented by visible-light MOKE measurements. This combined approach allows us to resolve the canting of the magnetization from an out-of-plane toward an in-plane orientation and to determine the characteristic timescales of the transient spin-reorientation process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用极紫外波段磁光克尔效应（MOKE）和可见光MOKE测量进行实验研究。；研究对象：铁磁性亚铁磁薄膜DyCo₅中的超快自旋重取向动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过飞秒激光激发，可以在超快时间尺度上触发DyCo₅薄膜中磁化矢量从面外向面内的瞬态倾斜，并确定了这一瞬态自旋重取向过程的特征时间尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过飞秒激光激发，可以在超快时间尺度上触发DyCo₅薄膜中磁化矢量从面外向面内的瞬态倾斜，并确定了这一瞬态自旋重取向过程的特征时间尺度。；创新点：首次实验证实了在飞秒激光激发下，亚铁磁DyCo₅薄膜中可发生超快自旋重取向，并实现了对磁化矢量倾斜方向的时间分辨定量表征。
papers.method_zh: 结合极紫外波段（EUV）的极向和横向磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量，分别探测磁化矢量的面外和面内分量；两种测量均在Co M₃₂共振处实施，并辅以可见光MOKE测量。

papers.title: Interfacial Noncollinear Filtering of Spin Hall Currents
papers.abstract: Spin Hall currents generated in nonmagnetic materials are conventionally regarded as bulk responses whose polarization is fixed by crystal symmetry. This view has motivated the search for intrinsically low-symmetry spin sources when unconventional spin polarizations are required. Here we point out that, in realistic heterostructures, the device-relevant quantity is not the fully symmetry-averaged bulk spin Hall current, but the emitted spin current transmitted across the interface. We therefore establish emitted spin currents as bulk-interface hybrid responses and propose interfacial noncollinear filtering as a mechanism to bypass the bulk-symmetry constraint. A low-symmetry interfacial spin-orbit field, generally noncollinear with the momentum-resolved spin polarization of the incident spin Hall current, imposes spin-dependent transmission and converts hidden momentum-resolved spin-polarization components into an observable unconventional emitted spin current. Using both a rotationally symmetric minimal model and a realistic high-symmetry Dirac-semimetal model, we show that conventional spin Hall sources can emit sizable out-of-plane spin currents when their hidden bulk spin Hall textures are selectively transmitted by the interfacial spin-orbit field. Our results reveal that spin-current polarization emerges from the cooperative action of bulk and interfacial responses, providing a strategy for reprogramming spin-current polarization in high-efficiency, CMOS-compatible spin Hall materials without relying on intrinsically low-symmetry bulk crystals or external symmetry-breaking schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“提出”“建立”“展示”等理论推导和模型分析，未涉及具体实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非磁性材料/重金属/异质结中自旋霍尔电流的界面传输行为，特别是自旋电流极化方向受界面调控的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋电流的极化方向并非仅由体材料对称性决定，而是体材料与界面响应的协同结果；通过界面非共线过滤机制，即使高对称性自旋霍尔源也能产生非常规（如面外）自旋电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋电流的极化方向并非仅由体材料对称性决定，而是体材料与界面响应的协同结果；通过界面非共线过滤机制，即使高对称性自旋霍尔源也能产生非常规（如面外）自旋电流。；创新点：提出“界面非共线过滤”概念，将自旋电流视为体-界面混合响应，突破了传统认为自旋电流极化必须依赖低对称性体材料的限制，为在CMOS兼容的高对称性自旋霍尔材料中重新编程自旋电流极化提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用旋转对称最小模型和真实高对称狄拉克半金属模型进行理论分析，研究界面自旋-轨道场对动量分辨自旋霍尔电流的透射选择性。

papers.title: Machine learning prediction of the convergence criterion for a topological invariant of finite non-Hermitian chains
papers.abstract: A topological invariant based on polar-decomposition of matrices correctly captures the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains exhibiting the non-Hermitian skin effect, provided that an appropriate crop-length parameter is chosen. This parameter, which sets the cutoff used in the calculation of the invariant, is usually chosen empirically and becomes especially important near topological phase transitions, where finite-size effects are strongest. Here we show that the required crop-length is controlled by physical decay (localization) lengths. For nearest-neighbor and pure longer-range hopping Hatano-Nelson-type chains, the crop-length is set mainly by a single localization length and is well approximated by a scalar multiple of that length. For more general longer-range hopping models, it is governed instead by a multichannel root structure of the characteristic polynomial. Random-forest regression captures finite-size and near-boundary corrections while preserving this decay-length interpretation. Trained on one set of Hamiltonians, the predictor accurately generalizes to unseen Hamiltonians and complex base energies, reproducing crop-lengths across full phase diagrams. We further show that the predictions learned from clean nearest-neighbor hopping chains remain stable under moderate hopping disorder. These results provide a practical and physically interpretable way to choose the crop-length, which in turn determines when the real-space invariant can reliably capture the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：machine learning prediction、random-forest regression、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：有限非厄米链（finite non-Hermitian chains）的拓扑不变量收敛判据，特别是表现出非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 用于计算拓扑不变量的裁剪长度（crop-length）主要由物理衰减（局域化）长度控制，对于近邻和纯长程跳跃的Hatano-Nelson型链，该长度近似为单一局域化长度的标量倍数；对于更一般的模型，则由特征多项式的多通道根结构决定。随机森林回归可准确预测该长度，并泛化到未见过的哈密顿量和复杂基能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：用于计算拓扑不变量的裁剪长度（crop-length）主要由物理衰减（局域化）长度控制，对于近邻和纯长程跳跃的Hatano-Nelson型链，该长度近似为单一局域化长度的标量倍数；对于更一般的模型，则由特征多项式的多通道根结构决定。随机森林回归可准确预测该长度，并泛化到未见过的哈密顿量和复杂基能量。；创新点：首次将裁剪长度的经验选择与物理衰减长度定量关联，并利用机器学习（随机森林回归）实现可解释的预测，且该预测能泛化至不同哈密顿量和复杂基能量，并在无序下保持稳定。摘要未突出说明与已有裁剪长度选择方法的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于矩阵极分解（polar-decomposition）的拓扑不变量计算；随机森林回归（random-forest regression）用于预测裁剪长度；通过分析特征多项式的根结构（root structure）理解多通道行为；在近邻跳跃链中引入中等强度的跳跃无序（hopping disorder）检验预测稳定性。

papers.title: Microscopic theory of the lower critical field in superconducting thin-film strips
papers.abstract: The lower critical field \(B_{c1}\) of a narrow superconducting thin-film strip sets the thermodynamic scale for vortex-free operation in a perpendicular magnetic field. The standard Pearl--London estimate requires a phenomenological vortex-core cutoff, because the London theory does not resolve the core. We formulate a microscopic theory for a dirty strip by solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations in the film plane, with the applied field included directly in the gauge-invariant momentum. Self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed at fixed field, and \(B_{c1}\) is obtained from their Gibbs-energy difference. The calculation resolves the vortex core and its finite-width deformation without introducing a cutoff. The resulting vortex self-energy is larger than the naive Pearl--London estimate and cannot, in general, be represented by a London logarithm with a single width-independent cutoff. The formulation applies at any \(T<T_c\) and provides a microscopic basis for predicting \(B_{c1}\) in superconducting nanostrips and related thin-film devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“formulate a microscopic theory”“solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations”“self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed”，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：窄超导薄膜条带（superconducting thin-film strip）在垂直磁场中的下临界场 \(B_{c1}\)，以及涡旋（vortex）的微观行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微观理论自洽求解，发现涡旋自能大于传统的Pearl-London估计值，且无法用一个与宽度无关的单一截断参数来用London对数形式表示。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微观理论自洽求解，发现涡旋自能大于传统的Pearl-London估计值，且无法用一个与宽度无关的单一截断参数来用London对数形式表示。；创新点：首次在微观层面（无需唯象截断）自洽地解析了窄超导薄膜条带中涡旋芯的有限宽度形变，并给出了 \(B_{c1}\) 的微观理论预测基础，适用于任意 \(T<T_c\)。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维Usadel方程（dirty limit）在薄膜平面内进行自洽求解，将外加磁场直接纳入规范不变动量中，计算固定磁场下的涡旋解和Meissner解，并通过Gibbs自由能差得到 \(B_{c1}\)。无需引入唯象的涡旋芯截断。

papers.title: Chiral-Structured Superconductors TrX4 (Tr = Rh, Ir; X = Ge, Si): A Platform for Mixed-Parity Pairing and Topological States
papers.abstract: Chiral-structured superconductors, with simultaneous broken mirror and inversion symmetries, promote unconventional superconductivity through parity-mixing mechanisms. Yet a few bulk chiral-structured superconductors are known, partly due to the difficulty in directly determining their atomic-scale chirality. Here we report three chiral-structured superconductors, , RhGe4, IrGe4, and IrSi4, synthesized under high pressure, with Tc values of about 1.6 K, 1.1 K, and 2.5 K, respectively.Using atomic resolution Cs-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) combined with X-ray diffraction characterizations, we directly confirm their chiral structure (space group P3121). This real space imaging approach overcomes ambiguities in traditional diffraction based methods. These materials exhibit type-II superconductivity, and the enhancement of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) leads to the emergence of mixed parity pairing. Calculations also reveal symmetry protected Weyl points near the Fermi level, which is robust against the SOC. Our work not only expands the family of chiral-structured superconductors but also demonstrates the indispensable role of STEM in directly determining chiral crystal structures. These materials thus offer a clean platform to explore the interplay among structural chirality, SOC, mixed parity superconductivity, and topological quantum phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了高压合成、STEM、XRD等实验手段，并辅以第一性原理计算。；研究对象：三种具有手性晶体结构的超导体：RhGe₄、IrGe₄ 和 IrSi₄。研究其混合宇称配对、拓扑态以及结构手性与超导电性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功合成了三种新的手性结构超导体（空间群P3₁21），并利用原子分辨率的STEM直接确认了其手性结构。这些材料是第二类超导体，强自旋-轨道耦合导致混合宇称配对的出现，且费米面附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功合成了三种新的手性结构超导体（空间群P3₁21），并利用原子分辨率的STEM直接确认了其手性结构。这些材料是第二类超导体，强自旋-轨道耦合导致混合宇称配对的出现，且费米面附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。；创新点：1.  **直接成像手性结构**：利用原子分辨率的STEM直接确认了手性晶体结构，克服了传统衍射方法在确定原子尺度手性时的模糊性。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **样品合成**：高压合成技术。

papers.title: Spatially heterogeneous noise restructures flocking into geometry-locked and vortex states
papers.abstract: Spatially heterogeneous environments continually challenge the ability of active matter to sustain coherent collective motion. Understanding how collective motion remains robust under changing environments is central to both the functioning of biological systems and the design of smart active matter. Here, we extend the Vicsek model to include a circular non-noisy region surrounded by a noisy environment - a configuration in which the noise difference sets up a contrast in local directional order between the two regions. We find that, as the surrounding noise is increased, the system passes through three distinct dynamical regimes: (i) conventional global flocking at low noise; (ii) geometry-locked motion, aligned with simulation boundaries, at intermediate noise; and (iii) vortical motion within the non-noisy region at high noise. Extending the environment to multiple non-noisy regions, we find that the geometry-locked regime can develop a directional coupling, while the vortex mode leads to antiferromagnetic order between the regions. Taken together, our results demonstrate that the spatial modulation of order and disorder offers a powerful and generic strategy for steering active matter, aligning with recent experimental observations of active particles in patterned landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend the Vicsek model”（扩展Vicsek模型）并进行数值模拟，属于计算与理论建模研究。；研究对象：活性物质（active matter）在空间异质性噪声环境中的集体运动行为。具体体系为：一个圆形无噪声区域被有噪声环境包围的二维空间构型，以及多个无噪声区域的扩展构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着周围噪声强度增加，系统依次经历三个不同的动力学相：低噪声下的常规全局集群运动、中等噪声下与模拟边界对齐的几何锁定运动、高噪声下无噪声区域内的涡旋运动。在多个无噪声区域中，几何锁定相可发展出方向耦合，而涡旋相则导致区域间的反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着周围噪声强度增加，系统依次经历三个不同的动力学相：低噪声下的常规全局集群运动、中等噪声下与模拟边界对齐的几何锁定运动、高噪声下无噪声区域内的涡旋运动。在多个无噪声区域中，几何锁定相可发展出方向耦合，而涡旋相则导致区域间的反铁磁序。；创新点：揭示了通过空间调制有序与无序（即噪声的空间分布）来引导活性物质运动的通用策略，并发现了几何锁定和涡旋态等新型集体运动模式，与近期图案化景观中活性粒子的实验观察一致。
papers.method_zh: 基于Vicsek模型的扩展，引入空间异质性噪声：一个圆形无噪声区域被有噪声环境包围，通过调节噪声差异控制局部方向有序度的对比。未使用具体实验手段或第一性原理计算方法。

papers.title: Autoencoder-Based Unsupervised Identification of Nonequilibrium Phases in Sheared Binary Colloids
papers.abstract: Identifying nonequilibrium phases in particle systems remains a major challenge because they often exhibit complex and spatially heterogeneous structures without long-range order. Here, we develop an unsupervised machine-learning framework for classifying such nonequilibrium phases by integrating Fourier-based preprocessing, an autoencoder, and a Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Specifically, we transform global spatial configurations into Fourier space and use the amplitudes of Fourier coefficients as inputs to the autoencoder. This preprocessing suppresses spatial noise while preserving phase-specific structural features and physical interpretability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this framework using a binary charged colloidal system under steady shear flow, where the competition between Coulomb interactions and shear gives rise to three nonequilibrium phases characterized by distinct local structures. The encoded latent space reveals well-separated clusters that are robustly identified by the GMM, enabling the construction of a nonequilibrium phase diagram based on cluster membership probabilities. The resulting phase boundaries are consistent with those independently obtained from radial distribution function analysis and unsupervised anomaly detection. These results demonstrate that autoencoder-based unsupervised learning provides an effective framework for identifying nonequilibrium phases in complex particle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“develop an unsupervised machine-learning framework”（开发无监督机器学习框架）、“transform global spatial configurations into Fourier space”（将全局空间构型变换到傅里叶空间）等，属于计算与数据分析方法研究。；研究对象：二元带电胶体体系在稳态剪切流下的非平衡相。具体物理现象为库仑相互作用与剪切流竞争导致的三种非平衡相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于自编码器的无监督学习框架能够有效识别剪切二元胶体中的非平衡相，并构建出与径向分布函数分析及无监督异常检测结果一致的非平衡相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于自编码器的无监督学习框架能够有效识别剪切二元胶体中的非平衡相，并构建出与径向分布函数分析及无监督异常检测结果一致的非平衡相图。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合傅里叶预处理、自编码器（autoencoder）和高斯混合模型（GMM）的无监督机器学习框架。具体步骤为：将全局空间构型变换到傅里叶空间，以傅里叶系数振幅作为自编码器输入，再通过GMM对编码后的隐空间进行聚类。

papers.title: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
papers.abstract: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigated、consider、lead to、interpreted as（理论推导与模型分析）。；研究对象：由局域磁矩（具有反铁磁序）与传导电子通过局域交换耦合构成的双重体系，具体研究其表面隧穿谱中由局域磁矩磁振子激发引起的动态效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 考虑局域磁矩磁振子激发的动态散射后，传导电子态发生自能修正与重整化，导致隧穿谱中出现超出静态有序影响的磁振子边带（magnon sidebands）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：考虑局域磁矩磁振子激发的动态散射后，传导电子态发生自能修正与重整化，导致隧穿谱中出现超出静态有序影响的磁振子边带（magnon sidebands）。；创新点：在已有静态近似（仅考虑磁有序导致的能带重构）基础上，首次纳入局域磁矩磁振子激发的动态散射，揭示了磁振子边带对隧穿谱的额外贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用静态近似下已知的磁能带重构结果，进一步引入传导电子与局域磁矩磁振子激发的散射过程，通过自能计算和电子态重整化理论分析动态效应对隧穿谱的修正。

papers.title: Floquet polaritons in optically driven materials
papers.abstract: Polaritons are coupled collective modes of light and matter in quantum materials. In modern pump-probe experiments, a pump light pulse may dramatically alter the properties of the polaritons, rendering them Floquet polaritons that can be detected by a probe pulse. We present a practical framework to describe Floquet polaritons in terms of the linear and nonlinear optical properties of the material. The central quantity that yields the spectra of Floquet polaritons is an effective linear optical susceptibility contributed by the pump through nonlinear optical susceptibilities. We apply this method to graphene and show that via its third-order optical nonlinearity, infrared pump leads to Floquet plasmon bands. Notably, near plasmonic band crossings, parametric instability leads to flat bands with unstable modes and exceptional points that closely resemble those of non-Hermitian systems. As a second example, we show that in hexagonal boron nitride pumped by mid-infrared laser, the pump induces Floquet phonon polariton bands via phononic nonlinearity, which can be detected with either far-field or near-field optical technique. Finally, in layered superconductors pumped by THz light polarized along the out-of-plane direction, the Josephson-type optical nonlinearity leads to Floquet Josephson plasmons, which manifest as new peaks in the THz reflectivity of a probe pulse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述“提出一个实用框架”（present a practical framework）、“应用此方法”（apply this method）等，属于理论建模与计算分析，未提及实验数据或具体实验操作。；研究对象：光驱动材料中的Floquet极化激元（Floquet polaritons），具体包括石墨烯中的Floquet等离激元、六方氮化硼中的Floquet声子极化激元、以及层状超导体中的Floquet约瑟夫森等离激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泵浦光诱导的非线性光学效应，可以产生Floquet极化激元能带；在石墨烯中，等离激元能带交叉处出现参数不稳定性导致的平带、非厄米系统特有的异常点和不稳定模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泵浦光诱导的非线性光学效应，可以产生Floquet极化激元能带；在石墨烯中，等离激元能带交叉处出现参数不稳定性导致的平带、非厄米系统特有的异常点和不稳定模式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但该工作首次将Floquet极化激元统一描述为泵浦光通过材料非线性光学响应产生的有效线性响应，并应用于三种不同材料体系（石墨烯、六方氮化硼、层状超导体）展示了其普适性。
papers.method_zh: 基于材料的线性和非线性光学性质，构建描述Floquet极化激元的理论框架；核心是定义一个由泵浦光通过非线性光学极化率贡献的有效线性光学磁化率，用于计算Floquet极化激元谱。

papers.title: Anomalous Piezoelectricity from Polarization-Dependent Electrostriction in Wurtzites
papers.abstract: The piezoelectric coefficient is a third-rank tensor connecting the strain or stress with the electric field or polarization, whereas the electrostriction coefficient is a fourth-rank tensor relating the strain to the square of electric polarization. The electrostriction tensor components in the current literature are often treated as constants independent of polarization, resulting in piezoelectric tensor components that are linearly proportional to polarization and the dielectric susceptibility tensor. Here, we study the electrostriction and piezoelectricity in strongly polar wurtzites, including AlN, Al$_{1-x}$Sc$_x$N, Al$_{1-x}$B$_x$N, GaN, and ZnO. We discover that electrostriction and the elastic modulus in wurtzites are both strongly polarization-dependent, and the piezoelectric coefficient is highly nonlinear with respect to polarization, including the anomalous possibility that decreasing polarization increases the electromechanical strain response. These unusual dependencies of electrostriction and piezoelectric effects on polarization arise from the evolution of a layered reference nonpolar structure toward a tetrahedrally coordinated wurtzite network structure as the polarization increases. The findings have important implications in understanding the thermodynamics of the general class of wurtzite ferroelectrics and in manipulating their piezoelectric and ferroelectric behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“研究”“发现”“分析”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验手段，主要基于第一性原理或理论建模研究电致伸缩和压电效应。；研究对象：强极性纤锌矿材料，包括 AlN、Al₁₋ₓScₓN、Al₁₋ₓBₓN、GaN 和 ZnO，以及其电致伸缩和压电行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现纤锌矿中电致伸缩系数和弹性模量强烈依赖于极化强度，导致压电系数与极化呈高度非线性关系，甚至出现“降低极化反而增强机电应变响应”的反常现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现纤锌矿中电致伸缩系数和弹性模量强烈依赖于极化强度，导致压电系数与极化呈高度非线性关系，甚至出现“降低极化反而增强机电应变响应”的反常现象。；创新点：揭示了纤锌矿中电致伸缩和压电效应强烈依赖于极化强度这一被现有文献忽略的特性，并指出压电系数与极化之间并非简单的线性关系，存在反常的非线性行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与计算建模，具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否使用 DFT 等），但涉及对极化依赖的电致伸缩张量和弹性模量的系统研究，以及从参考非极性层状结构向四面体配位纤锌矿网络结构演化的结构分析。

papers.title: Efficient Bethe-Salpeter Equation Calculations Based on Numerical Atomic Orbitals and Norm-Conserving Pseudopotentials: Dual-${\boldsymbol k}$-Mesh Strategy
papers.abstract: We present an efficient implementation of the Bethe--Salpeter equation (BSE) based on numerical atomic orbitals (NAOs) and norm-conserving pseudopotentials within the ABACUS+LibRPA framework. By exploiting the localized resolution-of-identity (LRI) technique, the screened Coulomb interaction is cast into a real-space, unit-cell-indexed form $W_{μν}(\boldsymbol R)$ that is inherently short-ranged and well localized. This spatial locality enables an efficient Fourier interpolation of the BSE kernel from the coarse $\boldsymbol k$-mesh used in the preceding $GW$ calculation to an arbitrarily dense $\boldsymbol k$-mesh on which the BSE Hamiltonian is assembled and diagonalized, thereby giving rise naturally to a dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh workflow. Building on this scheme, we systematically examine the convergence of the absorption spectra with respect to the NAO basis set, the auxiliary basis set, and the $\boldsymbol k$-point sampling. Benchmark calculations for both molecular and periodic systems collectively validate the accuracy of the present implementation and establish the dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh strategy as a practical and reliable approach for $GW$+BSE calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：implementation（实现）、calculations（计算）、framework（框架）、benchmark calculations（基准计算）。；研究对象：分子和周期性体系的光吸收谱，具体为基于数值原子轨道（NAO）和模守恒赝势的GW+BSE计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过利用局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，将屏蔽库仑相互作用转化为实空间短程形式，从而实现了BSE核从粗k网格到任意密k网格的傅里叶插值，建立了双k网格策略，并验证了该策略在GW+BSE计算中的准确性和实用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过利用局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，将屏蔽库仑相互作用转化为实空间短程形式，从而实现了BSE核从粗k网格到任意密k网格的傅里叶插值，建立了双k网格策略，并验证了该策略在GW+BSE计算中的准确性和实用性。；创新点：提出并实现了基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势的双k网格策略，使得BSE哈密顿量可以在任意密k网格上组装和对角化，而无需在粗k网格上直接计算，显著提高了计算效率。摘要未突出说明与已有实现相比的具体性能提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 基于ABACUS+LibRPA框架，采用数值原子轨道（NAO）和模守恒赝势，结合局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，实现Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）的高效计算。具体包括：将屏蔽库仑相互作用表示为实空间、以晶胞索引的形式W_{μν}(R)，利用其短程局域性进行傅里叶插值，构建双k网格工作流。

papers.title: Dynamical crossover from motor-dominated to drag-dominated transport in a minimal active transport network
papers.abstract: Motor-driven intracellular transport is often described in terms of motor activity, but macroscopic transport also depends on how effectively motor-generated force is converted into coherent motion. Motivated by cytoplasmic streaming, a minimal active transport network is examined in which motor-driven transport competes with an effective slip-related dissipative resistance. The model is not intended as a quantitative reconstruction of Nitella cytoplasmic streaming, but as a minimal system for isolating the relation between motor activity, resistance, and transport output. A controlled scan over $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ and $α_m$, with three independent seeds per condition, shows that increasing $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ strongly suppresses mean transport speed while leaving the motor-bound fraction nearly unchanged. The mean load and motor force remain finite in the high-$γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ regime, indicating that motors remain mechanically active even when transport is suppressed. The dependence of transport speed on $α_m$ progressively disappears with increasing $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$: the motor dominance ratio decreases from $R\approx1.69$ to $R\approx1.01$, and the corresponding velocity difference decreases from $\sim1.9~μ\mathrm{m/s}$ to $\sim0.003~μ\mathrm{m/s}$. These results indicate a dynamical crossover from motor-dominated to drag-dominated transport. The minimal model provides a compact physical scenario in which active force generation persists while its contribution to net transport is suppressed by increased effective dissipative resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：minimal model、controlled scan、dynamical crossover）；研究对象：基于细胞质流（cytoplasmic streaming）启发的主动输运网络模型，研究马达驱动与滑移相关耗散阻力之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着有效滑移阻力（γ_Slip）增大，输运速度被强烈抑制，但马达仍保持机械活性；系统从马达主导的输运（motor-dominated）转变为阻力主导的输运（drag-dominated），表现为马达主导比R从约1.69降至约1.01，速度差从约1.9 μm/s降至约0.003 μm/s。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着有效滑移阻力（γ_Slip）增大，输运速度被强烈抑制，但马达仍保持机械活性；系统从马达主导的输运（motor-dominated）转变为阻力主导的输运（drag-dominated），表现为马达主导比R从约1.69降至约1.01，速度差从约1.9 μm/s降至约0.003 μm/s。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小主动输运网络模型，通过控制参数γ_Slip和α_m进行系统扫描，每个条件使用三个独立随机种子，分析平均输运速度、马达结合分数、平均负载和马达力等物理量。

papers.title: Engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in artificial spin ice via vertex dipolar control
papers.abstract: Artificial spin ice (ASI), composed of geometrically frustrated arrays of interacting nanoislands, provides a versatile platform for reprogrammable magnonic functionality. However, the commonly used geometric control parameters such as island length, width, and aspect ratio simultaneously modify the island footprint, inter island dipolar spacing, and shape anisotropy, making it difficult to tune the nonlinear response independently of the linear spectrum and lattice density. Using micromagnetic simulations of kagome ASI under strong microwave drive, we identify edge curvature as a geometric degree of freedom that separates nonlinear magnon scattering from the island footprint. Sharp tipped islands predominantly generate integer harmonics, whereas dumbbell shaped tips produce a transition toward subharmonic rich spectra by concentrating demagnetizing and exchange fields near the island ends without changing the overall island volume or lattice spacing. By mapping the curvature and drive parameter space, we identify a continuous threshold for subharmonic onset controlled by tip curvature. We further show that the angular dependence of the second harmonic amplitude reverses between sharp and dumbbell geometries, providing an experimentally accessible signature of curvature localized nonlinearity. Width and leg length asymmetry can also modify harmonic amplitudes, but they do not remove the intrinsic trade off between footprint and coupling. These results establish tip curvature as a footprint preserving design parameter for engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in ASI, with implications for reconfigurable magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：micromagnetic simulations，即微磁模拟）；研究对象：人工自旋冰（ASI）中的非线性磁振子散射，具体为kagome型人工自旋冰在强微波驱动下的非线性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控岛末端曲率（edge curvature），可以在不改变岛体积或晶格间距的前提下，独立调控非线性磁振子散射行为：尖锐末端主要产生整数谐波，而哑铃形末端通过集中退磁和交换场产生丰富的次谐波谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控岛末端曲率（edge curvature），可以在不改变岛体积或晶格间距的前提下，独立调控非线性磁振子散射行为：尖锐末端主要产生整数谐波，而哑铃形末端通过集中退磁和交换场产生丰富的次谐波谱。；创新点：提出岛末端曲率作为独立于岛足迹（footprint）和晶格密度的几何设计参数，实现了非线性响应与线性谱及晶格密度的解耦，避免了传统几何参数（长度、宽度、长宽比）同时改变多个物理量的固有问题。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），对kagome人工自旋冰施加强微波驱动，系统扫描曲率和驱动参数空间，分析谐波幅度与角度依赖关系。

papers.title: From Closed-Loop Optimization to Open Decision Making: Coupled Digital Twins for Predictive and Autonomous Microscopy
papers.abstract: Automated experimentation is moving from closed-loop optimization toward open decision-making, where human or AI planners must forecast the consequences of candidate actions before executing them. Such forecasts require a model of both sides of the experiment: how the sample is likely to respond and what the instrument is likely to detect. We therefore introduce a coupled digital-twin framework that separates these roles and then links them. In this framework, the sample twin encodes material state inferred from prior knowledge and measurements till the moment. The instrument twin captures signal formation, feedback dynamics, and operating constraints based on prior knowledge. When coupled, the two twins estimate expected outcomes, uncertainty, and risk for candidate microscope operations. For amplitude-modulation scanning probe microscopy, we realize this framework with a physics-informed encoder of force-distance curves, a deterministic scanner model of cantilever and feedback dynamics, and sparse learned residual corrections. The encoder first recovers scanner-driving descriptors with sub-nanometer accuracy. The calibrated scanner then reproduces typical traces within a few nanometers and identifies operating-point noise amplification as the main source of mismatch. Supplementary phase analysis localizes residual error to the phase channel, which clarifies where added physics is needed. Together, these results establish coupled sample and instrument twins as a practical foundation for predictive microscope operation and autonomous experimental planning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：涉及自动化实验、数字孪生框架、物理信息编码器、扫描探针显微镜操作及模型校准。；研究对象：扫描探针显微镜（特别是振幅调制扫描探针显微镜）中的自动化实验系统，包括样品响应与仪器检测的耦合建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种耦合数字孪生框架，将样品孪生与仪器孪生分离并链接，能够预测候选操作的结果、不确定性和风险，为自主显微镜实验规划提供实用基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种耦合数字孪生框架，将样品孪生与仪器孪生分离并链接，能够预测候选操作的结果、不确定性和风险，为自主显微镜实验规划提供实用基础。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理信息编码器处理力-距离曲线，结合确定性扫描器模型（含悬臂和反馈动力学）以及稀疏学习残差校正，实现样品状态推断与仪器信号建模的耦合。

papers.title: Magnon-Mediated Superconductivity in a 2D Itinerant Ferromagnet with Weak Easy-plane Magnetic Anisotropy
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent observations of superconductivity in a quarter-metal state of spin- and valley- polarized graphene multilayers, we investigate pairing within a ferromagnetic phase of a single-valley model of itinerant two-dimensional (2D) electrons with Hubbard-type interaction and no artificial high-energy cutoff. In 2D, the Stoner transition is first-order into a fully-polarized state wherein the only gapless collective excitations are transverse magnons. We find that in a spin-SU(2) symmetric model, this magnon-mediated pairing interaction between equal-spin fermions vanishes at $T=0$. We show that a small easy-plane magnetic anisotropy $Ω_0 \ll E_F$, where $E_F$ is the Fermi energy, breaks the SU(2) symmetry and generates an attractive interaction for equal-spin $p-$wave pairing. We explicitly derive the corresponding coupling constant $λ_p$ as the scaling function of both the relative strength of the easy-plane anisotropy, $Ω_0/E_F$, and the proximity to the ferromagnetic transition. While $λ_p$ is parametrically small in $Ω_0/E_F$ deep inside the ferromagnetic phase, it becomes enhanced near the ferromagnetic transition, reaching order unity regardless of how small $Ω_0/E_F$ is. This mechanism yields a sizable $T_c$, peaked near the onset of ferromagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we investigate”“we find”“we show”“we explicitly derive”等理论推导和模型分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维巡游铁磁体中的超导电性，具体为单谷模型下具有Hubbard型相互作用的二维电子系统，并考虑弱易平面磁各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋SU(2)对称模型中，磁振子介导的等自旋费米子配对在T=0时消失；引入弱易平面磁各向异性（Ω₀ ≪ E_F）可产生等自旋p波配对的吸引相互作用，且该耦合常数λ_p在铁磁相变附近可增强至量级为1，从而获得可观的超导转变温度T_c。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋SU(2)对称模型中，磁振子介导的等自旋费米子配对在T=0时消失；引入弱易平面磁各向异性（Ω₀ ≪ E_F）可产生等自旋p波配对的吸引相互作用，且该耦合常数λ_p在铁磁相变附近可增强至量级为1，从而获得可观的超导转变温度T_c。；创新点：揭示了在弱易平面磁各向异性下，磁振子介导的等自旋p波配对可在铁磁相变附近获得显著增强，即使各向异性极弱（Ω₀/E_F很小），λ_p仍可达到量级1，从而解释了近期在自旋-谷极化石墨烯多层膜四分之一金属态中观测到的超导电性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于二维巡游电子单谷模型，采用Hubbard型相互作用，无人工高能截断；通过分析Stoner相变（一级相变进入全极化态）和横向磁振子激发，推导磁振子介导的配对相互作用；引入易平面磁各向异性破缺SU(2)对称性，解析计算p波配对耦合常数λ_p作为Ω₀/E_F和距铁磁相变距离的标度函数。

papers.title: Three-point density correlations in a weakly interacting 2D Fermi liquid
papers.abstract: We study the three-point equal-time correlations of the density in a weakly interacting spin 1/2 Fermi gas and present two new results. First, we compute the three-point correlation for the total density $ρ= ρ_\uparrow + ρ_\downarrow$ exactly as a function of momentum to first order in a dimensionless interaction parameter ${\cal I}$. This generalizes a previous result that related the three-point function to the Landau Fermi liquid parameters $F_0^s$ and $F_0^a$ and applied in a certain long-wavelength collinear limit. Second, we compute the leading order ${\cal O}({\cal I}^3)$ interaction correction to the same-spin three-point correlation function in the long-wavelength collinear limit. These results are directly relevant to current experiments on atomic Fermi gases using quantum gas microscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“compute”“exactly as a function of momentum”“leading order correction”，以及摘要中未提及任何实验数据或数值模拟，属于解析理论计算。；研究对象：弱相互作用的二维自旋1/2费米气体中的密度三点关联函数，具体涉及总密度和同自旋密度关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1. 精确计算了总密度三点关联函数对相互作用参数的一阶修正，推广了此前仅适用于长波共线极限的结果。2. 计算了同自旋三点关联函数在长波共线极限下的三阶相互作用修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1. 精确计算了总密度三点关联函数对相互作用参数的一阶修正，推广了此前仅适用于长波共线极限的结果。2. 计算了同自旋三点关联函数在长波共线极限下的三阶相互作用修正。；创新点：将总密度三点关联函数从之前仅适用的长波共线极限推广到任意动量下的精确一阶结果，并首次给出同自旋三点关联函数的三阶修正。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰理论，以无量纲相互作用参数 \({\cal I}\) 为小量进行展开，在动量空间中解析计算等时密度关联函数。

papers.title: Equivalence between the Axion Invariant and the $S_4$ Symmetry Indicator
papers.abstract: The equivalence between the axion invariant and the $S_4$ symmetry indicator is established for three-dimensional $S_4$-symmetric axion insulators with vanishing three-dimensional Chern numbers. Starting from the Chern-Simons expression for the magnetoelectric polarizability, $2P_3=θ/π$ is rewritten in terms of the $S_4$ sewing matrix. After stable reduction to determinant-one two-band blocks, the invariant is expressed as the degree of a map from the Brillouin zone to $SU(2)$. The degree modulo two is then evaluated from the $S_4$ eigenvalues at the four $S_4$-invariant momenta and is shown to coincide with the symmetry indicator $z_2$. A minimal tight-binding model verifies the correspondence between $2P_3$ and $z_2$. The result closes a gap between the topological-field-theory description of the axion response and the topological-band-theory classification by symmetry indicators. It also extends the known response-indicator equivalence from antiunitary settings such as $C_nT$ symmetry to the unitary, orientation-reversing rotoinversion symmetry $S_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Chern-Simons表达式、拓扑场论、对称性指标、紧束缚模型验证。；研究对象：三维$S_4$对称轴子绝缘体（axion insulators），具体研究其轴子不变量（axion invariant）与$S_4$对称性指标（symmetry indicator）之间的等价关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在三维陈数为零的$S_4$对称轴子绝缘体中，磁电极化率$2P_3=\theta/\pi$（轴子不变量）与对称性指标$z_2$完全等价，从而弥合了拓扑场论描述与拓扑能带理论分类之间的鸿沟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在三维陈数为零的$S_4$对称轴子绝缘体中，磁电极化率$2P_3=\theta/\pi$（轴子不变量）与对称性指标$z_2$完全等价，从而弥合了拓扑场论描述与拓扑能带理论分类之间的鸿沟。；创新点：将已知的反幺正对称性（如$C_nT$）下的响应-指标等价关系，推广到幺正的、定向反转的旋转反演对称性$S_4$情形。
papers.method_zh: 从磁电极化率的Chern-Simons表达式出发，将$2P_3$用$S_4$缝补矩阵（sewing matrix）重新表述；通过稳定约化将系统简化为行列式为1的二能带块，将不变量表达为布里渊区到$SU(2)$的映射度；利用四个$S_4$不变动量点上的$S_4$本征值计算模2的映射度，证明其与对称性指标$z_2$一致；最后通过最小紧束缚模型验证对应关系。

papers.title: Ultrahigh-Entropy Compositionally Complex Ceramics: Fluorite-Pyrochlore Phase Stability and Order-Disorder Transitions
papers.abstract: Three groups of 32 ultrahigh-entropy compositionally complex ceramics (CCCs) containing 16-19 components were synthesized and characterized. The first group of 15 CCCs forms single ultrahigh-entropy fluorite or pyrochlore phases in 12 compositions, while two compositions exhibit fluorite-fluorite dual phases, observed for the first time. Compared with ternary A2B2O7 pyrochlore, these ultrahigh-entropy CCCs are more prone to ordering (pyrochlore formation), surprisingly even more at higher size disorder (more lattice distortion), with suppressed dual-phase formation relative to five-component high-entropy ceramics. Two new 19-component series, denoted as "19CCC-P|Fy" and "19CCC-P|Fz", form single ultrahigh-entropy fluorite or pyrochlore phases. The 19CCC-P|Fy series, maintaining a 2:2 ratio of 3+ and 4+ cations, exhibits a pyrochlore-to-fluorite order-disorder transition (ODT) at y ~ 0.84, consistent with the linear projection of the pyrochlore superstructure peak intensity as an order parameter. In contrast, the 19CCC-P|Fz series with non-2:2 ratios of 3+ and 4+ cations show an abrupt ODT at z ~ 0.41-0.44, despite a projected transition at z ~ 0.64 from the order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“synthesized and characterized”（合成与表征）。；研究对象：超高温熵组分复杂陶瓷（CCCs），具体为含16-19种组分的氟石-烧绿石相体系，以及其中的有序-无序相变（ODT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在32种超高温熵CCCs中，多数形成单相超高温熵氟石或烧绿石相，首次观察到氟石-氟石双相共存。与三元A2B2O7烧绿石相比，这些超高温熵CCCs更倾向于有序化（形成烧绿石相），甚至在更大尺寸无序（更高晶格畸变）时也是如此，且双相形成被抑制。两个19组分系列表现出不同的有序-无序相变行为：保持2:2阳离子比的系列在y~0.84处发生连续相变，而非2:2比的系列在z~0.41-0.44处发生突变相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在32种超高温熵CCCs中，多数形成单相超高温熵氟石或烧绿石相，首次观察到氟石-氟石双相共存。与三元A2B2O7烧绿石相比，这些超高温熵CCCs更倾向于有序化（形成烧绿石相），甚至在更大尺寸无序（更高晶格畸变）时也是如此，且双相形成被抑制。两个19组分系列表现出不同的有序-无序相变行为：保持2:2阳离子比的系列在y~0.84处发生连续相变，而非2:2比的系列在z~0.41-0.44处发生突变相变。；创新点：首次在超高温熵CCCs中观察到氟石-氟石双相共存；发现超高温熵体系比低组分高熵陶瓷更易形成有序烧绿石相，且相变行为受阳离子比例调控。
papers.method_zh: 通过合成与X射线衍射等表征手段，分析相组成与结构；利用烧绿石超结构峰强度作为序参量，线性投影确定有序-无序相变点。

papers.title: Modern view of activated rate processes: unidirectional fluxes at equilibrium, correlation functions, and splitting probabilities
papers.abstract: More than 80 years ago Kramers published a paper calculating how fast a Brownian particle escapes from a potential well over an activation barrier. Since then Kramers' model has been widely adopted by nuclear physics, biophysics and chemical physics communities as a description of activated barrier crossing. From a chemical kinetics perspective, Kramers' theory provides a mapping from continuous dynamics to discrete-state chemical kinetics. Motivated by recent developments, this Perspective provides a rigorous way of performing such a mapping, explaining why and how Kramers' theory works from several points of view. Specifically, we consider transitions of a Brownian particle between two potential wells corresponding to the ``reactant'' and the ``product'' of a chemical reaction. A central unifying idea is to divide the equilibrium ensemble of possible states of the system into two sub-ensembles corresponding to the reactant and product states and then to consider fluxes between these sub-ensembles. Importantly, naive separation based on the location measured relative to the barrier top does not result in a mapping that is physically tenable, and instead the past of the trajectory should be considered. Thus constructed reactant and product ensembles provide an internally consistent description of the problem when also viewed from two different perspectives: one based on the definition of the rate as a conditional transition probability per unit time and the other based on the relaxation modes of the time-evolution operator governing the dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提供了一种严格的方法”、“从多个视角解释Kramers理论为何以及如何工作”，属于理论推导与概念分析。；研究对象：布朗粒子在双势阱（对应化学反应中的“反应物”和“产物”）之间的激活势垒穿越过程，即经典Kramers逃逸问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将平衡态系统划分为反应物和产物两个子系综时，仅依据粒子相对于势垒顶点的位置进行划分无法得到物理上合理的映射，必须考虑轨迹的历史信息。基于此构建的反应物和产物系综，能够从条件跃迁概率和动力学算子的弛豫模式两个视角给出自洽的描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将平衡态系统划分为反应物和产物两个子系综时，仅依据粒子相对于势垒顶点的位置进行划分无法得到物理上合理的映射，必须考虑轨迹的历史信息。基于此构建的反应物和产物系综，能够从条件跃迁概率和动力学算子的弛豫模式两个视角给出自洽的描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于平衡态子系综划分与单向通量、关联函数和分裂概率的概念，对连续动力学到离散态化学动力学的映射进行严格推导。

papers.title: Complete local expansion of the availability function in random sequential adsorption of aligned squares at low density: Termination at fourth order
papers.abstract: We consider random sequential adsorption (RSA) of aligned squares and derive the low-coverage expansion of the availability function alpha(q), the fraction of positions accessible to an additional square, up to fourth order in the coverage q. At low coverage, the reduction of available space can be understood in terms of geometric overlap between exclusion regions created by previously deposited squares. A single square blocks a finite area; pairs of squares may have overlapping exclusion zones, reducing the total blocked area; similarly, three and four squares can share a common overlap region, leading to higher-order corrections. These contributions can be systematically accounted for through an inclusion-exclusion expansion based on the geometry of overlapping exclusion regions, with alternating signs dictated by inclusion-exclusion. The expansion terminates exactly at fourth order, since no more than four deposited squares can simultaneously overlap the exclusion region of a trial insertion. The coefficients are obtained by explicit enumeration of all such geometrically admissible configurations and are further confirmed by numerical simulations on a discrete lattice, showing agreement within statistical uncertainty.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟验证）。判断依据：推导低覆盖展开的解析表达式，并通过离散晶格数值模拟确认系数。；研究对象：随机顺序吸附（RSA）过程中对齐正方形的可用性函数α(q)，即允许额外正方形插入的位置比例随覆盖度q的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可用性函数的低覆盖展开精确终止于四阶，因为最多四个已沉积正方形可以同时与一个试探插入的正方形的排斥区域重叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可用性函数的低覆盖展开精确终止于四阶，因为最多四个已沉积正方形可以同时与一个试探插入的正方形的排斥区域重叠。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含-排除展开方法，基于重叠排斥区域的几何结构系统计算各阶修正系数；通过显式枚举所有几何允许的构型得到系数，并用离散晶格上的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Electric Field Induced Multi-Space Topological Phase Transitions in Janus Monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2
papers.abstract: Manipulating coexisting multi-space topological states within a single material is a critical frontier for low-power spintronic applications, for which perpendicular electric-field gating offers a highly precise tuning mechanism. Using first-principles calculations and atomistic spin simulations, it is demonstrated that Janus monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2 can exhibit simultaneous momentum-space and real-space topological phase transitions under an external electric field. Specifically, the electric field drives momentum-space transitions across a topologically trivial state (C = 0), a low-Chern-number quantum anomalous Hall state (C = -1), and a high-Chern-number state (C = 2). Concurrently, by actively tuning the competition between the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and magnetic anisotropy, the electric field induces real-space magnetic transitions from a uniform ferromagnetic state to an isolated skyrmion state, and ultimately to a skyrmion-spiral domain coexistence phase. Electric-field-induced variations in both the QAHE and magnetic textures may give rise to multiple topological phase transitions, involving distinct topological regimes: a purely k-space topology, RK-joint skyrmions, and pure real-space skyrmions. These findings establish a powerful material platform and efficient route for the synergistic control of coexisting topological orders, making it highly promising for next generation multi-functional spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用了“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“atomistic spin simulations”（原子自旋模拟）。；研究对象：Janus单层MnBi2Se2Te2材料。具体研究该材料在外加垂直电场作用下，同时发生的动量空间（拓扑能带）和实空间（磁性纹理）的拓扑相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单层Janus MnBi2Se2Te2中，外加电场可以同时驱动动量空间的拓扑相变（从平庸绝缘体到低陈数量子反常霍尔态，再到高陈数态）和实空间的磁性相变（从均匀铁磁态到孤立斯格明子态，再到斯格明子-螺旋畴共存态），从而实现多种拓扑序的协同调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单层Janus MnBi2Se2Te2中，外加电场可以同时驱动动量空间的拓扑相变（从平庸绝缘体到低陈数量子反常霍尔态，再到高陈数态）和实空间的磁性相变（从均匀铁磁态到孤立斯格明子态，再到斯格明子-螺旋畴共存态），从而实现多种拓扑序的协同调控。；创新点：首次在单一材料体系中，通过电场实现了对动量空间拓扑（如量子反常霍尔效应）和实空间拓扑（如斯格明子）的同步、协同调控，并揭示了二者耦合产生的多种拓扑相（纯k空间拓扑、RK联合斯格明子、纯实空间斯格明子），为多功能自旋电子学器件提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）和原子自旋模拟。具体用于计算电子结构、拓扑性质（陈数），以及模拟电场对Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）和磁各向异性的竞争调控，进而预测磁性纹理的演化。

papers.title: Domain-Growth Kinetics and Scaling Laws Governing Pulse-Driven Accumulative Polarization Switching in HZO
papers.abstract: Accumulative polarization switching driven by sequential sub-coercive electric-field pulses offers a promising route toward low-power ferroelectric memories and neuromorphic devices. However, the kinetic regimes governing this nonequilibrium process remain poorly understood. Here, we employ a phase-field model based on the time-dependent Landau-Ginzburg formalism to investigate pulse-driven accumulative switching in ferroelectric HZO. By systematically varying the initial domain configuration, pulse amplitude, pulse-on time, and pulse-off time, we establish a quantitative link between microscopic domain-wall dynamics and macroscopic polarization accumulation. We show that the effective switched-domain radius follows distinct scaling regimes characterized by the local kinetic exponent. Initially, a local exponent greater than 1 indicates superlinear domain growth driven by enhanced irreversible domain-wall propagation under successive pulses. As switching progresses, a local exponent close to unity marks steady self-similar growth, whereas a local exponent less than 1 signifies decelerating dynamics caused by geometric confinement, depletion of switchable polarization, and relaxation-induced back switching. The transition between these regimes is governed by the competition between field-driven excitation during the pulse-on interval and spontaneous relaxation during the pulse-off interval. The initial domain geometry further influences this transition. Increasing the pulse amplitude or pulse-on duration extends the superlinear regime, whereas longer pulse-off times promote relaxation and suppress accumulation. These findings establish a unified scaling framework for pulse-driven accumulative switching, providing quantitative insight into nonequilibrium ferroelectric domain evolution and design guidelines for HZO-based memory and neuromorphic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“phase-field model”、“time-dependent Landau-Ginzburg formalism”。；研究对象：铁电HZO（HfO₂-ZrO₂）薄膜中由亚临界电场脉冲驱动的累积极化翻转过程，具体关注畴生长动力学与标度律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了脉冲驱动累积极化翻转的统一标度框架：有效翻转畴半径遵循由局域动力学指数表征的不同标度区（超线性增长、稳态自相似增长、减速增长），这些区间的转变由脉冲开启期间的场驱动激发与脉冲关闭期间的弛豫竞争决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了脉冲驱动累积极化翻转的统一标度框架：有效翻转畴半径遵循由局域动力学指数表征的不同标度区（超线性增长、稳态自相似增长、减速增长），这些区间的转变由脉冲开启期间的场驱动激发与脉冲关闭期间的弛豫竞争决定。；创新点：首次揭示了脉冲驱动累积翻转中畴生长动力学从超线性到自相似再到减速的完整标度转变，并阐明了脉冲参数（幅度、时长、间隔）和初始畴几何对该转变的调控机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时Landau-Ginzburg理论的相场模型。通过系统改变初始畴构型、脉冲幅度、脉冲开启时间和脉冲关闭时间，定量关联微观畴壁动力学与宏观极化累积。

papers.title: Raman spectroscopy of the van der Waals altermagnet Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We investigate the influence of Co intercalation and altermagnetic order on the lattice dynamics of the layered compound Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$. Polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy, supported by density-functional theory, enables identification of six Raman-active phonons. Co intercalation drives a substantial reconstruction of the vibrational spectrum through zone folding of NbSe$_2$ phonons, producing hybridized modes with mixed zone-center and zone-boundary character. Despite this, Co atoms do not participate in any Raman-active modes by symmetry, which is in marked contrast to related 1/3 compounds where intercalant modes do contribute to the Raman spectrum. Temperature-dependent Raman measurements across the altermagnetic transition show no discontinuities, which is consistent with short-range spin correlations in the quasi-one-dimensional Co chains. However, we find evidence for spin-phonon coupling in A$_{1g}$ symmetry modes owing to their out-of-plane Se displacements. Our work demonstrates the substantial impact of intercalation on the vibrational properties of transition metal dichalcogenides and the presence of spin-phonon interactions in a newly discovered altermagnetic material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：Polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy（偏振分辨拉曼光谱）、Temperature-dependent Raman measurements（变温拉曼测量）为实验手段；density-functional theory（密度泛函理论）为辅助计算。；研究对象：层状化合物 Co₁/₄NbSe₂ 的晶格动力学，特别是钴插层和交变磁序对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钴插层通过能带折叠效应显著重构了 NbSe₂ 的振动谱，产生了具有混合特性的声子模式；尽管存在交变磁序，但拉曼光谱在相变温度附近未观察到不连续性，表明准一维钴链中存在短程自旋关联，但自旋-声子耦合仅存在于特定对称性的声子模式中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钴插层通过能带折叠效应显著重构了 NbSe₂ 的振动谱，产生了具有混合特性的声子模式；尽管存在交变磁序，但拉曼光谱在相变温度附近未观察到不连续性，表明准一维钴链中存在短程自旋关联，但自旋-声子耦合仅存在于特定对称性的声子模式中。；创新点：首次研究了新型交变磁体 Co₁/₄NbSe₂ 的拉曼光谱，揭示了其与相关 1/3 插层化合物（如 Co₁/₃NbSe₂）的关键区别：在 Co₁/₄NbSe₂ 中，插层钴原子由于对称性原因不参与任何拉曼活性模式。同时，实验证实了该材料中存在自旋-声子耦合。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨拉曼光谱（Polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy）、变温拉曼测量（Temperature-dependent Raman measurements）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Effect of pressure on the magnetic properties of (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Cobalt-doped Fe$_5$GeTe$_2$ possesses a rich magnetic phase diagram as a function of Co concentration. The nature of magnetic order in (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$ is especially interesting, as it has been shown to exhibit ferromagnetic order, A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) order, or potentially both at the same time. Here we present magnetoresistance measurements on antiferromagnetic (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$ at a series of pressures and extract the anisotropy and interlayer exchange fields using the two-sublattice model. We show a 50 % increase of the interlayer exchange at 2 GPa, highlighting the sensitivity of magnetic properties to interlayer distance. In addition, we find that the sharp hysteretic transitions observed within the AFM state can be qualitatively described by a linear chain model, which suggests an even-odd effect as a function of layer number instead of a coexisting ferromagnetic phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“magnetoresistance measurements”（磁阻测量）和“extract the anisotropy and interlayer exchange fields”（提取各向异性和层间交换场），属于实验手段。；研究对象：(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂ 这一钴掺杂铁基二维磁性材料在压力下的磁性质，特别是其反铁磁（A型反铁磁）有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2 GPa压力下，层间交换作用增强了50%，表明磁性质对层间距高度敏感；反铁磁态中尖锐的磁滞转变可用线性链模型定性描述，暗示该现象源于层数奇偶效应，而非共存的铁磁相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2 GPa压力下，层间交换作用增强了50%，表明磁性质对层间距高度敏感；反铁磁态中尖锐的磁滞转变可用线性链模型定性描述，暗示该现象源于层数奇偶效应，而非共存的铁磁相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁阻测量（magnetoresistance measurements），结合两子晶格模型（two-sublattice model）提取各向异性和层间交换场，并采用线性链模型（linear chain model）解释磁滞转变。

papers.title: Magnetotransport of tomographic electrons in a Corbino disk
papers.abstract: In clean electron gases at low-to-moderate temperatures, odd-parity modes of the Fermi surface are anomalously long-lived due to Pauli blocking, giving rise to ``tomographic transport'' that is not captured by a hydrodynamic model. Here we show that tomographic flow in a Corbino disk induces an extended boundary layer near electrodes with superballistic transport and enhanced slip velocity, which leads to a parametric enhancement of the quadratic magnetoresistance coefficient. The enhancement depends explicitly on the electrode curvature, allowing its strength to be controlled by the device geometry. The magnetoresistance coefficient reveals three distinct regimes as a function of magnetic field: a tomographic regime at weak fields; a hydrodynamic regime at intermediate fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to a large odd-mode mean free path; and a conventional Ohmic regime at large fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to the short even-mode mean free path. The tomographic regime is characterized by an anomalous dependence of the magnetoresistance on temperature and density, which may account for recent experimentally observed anomalous scaling of the electron viscosity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论分析、模型、输运机制。；研究对象：Corbino圆盘几何结构中的电子“断层扫描输运”（tomographic transport）现象，具体研究该几何结构下的磁输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Corbino圆盘中，断层扫描电子流会在电极附近形成具有超弹道输运和增强滑移速度的扩展边界层，导致二次磁电阻系数出现参数性增强；该系数随磁场变化呈现三个不同输运区：弱场下的断层扫描区、中场下的流体动力学区、强场下的常规欧姆区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Corbino圆盘中，断层扫描电子流会在电极附近形成具有超弹道输运和增强滑移速度的扩展边界层，导致二次磁电阻系数出现参数性增强；该系数随磁场变化呈现三个不同输运区：弱场下的断层扫描区、中场下的流体动力学区、强场下的常规欧姆区。；创新点：揭示了Corbino圆盘几何中电极曲率对断层扫描输运边界层及磁电阻系数的直接调控作用，并指出断层扫描区磁电阻对温度和密度的反常依赖可能解释近期实验中观测到的电子黏度反常标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于费米面奇宇称模式因泡利阻塞而异常长寿命的理论框架，分析Corbino圆盘几何中的电子输运，推导磁电阻系数对磁场、温度、密度及电极曲率的依赖关系。

papers.title: Anomalous suppression of quantum chaos between two integrable limits
papers.abstract: Level statistics in non-integrable quantum many-body systems with time reversal symmetry are expected to follow the Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE), a hallmark of quantum chaos. However, we show that the interacting Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model exhibits a clear suppression of the mean level-spacing ratio $\langle r\rangle$ from the GOE value $\approx 0.535$, persisting deep in the nonintegrable regime. This challenges the conventional association between non-integrability and fully chaotic spectral statistics. Using exact diagonalization supported by semi-analytical arguments, we trace this anomaly to incomplete hybridization of many-body band states inherited from the noninteracting band structure. The resulting restructuring of the spectrum weakens level repulsion without restoring integrability. We show the robustness of this mechanism in extensions of the model which break chiral and inversion symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：level statistics、exact diagonalization、semi-analytical arguments。；研究对象：具有时间反演对称性的非可积量子多体系统，具体为相互作用的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在深度非可积区域中，平均能级间距比⟨r⟩显著低于高斯正交系综（GOE）的预期值≈0.535，表明量子混沌被反常抑制，挑战了非可积性必然导致完全混沌谱统计的传统观点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在深度非可积区域中，平均能级间距比⟨r⟩显著低于高斯正交系综（GOE）的预期值≈0.535，表明量子混沌被反常抑制，挑战了非可积性必然导致完全混沌谱统计的传统观点。；创新点：将反常的能级排斥减弱归因于多体带态的不完全杂化（incomplete hybridization），这些态继承自非相互作用能带结构，且该机制在打破手征对称性和反演对称性的模型扩展中依然稳健。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）计算，并辅以半解析论证（semi-analytical arguments）分析能谱统计。

papers.title: Non Hermitian Tight Binding Bands in Graphene from Tan Bo Model: Strain Effects and Bernal Bilayer Extensions
papers.abstract: Within the tight binding framework of graphenes π electron nearest neighbors, the Tan Bo model parametrizes transition energies t(dr) based on bond lengths and angles via the Mobius transformation combined with exponential decay. Comparisons between isotropic , geometrically anisotropic , and Slater Koster scales reveal that B = 0 is equivalent to the SK scheme, with L(B) reaching its optimum at Bopt = 0. The Hermitian assembly maintains the Dirac cone at the K point.The Tan Bo geometry dependent transition model and non Hermitian TB assembly scheme developed in this study provide a reproducible single particle benchmark and parameterization reference for future non Hermitian chemical calculations incorporating electron correlation effects in graphene systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tight binding framework（紧束缚框架）、parametrizes（参数化）、model（模型）、calculations（计算）。；研究对象：石墨烯（graphene）及其双层结构（Bernal bilayer）中的非厄米紧束缚能带，特别是考虑应变效应（strain effects）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tan Bo模型通过Möbius变换结合指数衰减来参数化跃迁能，在B=0时等价于Slater-Koster方案，且最优参数Bopt=0。该模型为未来包含电子关联效应的非厄米化学计算提供了可重复的单粒子基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tan Bo模型通过Möbius变换结合指数衰减来参数化跃迁能，在B=0时等价于Slater-Koster方案，且最优参数Bopt=0。该模型为未来包含电子关联效应的非厄米化学计算提供了可重复的单粒子基准。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，创新点在于提出了一个依赖于几何结构的Tan Bo跃迁模型以及一个非厄米紧束缚组装方案，为石墨烯系统中未来包含电子关联效应的非厄米化学计算提供了可重复的单粒子基准和参数化参考。
papers.method_zh: 基于石墨烯π电子最近邻紧束缚框架，采用Tan Bo模型。该模型通过Möbius变换结合指数衰减，根据键长和键角参数化跃迁能t(dr)。研究比较了各向同性、几何各向异性以及Slater-Koster标度。

papers.title: Broken Ergodicity and the Violation of the Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem Lead to Generalization Beyond Overfitting in Machine Learning
papers.abstract: The remarkable ability of modern neural networks to generalize improves with increasing network capacity, even when the number of model parameters or effective degrees of freedom exceeds the number of training data points. This phenomenon is all the more surprising given that generalization error diverges when the number of model parameters approaches a critical value from below. Here we use dynamical mean field theory to show that this so-called "double descent" behavior is the outcome of a phase transition in the stochastic field theory describing the training process. We calculate the critical exponents and scaling function of the double descent phase transition, and show that it is marked by a breakdown of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem associated with broken ergodicity. The corresponding response function has the same functional form as the simple London model of the superconducting transition, with the rigidity of the wave function corresponding to the neural network's ability to generalize accurately.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“dynamical mean field theory”（动力学平均场理论）进行理论分析，并计算临界指数和标度函数，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：现代神经网络在训练过程中的泛化行为，具体为“double descent”（双下降）现象及其与遍历性破缺、涨落-耗散定理违反的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经网络泛化能力中的“双下降”行为本质上是随机场理论描述的训练过程中的一个相变，该相变由遍历性破缺导致的涨落-耗散定理失效所标志，其响应函数与超导转变的London模型具有相同函数形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经网络泛化能力中的“双下降”行为本质上是随机场理论描述的训练过程中的一个相变，该相变由遍历性破缺导致的涨落-耗散定理失效所标志，其响应函数与超导转变的London模型具有相同函数形式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean field theory），用于分析描述训练过程的随机场理论，并计算相变的临界指数和标度函数。

papers.title: Quantum state localization in dipole-dipole interacting disordered networks
papers.abstract: We study the localization of excitations in positionally disordered spin or atom networks coupled via the realistic resonant dipole-dipole interaction (RDDI), which does not conform to a simple power law, as the spatial dependence and dissipative character distinguish it from conventional short or long-range models. Despite its partially long-ranged and radiative nature, positional disorder in the RDDI coupling leads to strong spatial localization of excitations. The interplay between coherent and dissipative couplings gives rise to nontrivial interference effects that stabilize localized modes even in open geometries. Our results uncover a photon wavelength-induced transition from extended to localized excitation dynamics, establishing RDDI networks as a unique setting to explore the emergence of localization in realistic quantum optical systems. Our analysis of the localized modes induced by RDDI has potential applications in coherent photovoltaics, excitonic circuits, quantum memory, and quantum sensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“Our results uncover”“Our analysis”等表述，未提及实验或计算具体手段，属于理论分析。；研究对象：位置无序的自旋或原子网络，通过现实共振偶极-偶极相互作用（RDDI）耦合的激发局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管RDDI具有部分长程和辐射特性，位置无序仍能导致激发的强空间局域化；相干与耗散耦合的干涉效应可在开放几何中稳定局域模式，并发现光子波长诱导的从扩展态到局域态的动力学期望转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管RDDI具有部分长程和辐射特性，位置无序仍能导致激发的强空间局域化；相干与耗散耦合的干涉效应可在开放几何中稳定局域模式，并发现光子波长诱导的从扩展态到局域态的动力学期望转变。；创新点：揭示了RDDI网络中由光子波长调控的局域化转变，并指出其相干-耗散耦合的干涉效应是稳定局域模式的关键机制，将局域化研究拓展到现实量子光学系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于现实共振偶极-偶极相互作用（RDDI）模型，该模型不遵循简单幂律，具有空间依赖性和耗散特性，区别于传统短程或长程模型。

papers.title: Terahertz-driven four-wave mixing at glass surfaces: Probing vibrational resonances and structural regimes
papers.abstract: Disordered materials such as glasses exhibit complex structural dynamics that are challenging to probe with conventional spectroscopies. We demonstrate that terahertz-driven four-wave mixing (FWM) at glass surfaces provides direct access to low-frequency vibrational modes and structural evolution in amorphous solids. Applied to a compositional series of PbO-silicate glasses (20-54 mol% PbO), this technique resolves distinct contributions from collective Boson-peak excitations and Pb-O / Si-O network stretching modes, and tracks their systematic evolution across structurally distinct compositional regimes. The dominant vibrational frequency blueshifts with PbO content, reflecting the progressive evolution of the Pb$^{2+}$ network role from silicate-modifier to ward network-former. A pronounced enhancement of the FWM signal near 44 mol% PbO coincides with the emergence of medium-range Pb-Pb correlations, while in-plane-to-out-of-plane FWM intensity ratio ($I_{\rm SS}/I_{\rm PS}$) tracks $χ^{(3)}$ tensor anisotropy tied to Pb$^{2+}$ lone-pair spatial correlations. The non-monotonic peak in both observables at 44 mol% PbO - a composition where NMR finds no change in local Pb-O coordination and Pb-O-Pb free-oxide linkages are negligible - provides direct evidence that a collective lone-pair reorganization occurs in the medium-range structure independently of nearest-neighbor bonding. These results establish terahertz-driven FWM as a bulk-sensitive, near-surface depth-confined ($\sim$50 nm) nonlinear spectroscopy sensitive to vibrational and electronic structural fingerprints inaccessible to linear infrared, Raman, and terahertz time-domain probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了实验技术（太赫兹驱动四波混频）及其在玻璃表面的应用，并给出了具体实验观测结果（如信号增强、强度比变化等）。；研究对象：无序材料（玻璃），具体为一系列不同PbO摩尔含量（20-54 mol%）的PbO-硅酸盐玻璃。研究的物理现象包括低频振动模式、结构演化、玻色峰激发、网络拉伸模式以及中程结构有序性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 太赫兹驱动四波混频（FWM）技术能够直接探测玻璃表面的低频振动模式和结构演化，并在44 mol% PbO成分处观测到非单调的信号增强和强度比峰值，这揭示了独立于最近邻键合的中程结构中孤对电子的集体重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：太赫兹驱动四波混频（FWM）技术能够直接探测玻璃表面的低频振动模式和结构演化，并在44 mol% PbO成分处观测到非单调的信号增强和强度比峰值，这揭示了独立于最近邻键合的中程结构中孤对电子的集体重排。；创新点：该工作首次将太赫兹驱动的四波混频技术应用于玻璃表面，实现了对线性红外、拉曼和太赫兹时域光谱无法探测的振动和电子结构指纹的灵敏检测，并揭示了中程尺度上孤对电子空间关联的独立重排机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为太赫兹驱动四波混频（FWM）光谱学，这是一种近表面深度受限（约50 nm）的非线性光谱技术。具体测量了FWM信号强度及其偏振依赖的强度比（I_SS/I_PS），以追踪χ^(3)张量各向异性。

papers.title: Economised path integrals
papers.abstract: The Hessian of the ring polymer spring potential in the standard Trotter path integral is a $P\times P$ symmetric circulant matrix with a centroid eigenvalue of zero. All such matrices commute and are diagonalised by the same bead to normal mode transformation matrix, and their eigenvalues contain $\lceil P/2\rceil-1$ degenerate pairs by symmetry. However, this still leaves some freedom to improve on the Trotter approximation: one can optimise the remaining $\lfloor P/2\rfloor$ independent non-zero normal mode frequencies to fit the exact quantum mechanical radii of gyration of harmonic ring polymers with frequencies in the range $0\leω\leω_{\rm max}$, where $ω_{\rm max}$ is the maximum physical frequency in the problem of interest. The optimisation involves solving a simple least squares problem for the optimum (economised or "Eco") internal mode frequencies. The remainder of the calculation then proceeds in the same way as a Trotter path integral calculation. An example application to hexagonal ice shows that the convergence of the Eco path integral is comparable to that of the 4th order Suzuki-Chin path integral, but with purely 2nd order Trotter effort. There is no need to calculate the projected Hessians that arise in the Suzuki-Chin method by finite differences, there is no need to develop any new estimators for observables, and once the Eco frequencies have been calculated the implementation of the Eco path integral involves changing just a few lines of a Trotter path integral code. To provide a more impressive example we have implemented the Eco method in GPUMD and used it to converge the (negative) thermal expansion coefficient and the constant pressure heat capacity of MOF-5 with a machine-learned neuroevolution potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：path integral、optimisation、least squares problem、implementation。；研究对象：路径积分分子动力学中的环聚合物（ring polymer）模型，具体应用于六角冰（hexagonal ice）和MOF-5（金属有机框架材料）的热力学性质计算（热膨胀系数、定压热容）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化环聚合物内部模式频率（Economised/Eco方法），可以在仅使用二阶Trotter计算量的情况下，达到与四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分相当的收敛精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化环聚合物内部模式频率（Economised/Eco方法），可以在仅使用二阶Trotter计算量的情况下，达到与四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分相当的收敛精度。；创新点：提出了一种无需计算投影Hessian矩阵（如Suzuki-Chin方法所需）、无需开发新可观测量估计器的路径积分改进方案，仅需修改少量代码即可将现有Trotter路径积分程序升级为Eco路径积分，显著降低实现复杂度。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值优化相结合。具体包括：利用环聚合物弹簧势的Hessian矩阵（对称循环矩阵）的本征值简并性，通过最小二乘问题优化剩余独立非零简正模频率，使其拟合量子力学精确的回转半径；在GPUMD软件中实现Eco路径积分，并结合机器学习神经进化势（neuroevolution potential）进行实际计算。

papers.title: Calculating strongly correlated ground states from the non-Markovian dissipative dynamics of Gaussian fermions
papers.abstract: We introduce a mapping between the ground state of interacting fermionic Hamiltonians and the non-equilibrium steady state of a purely dissipative open quantum system. Within the framework of third quantization, we map the Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian onto Lindblad jump operators acting on Majorana fermions. Remarkably, both hopping and interaction terms map onto jump operators that preserve the Gaussianity of Majorana fermions along individual quantum trajectories. As a result, the dynamics can be unravelled and each trajectory can be simulated efficiently using only two-point correlation functions, with a computational cost that scales polynomially with system size. We further show that finite particle number requires negative dissipative rates, leading to an intrinsically non-Markovian dynamics. The corresponding trajectory unravelling involves both positive and negative stochastic weights and exhibits a sign problem and large fluctuations, so that convergence requires an exponentially large number of trajectories. The overall computational cost remains exponential in system size despite the efficient Gaussian representation of individual trajectories, but is crucially dependent on the computational complexity of the non-Markovian unravelling, motivating further studies on the efficiency of such unravellings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mapping（映射）、framework（框架）、dynamics（动力学）、computational cost（计算成本）。；研究对象：强关联费米子体系的基态，具体以费米-哈伯德模型（Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将相互作用费米子基态映射到非马尔可夫耗散开放量子系统的非平衡稳态，发现该映射中有限粒子数要求负耗散率，导致动力学本质上是非马尔可夫的，且轨迹模拟存在符号问题和大幅涨落，整体计算复杂度仍为指数增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将相互作用费米子基态映射到非马尔可夫耗散开放量子系统的非平衡稳态，发现该映射中有限粒子数要求负耗散率，导致动力学本质上是非马尔可夫的，且轨迹模拟存在符号问题和大幅涨落，整体计算复杂度仍为指数增长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第三量子化（third quantization）框架，将费米-哈伯德哈密顿量映射为作用于马约拉纳费米子的林德布拉德跳变算符（Lindblad jump operators），并通过量子轨迹非纠缠（unravelling）方法，仅利用两点关联函数模拟单个轨迹的动力学。

papers.title: Determination of thermodynamics from entanglement entropy in the finite-density O(N) model
papers.abstract: We nonperturbatively compute Rényi entropies for strip-shaped subregions in the three-dimensional O(4) model at finite density on the lattice. By using a dual variable representation and a tailored worm algorithm, we circumvent the sign problem when sampling the grand canonical ensemble. In the limit of large subregions, we also establish a direct, quantitative relationship between the derivative of entanglement entropy with respect to the size of the entangling region and the thermal entropy density for general quantum field theories, providing a new way to study their thermodynamics. We corroborate this argument with our lattice results by demonstrating that, in the appropriate limit, the derivative of entanglement entropy satisfies the same Maxwell relation as the thermal entropy density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：nonperturbatively compute、lattice、dual variable representation、worm algorithm）；研究对象：三维O(4)模型在有限密度下的热力学性质，具体通过纠缠熵（Rényi熵）研究其热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大子区域极限下，纠缠熵对区域大小的导数与热熵密度之间存在直接的定量关系，并且该导数满足与热熵密度相同的麦克斯韦关系，从而提供了一种通过纠缠熵研究热力学的新途径。
