We then pass the gate-derived confinement, rather than a harmonic or fitted potential, to a spin-valley many-body calculation for a jellybean quantum dot with N = 2-17 electrons at B = 5 T. The unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF) solution supports occupation-dependent, Wigner-molecule-like charge localization but likely overestimates spin polarization. Complete active-space configuration interaction (CASCI) supports a low-spin branch within the tested active spaces, which aligns with the experiments. The workflow therefore connects CMOS layout, device electrostatics, and potential-determined quantum observables, providing an auditable modelling layer for CMOS-based qubit design and DTCO.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：reduced-order analytical framework、Poisson-kernel coupled-interface Green-function (PK-GF) model、unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF)、complete active-space configuration interaction (CASCI)。；研究对象：非对称多栅极硅基CMOS量子点器件，具体研究从CMOS版图几何、静电约束到多电子自旋填充的完整物理连接。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个从CMOS版图到量子点自旋填充的统一建模流程，其中PK-GF静电模型与独立有限体积解在毫伏尺度吻合，而CASCI计算支持低自旋分支，与实验一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个从CMOS版图到量子点自旋填充的统一建模流程，其中PK-GF静电模型与独立有限体积解在毫伏尺度吻合，而CASCI计算支持低自旋分支，与实验一致。；创新点：提出了一个可审计的建模层，首次将CMOS版图几何、器件静电学与势决定的量子可观测量（如自旋填充）直接连接，无需拟合参数，适用于设计-技术协同优化（DTCO）。
papers.method_zh: 采用降阶解析框架，核心是泊松-核耦合界面格林函数（PK-GF）模型用于静电计算；随后将栅极导出的约束势（而非简谐或拟合势）传递给自旋-谷多体计算，使用无限制Hartree-Fock（UHF）和完全活性空间组态相互作用（CASCI）方法处理N=2-17电子、B=5 T下的“果冻豆”量子点。

papers.title: Bloch-sphere rotations in driven double-well for ultracold atoms
papers.abstract: We show that, by using suitable protocols for a non-interacting condensate in a driven double-well, one can achieve controlled rotations about arbitrary axes in the equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere, composed with fast rotations about the $z$-axis. Specifically, we investigate the dynamics induced by a spatially linear time-periodic potential, by means of numerical simulations. We also provide an explicit two-level model that accurately captures the microscopic evolution of the driven system, with the full time-dependent evolution operator obtained using a Floquet-based approach. The analysis is carried out using as a reference a recently realized experimental platform consisting of arrays of double-well potentials based on Beat-Note Superlattices, to which the proposed control scheme is directly applicable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：numerical simulations、Floquet-based approach、two-level model）；研究对象：驱动双阱势阱中的超冷原子非相互作用玻色凝聚体，具体参考基于Beat-Note Superlattices的双阱阵列实验平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过合适的驱动协议，可以在布洛赫球赤道面上实现绕任意轴的受控旋转，并与绕z轴的快速旋转相结合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过合适的驱动协议，可以在布洛赫球赤道面上实现绕任意轴的受控旋转，并与绕z轴的快速旋转相结合。；创新点：提出了一种可直接应用于现有Beat-Note Superlattices双阱阵列实验平台的控制方案，实现了布洛赫球赤道面上绕任意轴的受控旋转。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（驱动双阱中线性时间周期势诱导的动力学）；基于Floquet方法解析推导全时间演化算符，并建立精确描述微观演化的两能级模型。

papers.title: Unveiling Structural Bottlenecks of Dynamic Disorder in a Density-Tunable Glass Former: From Strong to Fragile Regimes
papers.abstract: Fragility characterizes how rapidly a glass-forming liquid slows down upon supercooling, but whether strong and fragile behaviors arise from the same microscopic relaxation mechanism remains unclear. Here, we address this question using a density-tunable soft-repulsive binary mixture spanning distinct fragility regimes and analyze particle jump dynamics within the framework of dynamic disorder. Across these regimes, we show that increasing fragility leads to progressively broader cage-lifetime distributions and increasingly non-exponential survival probabilities, revealing non-Poisson cage-to-jump statistics governed by fluctuating jump rates and slowly evolving structural variables. To characterize their structural origin, we first identify the neighbor ranks most strongly coupled to jump motion using Kullback-Leibler divergence and Pearson correlation analyses. We then introduce a structural slowness parameter that combines these neighbor-distance fluctuations into a reduced slow coordinate for constructing the slow-fluctuation survival probability. A comparison with the actual survival probability shows that localized neighbor-distance fluctuations control the jump rate in the strong regime, whereas extended neighbor rearrangements become relevant in the intermediate and fragile regimes, increasing the effective dimensionality of the slow-variable space. In the fragile regime, distance-based descriptors alone become insufficient at the lowest temperature, where the Voronoi free volume captures additional cage-volume fluctuations in the rate-controlling slow variable. Point-to-set correlations grow with fragility, but the spatial extent of the slow variables exceeds the point-to-set length. These results show that fragility changes the structural bottleneck for microscopic rate fluctuations, linking dynamic disorder and multidimensional slow variables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：分子动力学模拟（分析粒子跳跃动力学）、Kullback-Leibler散度、Pearson相关性分析、结构慢度参数。；研究对象：密度可调的软排斥二元混合物体系，研究其从强玻璃到脆性玻璃转变过程中的动态无序与结构瓶颈。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻璃形成液的脆性增加会导致笼寿命分布变宽、生存概率非指数化，且控制微观弛豫速率的结构瓶颈从强玻璃态的局域近邻距离涨落，演变为中间态和脆性态的扩展近邻重排，在脆性态低温下还需引入Voronoi自由体积描述笼体积涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻璃形成液的脆性增加会导致笼寿命分布变宽、生存概率非指数化，且控制微观弛豫速率的结构瓶颈从强玻璃态的局域近邻距离涨落，演变为中间态和脆性态的扩展近邻重排，在脆性态低温下还需引入Voronoi自由体积描述笼体积涨落。；创新点：首次将动态无序框架与多维慢变量结构分析相结合，系统揭示了从强玻璃到脆性玻璃转变中控制微观速率涨落的结构瓶颈的维度变化，并指出点对点关联长度不足以描述慢变量的空间范围。
papers.method_zh: 通过分子动力学模拟分析粒子跳跃动力学，利用Kullback-Leibler散度和Pearson相关性分析识别与跳跃运动耦合最强的近邻层级，构建结构慢度参数（结合近邻距离涨落）计算慢涨落生存概率，并与实际生存概率对比；在脆性态低温下引入Voronoi自由体积描述额外笼体积涨落，并计算点对点关联函数。

papers.title: Uniform distributions in nonuniform systems: Wall potentials generating constant density profiles in classical density functional theory
papers.abstract: We study the inverse problem of classical density functional theory for inhomogeneous fluids: finding the wall potential that produces a constant equilibrium density profile, i.e., a perfectly flat density distribution in the accessible region adjacent to a substrate. Within Rosenfeld's fundamental measure theory, we solve this problem for a one-component fluid in planar, spherical, and cylindrical geometries, considering both a hard-sphere fluid and a fluid with an additional truncated Lennard-Jones attraction treated at the mean-field level. Explicit analytical expressions are obtained for planar walls, while spherical walls also admit an analytical treatment in a more cumbersome form. The cylindrical case is treated numerically. The construction provides an explicit microscopic realization of structure-cancelling wall fields, related to flat-profile conditions that occur under special matching conditions in interfacial theories of wetting and drying. The theory also yields a compact collection of formulae for weighted densities and one-body direct correlation functions in the three fundamental geometries, providing useful reference expressions for density-functional implementations. The resulting analytic wall potentials are validated in independent density functional calculations, which confirm that the prescribed flat profiles are recovered within numerical accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“inverse problem of classical density functional theory”、“analytical expressions”、“numerical treatment”。；研究对象：非均匀流体（inhomogeneous fluids）在平面、球面和圆柱几何结构中的密度分布问题，具体包括硬球流体和具有截断Lennard-Jones吸引相互作用的流体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过求解经典密度泛函理论的反问题，找到了能够产生完全平坦（恒定）密度分布曲线的壁面势（wall potential）的解析表达式，并验证了其数值准确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过求解经典密度泛函理论的反问题，找到了能够产生完全平坦（恒定）密度分布曲线的壁面势（wall potential）的解析表达式，并验证了其数值准确性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Rosenfeld的基本度量理论（fundamental measure theory），对平面壁情况给出显式解析解，对球面壁给出较复杂的解析形式，对圆柱壁采用数值方法处理。同时利用独立密度泛函计算验证所得壁面势的准确性。

papers.title: Different dielectric, magnetic, and magnetodielectric mechanisms in M-type BaFe12O19 hexaferrite regulated by doping Ga3+ and In3+ cations
papers.abstract: We systematically investigated the magnetic, dielectric, and MD properties of BaFe12-xMexO19 ceramics prepared by a solid-state reaction method. The Ga3+ cations with a smaller radius preferentially substitute the Fe3+ ions in FeO6 octahedra while the In3+ cations with a larger radius tend to replace the Fe3+ ions in FeO5 bipyramids of R blocks, inducing different physical characteristics. The pure BaFe12O19 and Ga-doped samples show ferrimagnetism in the temperature range from 10 K to 300 K. The In-doped samples exhibit a transition from non-collinear magnetism to collinear ferrimagnetism. The dielectric decrease of pure BaFe12O19 at around 10-175 K is attributed to the quantum paraelectric state, and the shoulder peaks of loss at about 140-200 K are from electron hopping. The dipole glass state is responsible for the dielectric peak of Ga-doped samples at around 20-40 K. The dielectric increase and plateau of In-doped samples are mainly ascribed to the electron hopping at low temperatures. Their dielectric properties at high temperatures are all attributed to the interfacial polarization caused by the Maxwell-Wagner effect. The MD effect also has different origins for the various samples at low temperatures. For the pure BaFe12O19, the negative MD effect at extremely low temperatures and the positive MD effect after warming are ascribed to spin-phonon coupling and field-dependent electron hopping, respectively. The positive MD effect in Ga-doped hexaferrites results from the field-dependent electric dipoles inside FeO5 bipyramids. For the In-doped samples, the negative MD effect and subsequent transformation to the positive MD effect originate from the field-dependent non-collinear spin ordering and electron hopping, respectively. The MD effect at high temperatures is attributed to the combination of magnetoresistance and Maxwell-Wagner effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：solid-state reaction method（固相反应法）、prepared、investigated。；研究对象：M型六角铁氧体 BaFe12O19 及其通过 Ga³⁺ 和 In³⁺ 掺杂调控后的体系，具体研究其介电、磁性和磁介电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同半径的掺杂离子（Ga³⁺ 和 In³⁺）优先占据不同晶格位（FeO6 八面体或 FeO5 双锥体），导致截然不同的磁有序、介电行为及磁介电效应机制，包括量子顺电态、偶极玻璃态、自旋-声子耦合及场依赖的电子跳跃等。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同半径的掺杂离子（Ga³⁺ 和 In³⁺）优先占据不同晶格位（FeO6 八面体或 FeO5 双锥体），导致截然不同的磁有序、介电行为及磁介电效应机制，包括量子顺电态、偶极玻璃态、自旋-声子耦合及场依赖的电子跳跃等。；创新点：通过对比两种不同离子半径的掺杂（Ga³⁺ 和 In³⁺）对晶格占位和物理性质的调控，揭示了 M 型六角铁氧体中多种磁、介电及磁介电机制的微观起源，特别是区分了不同掺杂下磁介电效应的正负符号转变及其物理根源。
papers.method_zh: 固相反应法制备陶瓷样品；系统测量了温度范围 10 K 至 300 K 的磁性、介电及磁介电性质。

papers.title: Disentangling Electronic and Lattice Contributions to Transient Absorption in Metal Halide Perovskites: A First-Principles Study of CH3NH3PbBr3
papers.abstract: Soft lattices combined with strong electron-phonon coupling in metal halide perovskites result in a complex interplay between electronic and lattice degrees of freedom. This interplay complicates the interpretation of time-resolved excitation spectra like pump-probe spectra. Here, we develop a first-principles approach that combines a nonequilibrium extension of the Bethe-Salpeter equation with \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics to resolve the origin of transient absorption. This approach can quantitatively disentangle electronic and thermal lattice contributions across femtosecond-to-picosecond timescales. Exemplified with \ce{CH3NH3PbBr3}, we find that on the femtosecond scale, both X-ray and optical transient absorption spectra are dominated by electronic contributions: Photoinduced Coulomb screening weakens the effective electron-hole interaction and blueshifts the excitonic resonances, whereas Pauli blocking is negligible. On the picosecond scale, thermal lattice contributions become essential, with distinct mechanisms dominating different spectral regions: Lattice vibrations lead to spectral redistribution in the X-ray transient absorption spectrum, whereas lattice expansion blueshifts the optical transient absorption spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：first-principles approach、Bethe-Salpeter equation、ab initio molecular dynamics。；研究对象：金属卤化物钙钛矿CH3NH3PbBr3中的瞬态吸收光谱，具体研究电子和晶格自由度对瞬态吸收信号的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在飞秒时间尺度，X射线和光学瞬态吸收光谱主要由电子贡献主导（光诱导库仑屏蔽导致激子共振蓝移，泡利阻塞可忽略）；在皮秒时间尺度，热晶格贡献变得重要，其中晶格振动主导X射线瞬态吸收谱的谱重分布，晶格膨胀导致光学瞬态吸收谱蓝移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在飞秒时间尺度，X射线和光学瞬态吸收光谱主要由电子贡献主导（光诱导库仑屏蔽导致激子共振蓝移，泡利阻塞可忽略）；在皮秒时间尺度，热晶格贡献变得重要，其中晶格振动主导X射线瞬态吸收谱的谱重分布，晶格膨胀导致光学瞬态吸收谱蓝移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合非平衡贝特-萨皮特方程（Bethe-Salpeter equation）扩展与第一性原理分子动力学（ab initio molecular dynamics）的第一性原理方法，用于定量分离电子和热晶格贡献。

papers.title: Glassy Dynamics of LiCl.6H2O Solution in Nanoporous Media
papers.abstract: Understanding how nanoconfinement alters the dynamics of glass-forming aqueous electrolytes is essential for clarifying the interplay among ionic hydration, hydrogen-bond structure, and interfacial effects. Here, LiCl.6H2O was investigated in the bulk and under confinement in SBA-15 mesoporous silica with an average pore diameter of 8 nm. Differential scanning calorimetry, Raman spectroscopy, quasielastic neutron scattering, 1 H spin-lattice relaxation, and pulsed-fieldgradient NMR were combined to probe thermal behavior, hydrogen-bond structure, local mobility, and translational transport over complementary time and length scales. The calorimetric results show that LiCl.6H2O remains glass-forming under confinement, while its thermal signature of the glass transition becomes slightly broader and shifted upward relative to the bulk. Raman spectra in the O-H stretching region indicate that the concentrated LiCl solution possesses a weakened and less tetrahedrally connected hydrogen-bond network compared with bulk water. On the subnanosecond timescale, elastic fixed-window analysis reveals reduced mean-squared displacements under confinement, demonstrating suppressed motional amplitudes inside the pores. Inelastic fixed-window neutron scattering scans analyzed within a jump-diffusion framework yield lower effective translational diffusion coefficients and longer residence times for the confined liquid, indicating that confinement mainly hinders translational escape from transient local environments. 1 H relaxometry further shows that confinement broadens the distribution of local proton fluctuation times, while PFG-NMR confirms that the measured long-range water mobility in bulk LiCl.6H2O solution is reduced relative to bulk water. While the present data do not resolve distinct interfacial and pore-centered populations in confined LiCl.6H2O, its dynamics are markedly altered across timescales, from the glassy to the liquid state, resulting in slower, spatially constrained, and more heterogeneous motions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了多种实验手段（Differential scanning calorimetry, Raman spectroscopy, quasielastic neutron scattering, ¹H spin-lattice relaxation, pulsed-field-gradient NMR）。；研究对象：纳米限域下的LiCl·6H₂O溶液（玻璃形成电解质），具体限域介质为平均孔径8 nm的SBA-15介孔二氧化硅。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米限域使LiCl·6H₂O溶液的玻璃化转变温度升高且热信号展宽，并显著抑制了亚纳秒时间尺度上的分子运动幅度，导致更慢、空间受限且更不均匀的动力学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米限域使LiCl·6H₂O溶液的玻璃化转变温度升高且热信号展宽，并显著抑制了亚纳秒时间尺度上的分子运动幅度，导致更慢、空间受限且更不均匀的动力学行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 差示扫描量热法（DSC）、拉曼光谱、准弹性中子散射（QENS，包括弹性固定窗分析和非弹性固定窗分析）、¹H自旋-晶格弛豫（¹H relaxometry）、脉冲场梯度核磁共振（PFG-NMR）。其中QENS数据在跳跃扩散框架下进行分析。

papers.title: Formation and Thermodynamic Behavior of THF-Water Hydrates in Confined Mesoporous Media
papers.abstract: Tetrahydrofuran (THF) is a benchmark guest for probing clathrate hydrate thermodynamics because a stoichiometric aqueous solution (THF.17H2O) forms structure-II (sII) hydrate at ambient pressure with a well-defined dissociation temperature. Here, we combine differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS) in bulk and confined media to resolve how composition, pore filling, and cooling rate govern hydrate formation in SBA-15 mesoporous silica. Bulk DSC establishes mass-balanced enthalpies for ice and sII hydrate and confirms reversible dissociation/melting temperatures. In confinement, the heating traces separate into a Gibbs-Thomson depressed ice melt (= -14.7 $\pm$ 0.2 {\textdegree}C), an in-pore hydrate dissociation (= -13.2 $\pm$ 0.2 {\textdegree}C). Confined hydrate appears only when two criteria are met: near-percolating filling ($φ$ = 1.0 -1.1 cm3/g) and sufficient THF ($\ge$ 1:16 mol:mol). Cooling-rate experiments (1.0 vs 0.5 {\textdegree}C/min) demonstrate that slower precooling increases the confined-hydrate fraction and reduces confined ice without shifting equilibrium temperatures: at $φ$ = 1.1, the hydrate enthalpy rises by ~60% at 1:11 and ~54% at 1:14, but by $\le$ 17% at 1:16. Temperature-cycling tests show invariant reheating peak positions, indicating that capillarity and composition, rather than kinetic history, fix the liquidus and dissociation temperatures. WAXS indicates that the phase formed in pores is crystallographically identical to bulk sII. Finally, the variation of melting points ($Δ$T___) plotted against inverse pore radius follows the Gibbs-Thomson law for both ice melting and hydrate dissociation, quantitatively linking the observed shifts to crystalline size and clarifying how confinement, cooling rate, and composition govern the competition between hydrate formation and water crystallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“differential scanning calorimetry (DSC)”和“wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS)”等实验手段。；研究对象：四氢呋喃（THF）水合物在受限介孔介质（SBA-15介孔二氧化硅）中的形成过程及其热力学行为。具体研究了组成、孔隙填充率和冷却速率对水合物形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在受限介孔中，THF水合物的形成需要同时满足两个条件：接近渗流阈值的填充率（φ = 1.0 -1.1 cm³/g）和足够的THF浓度（≥ 1:16 mol:mol）。较慢的预冷却速率能增加受限水合物的比例，但不会改变其平衡解离温度。受限水合物的熔点降低遵循吉布斯-汤姆逊定律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在受限介孔中，THF水合物的形成需要同时满足两个条件：接近渗流阈值的填充率（φ = 1.0 -1.1 cm³/g）和足够的THF浓度（≥ 1:16 mol:mol）。较慢的预冷却速率能增加受限水合物的比例，但不会改变其平衡解离温度。受限水合物的熔点降低遵循吉布斯-汤姆逊定律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于定量揭示了在介孔受限条件下，THF水合物形成的两个关键阈值（填充率和浓度），并系统阐明了冷却速率、毛细作用与组成如何共同调控水合物与冰之间的竞争关系，且通过吉布斯-汤姆逊定律将熔点变化与晶体尺寸定量关联。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了差示扫描量热法（DSC）和广角X射线散射（WAXS）技术，分别对体相（bulk）和受限（confined）于SBA-15介孔二氧化硅中的THF-水体系进行表征。通过改变冷却速率（1.0 vs 0.5 °C/min）和进行温度循环实验来研究动力学和热力学效应。

papers.title: Nonlocal Kondo-exchange-driven intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in localized-$4f$ antiferromagnetic metals
papers.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect in antiferromagnetic metals has attracted considerable attention. Most known realizations involve itinerant $d$ electrons that simultaneously mediate charge transport and magnetic order. Here, we focus on $f$-electron materials, where localized magnetic moments and conduction electrons are hosted in different orbitals. We develop a theoretical framework to describe the impact of localized antiferromagnetic order on itinerant electrons. Applying this approach to the recently discovered $4f$ antiferromagnetic metal $\mathrm{Ce}_{2}\mathrm{Cu}\mathrm{Ge}_{6}$, we identify the origin of both the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity and the spin splitting of the energy bands as spin-dependent intersite hopping induced by nonlocal Kondo exchange coupling, rather than a Zeeman-type effective field acting locally on the conduction electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theoretical framework”（发展理论框架）、“Applying this approach”（应用该方法），属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：局域4f反铁磁金属中的反常霍尔效应，具体以Ce₂CuGe₆化合物为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域4f反铁磁金属中，本征反常霍尔电导率和能带自旋劈裂的起源并非局域作用于传导电子的类塞曼有效场，而是由非局域近藤交换耦合诱导的自旋依赖的格点间跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域4f反铁磁金属中，本征反常霍尔电导率和能带自旋劈裂的起源并非局域作用于传导电子的类塞曼有效场，而是由非局域近藤交换耦合诱导的自旋依赖的格点间跳跃。；创新点：揭示了在f电子材料中，局域磁矩与传导电子分属不同轨道时，反常霍尔效应的驱动机制是“非局域近藤交换耦合”而非传统的局域有效场模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建，用于描述局域反铁磁序对巡游电子的影响，并应用于Ce₂CuGe₆体系进行分析。

papers.title: Chiral Phonons Coupled to Spin-Split Bands in Altermagnetic CrSb and MnTe
papers.abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, providing a unique platform where magnetic order, electronic structure and lattice dynamics intertwine. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the prototypical altermagnets CrSb and MnTe host locally chiral phonon modes carrying finite phonon angular momentum with a six-lobes $f$-wave texture in momentum space. Our results show that the chiral lattice motion originates from the pnictogen/chalcogen sublattice, while the altermagnetic spin splitting is generated by the magnetic transition-metal atoms, indicating that chiral lattice dynamics and altermagnetic electronic states originate from different atomic sublattices of the same crystal. In pristine compounds, at each valley, inversion symmetry suppresses the net phonon angular momentum despite local circular atomic motion. We further demonstrate that isoelectronic symmetry lowering induced by chemical substitution lifts this cancellation and generates finite valley phonon chirality, while keeping the altermagnetic nature of the compounds intact. Most importantly, we reveal that chiral phonons couple to momentum-dependent spin-split electronic bands through momentum-dependent electron-phonon interaction, producing characteristic modifications of the electronic structure, possibly accessible by photoemission experiments. Our results establish altermagnets as a promising platform for chiral phononics and spin-selective lattice control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：交替磁体CrSb和MnTe中的手性声子模式及其与自旋劈裂电子能带的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交替磁体CrSb和MnTe中，手性声子模式携带有限声子角动量，在动量空间中呈现六瓣f波纹理；手性晶格动力学源于磷族/硫族元素子晶格，而交替磁自旋劈裂源于磁性过渡金属原子，两者来自不同子晶格；化学取代可产生有限谷声子手性，且手性声子通过动量依赖的电子-声子耦合与自旋劈裂能带相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交替磁体CrSb和MnTe中，手性声子模式携带有限声子角动量，在动量空间中呈现六瓣f波纹理；手性晶格动力学源于磷族/硫族元素子晶格，而交替磁自旋劈裂源于磁性过渡金属原子，两者来自不同子晶格；化学取代可产生有限谷声子手性，且手性声子通过动量依赖的电子-声子耦合与自旋劈裂能带相互作用。；创新点：首次在交替磁体中揭示手性声子模式的存在及其与自旋劈裂电子能带的动量依赖耦合，并指出交替磁体可作为手性声子学和自旋选择性晶格调控的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）进行理论模拟，分析声子角动量、电子能带结构及电子-声子耦合。

papers.title: Local Defects and the Topology of the Haldane Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between local defects and topology in the Haldane model within the framework of the tenfold classification. The Haldane model realizes a Chern-insulating phase characterized by an integer topological invariant ($C=\pm 1$) and supports chiral edge states. Introducing vacancies gives rise to localized states at the defect sites, classified by a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant $ν= C\cdot m,\mathrm{mod},2$, where $m=N_A-N_B$ is the net sublattice imbalance of the vacancy configuration: an odd imbalance hosts a protected zero-energy mode, whereas an even imbalance does not. We identify three independent experimental signatures that distinguish these topological defect states from trivial (adatom) defects. First, vacancy-induced states exhibit characteristic dislocations in their wavefunction profiles that track the phase winding associated with the defect. Second, a fractional charge of $e/2$ accumulates at vacancy sites, while no such charge appears at adatoms. Third, the probability current circulating around a vacancy-induced state flows in the opposite direction to that of chiral edge states, in direct analogy with the current reversal produced by a vortex in a $p$-wave superconductor. All three signatures are in quantitative agreement with the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“framework of the tenfold classification”“topological invariant”“Z₂ invariant”等理论分析术语，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：Haldane模型中的局域缺陷（空位）与拓扑性质的相互作用，具体研究空位缺陷在Chern绝缘体相中诱导的局域态及其拓扑分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空位缺陷在Haldane模型中诱导的局域态由Z₂不变量ν = C·m mod 2分类：当子晶格净不平衡m为奇数时，缺陷处存在受保护的零能模；当m为偶数时则不存在。该拓扑缺陷态可通过三种实验可观测信号与普通杂质缺陷区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空位缺陷在Haldane模型中诱导的局域态由Z₂不变量ν = C·m mod 2分类：当子晶格净不平衡m为奇数时，缺陷处存在受保护的零能模；当m为偶数时则不存在。该拓扑缺陷态可通过三种实验可观测信号与普通杂质缺陷区分。；创新点：首次将Haldane模型中的空位缺陷态与Z₂拓扑不变量联系起来，并提出了三种可直接实验验证的区分拓扑缺陷态与普通杂质缺陷的定量特征。
papers.method_zh: 基于十重分类框架的理论分析，通过拓扑不变量（Chern数C和Z₂不变量ν）对缺陷态进行分类，并推导了三种实验可观测特征：波函数位错、分数电荷（e/2）积累、概率流方向反转。

papers.title: Strain- and potential-controlled tunneling in monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of spin- and valley-resolved quantum transport in monolayer MoS$_2$ under the combined influence of mechanical strain and an external scalar potential, a combination whose simultaneous unexplored. Within an effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian that incorporates intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, strain induces valley-dependent momentum shifts that lift the degeneracy between the $K$ and $K'$ valleys and strongly modify the transport characteristics. The scalar potential modifies the tunneling spectrum, leading to pronounced changes in resonant transmission, Fabry--Pérot interference, and conductance. We show that the interplay between strain and electrostatic potential enables efficient control of both valley and spin polarization of the transmitted current. In particular, we identify a dual-knob control scheme in which the barrier width governs the frequency of conductance oscillations while strain independently controls their phase and amplitude. Furthermore, we predict electrostatic spin inversion -- a sign reversal of spin polarization achievable purely by gate tuning at finite strain, requiring no geometric reconfiguration. Depending on the strain orientation, the transmission probability and conductance can be selectively suppressed or enhanced, resulting in highly tunable valley- and spin-polarized transport. These findings demonstrate that strain and potential engineering provide orthogonal and independently operable mechanisms for controlling conductance as well as spin and valley degrees of freedom in monolayer MoS$_2$, offering promising prospects for spintronic and valleytronic device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical study”、“effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian”、“quantum transport”。；研究对象：单层MoS₂中自旋和谷分辨的量子输运现象，具体研究机械应变和外部标量势共同作用下的隧穿特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变和静电势的协同作用可独立且正交地控制单层MoS₂中的电导、自旋极化和谷极化，特别是通过纯栅极调控实现静电自旋反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变和静电势的协同作用可独立且正交地控制单层MoS₂中的电导、自旋极化和谷极化，特别是通过纯栅极调控实现静电自旋反转。；创新点：首次同时探索机械应变和外部标量势对单层MoS₂中自旋和谷分辨量子输运的联合影响，提出“双旋钮控制方案”（势垒宽度控制电导振荡频率，应变独立控制相位和振幅），并预测了无需几何重构的静电自旋反转效应。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效大质量狄拉克哈密顿量（包含本征自旋-轨道耦合）的理论模型，计算应变诱导的谷依赖动量偏移，分析隧穿谱、共振透射、法布里-珀罗干涉和电导的变化。

papers.title: On the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel noise in InP HEMTs from 4 K to 300 K
papers.abstract: The InP high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) is indispensable for low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) in radio astronomy and quantum computing. The composition of the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel in InP HEMT is known to influence the LNA noise performance. However, the various physical mechanisms responsible for noise generation are not fully characterized and understood. Here, we investigate the $\mathrm{In_{x}Ga_{1-x}As}$ channel noise from 4 K to 300 K for 100-nm gate-length InP HEMTs with channel indium content of 53\%, 60\% and 70\%. Channel noise was quantified by extracting the equivalent drain noise temperature $\mathit{T}_{d}$ using both on-wafer and LNA-based measurements, covering 40-300 K and 4-40 K, respectively. The 60\% indium channel InP HEMT exhibited the lowest channel noise across the full temperature range. The $\mathit{T}_{d}$ extracted from on-wafer characterization was found to obey a parabolic temperature dependence which predicted the $\mathit{T}_{d}$ at 4 K for all InP HEMTs in good agreement with LNA-based measurements. By expressing the channel noise as the sum of one thermal and one excess noise term, it was found that the former increased linearly with ambient temperature and dominated at 300 K. The channel noise at 4 K was determined by the excess noise term and exhibited a non-monotonic dependence on the channel indium content in the InP HEMT. The results suggest that the excess noise in the InP HEMT originates not only from temperature-independent shot noise but also from impact ionization and real-space transfer noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“on-wafer and LNA-based measurements”（基于晶圆和低噪声放大器的测量），并给出了温度范围（4 K至300 K）和具体实验参数（100-nm栅长、不同铟含量）。；研究对象：InP高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）中InₓGa₁₋ₓAs沟道的噪声特性，具体研究沟道铟含量（53%、60%、70%）对噪声的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 60%铟含量的InP HEMT在4 K至300 K全温区表现出最低的沟道噪声；沟道噪声可分解为热噪声和过剩噪声两项，其中热噪声在300 K占主导，而4 K下的噪声由过剩噪声决定，且过剩噪声对铟含量呈非单调依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：60%铟含量的InP HEMT在4 K至300 K全温区表现出最低的沟道噪声；沟道噪声可分解为热噪声和过剩噪声两项，其中热噪声在300 K占主导，而4 K下的噪声由过剩噪声决定，且过剩噪声对铟含量呈非单调依赖关系。；创新点：首次系统揭示了InP HEMT中InₓGa₁₋ₓAs沟道噪声从4 K到300 K的完整温度依赖关系，并发现过剩噪声不仅来源于温度无关的散粒噪声，还来源于碰撞电离和实空间转移噪声。
papers.method_zh: 通过两种测量手段提取等效漏极噪声温度T_d：1）基于晶圆（on-wafer）测量覆盖40-300 K；2）基于低噪声放大器（LNA）测量覆盖4-40 K。同时将沟道噪声分解为热噪声项和过剩噪声项进行定量分析。

papers.title: Observation of Non-linear hall effect in Polycrystalline magnetic multilayes
papers.abstract: The Nonlinear Hall effect(NLHE) driven principally by the Berry curvature dipole has been established in non-centrosymmetric vander Waals crystals, topological semimetals, and moiré superlattices, but its extension to technologically mature heavy-metal/ferromagnet multilayer platforms remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the observation of a robust NLHE in polycrystalline magnetic multilayers, persisting from 2 K to room temperature. The second-harmonic transverse voltage is independent of both excitation frequency and applied out-of-plane magnetic field, while the vanishingly small third-harmonic response confirms that the observed signal is not dominated by a quantum-metric contribution and instead reflects a genuine second-order electronic response. A scaling analysis of the second-order Hall conductivity against the longitudinal conductivity identifies a dominant, conductivity-independent term establishing the intrinsic berry curvature dipole. Our theoretical analysis, supported by first-principles DFT calculations, further satisfies and corroborates the experimental results. These results establish sputter-deposited polycrystalline thin film as the first engineered magnetic multilayer platform for BCD-driven nonlinear Hall transport, extending the NLHE material landscape beyond van der Waals systems into scalable, industry-compatible thin-film spintronic architectures suitable for high frequency rectifications and nonlinear sensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了“observation”（观测）、“second-harmonic transverse voltage”（二次谐波横向电压）等实验测量结果，并提及“first-principles DFT calculations”（第一性原理DFT计算）作为理论支持。；研究对象：多晶磁性多层膜（polycrystalline magnetic multilayers）中的非线性霍尔效应（NLHE）。具体为一种可扩展的重金属/铁磁体（heavy-metal/ferromagnet）多层膜平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多晶磁性多层膜中观测到了稳健的非线性霍尔效应，该效应从2K一直持续到室温。通过标度分析确认其主导机制是内禀的贝里曲率偶极子（Berry curvature dipole, BCD），而非量子度量（quantum-metric）贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多晶磁性多层膜中观测到了稳健的非线性霍尔效应，该效应从2K一直持续到室温。通过标度分析确认其主导机制是内禀的贝里曲率偶极子（Berry curvature dipole, BCD），而非量子度量（quantum-metric）贡献。；创新点：将非线性霍尔效应的研究从非中心对称的范德瓦尔斯晶体、拓扑半金属和莫尔超晶格，首次扩展到了技术成熟的、可规模化制备的多晶磁性多层膜平台。这为基于贝里曲率偶极子的非线性霍尔输运提供了一个与工业兼容的薄膜自旋电子学架构。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，测量了二次谐波横向电压，并检验了其对激发频率和外加垂直磁场的独立性；通过测量三次谐波响应排除了量子度量贡献的主导地位。理论上，对二阶霍尔电导率与纵向电导率进行了标度分析（scaling analysis），并结合第一性原理DFT计算（first-principles DFT calculations）进行验证。

papers.title: Tunable Nonlinear Landscapes in Graphene Nanoelectromechanical Systems
papers.abstract: Nonlinear nanomechanical resonators give convenient solid-state access to classical analogs of extreme nonlinear optics and to phononic signal processing. Here we report integer high-harmonic generation and phononic frequency combs in a suspended monolayer graphene drum. A gate voltage breaks the out-of-plane symmetry of the membrane and tunes its fundamental flexural mode onto a 1:2 internal resonance with a higher mode at twice the frequency, where the quadratic coupling between the two modes becomes large. A single drive tone then generates phase-locked integer harmonics in sequence, and at larger drive these fill in to a dense frequency comb. Raising the drive further, we find a reverse period-doubling transition: the comb spacing doubles, the line density halves, and energy flows back into the even-order comb lines. The measured spectra yield the quadratic ($ζ$) and cubic ($β$) nonlinear coefficients of the membrane. These results show how the tunable nonlinear landscape of graphene supports distinct dynamical regimes on demand, allowing a single gated device to act in turn as a frequency multiplier, a broadband comb source, and a chaotic generator.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Here we report”、“measured spectra”、“gate voltage”等表明该工作基于实验测量。；研究对象：悬浮单层石墨烯鼓（suspended monolayer graphene drum）中的非线性纳米机电系统，具体研究其高次谐波产生、声子频率梳以及可调非线性动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过栅极电压打破石墨烯膜的面外对称性，可将其基频弯曲模式调谐至与高频模式形成1:2内共振，从而产生整数高次谐波和声子频率梳；进一步增大驱动可观察到反向周期倍增转变，梳齿间距加倍、线密度减半。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过栅极电压打破石墨烯膜的面外对称性，可将其基频弯曲模式调谐至与高频模式形成1:2内共振，从而产生整数高次谐波和声子频率梳；进一步增大驱动可观察到反向周期倍增转变，梳齿间距加倍、线密度减半。；创新点：展示了石墨烯中可调非线性景观（tunable nonlinear landscape）能够按需支持不同的动力学状态（频率倍增器、宽带梳源、混沌发生器），且单个栅控器件即可实现多种功能切换。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用悬浮单层石墨烯鼓作为纳米机械谐振器，通过施加栅极电压（gate voltage）调控膜的面外对称性，利用单频驱动（single drive tone）激发非线性动力学，测量高次谐波和频率梳光谱，并从中提取二次（ζ）和三次（β）非线性系数。

papers.title: Supercritical fluid of quantum electrons in three-dimensional superconducting fullerides
papers.abstract: The supercritical fluid (SCF) of quantum electrons at the Mott metal-insulator transition without symmetry breaking is one of the most elusive phenomena in strongly correlated electron physics. Prior studies of Cr-doped V2O3 and organic Mott systems reported discrepant critical exponents. A key limitation is that the scaling analysis relies on a single experimental observable, leaving the roles of phase coexistence, inhomogeneity, and percolation unaddressed. Here we report the first experimental identification of a thermodynamically equilibrated SCF phase and its associated Mott endpoint in the three-dimensional superconducting fullerides CsxRb3-xC60, using two independent probes of electrical conductivity and magnetic susceptibility, which reveal two distinct metal-insulator transition lines converging at a single Mott endpoint. A hypothesis-free two-particle analysis of magnetic susceptibilities yields a metal-insulator coexisting SCF by exhibiting the maximum two-phase mixing entropy, in agreement with a picture of a thermodynamically equilibrated Widom line. Simultaneously, conductivity scaling yields a critical exponent in the regime of quantum critical predictions. Our new dual-probe approach provides a unified microscopic picture of the Mott SCF with a characteristic length scale below current diffraction resolution, in addition to a new interpretation on the origin of superconducting Tc-dome.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental identification”、“using two independent probes”、“conductivity scaling”等实验关键词。；研究对象：三维超导富勒烯化合物 CsxRb3-xC60 中的量子电子超临界流体（SCF）相，以及与之相关的Mott金属-绝缘体相变和Mott端点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在三维超导富勒烯中实验鉴定出热力学平衡的超临界流体相及其对应的Mott端点，并通过电导率和磁化率两种独立探针揭示了两条不同的金属-绝缘体转变线汇聚于同一个Mott端点，同时电导率标度给出的临界指数符合量子临界预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在三维超导富勒烯中实验鉴定出热力学平衡的超临界流体相及其对应的Mott端点，并通过电导率和磁化率两种独立探针揭示了两条不同的金属-绝缘体转变线汇聚于同一个Mott端点，同时电导率标度给出的临界指数符合量子临界预言。；创新点：首次使用双探针（电导率+磁化率）方法同时表征Mott超临界流体，克服了以往单一观测量无法区分相共存、不均匀性和逾渗效应的局限，并提供了关于超导Tc穹顶起源的新解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用电导率（electrical conductivity）和磁化率（magnetic susceptibility）两种独立实验探针进行测量；对磁化率数据进行了无假设的双粒子分析（hypothesis-free two-particle analysis），以提取两相混合熵；对电导率数据进行了标度分析（conductivity scaling）以提取临界指数。

papers.title: Quantum Geometric Friedel Oscillations
papers.abstract: In conventional Friedel oscillations, the real-space charge density oscillations induced by an impurity are characterized by an oscillation period set by the Fermi momentum. In this work, we show that the conventional theory is incomplete when the Bloch wavefunctions carry nontrivial quantum geometry. We demonstrate that in metals with an isolated (nearly) flat band at the Fermi energy, quantum geometry induces a distinct type of oscillations, which we call the \emph{quantum geometric Friedel oscillations} (QGFOs). The period of the QGFOs is set by the momentum space separation of the quantum metric hot spots of the flat band. The conventional and quantum metric-induced oscillations coexist at low temperatures. At higher temperatures, the conventional Friedel oscillations away from the impurity site are set by the thermal length such that the oscillations can be easily washed out by temperature effects. Remarkably, the QGFOs decay length is set by the quantum metric length which is defined by the integration of the quantum metric of the flat band. As a result, the QGFOs can persist even at temperatures much larger than the bandwidth of the flat band. Moreover, the decay length is independent of temperature for a wide range of temperatures which is a manifestation of the quantum metric protection. In conclusion, we show that the quantum metric induces novel Friedel oscillations. Our work suggests that the measurement of the QGFOs is a powerful way to detect the quantum metric length (which is associated with the integral of the quantum metric) and the quantum metric hot spot separations (which are associated with the distribution of the quantum metric in the momentum space).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show”“we demonstrate”“our work suggests”等理论推导与预言表述，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：金属中由杂质诱导的电荷密度振荡现象，特别是当布洛赫波函数具有非平凡量子几何时，在费米能级处存在孤立（近）平带的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有平带的金属中，量子度量会诱导一种新型的弗里德尔振荡——量子几何弗里德尔振荡（QGFOs），其振荡周期由平带量子度量热点在动量空间中的分离决定，且衰减长度由量子度量长度控制，可在远高于平带宽度的温度下持续存在，表现出温度无关性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有平带的金属中，量子度量会诱导一种新型的弗里德尔振荡——量子几何弗里德尔振荡（QGFOs），其振荡周期由平带量子度量热点在动量空间中的分离决定，且衰减长度由量子度量长度控制，可在远高于平带宽度的温度下持续存在，表现出温度无关性。；创新点：首次揭示量子度量可独立于费米动量诱导新型弗里德尔振荡，并指出QGFOs的衰减长度受量子度量保护，在宽温区内不随温度变化，为实验探测量子度量长度和量子度量动量空间分布提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于量子度量（quantum metric）的概念，结合平带系统的量子几何性质，推导出杂质诱导电荷密度振荡的新形式及其周期、衰减长度与温度依赖关系。

papers.title: Topological Electronic States and Phonon Mediated Superconductivity in Ru Based Ternary Pnictides: ZrRuAs and HfRuP
papers.abstract: This study investigates the structural, electronic, mechanical, optical, thermodynamic, and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP. Electronic band structure calculations reveal topological semimetallic behavior in both compounds with several bands crossing the Fermi level. The inclusion of spin orbit coupling lifts band degeneracies in both compounds. The Fermi surface shows both electron and hole segments. The estimated Pugh ratio, Poisson ratio and machinability index indicate that both compounds are ductile in nature and exhibit excellent machinability. Optical results show metallic reflectivity and notable absorption in the ultraviolet region. Thermodynamic analysis indicates stable behavior. The estimated superconducting transition temperatures are 9.75 K for ZrRuAs and 9.03 K for HfRuP that indicates strong coupling conventional superconductivity. The results provide a detailed view of the physical and superconducting properties of ZrRuAs and HfRuP and help to close the existing research gaps in these topological superconducting materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Electronic band structure calculations”（电子能带结构计算）、“estimated”（估算）等关键词，未提及任何实验合成或测量手段。；研究对象：两种钌基三元磷族化合物：ZrRuAs 和 HfRuP。具体研究了它们的结构、电子、力学、光学、热力学和超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ZrRuAs 和 HfRuP 均表现为拓扑半金属行为，且是声子介导的强耦合常规超导体，超导转变温度分别约为 9.75 K 和 9.03 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ZrRuAs 和 HfRuP 均表现为拓扑半金属行为，且是声子介导的强耦合常规超导体，超导转变温度分别约为 9.75 K 和 9.03 K。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要最后一句，该工作填补了这两种拓扑超导材料在物理性质研究方面的空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，并考虑了自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的影响。具体计算了电子能带结构、费米面、力学常数、光学响应、热力学性质以及超导转变温度。

papers.title: Statistics of rupture in phantom chain network simulations
papers.abstract: Phantom chain simulations have shown that the mean rupture properties of star polymer networks collapse onto master curves against the cycle rank density $ξ$. This study revisits this universality with a much larger ensemble than in earlier studies to discuss the statistics. Phantom Gaussian networks were made by end-linking star prepolymers, and 1,000 realizations were collected for each of 30 conditions with functionality $f=3$--$8$ and conversion $p=0.60$--$0.95$, giving 30,000 networks in total. For each realization, the breaking stretch $λ_b$, the breaking stress $σ_b$, the breaking energy $W_b$, and the cycle rank $ξ$ were recorded. The master curves are unchanged by the larger sample, demonstrating that the earlier conclusions reported for the averages of smaller ensembles hold. However, the individual realizations are inherently random, and their statistical properties, rather than the individual values, are examined. At fixed $f,p$, the fluctuation of $ξ$ is small, varying by less than 0.01, whereas $λ_b$, $σ_b$, and $W_b$ scatter by 0.05--0.3. The fluctuation of $ξ$ is almost uncorrelated with that of the breaking properties. In addition, the scatter has a definite structure; its magnitude decreases with the mean cycle rank density $ξ$, the $λ_b$--$σ_b$ correlation grows with $ξ$, and the distributions deviate from Gaussian. The $λ_b$ distribution is skewed to the right at small $ξ$, whereas $σ_b$ is skewed to the left at large $ξ$. These rupture statistics were discussed in the framework of extreme-value statistics to demonstrate that the observed trends are opposite to those of the random fuse model, in which strength decreases with size and weakest-link statistics appear for weak disorder. The difference may reflect the source of fluctuation, i.e., the cross-linking in the present networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：phantom chain simulations、realizations、statistics）；研究对象：星形聚合物网络的断裂统计性质，具体为phantom高斯网络在端连接星形预聚物后的断裂行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均断裂性质对循环秩密度ξ的普适标度曲线在大样本下依然成立，但单个网络的断裂性质（λ_b、σ_b、W_b）存在显著随机涨落，且涨落结构随ξ变化，与随机熔丝模型的极端值统计行为相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均断裂性质对循环秩密度ξ的普适标度曲线在大样本下依然成立，但单个网络的断裂性质（λ_b、σ_b、W_b）存在显著随机涨落，且涨落结构随ξ变化，与随机熔丝模型的极端值统计行为相反。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用phantom链网络模拟，通过端连接星形预聚物构建phantom高斯网络，对功能度f=3–8、转化率p=0.60–0.95的30种条件各生成1000个网络实现（共30000个网络），记录每个网络的断裂拉伸比λ_b、断裂应力σ_b、断裂能量W_b和循环秩ξ，并分析其统计分布与相关性。

papers.title: Superconductivity on the verge of metal-insulator transition in Cu$_{1-x}$Zn$_x$Ir$_2$S$_4$ probed by $μ$SR
papers.abstract: The thiospinel CuIr$_2$S$_4$ undergoes a metal-insulator transition below $\approx$230 K, which is suppressed by substitution of Cu with Zn (Cu$_{1-x}$Zn$_x$Ir$_2$S$_4$) to induce superconductivity for $0.2\lesssim x\lesssim0.8$. We show that the temperature/field dependence of superfluid density in samples with $x = 0.3$ and 0.4 ($T_{\rm c} \approx 3$ K and 2.5 K) investigated by muon spin rotation and relaxation ($μ$SR) is consistent with a fully gapped $s$-wave pairing. Meanwhile, the relatively high resistivity (10$^{-3}$-10$^{-2}$ $Ω\:$cm) in their normal state suggests that the superconductivity is in the "dirty limit" where the mean free path is much shorter than the coherence length ($\ell \ll ξ_0$). This indicates that the potential anisotropy associated with unconventional pairing mechanisms expected under the strong electron correlations is smeared out by the electron scattering. Based on these observations, we discuss potential link between the Zn substitution-induced superconductivity and that recently discovered in CuIr$_2$S$_4$ under high pressure ($>18$ GPa) where the existence of strong electron scattering is also suggested.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：μSR（muon spin rotation and relaxation，μ子自旋旋转与弛豫）、电阻率测量。；研究对象：Cu₁₋ₓZnₓIr₂S₄（硫尖晶石体系），具体研究Zn替代Cu诱导的超导电性，以及其与金属-绝缘体转变临界点的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在x=0.3和0.4的样品中，超流密度的温度/磁场依赖关系与完全能隙的s波配对一致；正常态电阻率较高（10⁻³–10⁻² Ω·cm），表明超导处于“脏极限”（平均自由程远小于相干长度），强电子关联下可能存在的非常规配对各向异性被电子散射抹平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在x=0.3和0.4的样品中，超流密度的温度/磁场依赖关系与完全能隙的s波配对一致；正常态电阻率较高（10⁻³–10⁻² Ω·cm），表明超导处于“脏极限”（平均自由程远小于相干长度），强电子关联下可能存在的非常规配对各向异性被电子散射抹平。；创新点：通过μSR实验直接探测了Zn替代诱导超导的配对对称性，并指出该超导与高压下（>18 GPa）CuIr₂S₄中发现的超导之间可能存在联系，两者均处于强电子散射环境。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: μ子自旋旋转与弛豫（μSR）技术，结合电阻率测量。

papers.title: VASP Plugins: Linking the Vienna ab-initio Simulation Package with Python
papers.abstract: Implementing novel features and experimental algorithms into widely adopted density functional theory (DFT) codes is frequently hindered by complex legacy architectures and the use of compiled languages such as Fortran. These production codes, while optimised for high-performance computing clusters, present significant hurdles for software development and rapid prototyping, often requiring deep expertise in the code's internal structure to modify. To address this challenge, we present a Python plugin infrastructure for the Vienna ab-initio Simulation Package (VASP) that combines computational efficiency with the flexibility of high-level scripting. Our architecture uses a C++ intermediate layer and pybind11 to expose VASP data as NumPy arrays via shared memory buffers, ensuring high performance without data duplication. We implement two categories of plugins: those that modify quantities at the end of each converged self-consistent field (SCF) cycle, such as structure and force_and_stress, and those that operate during the SCF cycle, such as local_potential and occupancies. We demonstrate the utility of our implementation through three applications, structure relaxation using the scipy library, implementing an implicit solvent model, and adding the DFT-D4 dispersion corrections. This infrastructure effectively bridges the gap between high-performance electronic structure routines and the widespread scientific Python ecosystem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)，Vienna ab-initio Simulation Package (VASP)，Python plugin infrastructure。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是VASP（维也纳第一性原理模拟包）这一DFT计算软件本身，具体是开发一种将其与Python语言连接的插件基础设施。并非研究特定的物理材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一套Python插件基础设施，通过C++中间层和pybind11，将VASP内部数据以NumPy数组形式暴露给Python，在不牺牲性能的前提下，实现了对VASP计算流程（如SCF循环）的灵活修改和扩展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一套Python插件基础设施，通过C++中间层和pybind11，将VASP内部数据以NumPy数组形式暴露给Python，在不牺牲性能的前提下，实现了对VASP计算流程（如SCF循环）的灵活修改和扩展。；创新点：该工作首次为VASP这一广泛使用但架构复杂的Fortran代码提供了高效、易用的Python插件接口，弥合了高性能电子结构计算与Python科学计算生态之间的鸿沟，使得快速原型开发和实现新算法（如使用scipy进行结构弛豫、实现隐式溶剂模型、添加DFT-D4色散修正）成为可能。
papers.method_zh: 采用软件工程方法，构建了一个由C++中间层和pybind11库组成的插件架构。该架构通过共享内存缓冲区实现VASP与Python之间的数据交换，并定义了两种插件类型：在自洽场（SCF）循环结束后修改量的插件（如结构、力与应力），以及在SCF循环过程中操作的插件（如局域势、占据数）。

papers.title: Orbital-Selective Mott and Antiferromagnetic Phases in Diagonally Compressed Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: We perform determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the half-filled Hubbard model on a diagonally compressed kagome lattice, introducing exponential decay long-range hopping $t(r) = t_0 \exp\bigl(-r / r_0\bigr)$ to account for the evolving bond length. By varying the lattice angle $θ$ and the on-site interaction $U$, double occupancy, charge compressibility, and spin-spin correlation functions of the whole system and each sub-lattice are measured. We find that geometric compression induces a clear sublattice differentiation: for $θ\gtrsim52^\circ$, the A sublattice establishes long-range hoppings, which in turn suppresses the metallic behavior of the $B/C$ sublattice and drives a selective Mott transition; for $θ\lesssim52^\circ$, the $B$-$C$ chains develop long-range antiferromagnetic correlations within the finite-size simulations, which in turn suppresses the metallic behavior of the $A$ sublattice and drives a selective Mott transition. The critical interaction $U^c_A$ for the $A$ sites decreases sharply near the onset of $B$-$C$ antiferromagnetic correlations, while $U^c_{B/C}$ increases. These competing orders give rise to an orbital-selective Mott phase and a rich $U$-$θ$ phase diagram featuring paramagnetic-metal, paramagnetic-Mott, antiferromagnetic-metal, and antiferromagnetic-Mott states. Our results highlight the complex interplay between lattice geometry, magnetic frustration, and strong correlations in frustrated two-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations（行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：对角压缩的kagome晶格上的半填充Hubbard模型，以及由几何压缩诱导的轨道选择性Mott相和反铁磁相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 几何压缩导致子晶格分化，通过调节晶格角度θ和相互作用U，系统出现轨道选择性Mott相变，并形成包含顺磁金属、顺磁Mott、反铁磁金属和反铁磁Mott态的丰富U-θ相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：几何压缩导致子晶格分化，通过调节晶格角度θ和相互作用U，系统出现轨道选择性Mott相变，并形成包含顺磁金属、顺磁Mott、反铁磁金属和反铁磁Mott态的丰富U-θ相图。；创新点：揭示了在压缩kagome晶格中，几何压缩通过子晶格间长程跳跃和反铁磁关联的竞争，驱动轨道选择性Mott相变，并首次系统绘制了该体系在U-θ参数空间中的完整相图。
papers.method_zh: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟，引入指数衰减的长程跳跃t(r)=t0 exp(-r/r0)以考虑键长变化，测量了整体及各子晶格的双占据、电荷压缩率和自旋-自旋关联函数。

papers.title: Synchro-nematic and -antinematic ordering of spheroidal circle swimmers
papers.abstract: Chirality gives a microswimmer something a straight-line swimmer lacks: a phase. This variable both modulates, and is affected by, the hydrodynamic interactions between microswimmers. Here we ask what collective order emerges when many such chiral swimmers are free to move, and how the shape and actuation anisotropies of an individual swimmer dictate the outcome. Using a kinetic theory for hydrodynamically interacting circle swimmers, we show that the interplay between intrinsic rotation, stresslet flows, and Jeffery-like reorientation generates effective phase-locking interactions. Asymmetries in the actuation are encoded through a non-axisymmetric stresslet tensor. At the pair level, pusher swimmers select one of two synchronized states depending on particle shape and actuation asymmetry: in-phase/anti-phase locking, or quarter-shifted locking. Extending the analysis to many-body systems, we find that these pair-level synchronization mechanisms drive emergent collective phases. The swimmers develop global \textit{synchro-nematic} order when the hydrodynamic coupling favors parallel or anti-parallel phase locking, and \textit{synchro-antinematic} local order where quarter-shifted locking prevails. A coarse-grained field theory predicts the onset of nematic order through a hydrodynamic instability criterion. In addition, we find that the collective states exhibit crystalline or disordered hyperuniform structure arising from period-averaged hydrodynamic interactions that are effectively repulsive between swimmers. Lattice Boltzmann simulations of chiral oblate squirmers, resolving finite-size and near-field flows, recover the synchro-nematic ordering. Together, these results show how a swimmer's geometric and actuation anisotropies can be leveraged to program synchronization and spatiotemporal order in chiral active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：kinetic theory（动力学理论）、coarse-grained field theory（粗粒化场论）、Lattice Boltzmann simulations（格子玻尔兹曼模拟）。；研究对象：手性微游泳体（chiral microswimmers）的集体有序行为，具体为椭球状圆游泳者（spheroidal circle swimmers）在流体动力学相互作用下的同步-向列相（synchro-nematic）和同步-反向列相（synchro-antinematic）有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性微游泳者之间的流体动力学耦合可产生有效的相位锁定相互作用，导致两种全局有序态：当耦合倾向于平行或反平行相位锁定时形成全局“同步-向列”序；当耦合倾向于四分之一相位偏移锁定时形成局域“同步-反向列”序。此外，周期平均后的有效排斥相互作用可导致晶体或无序超均匀结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性微游泳者之间的流体动力学耦合可产生有效的相位锁定相互作用，导致两种全局有序态：当耦合倾向于平行或反平行相位锁定时形成全局“同步-向列”序；当耦合倾向于四分之一相位偏移锁定时形成局域“同步-反向列”序。此外，周期平均后的有效排斥相互作用可导致晶体或无序超均匀结构。；创新点：揭示了游泳者几何形状和驱动各向异性如何通过相位锁定机制编程手性活性物质中的同步与时空有序，特别是发现了“同步-反向列”这一新型局域有序态，并建立了从单粒子各向异性到集体相行为的理论联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学理论（kinetic theory）描述流体动力学相互作用的圆游泳者；通过非轴对称应力张量（non-axisymmetric stresslet tensor）编码驱动不对称性；使用粗粒化场论（coarse-grained field theory）预测向列序的流体动力学不稳定性判据；并采用格子玻尔兹曼模拟（Lattice Boltzmann simulations）对手性扁球体游动者（chiral oblate squirmers）进行验证，考虑了有限尺寸和近场流动效应。

papers.title: Data-Driven Prediction of NaCl-Type Entropy-Stabilized Oxide Compositions from First-Principles and Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Entropy-stabilized oxides (ESOs) open access to vast multicomponent compositional spaces, but identifying promising candidates remains challenging because of the large number of possible mixtures and the need to assess their stability against competing phases. In this work, we develop a high-throughput computational framework to screen equimolar quinary ESOs in the NaCl structure type by combining density functional theory (DFT), special quasirandom structures (SQS), convex-hull thermodynamics, and supervised machine learning. A consistent reference database of binary and ternary ordered oxides, including disordered phases such as all binary cation combinations in the NaCl-type oxide, is first constructed using GGA and meta-GGA calculations. Quinary disordered phases are then described by SQS supercells and used to train machine-learning models that predict the distance to the convex hull and the corresponding stabilization temperature over the full set of 4368 possible equimolar quinary compositions generated from 16 cation species. Among the tested models, an optimized multilayer perceptron provides the best predictive performance, with a test error of about 4 kJ/mol, while requiring explicit DFT calculations for only about 10% of the quinary systems. Comparison with experimental synthesis tests and computed decomposition paths further shows that the approach captures the main stability trends and the dominant competing phases, although absolute stabilization temperatures remain affected by systematic thermodynamic approximations. These results establish an efficient route for the data-driven exploration of multicomponent oxides and provide practical guidance for the experimental search for new ESOs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles, density functional theory, supervised machine learning, high-throughput computational framework）；研究对象：NaCl结构类型的等摩尔五元熵稳定氧化物（ESOs）成分
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合第一性原理计算与监督机器学习，仅需对约10%的五元体系进行显式DFT计算，即可高精度预测全部4368种等摩尔五元成分的凸包距离和稳定化温度，最优多层感知机模型的测试误差约为4 kJ/mol。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合第一性原理计算与监督机器学习，仅需对约10%的五元体系进行显式DFT计算，即可高精度预测全部4368种等摩尔五元成分的凸包距离和稳定化温度，最优多层感知机模型的测试误差约为4 kJ/mol。；创新点：构建了包含二元和三元有序氧化物（含NaCl型氧化物中所有二元阳离子组合的无序相）的一致参考数据库，并利用SQS超胞描述五元无序相，实现了对海量多组分氧化物成分空间的高通量筛选。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（GGA和meta-GGA计算）、特殊准随机结构（SQS）、凸包热力学分析、监督机器学习（多层感知机等模型）

papers.title: Pseudo-superconducting-diode effect in ferroelectric Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE), characterized by unequal critical supercurrents in opposite current directions, enables supercurrent rectification. We propose a magnetic-field-free pseudo-superconducting-diode effect in ferroelectric Josephson junctions with broken inversion symmetry. Using a coupled dynamical model that combines a polarization-dependent RCSJ description with Landau-Khalatnikov-Tani ferroelectric dynamics, we show that ferroelectric polarization switching induces asymmetric critical and retrapping currents under current sweeps. The resulting nonreciprocity is highly tunable via ferroelectric parameters and the sweep protocol and remains robust at finite temperatures. Our work identifies ferroelectric Josephson junctions as a promising platform for magnetic-field-free nonreciprocal superconducting devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、using a coupled dynamical model、show that。；研究对象：铁电约瑟夫森结（ferroelectric Josephson junctions）中的伪超导二极管效应（pseudo-superconducting-diode effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无外加磁场条件下，通过铁电约瑟夫森结中极化翻转诱导的非互易临界电流与回滞电流，实现了伪超导二极管效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无外加磁场条件下，通过铁电约瑟夫森结中极化翻转诱导的非互易临界电流与回滞电流，实现了伪超导二极管效应。；创新点：提出了一种无需磁场的伪超导二极管效应机制，利用铁电约瑟夫森结中极化翻转与超导电流的耦合实现非互易整流，且该效应可通过铁电参数和扫描协议高度调控。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合动力学模型，将依赖于极化的RCSJ（电阻-电容-并联-约瑟夫森结）描述与Landau-Khalatnikov-Tani铁电动力学方程相结合进行理论分析。

papers.title: Quasi-two-dimensional Majorana zero modes from finite-size-coupled chiral hinge states
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) in topological superconductors have attracted broad research interest for their potential applications in topological quantum computation. In this work, we propose a quasi-two-dimensional route to realize spatially separated MZMs in a chiral higher-order topological insulator (HOTI) proximitized by a conventional $s$-wave superconductor through a theoretical model study. In three dimensions, the chiral HOTI hosts gapless hinge states along the $z$ direction, arising from a mass term that anisotropically gaps the surface Dirac cones of a topological insulator. By confining the sample along the $x$ direction while keeping it extended along $y$ and finite along $z$, opposite $z$-directed chiral hinge states hybridize and effectively form one-dimensional helical channels. Incorporating the superconducting proximity effect into this quasi-two-dimensional system induces effective $p$-wave pairing in these helical channels, thereby opening a topological gap. A fully open-boundary sample then hosts four localized MZMs, one at each endpoint of the helical channels, realizing a second-order topological superconductor characterized by Majorana corner modes. In addition to MZMs, we also find that superconducting pairing in this model produces extended Majorana hinge modes in three dimensions. Furthermore, representative disorder calculations indicate that these Majorana corner modes are robust against weak-to-moderate disorder, provided the excitation gap remains open. These results establish finite-size-coupled chiral hinge states as a promising platform for engineering multiple MZMs via conventional superconducting proximity effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、theoretical model study、indicate。；研究对象：准二维手性高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI）与常规s波超导体通过邻近效应耦合形成的体系，具体研究其中由有限尺寸耦合的手性铰链态诱导的马约拉纳零模（MZMs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将三维手性高阶拓扑绝缘体沿x方向限制、沿y方向延展、沿z方向有限，使相反方向的手性铰链态杂化形成一维螺旋通道；再引入超导邻近效应，可在该准二维体系中实现有效p波配对，从而在完全开放边界样品中产生四个局域化的马约拉纳零模（即二阶拓扑超导体的角态）。此外，该模型在三维中还可产生扩展的马约拉纳铰链模，且这些角态在弱至中等无序下保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将三维手性高阶拓扑绝缘体沿x方向限制、沿y方向延展、沿z方向有限，使相反方向的手性铰链态杂化形成一维螺旋通道；再引入超导邻近效应，可在该准二维体系中实现有效p波配对，从而在完全开放边界样品中产生四个局域化的马约拉纳零模（即二阶拓扑超导体的角态）。此外，该模型在三维中还可产生扩展的马约拉纳铰链模，且这些角态在弱至中等无序下保持鲁棒性。；创新点：提出了一种通过有限尺寸耦合手性铰链态来实现准二维马约拉纳零模的新途径，利用常规超导邻近效应即可在准二维体系中获得多个空间分离的马约拉纳零模（角态），避免了传统方案中需要非常规超导配对或精细调控的要求。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型研究：基于手性高阶拓扑绝缘体的有效质量模型，通过有限尺寸约束（x方向限制）使手性铰链态耦合形成一维螺旋通道，再引入常规s波超导邻近效应，分析其拓扑超导相及马约拉纳零模的局域化特征。同时进行了代表性无序计算以检验鲁棒性。

papers.title: Mass weighting algorithm optimizes Fourier-based physics-informed neural network in adhesive contact mechanics
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for elastic contact mechanics suffer from a spectral stiffness imbalance,that is, the elastic kernel grows linearly with wave number, causing short-wavelength modes to dominate gradient updates and stall convergence of the macroscopic deformation. We introduce a spectral preconditioning strategy that reweights displacement gradients in Fourier space before back-propagation, amplifying low wavenumber components through a mass weighting (MW) function while suppressing sub-grid noise via a built-in low-pass filter. Applied to adhesive line contact problems, the mass weighted PINN reaches machine-zero residual loss within 400 Adam iterations for specified benchmark, whereas the reference benchmark stalls at three orders of magnitude higher loss. The converged displacement and contact stress fields agree quantitatively with Green's function molecular dynamics (GFMD) solutions for both smooth Hertz contact at pressures spanning tension to compression and rough surfaces with roughness covering several decades of wavelength. The method operates directly on a uniform real-space grid, requires no explicit Green's function integration or quadrature rules, and is formulated entirely in terms of minimising a scalar energy function. Extension to two-dimensional rough surfaces is direct, as both the Fourier elastic energy and the spectral preconditioner depend only on the wave-number magnitude.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)、spectral preconditioning、Fourier space、Green's function molecular dynamics (GFMD)。；研究对象：粘弹性接触力学中的粘附线接触问题，包括光滑赫兹接触（压力范围从拉伸到压缩）和粗糙表面（粗糙度覆盖多个波长量级）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入基于质量加权的傅里叶谱预处理策略，物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在粘附接触力学问题中实现了快速收敛（400次Adam迭代内达到机器精度残差），而传统方法残差高出三个数量级且无法收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入基于质量加权的傅里叶谱预处理策略，物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在粘附接触力学问题中实现了快速收敛（400次Adam迭代内达到机器精度残差），而传统方法残差高出三个数量级且无法收敛。；创新点：首次将谱预处理策略引入基于傅里叶的物理信息神经网络，解决了弹性接触力学中因弹性核随波数线性增长导致的谱刚度不平衡问题，使短波长模式不再主导梯度更新，从而恢复宏观变形的收敛。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种质量加权（mass weighting, MW）算法，在反向传播前对傅里叶空间中的位移梯度进行重新加权，通过质量加权函数放大低波数分量，并利用内置低通滤波器抑制亚网格噪声。该方法直接在均匀实空间网格上操作，无需显式格林函数积分或求积规则，完全基于标量能量函数的最小化。

papers.title: First-principles Floquet analysis from real-time propagation
papers.abstract: We present a real-time Floquet analysis method for extracting quasi-energies and Floquet states directly from propagated wavefunctions. By reconstructing the one-period evolution operator from overlaps between time-evolved states, the method avoids the explicit construction of the enlarged Floquet Hamiltonian and adds negligible computational overhead to time-dependent simulations. To resolve the ambiguity inherent in the reduced-zone representation, we introduce an unfolding procedure based on the harmonic decomposition of Floquet states, which recovers their underlying equilibrium band character beyond the reduced Floquet Brillouin zone. The reconstructed wavefunctions further provide access to the symmetry properties of individual light-induced sidebands. We demonstrate the applicability and generality of the method in first-principles time-dependent simulations of real materials, ranging from two-dimensional monolayers to a three-dimensional bulk semiconductor, and including finite pulses without strict time periodicity. This framework directly connects real-time simulations with Floquet observables, enabling practical analysis of light-driven electronic structure in materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles、real-time propagation、time-dependent simulations）；研究对象：光驱动材料中的电子结构，具体包括二维单层材料、三维体相半导体，以及有限脉冲（非严格时间周期性）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种直接从实时传播波函数提取准能量和Floquet态的方法，并通过谐波分解恢复Floquet态的平衡能带特征，从而解决约化区表示中的模糊性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种直接从实时传播波函数提取准能量和Floquet态的方法，并通过谐波分解恢复Floquet态的平衡能带特征，从而解决约化区表示中的模糊性。；创新点：该方法避免了传统Floquet分析中构造扩展哈密顿量的计算开销，并能处理有限脉冲等非严格周期体系，直接连接实时模拟与Floquet可观测量。
papers.method_zh: 实时Floquet分析方法：通过时间演化态之间的重叠重构单周期演化算符，避免显式构造扩展Floquet哈密顿量；引入基于Floquet态谐波分解的展开程序；在第一性原理含时模拟中实现，适用于真实材料。

papers.title: Phase-Factor-Controlled Interaction and Bonding between a Chiral Bobber and a Skyrmion String in the Conical Phase
papers.abstract: Skyrmion interactions govern the formation of skyrmion lattices, clusters, and particle-like growth patterns. In contrast, the interaction between a chiral bobber and a skyrmion string remains largely unexplored, despite the role of bobbers as intermediate states in skyrmion-string formation and annihilation. Here we show that this interaction is intrinsically phase dependent in the conical phase. Using three-dimensional micromagnetic simulations, we compute the locally relaxed constrained energy landscape as a function of the bobber--skyrmion separation $R$ and the surface phase factor $φ_0$. We find that changing $φ_0$ qualitatively reshapes the interaction, producing repulsive, attractive, and bonding-like regimes that cannot be reduced to a conventional distance-dependent potential. Real-space analysis shows that this behavior originates from phase-dependent reconstruction of nonaxisymmetric outer distortion shells. The phase-controlled interaction persists over a finite field range and follows the expected top--bottom phase relation of surface-sensitive conical textures. These results identify the conical phase direction, often hidden in projected or thickness-averaged descriptions, as a previously underappreciated degree of freedom in the interaction between skyrmion strings and finite-length chiral textures, as demonstrated here for chiral bobbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用三维微磁学模拟（three-dimensional micromagnetic simulations）进行计算，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：手性磁体中锥形态（conical phase）下，手性bobber与斯格明子弦（skyrmion string）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性bobber与斯格明子弦之间的相互作用本质上依赖于表面相位因子φ₀，改变φ₀可产生排斥、吸引甚至类成键（bonding-like）的相互作用模式，无法简化为常规的距离依赖势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性bobber与斯格明子弦之间的相互作用本质上依赖于表面相位因子φ₀，改变φ₀可产生排斥、吸引甚至类成键（bonding-like）的相互作用模式，无法简化为常规的距离依赖势。；创新点：揭示了锥形态中表面相位因子作为此前被忽视的自由度，能够定性调控手性bobber与斯格明子弦之间的相互作用，并指出该效应源于非轴对称外部畸变壳层的相位依赖重构。摘要未突出说明与实验对比或具体材料参数。
papers.method_zh: 三维微磁学模拟（3D micromagnetic simulations），通过计算局域松弛约束能量景观（locally relaxed constrained energy landscape）作为bobber-斯格明子弦间距R和表面相位因子φ₀的函数。

papers.title: Universal fluctuations of first discoveries in competitive exploration
papers.abstract: Random exploration is usually quantified by how fast new space is found, from the range of a single walker to the territory collectively covered by many walkers. In competitive exploration, first arrival secures an exclusive resource, as when foragers compete for food items or agents capture distributed targets. It is then no longer enough to know which sites have been discovered: one must determine, for each discovered site, which searcher reached it first. We introduce the discovery share $X_n$, the fraction of the first $n$ collective discoveries secured by a tagged searcher. For two identical competitors, exchange symmetry fixes $\langle X_n\rangle=1/2$, but the central question is whether this equal split emerges in each long exploration history or only on average, i.e. whether early competitive advantages are erased or persist. Here we show that the answer is controlled by the spectral dimension $d_s$, defined by the large-time decay of the probability that a single searcher is at its starting point after $t$ steps, $p_0(t)\sim t^{-d_s/2}$. Across ordinary diffusion, long-range superdiffusion and subdiffusion induced by crowding or memory, $d_s$ separates persistent randomness in recurrent exploration $(d_s<2)$, anomalously slow non-Gaussian concentration for $2\le d_s<3$, and Gaussian concentration, logarithmically corrected at $d_s=3$, for $d_s\ge3$. For $d_s\ge2$, we derive exact asymptotic variances, including prefactors, and the discovery scale on which competitive imbalances are erased. Two-point correlations of first-discovery labels identify the memory mechanism behind these regimes. The same phase structure persists under changes in geometry, competitor heterogeneity, number of competitors and memory, revealing a general fluctuation theory of first-arrival inequalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、show、derive、fluctuation theory。；研究对象：竞争性探索过程中首次发现的普遍涨落现象，具体为两个或多个搜索者在同一空间中竞争发现新位置时，各自“首次发现份额”的统计行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 竞争性探索中，两个相同搜索者的首次发现份额在单次长探索历史中是否趋于相等，取决于系统的谱维数 \(d_s\)：当 \(d_s<2\) 时，竞争不平衡持续存在；当 \(d_s\ge2\) 时，不平衡会在特定发现尺度上被抹平，且涨落行为呈现从非高斯到高斯的不同相结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：竞争性探索中，两个相同搜索者的首次发现份额在单次长探索历史中是否趋于相等，取决于系统的谱维数 \(d_s\)：当 \(d_s<2\) 时，竞争不平衡持续存在；当 \(d_s\ge2\) 时，不平衡会在特定发现尺度上被抹平，且涨落行为呈现从非高斯到高斯的不同相结构。；创新点：建立了竞争性探索中首次发现份额的普适涨落理论，揭示了谱维数 \(d_s\) 作为控制参数，将不同扩散类型（正常扩散、超扩散、亚扩散）中的竞争不平衡行为统一到同一相图框架下。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于随机游走模型和谱维数 \(d_s\) 的定义（由单搜索者回到起点的概率衰减指数决定），推导了发现份额的渐近方差及其前因子，并分析了首次发现标签的两点关联函数。

papers.title: Tellurium sublattice instability driven amorphization in the chalcogenide AgSbTe2 under pressure
papers.abstract: Pressure provides a powerful thermodynamic route to access hidden structural states in functional materials, yet the microscopic origin of pressure-induced amorphization remains elusive in many complex chalcogenides. Here we report a detailed high-pressure structural study of AgSbTe2,combining synchrotron X-ray diffraction with density functional theory and molecular dynamics calculations up to 60 GPa. We uncover a pressure-driven transformation from the ambient R-3m phase to a fully disordered cubic Im3m phase, through an extended intermediate amorphous state. Enthalpy calculations reveal a near-degeneracy between the R3m and Im3m structures over a broad pressure range, dictating amorphization. Contrary to previously speculated cation vacancies, the amorphization is governed by a pronounced displacement instability of the Te sublattice. Remarkably, the time dependent decompression pathway controls the final structural state, resulting in either amorphous (slow decompression) or fully crystalline (fast decompression) states, indicative of a strong counterintuitive kinetic effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合了同步辐射X射线衍射实验、密度泛函理论（DFT）和分子动力学计算。；研究对象：硫族化合物AgSbTe₂在高压下的非晶化过程及其微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AgSbTe₂在压力驱动下经历从环境相R-3m到完全无序立方Im3m相的转变，中间经过一个扩展的非晶态；非晶化并非由阳离子空位引起，而是由Te亚晶格的显著位移不稳定性主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AgSbTe₂在压力驱动下经历从环境相R-3m到完全无序立方Im3m相的转变，中间经过一个扩展的非晶态；非晶化并非由阳离子空位引起，而是由Te亚晶格的显著位移不稳定性主导。；创新点：揭示了Te亚晶格位移不稳定性而非阳离子空位是压力诱导非晶化的关键机制；发现了反直觉的动力学效应——缓慢卸压导致非晶态、快速卸压导致完全晶态，表明卸压路径可控制最终结构状态。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线衍射（高压原位结构表征）、密度泛函理论（焓计算）、分子动力学模拟（微观动力学过程分析），压力范围达60 GPa。

papers.title: Cuprate d-wave superconductivity based on Non perturbative many body theory for spin fluctuation
papers.abstract: We employ the nonperturbative many-body spin GW method to compute the single-particle Green's function, and the covariance method to evaluate the correlation functions of two body, for the Hubbard model for superconductors. The key transition temperatures, namely the Neel temperature and the superconducting critical temperature Tc are found to be in quantitative agreement with experimental data. The evolution of the Fermi surface in different doping regimes is also presented, which clearly shows transitions from pseudogap to strange metal and to Fermi liquid phase. The method has been benchmarked at strong coupling and low temperature and is free from the fermion sign problem. Simulations on lattices up to 64 times 64 are also feasible, making access to the thermodynamic limit possible. This approach may offer a new route toward investigating strongly correlated systems, especially cuprate superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“非微扰多体自旋GW方法”、“协方差方法”等理论计算框架，并提及了在晶格上的数值模拟。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体（cuprate superconductors）中的d波超导电性，具体基于Hubbard模型进行模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非微扰多体理论计算，得到的奈尔温度和超导临界温度Tc与实验数据定量吻合；同时，计算清晰地展示了从赝能隙到奇异金属、再到费米液体的费米面演化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非微扰多体理论计算，得到的奈尔温度和超导临界温度Tc与实验数据定量吻合；同时，计算清晰地展示了从赝能隙到奇异金属、再到费米液体的费米面演化过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的明确创新点，但该方法的核心优势在于：它是一种无符号问题的非微扰方法，能够在大尺寸晶格（64x64）上实现热力学极限下的计算，并定量复现铜氧化物超导体的关键实验相图（包括磁有序和超导转变温度）。
papers.method_zh: 采用了非微扰多体自旋GW方法（nonperturbative many-body spin GW method）计算单粒子格林函数，并使用协方差方法（covariance method）评估两体关联函数。该方法在强耦合和低温下进行了基准测试，且无费米子符号问题（fermion sign problem），可模拟高达64x64的晶格。

papers.title: Emergent Fermi polarons in Dirac materials
papers.abstract: We investigate band-structure effects on the absorption spectra of quantum impurities in Dirac materials. We uncover the formation of novel quasiparticles -- Dirac-Fermi polarons -- emerging from the dressing of impurities by excitations near the Dirac point. These quasiparticles are remarkably robust, persisting for both attractive and repulsive interactions, and across the full range of electron and hole doping. We show that their spectroscopic signature is a generic feature of Dirac materials, accessible with established techniques in both solid-state and ultracold atomic platforms. Our results establish polaron spectroscopy as a powerful probe of Dirac points at energies far from the Fermi surface, providing direct access to band-structure effects beyond conventional approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate”（理论研究）、“uncover the formation”（理论发现）、“show that”（理论论证），未提及实验或计算具体方法。；研究对象：狄拉克材料（Dirac materials）中量子杂质（quantum impurities）的吸收光谱，以及由此形成的准粒子——狄拉克-费米极化子（Dirac-Fermi polarons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在狄拉克材料中，杂质被狄拉克点附近的激发所“修饰”，形成一种新型准粒子——狄拉克-费米极化子。这种极化子非常稳健，在吸引和排斥相互作用下、以及从电子掺杂到空穴掺杂的整个范围内都能存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在狄拉克材料中，杂质被狄拉克点附近的激发所“修饰”，形成一种新型准粒子——狄拉克-费米极化子。这种极化子非常稳健，在吸引和排斥相互作用下、以及从电子掺杂到空穴掺杂的整个范围内都能存在。；创新点：揭示了狄拉克材料中一种普适的极化子光谱特征，该特征可通过固态和超冷原子平台中的现有技术观测，并建立了极化子光谱学作为探测远离费米面的狄拉克点能带结构效应的新手段。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法（如是否使用变分法、自洽T矩阵、蒙特卡洛等），仅提及“研究能带结构对吸收光谱的影响”。

papers.title: Hall Coefficient Sign Reversal Driven by Orbital-Selective Oxygen-Vacancy Scattering in Nickelate Films
papers.abstract: Hall measurements in superconducting bilayer nickelate films show sign reversals that cannot be explained by rigid-band electron doping alone. We combine a DFT+CDMFT-derived correlated multi-orbital quasiparticle model with a $T$-matrix treatment of oxygen-vacancy scattering in a semiclassical Boltzmann transport framework. We find that multiband compensation is insufficient by itself: in-plane vacancies selectively suppress the transport channel dominated by the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital and drive $R_H$ through zero, whereas inner-apical vacancies make $R_H$ more negative. These results identify pocket-resolved and orbital-selective oxygen-vacancy scattering as the microscopic origin of the Hall coefficient sign reversal and provide a framework for oxygen-stoichiometry-dependent transport in nickelate films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论）。判断依据：结合了DFT+CDMFT计算、T-矩阵散射处理以及半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论框架。；研究对象：镍酸盐薄膜（超导双层镍酸盐薄膜）中霍尔系数符号反转现象，具体涉及氧空位散射对输运通道的轨道选择性影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 霍尔系数符号反转并非由多带补偿效应单独导致，而是由面内氧空位对d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导的输运通道的选择性抑制所驱动；而内顶角氧空位则使霍尔系数更负。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：霍尔系数符号反转并非由多带补偿效应单独导致，而是由面内氧空位对d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导的输运通道的选择性抑制所驱动；而内顶角氧空位则使霍尔系数更负。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+CDMFT（密度泛函理论+连续时间量子蒙特卡洛）推导出关联多轨道准粒子模型，并结合T-矩阵方法处理氧空位散射，在半经典玻尔兹曼输运框架下进行计算分析。

papers.title: Electronic Structure, Optical Response, Thermal and Mechanical Behavior of B6X (X = S, Se) under Pressure: A Comprehensive Ab-initio Exploration
papers.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of the pressure dependent structural, electronic, optical, mechanical, and bonding properties of orthorhombic boron rich chalcogenides B6S and B6Se. Calculations were performed using density functional theory across a wide range of hydrostatic pressures. The computed elastic constants, bulk, Young, shear moduli, and Poisson ratio, revealed mechanical robustness and strong resistance to deformation, even under significant compression. Electronic band structure and density of states analyses indicate that the materials exhibit indirect bandgap semiconducting behavior. Optical results reveal clear pressure induced spectral shifts, particularly in the visible and ultraviolet regions, suggesting modified light matter interaction under compression. Phonon dispersion curves verified the dynamical stability of both materials within the investigated pressure range. Hardness estimations, combined with elastic parameters, and melting temperatures, further indicate that B6S and B6Se possess significant mechanical strength suitable for applications under harsh environments. The thermal properties suggest that both these compounds possess features suitable to be used as excellent thermal barrier coating materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Calculations were performed using density functional theory”（使用密度泛函理论进行计算）。；研究对象：富硼硫族化合物B6S和B6Se的正交晶相。具体研究了其在静水压力下的结构、电子、光学、力学和热学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: B6S和B6Se是间接带隙半导体，具有优异的机械强度和抗变形能力，其光学性质在压力下会发生显著变化（特别是在可见光和紫外区），并且具备作为优异热障涂层材料的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：B6S和B6Se是间接带隙半导体，具有优异的机械强度和抗变形能力，其光学性质在压力下会发生显著变化（特别是在可见光和紫外区），并且具备作为优异热障涂层材料的潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作对B6S和B6Se在压力下的多种物理性质（结构、电子、光学、力学、热学）进行了全面且系统的第一性原理研究。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。具体计算了弹性常数、体模量、杨氏模量、剪切模量、泊松比、电子能带结构、态密度、光学响应（光谱）、声子色散曲线、硬度、熔融温度和热学性质。

papers.title: Vortex-Number-Controlled Josephson Diode Polarity in Corbino Junctions
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the polarity of the Josephson diode effect in Corbino Josephson junctions can be deterministically controlled by the vortex number, which arises as a generic consequence of structured spatial inhomogeneity. By solving the continuum Andreev spectral problem, we identify a mechanism in which the vortex number selectively filters specific spatial Fourier harmonics of the local inhomogeneity. This harmonic selection reshapes the amplitudes and relative phases of higher-order Josephson current harmonics, ultimately reversing the critical-current asymmetry. Numerical simulations of both an effective one-dimensional edge model and full two-dimensional lattice models confirm the robustness of this mechanism. Crucially, our results show that a vortex-parity-dependent reversal of diode polarity is not an exclusive signature of Majorana physics, but can emerge generically from geometric and structural inhomogeneities in Corbino junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提到“solving the continuum Andreev spectral problem”、“numerical simulations of both an effective one-dimensional edge model and full two-dimensional lattice models”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Corbino Josephson结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应，具体研究涡旋数（vortex number）对二极管极性的控制机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Corbino约瑟夫森结中，涡旋数可以确定性地控制约瑟夫森二极管效应的极性，其机制源于结构空间不均匀性对高阶约瑟夫森电流谐波的选择性滤波，从而反转临界电流不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Corbino约瑟夫森结中，涡旋数可以确定性地控制约瑟夫森二极管效应的极性，其机制源于结构空间不均匀性对高阶约瑟夫森电流谐波的选择性滤波，从而反转临界电流不对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的对比，但明确指出涡旋奇偶性依赖的二极管极性反转并非马约拉纳物理的独有特征，而是Corbino结中几何和结构不均匀性的一般性结果。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解连续安德烈夫谱问题（continuum Andreev spectral problem）识别机制，并采用有效一维边缘模型和全二维晶格模型的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Full Gate-Voltage Control of a Parity-Protected Superconducting Qubit with an Altermagnetic Josephson Junction
papers.abstract: Parity-protected superconducting qubits offer intrinsically long coherence, but many current implementations require magnetic-flux biasing, which introduces flux noise, control overhead, and limited scalability. Here we propose a parity-protected qubit based on a gate-tunable superconductor-altermagnet-superconductor Josephson junction. Altermagnets are compensated magnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting and zero net magnetization, providing spin-dependent functionality without external magnetic fields. In the proposed junction, the two spin sectors acquire opposite phase shifts, generating two Josephson channels whose interference is controlled electrically by the chemical potential. At the tuned $0$-$π$ transition, the first Josephson harmonic is strongly suppressed while the second harmonic dominates, yielding a double-well potential with two nearly degenerate states of opposite Cooper-pair parity. For realistic gatemon-compatible parameters, we estimate coherence times of up to tens of milliseconds while maintaining fully gate-controlled qubit operations. These results establish altermagnetic Josephson junctions as a promising route toward protected superconducting qubits with local, scalable, and all-electrical control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Here we propose...”、“For realistic parameters, we estimate...”等表述，表明该工作主要基于理论模型和参数估算，而非实验实现。；研究对象：一种基于门可调谐的超导体-交变磁体-超导体（SAS）约瑟夫森结的宇称保护超导量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电化学势调控，在交变磁体约瑟夫森结中实现0-π跃迁，从而抑制第一约瑟夫森谐波，使第二谐波主导，形成具有两个近简并宇称态的双势阱，实现全电控的宇称保护量子比特。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电化学势调控，在交变磁体约瑟夫森结中实现0-π跃迁，从而抑制第一约瑟夫森谐波，使第二谐波主导，形成具有两个近简并宇称态的双势阱，实现全电控的宇称保护量子比特。；创新点：首次提出利用交变磁体（altermagnet）的零净磁化、动量依赖自旋劈裂特性，在约瑟夫森结中实现无需外加磁场的全电控宇称保护量子比特，避免了磁通噪声和磁通偏置带来的可扩展性问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与建模。具体包括：基于交变磁体（altermagnet）的动量依赖自旋劈裂特性，构建超导-交变磁体-超导约瑟夫森结模型；通过调节化学势（即门电压）控制两个自旋通道的相位差，实现0-π跃迁；基于“gatemon”兼容参数估算量子比特的相干时间。

papers.title: Katsura-Nagaosa-Balatsky magnetoelectricity in molecular magnets: Bipartite entanglement transfer by means of rotating electric field
papers.abstract: We investigate quantum entanglement in a spin-1/2 Heisenberg trimer with spin-induced electric polarization described by the Katsura-Nagaosa-Balatsky (KNB) mechanism in the presence of external magnetic and electric fields. The electric field is assumed to lie in the plane of the magnetic ions, allowing its strength and orientation to be tuned independently. We analyze both bipartite and tripartite entanglement and demonstrate that the spin-electric-field coupling provides an efficient mechanism for controlling quantum correlations within the molecular nanomagnet.
