Depending on the electric-field parameters, the bipartite entanglement can be significantly enhanced or suppressed, while the multipartite entanglement exhibits a rich dependence on the microscopic spin-electric coupling. Most notably, we demonstrate that a rotating in-plane electric field of constant magnitude induces a controllable transfer of bipartite entanglement between different spin pairs. In the symmetric case of homogeneous exchange interactions and uniform KNB coupling, this transfer is found to be nearly ideal, with the bipartite negativity approaching its theoretical maximum for one spin pair while simultaneously vanishing for the remaining pairs. We show that the efficiency of the transfer can be tailored through the exchange interactions, bond geometry, and nonuniform spin-electric coupling. These results establish molecular nanomagnets with KNB spin-electric coupling as a promising platform for the electrical manipulation, steering, and localization of quantum entanglement at the molecular scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We investigate”“We analyze”“We demonstrate”等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：自旋-1/2海森堡三聚体分子磁体，其中自旋诱导电极化由Katsura-Nagaosa-Balatsky（KNB）机制描述，并施加外磁场和电场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 旋转面内恒定电场可在不同自旋对之间实现可控的双粒子纠缠转移；在均匀交换耦合和均匀KNB耦合的对称情况下，该转移近乎理想，一对自旋的纠缠度接近理论最大值，而其余自旋对纠缠同时消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：旋转面内恒定电场可在不同自旋对之间实现可控的双粒子纠缠转移；在均匀交换耦合和均匀KNB耦合的对称情况下，该转移近乎理想，一对自旋的纠缠度接近理论最大值，而其余自旋对纠缠同时消失。；创新点：首次提出利用旋转电场在分子磁体中实现双粒子纠缠的可控转移，并证明该转移在对称条件下可达到近乎理想的效果，为分子尺度上量子纠缠的电学操控、引导和局域化提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用KNB自旋-电场耦合理论框架，分析双粒子纠缠（通过负性纠缠度度量）和三粒子纠缠，研究电场强度、方向及旋转对纠缠的调控作用，并探讨交换相互作用、键几何构型及非均匀KNB耦合对转移效率的影响。

papers.title: Spin-momentum locking of polariton edge states in honeycomb lattices
papers.abstract: Transverse-electric/Transverse-magnetic splitting in dielectric-mirror microcavities introduces an effective spin-orbit coupling for photons. While the bulk states remain linearly polarized, for exponentially localized edge states in a photonic lattice, this coupling induces elliptical polarization whose handedness is locked to the propagation direction, analogous to the transverse spin of evanescent electromagnetic waves. We reveal spin-momentum locking through Stokes polarimetry of zigzag edge states in a honeycomb exciton-polariton lattice. The effect persists in a stretched honeycomb supporting a photonic bandgap, where spin-polarized carrier injection enables selective lasing of either chiral edge states. Our results provide a route toward ultrafast spin-controlled unidirectional propagation in polariton systems without external magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过斯托克斯偏振测量（Stokes polarimetry）揭示”以及“自旋极化载流子注入实现选择性激射”，表明有实验观测和操作。；研究对象：蜂窝状激子-极化子晶格中的边缘态，具体研究其自旋-动量锁定现象，以及由此产生的椭圆偏振与传播方向的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在介电镜微腔中，横电/横磁分裂引入有效自旋-轨道耦合，使得蜂窝晶格中局域化的边缘态产生椭圆偏振，其手性与传播方向锁定（即自旋-动量锁定）。在拉伸蜂窝结构中，该效应可用于实现无外磁场的自旋控制单向激射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在介电镜微腔中，横电/横磁分裂引入有效自旋-轨道耦合，使得蜂窝晶格中局域化的边缘态产生椭圆偏振，其手性与传播方向锁定（即自旋-动量锁定）。在拉伸蜂窝结构中，该效应可用于实现无外磁场的自旋控制单向激射。；创新点：首次在激子-极化子蜂窝晶格中实验观测到边缘态的自旋-动量锁定，并利用该效应在无外磁场条件下实现自旋控制的单向激射，为超快自旋操控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用斯托克斯偏振测量（Stokes polarimetry）分析锯齿型边缘态的偏振特性；通过自旋极化载流子注入实现选择性激射。理论框架基于微腔中横电/横磁分裂引入的有效自旋-轨道耦合。

papers.title: Reentrant localization transition, quantum butterfly and robust edge modes in aperiodic zig-zag ladder
papers.abstract: Low dimensional tight-binding lattices in presence of quasiperiodic disorder generally exhibits localization transition. The system supports diffusive modes upto a limiting strength of disorder and all the eigenstates become localized beyond that critical strength thereby quenching the kinetic signature of the wavepacket. However, moving away from this situation, we demonstrate that with minimal long-range off-diagonal modulation, the eigenspectrum again may offer delocalization of electronic states for some subtle combination of kinetic parameters of the Hamiltonian leading to a second quantum phase change. The localization transitions are associated with the obvious presence of single-particle mobility edges. Multifractal energy landscape also shows quantum butterfly pattern with the in-gap robust edge modes. The re-emerging localization transition is manifested through the evaluation of inverse participation ratio, eigenspectrum and a pertinent quantum dynamical study.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、eigenspectrum、quantum dynamical study）；研究对象：准周期无序准一维锯齿型梯子（aperiodic zig-zag ladder）中的局域化转变、量子蝴蝶图案及边缘态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准周期无序的锯齿型梯子中，通过引入最小长程非对角调制，电子态可以再次出现退局域化，形成第二次量子相变（即重入局域化转变），并伴随单粒子迁移率边、量子蝴蝶图案和稳健的能隙边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准周期无序的锯齿型梯子中，通过引入最小长程非对角调制，电子态可以再次出现退局域化，形成第二次量子相变（即重入局域化转变），并伴随单粒子迁移率边、量子蝴蝶图案和稳健的能隙边缘态。；创新点：揭示了在准周期无序系统中，通过长程非对角调制的微小改变即可诱导出重入的局域化-退局域化转变，并发现该转变与量子蝴蝶图案及稳健边缘态共存。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算，包括计算逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）、本征谱分析以及量子动力学研究。

papers.title: Evidence of the Cooper-Pair Field with Gaussian Memory Kernel in Unconventional Superconductors
papers.abstract: We develop a dynamical description of the superconducting pair field in which the Cooper-channel Hubbard--Stratonovich field $Δ$ is treated as a memory-dressed Bogoliubov pair field rather than as a purely static order parameter. Starting from the standard pair-field effective action, we couple $Δ$ to antinode-selected collective or self-generated fields. An ensemble of such modes produces a distribution of local Bogoliubov frequencies; when this distribution is approximately Gaussian, ensemble averaging gives the memory factor $\exp[-t^2/(2τ_g^2)]$. In cuprate superconductors, the antinodal gap or pseudogap restricts the active electronic phase space and acts as a momentum-space spectral cavity. It selects fluctuation wavevectors $\mathbf Q_a$ that may become charge-density-wave-like instabilities in an ordered limit, but behave as a reservoir of local collective fields in the fluctuating regime. The same framework admits resonant algebraic prefactors, so that threshold and forced-oscillator responses generate the hierarchy $p=-1/2,1/2,1,3/2,\ldots$, while the Gaussian envelope cuts off secular growth and converts these branches into finite spectral components. The resulting picture contains a robust pseudogap memory channel and, below $T_c$, an additional condensate-assisted coherent channel proportional to $|Δ_0(T)|^2$. Thus the superconducting transition primarily reorganizes pair-field spectral weight between incoherent pseudogap memory and coherent Bogoliubov memory. The frequency-domain response is expressed in terms of parabolic-cylinder functions, and comparisons with Raman, ARPES, tunneling, and doping-dependent ARPES scaling suggest that these probes are complementary projections of the same Gaussian-memory pair continuum. We compare our numerical results with the recent experimental data on Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“dynamical description”“effective action”“ensemble averaging”“frequency-domain response”等理论推导和建模术语，未提及实验操作或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非常规超导体中的库珀对场（Cooper-pair field），特别是铜氧化物超导体（如Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ）中的赝能隙态和超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导对场应被描述为具有高斯记忆核的动力学Bogoliubov对场，而非静态序参量；超导转变主要将谱权重从非相干赝能隙记忆通道重新分配到与凝聚体相关的相干Bogoliubov记忆通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导对场应被描述为具有高斯记忆核的动力学Bogoliubov对场，而非静态序参量；超导转变主要将谱权重从非相干赝能隙记忆通道重新分配到与凝聚体相关的相干Bogoliubov记忆通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于对场有效作用量，将Hubbard-Stratonovich场Δ耦合到反节点选择的集体或自生场，通过系综平均得到高斯记忆核exp[-t²/(2τ_g²)]；利用谐振响应代数前因子得到p = -1/2, 1/2, 1, 3/2, …的谱分支；频率域响应用抛物柱函数表达，并与Raman、ARPES、隧穿及掺杂依赖的ARPES标度进行数值比较。

papers.title: Surface Functionalization Enables Two-Dimensional Altermagnetism and Giant Tunnel Magnetoresistance
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets (AMs) are highly desirable for ultrafast, stray-field-free spintronics because they combine compensated magnetic order and momentum-dependent spin splitting with the scalability, tunability, and interface compatibility of atomically thin materials. However, practical 2D AMs remain scarce. Rather than relying solely on the search for intrinsic 2D AMs, an appealing route is to transform known 2D antiferromagnets (AFMs) into AMs through symmetry engineering. Here, we propose surface functionalization as a symmetry-guided, nonvolatile chemical switch for realizing this AFM-to-AM transformation. By breaking inversion and out-of-plane mirror symmetries while preserving the rotation symmetry connecting opposite-spin sublattices, single-sided functionalization lifts spin degeneracy and induces altermagnetic spin splitting. Using monolayer FeSe as a representative platform, first-principles calculations show that hydrogenation, oxidation, and fluorination convert spin-degenerate antiferromagnetic FeSe into a d-wave AM with pronounced momentum-dependent spin splitting. At the device level, our transport simulations reveal that the functionalized FeSe monolayer magnetic tunnel junctions exhibit giant tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) up to $1.87\times10^3\%$, originating from momentum-selective spin filtering between parallel and antiparallel Néel-vector configurations. The strong dependence of TMR on functionalization geometry further demonstrates that surface chemistry provides an effective control knob for altermagnetic transport. Our work establishes a symmetry-to-chemistry-to-device strategy for engineering 2D AMs and developing high-performance altermagnetic spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations、transport simulations）；研究对象：二维单层FeSe通过表面功能化（氢化、氧化、氟化）实现的反铁磁-交变磁转变，以及由此构建的磁性隧道结中的隧穿磁电阻效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单侧表面功能化可将自旋简并的反铁磁单层FeSe转化为d波交变磁体，并在磁性隧道结中实现高达1.87×10³%的巨隧穿磁电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单侧表面功能化可将自旋简并的反铁磁单层FeSe转化为d波交变磁体，并在磁性隧道结中实现高达1.87×10³%的巨隧穿磁电阻。；创新点：提出表面功能化作为一种对称性引导的非易失化学开关，将已知二维反铁磁体转化为交变磁体，并展示了表面化学对交变磁输运的有效调控。摘要未突出说明与已有交变磁体材料相比的具体性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）和输运模拟（transport simulations）。

papers.title: Experimental signatures of bosonic pairing in a two-component Bose gas
papers.abstract: Two-component bosonic droplets are commonly described within Bogoliubov theory, where beyond-mean-field quantum fluctuations stabilize the system against mean-field collapse. In the interaction regime where droplets form, however, the Bogoliubov excitation spectrum contains an imaginary branch associated with the underlying instability, which is typically omitted when evaluating the beyond-mean-field energy. Bosonic pairing theory provides an alternative description with a fully real excitation spectrum. In this work, we reformulate bosonic pairing theory within an operator formalism, making its underlying approximations transparent, and compare its predictions with those of Bogoliubov theory for a homonuclear binary Bose mixture across the crossover from a weakly interacting gas to the droplet regime. Working at fixed particle density, we determine the variational parameters of bosonic pairing theory self-consistently and focus on the regime in which both theories possess real excitation spectra, allowing a direct comparison. We find that bosonic pairing theory yields a lower grand potential than Bogoliubov theory and predicts qualitatively distinct correlation signatures, including enhanced long-wavelength interspecies momentum-space correlations and a finite density static structure factor at experimentally accessible low momenta. These differences persist over a broad range of interaction strengths and suggest that correlation and structure-factor measurements can provide direct experimental tests of bosonic pairing across the gas-to-droplet crossover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：reformulate bosonic pairing theory within an operator formalism、self-consistently determine variational parameters、compare predictions with Bogoliubov theory）；研究对象：双组分玻色气体中的玻色配对现象，具体涉及从弱相互作用气体到液滴区的同核二元玻色混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻色配对理论比Bogoliubov理论给出更低的巨势，并预测了定性不同的关联信号，包括增强的长波长相间动量空间关联和有限密度静态结构因子，这些差异在实验可及的低动量区域持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻色配对理论比Bogoliubov理论给出更低的巨势，并预测了定性不同的关联信号，包括增强的长波长相间动量空间关联和有限密度静态结构因子，这些差异在实验可及的低动量区域持续存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用算符形式重新表述玻色配对理论，并在固定粒子密度下自洽求解变分参数，与Bogoliubov理论进行直接比较。

papers.title: Morphology-Property Interplay in Chemo-Mechanics of Ion-Intercalation Active Particles
papers.abstract: Morphology, material property, and mechanical constraint jointly govern the chemo-mechanical behavior of ion-intercalation particles, yet their coupled effects remain insufficiently understood. Here we establish a thermodynamically consistent single-particle framework and combine analytical solutions with multiphysics simulations to determine how these factors regulate lithiation and stress generation. We study hollow spherical, cylindrical, and ellipsoidal particles with isotropic or transversely isotropic material properties under fully constrained, inner-free, or unconstrained boundary conditions. We show that the transient lithiation pathway and the associated stress and strain fields are governed not by morphology, property, or constraint alone, but by their coupled interaction: isotropic particles are sensitive to the mechanical constraint, whereas transversely isotropic particles exhibit persistent heterogeneous lithiation dominated by anisotropic diffusivity. Flux decomposition analysis reveals that the mechanical contribution to Li flux is negligible in spheres but dominant in ellipsoids. Correlation analysis further shows that Li concentration and volumetric strain exhibit strong anti-correlation in unconstrained particles but weak correlation under full constraints. Bayesian optimization of hollow ellipsoids identifies Pareto-optimal morphologies that balance lithiation capacity against peak tensile stress. These results provide a unified framework for the morphology-property interplay in intercalation particles and offer morphology design principles for chemo-mechanical stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：thermodynamically consistent single-particle framework、analytical solutions、multiphysics simulations、Bayesian optimization）；研究对象：离子插层活性颗粒的化学-力学行为，具体包括空心球形、圆柱形和椭球形颗粒，以及各向同性/横观各向同性材料性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子插层颗粒的瞬态锂化路径及应力/应变场并非由形貌、材料性质或力学约束单独决定，而是由三者耦合作用主导；横观各向同性颗粒中，各向异性扩散系数导致持续的非均匀锂化，而各向同性颗粒则对力学约束更敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子插层颗粒的瞬态锂化路径及应力/应变场并非由形貌、材料性质或力学约束单独决定，而是由三者耦合作用主导；横观各向同性颗粒中，各向异性扩散系数导致持续的非均匀锂化，而各向同性颗粒则对力学约束更敏感。；创新点：系统揭示了形貌、材料性质与力学约束三者耦合对化学-力学行为的调控机制，并通过贝叶斯优化识别出平衡锂化容量与峰值拉伸应力的帕累托最优形貌，为插层颗粒的形貌设计提供了统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 建立了热力学一致的单颗粒理论框架，结合解析解与多物理场模拟，并采用通量分解分析、相关性分析以及贝叶斯优化方法。

papers.title: The Reweighting Principle in Statistical Mechanics
papers.abstract: Reweighting of probability measures provides a unifying perspective on conditioning, exponential tilting, and, more generally, ensemble transformations in statistical mechanics. We show that exponential tilting and conditioning arise as the minimum-relative-entropy updates associated with soft and hard constraints, respectively. Their relative entropies naturally inherit complementary thermodynamic structures: exponential tilting gives rise to the Legendre structure of the canonical ensemble and reduces to the Gibbs entropy for a uniform reference measure, while conditioning reduces to the Boltzmann entropy through the surprisal of the constrained macrostate. By introducing an enlarged probability space in which observables are treated as explicit variables, we further show that microcanonical and canonical ensembles arise as conditional and marginal distributions of a common structural prior after exponential reweighting. In the thermodynamic limit, described through large deviation theory, conditioning emerges from exponential tilting by concentration of measure, revealing ensemble equivalence as a consequence of entropy--bias competition. Finally, we outline how the same information-theoretic framework naturally extends to path space, suggesting a unified probabilistic description of equilibrium thermodynamics and conditioned stochastic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于概率测度重加权、最小相对熵、大偏差理论等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：统计力学中的系综变换，包括正则系综、微正则系综以及条件化与指数倾斜等概率变换的数学结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 指数倾斜与条件化分别对应软约束和硬约束下的最小相对熵更新，并自然衍生出互补的热力学结构（Legendre结构与Gibbs熵、Boltzmann熵）；在热力学极限下，条件化可通过测度集中从指数倾斜中涌现，揭示系综等价性源于熵-偏差竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：指数倾斜与条件化分别对应软约束和硬约束下的最小相对熵更新，并自然衍生出互补的热力学结构（Legendre结构与Gibbs熵、Boltzmann熵）；在热力学极限下，条件化可通过测度集中从指数倾斜中涌现，揭示系综等价性源于熵-偏差竞争。；创新点：将重加权原理统一为统计力学中系综变换的底层逻辑，并建立其与信息论（相对熵）、热力学结构（Legendre变换、Gibbs/Boltzmann熵）以及大偏差理论之间的严格对应关系；同时将这一框架推广至路径空间，为平衡热力学与条件化随机动力学提供统一概率描述。
papers.method_zh: 信息论框架（最小相对熵原理）、大偏差理论、概率空间扩展（将可观测量作为显式变量）。

papers.title: Quantum tunneling Mpemba effect
papers.abstract: The quantum tunneling Mpemba effect is investigated within a continuous one-dimensional symmetric double-well potential open to external environmental sinks at the boundaries ($x=\pm L$). Using a non-Hermitian spectral decomposition of the effective Hamiltonian, we characterize the open-system relaxation dynamics without relying on abstract state-space quenches. We mathematically prove that the non-monotonic behavior of the first non-trivial even-parity spectral coefficient, $a_{2}(T_{i})$, with respect to the initial preparation temperature $T_{i}$ is a universal topological property born from quantum statistical mechanics. Crucially, we demonstrate that this intermediate thermal peak is governed by the Sturm-Liouville oscillation theorem and remains completely invariant with respect to the global system size $L$, contrasting sharply with the boundary-driven classical Mpemba effect. This universal peak arises from the geometric and nodal alignment between highly localized unperturbed states and extended non-Hermitian decay channels. Furthermore, we clarify that while this mechanism is robust, the actual observation of anomalous crossings in the total survival probability trace $S(t,T_{i})$ and the trace distance $\mathcal{D}(t,T_i)$ demand a strict separation of timescales, requiring the over-barrier escape rate to vastly exceed the decay rate of the deep-well tunneling doublet ($Γ_{2}\gg Γ_{0}$ and $Γ_2\gg Γ_1$). Our continuous formulation successfully bridges real-space classical boundary-driven dissipation with open quantum dynamics, providing novel insights for engineering non-equilibrium states via tailored boundary loss.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用非厄米谱分解、数学证明、Sturm-Liouville振荡定理等理论工具，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：量子隧穿Mpemba效应，具体体系为连续一维对称双势阱，边界处连接外部环境漏极（x=±L）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次证明非平凡偶宇称谱系数a₂(T_i)随初始温度T_i的非单调行为是量子统计力学中的普适拓扑性质，该中间热峰由Sturm-Liouville振荡定理决定，且完全不受系统尺寸L影响，与经典边界驱动Mpemba效应形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次证明非平凡偶宇称谱系数a₂(T_i)随初始温度T_i的非单调行为是量子统计力学中的普适拓扑性质，该中间热峰由Sturm-Liouville振荡定理决定，且完全不受系统尺寸L影响，与经典边界驱动Mpemba效应形成鲜明对比。；创新点：建立了连续实空间边界耗散与开放量子动力学之间的桥梁，揭示了量子隧穿Mpemba效应中普适热峰的拓扑起源，并澄清了观测异常交叉所需的时间尺度分离条件（过垒逃逸率远大于深阱隧穿双重态衰减率）。
papers.method_zh: 采用非厄米有效哈密顿量的谱分解方法，描述开放系统的弛豫动力学；通过数学证明揭示谱系数的拓扑性质；利用Sturm-Liouville振荡定理分析本征态几何与节点对齐。

papers.title: Atomistic study of finite temperature properties in ferroelectric BiAlO$_3$
papers.abstract: The lead-free perovskite ferroelectrics captivate researchers with their unique functional properties leading to important technological applications. In the search for a new lead-free perovskite of technological importance, we develop a first-principles based atomistic model to accurately predict the properties of BiAlO$_3$ in experimentally relevant conditions. Consistent with the experimental observations, our simulations predict a rhombohedral ferroelectric ($R3c$) ground state for BiAlO$_3$ facilitated by a structural phase transition from paraelectric (cubic, $Pm\Bar{3}m$) phase. The room-temperature spontaneous polarization and Curie temperature are obtained to be 81 $μ$C/cm$^2$ (along [111] direction) and 1160 K, respectively. Our simulations reveal strong coupling between ferroelectric and antiferrodistortive modes for a broad spectrum of temperature and electric field. We find that hydrostatic pressure suppresses both spontaneous polarization and Curie temperature, while both uniaxial and biaxial stresses induce multiple phase transitions in BiAlO$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles based atomistic model、simulations、predict）；研究对象：无铅钙钛矿铁电体 BiAlO₃ 的有限温度性质，包括结构相变、自发极化、居里温度、铁电与反铁畸变模式耦合以及应力效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BiAlO₃ 具有菱方铁电（R3c）基态，室温自发极化为 81 μC/cm²（沿[111]方向），居里温度为 1160 K；静水压抑制极化和居里温度，而单轴和双轴应力可诱导多重相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BiAlO₃ 具有菱方铁电（R3c）基态，室温自发极化为 81 μC/cm²（沿[111]方向），居里温度为 1160 K；静水压抑制极化和居里温度，而单轴和双轴应力可诱导多重相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的原子尺度模型（first-principles based atomistic model），通过模拟预测材料在实验相关条件下的性质。

papers.title: First-principles study of the electronic structure and optical properties of two-dimensional $α$-graphdiyne
papers.abstract: The structural, electronic, and optical properties of monolayer $α$-graphdiyne ($α$-GDY) are systematically investigated using density-functional theory within the plane-wave pseudopotential formalism. The electronic band structure reveals a gapless Dirac crossing at the K point, demonstrating the Dirac semimetallic character of the monolayer. The calculated total and orbital-projected density of states show that the electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by the carbon $2p$ orbitals, while the contribution of the $2s$ orbitals is comparatively weak. The optical response exhibits pronounced polarization dependence. The in-plane dielectric function displays a strong Drude-like response and negative values of the real dielectric function at low photon energies, whereas the out-of-plane component remains positive throughout the investigated energy range. Consistently, the absorption coefficient, extinction coefficient, reflectivity, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal a pronounced optical anisotropy. The calculated plasma frequencies are approximately $3.21$~eV for the in-plane polarization and $1.06$~eV for the out-of-plane polarization, indicating substantially stronger collective electronic excitations within the atomic plane. These findings demonstrate that $α$-GDY combines Dirac-like electronic behavior with highly anisotropic optical properties, highlighting its potential for polarization-sensitive optoelectronic, plasmonic, and nanoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“First-principles study”、“density-functional theory”、“plane-wave pseudopotential formalism”。；研究对象：单层α-石墨二炔（α-graphdiyne, α-GDY）的电子结构和光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层α-GDY在K点存在无带隙的狄拉克锥，表现出狄拉克半金属特性；其光学响应具有显著的偏振依赖性，面内方向呈现类Drude响应和负介电常数，而面外方向则保持正介电常数，整体表现出强烈的光学各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层α-GDY在K点存在无带隙的狄拉克锥，表现出狄拉克半金属特性；其光学响应具有显著的偏振依赖性，面内方向呈现类Drude响应和负介电常数，而面外方向则保持正介电常数，整体表现出强烈的光学各向异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于平面波赝势形式的第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析了能带结构、总态密度和分轨道态密度，并计算了介电函数、吸收系数、消光系数、反射率和电子能量损失谱。

papers.title: Janus MgAlB_2 MBene: a dipole-engineered anode for ultrafast Li-ion transport and exceptional lithium storage
papers.abstract: In this work, we propose a group II/IIIA-based Janus MBene, MgAlB_2, and investigate its electrochemical properties using first-principles calculations. The substitution of one Mg layer in Mg_2B_2 MBene by an Al layer breaks the structural symmetry and generates a permanent out-of-plane polarization, giving rise to a distinct electronic environment compared with the parent Mg_2B_2 and Al_2B_2 monolayers. Electronic-structure analysis reveals enhanced orbital hybridization among B, Mg, and Al states near the Fermi level, resulting in improved electronic delocalization across the monolayer. The Janus MgAlB_2 monolayer is found to possess excellent dynamical, mechanical, and thermal stability. Owing to its polarization-modified energy landscape, Li ions migrate with an exceptionally low diffusion barrier of 17.1 meV, corresponding to a room-temperature diffusion coefficient of 3.43x10^-10 cm^2/s. Unlike the pristine Mg_2B_2 and Al_2B_2 monolayers, which support only a single stable adsorption layer, MgAlB_2 accommodates two complete Li layers. Detailed analysis shows that the residual polarization retained after first-layer lithiation continues to promote Li adsorption, whereas increasing Li-Li electrostatic interactions eventually limit further storage. As a result, the Janus monolayer delivers a high theoretical specific capacity of 1470.24 mAh/g together with a small volume expansion of only 3.7% during maximum lithiation. The present study demonstrates that intrinsic polarization can be utilized to regulate both the thermodynamics and kinetics of Li storage, providing a design strategy for high-rate and high-capacity two-dimensional electrode materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、electronic-structure analysis（电子结构分析）、diffusion barrier（扩散势垒）等。；研究对象：Janus MgAlB₂ MBene单层材料，一种基于II/IIIA族元素的Janus结构二维电极材料，用于锂离子电池负极。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Janus MgAlB₂单层因结构不对称产生永久面外极化，显著降低了锂离子扩散势垒（17.1 meV），并支持双层锂吸附，实现了1470.24 mAh/g的高理论比容量和仅3.7%的体积膨胀。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Janus MgAlB₂单层因结构不对称产生永久面外极化，显著降低了锂离子扩散势垒（17.1 meV），并支持双层锂吸附，实现了1470.24 mAh/g的高理论比容量和仅3.7%的体积膨胀。；创新点：首次提出利用II/IIIA族元素构建Janus MBene（MgAlB₂），通过内禀极化调控锂存储的热力学和动力学，实现了超快锂离子输运和超高容量，区别于仅支持单层锂吸附的母体Mg₂B₂和Al₂B₂单层。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），包括电子结构分析、扩散势垒计算、动力学/力学/热稳定性评估、容量与体积变化分析。

papers.title: Measurement-induced spatially nonuniform fluctuations of the local particle number and their crossover in a quasiperiodic free-fermion chain
papers.abstract: We study continuously monitored dynamics of a quasiperiodic free-fermion chain defined on a Fibonacci lattice. We focus on fluctuations of the local particle number, which exhibit a spatially uniform distribution in the unitary limit. Remarkably, we demonstrate that they exhibit a nonuniform spatial pattern originating from the quasiperiodic long-range order under continuous measurement. Furthermore, employing both physicaland perpendicular-space analyses, we elucidate that measurement-induced crossover emerges in fluctuations due to the interplay between the incommensurate modulation and the continuous measurement. While weak measurement yields a distribution reflecting the long-range spatial structure of the quasiperiodic system, an increase in measurement strength alters the distribution into one dominated by the local environment of each site. We also elucidate that the measurement-induced crossover emerges in other physical quantities such as connected correlation functions. These findings offer insights into nonequilibrium quasiperiodic phenomena emerging in continuously monitored dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：continuously monitored dynamics、physical and perpendicular-space analyses、connected correlation functions。；研究对象：准周期自由费米子链（定义在斐波那契晶格上），具体研究连续测量下局域粒子数的涨落及其空间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 连续测量导致局域粒子数涨落出现源于准周期长程有序的非均匀空间图案；随着测量强度增加，涨落分布从反映准周期系统长程空间结构转变为由每个格点局域环境主导，即出现测量诱导的交叉行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：连续测量导致局域粒子数涨落出现源于准周期长程有序的非均匀空间图案；随着测量强度增加，涨落分布从反映准周期系统长程空间结构转变为由每个格点局域环境主导，即出现测量诱导的交叉行为。；创新点：揭示了连续测量与准周期非公度调制之间的相互作用如何诱导出局域粒子数涨落的空间非均匀性及其交叉行为，并将该交叉现象推广到其他物理量（如连通关联函数）。摘要未突出说明与以往无测量或弱测量准周期系统研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续监测动力学框架，结合实空间（physical-space）和垂直空间（perpendicular-space）分析，研究准周期自由费米子链在连续测量下的局域粒子数涨落及相关关联函数。

papers.title: Pauli Spectrum and Stabilizer Rényi Entropy in Gapless Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases
papers.abstract: Quantum entanglement is widely used as a diagnostic of topological phases of matter. Beyond entanglement, non-stabilizerness captures a distinct aspect of quantum many-body states by quantifying their distance from the manifold of stabilizer states. In this work, we study the stabilizer Rényi entropy in symmetry protected topological (SPT) phases, including both gapped SPT, non-intrinsically gapless SPT, and intrinsically gapless SPT phases. Under symmetry preserving perturbations, we find numerically that the stabilizer Rényi entropy exhibits an extremum near the phase transition. However, the stabilizer Rényi entropy alone cannot distinguish different SPT phases. In contrast, the Pauli spectrum reveals a characteristic crossing structure at the transition point. This crossing reflects the exchange of dominant Pauli-string correlations associated with the non-local string order parameters of the two topological distinct phases. For gapped SPT and non-intrinsically gapless SPT phases, the crossing structure can be understood from a local-unitary duality that maps the Pauli spectrum between the two phases. For intrinsically gapless SPT phases, such a local-unitary mapping is absent. Instead, we find that the Pauli spectrum mapping is generated by a non-invertible duality transformation. These results show that although the stabilizer Rényi entropy provides only a coarse diagnostic of phase transitions, the Pauli spectrum contains finer information about the exchange of string order sectors. Our findings demonstrate that quantum magic offers a complementary perspective for characterizing both gapped and gapless SPT phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、numerically、duality transformation、mapping。；研究对象：对称保护拓扑（SPT）相，包括有能隙SPT、非本征无能隙SPT和本征无能隙SPT相，以及它们之间的量子相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳定子Rényi熵在相变点附近出现极值，但无法区分不同SPT相；而Pauli谱在相变点呈现特征性的交叉结构，反映了不同拓扑相之间非局域弦序参量的主导Pauli-弦关联的交换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳定子Rényi熵在相变点附近出现极值，但无法区分不同SPT相；而Pauli谱在相变点呈现特征性的交叉结构，反映了不同拓扑相之间非局域弦序参量的主导Pauli-弦关联的交换。；创新点：揭示了Pauli谱而非稳定子Rényi熵能够精细刻画SPT相变中弦序参量扇区的交换，并指出量子魔法（quantum magic）为表征有能隙和无能隙SPT相提供了互补视角。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算（numerically）稳定子Rényi熵和Pauli谱；利用局域幺正对偶性（local-unitary duality）解释有能隙和非本征无能隙SPT相的Pauli谱映射；对于本征无能隙SPT相，采用非可逆对偶变换（non-invertible duality transformation）生成Pauli谱映射。

papers.title: Intermittency Signatures in the Deformation of a Passive Droplet in Active Turbulence
papers.abstract: We use fully resolved nematohydrodynamic simulations to study deformation statistics of a passive nematic droplet in two-dimensional extensile active-nematic turbulence. We find that the droplet aspect ratio serves as a scalar probe of the active bath. Its increments show heavy-tailed distributions with dependence on the time lag, scale-free burst statistics and multiscaling structure functions which establish temporal intermittency. While the mean deformation increases with activity, normalized intermittency is strongest at lower activity. This suggests slower and more coherent bath forcing. When compared with translational and forcing-side fluctuations, it reveals a hierarchy of intermittency: shape is more weakly intermittent than translation and active-stress fluctuations, consistent with filtering by interfacial restoring forces. Power spectra show an extended near-$1/ω$ regime for the maximal normal interface velocity, distinct from the steeper, approximately $1/ω^{2}$ spectrum of the interfacial active stress. Soft inclusions thus reveal how interfacial restoring forces convert active forcing into bursty, scale-rich deformation dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“fully resolved nematohydrodynamic simulations”（全分辨向列流体动力学模拟）。；研究对象：被动向列液滴在二维伸展型活性向列湍流中的变形统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴的纵横比可作为活性浴的标量探针，其增量呈现重尾分布、无标度爆发统计和多标度结构函数，表明时间间歇性；归一化间歇性在低活性时最强，且形状变形比平移和活性应力涨落更弱地间歇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴的纵横比可作为活性浴的标量探针，其增量呈现重尾分布、无标度爆发统计和多标度结构函数，表明时间间歇性；归一化间歇性在低活性时最强，且形状变形比平移和活性应力涨落更弱地间歇。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 全分辨向列流体动力学模拟（fully resolved nematohydrodynamic simulations），用于研究二维伸展型活性向列湍流中被动向列液滴的变形。

papers.title: Free energies and optimal reaction coordinates via entropy production
papers.abstract: We show through theory and numerical experiments that a straightforward calculation of entropy production on short molecular dynamics trajectories allows estimating free-energy barriers and identifying optimal reaction coordinates of activated processes. To this aim, we perform an analysis based on stochastic energetics on a set of trajectories relaxing towards equilibrium from a same initial configuration, projected on different putative coordinates. After demonstrating the approach on simple benchmarks, we show that it is possible to estimate the free-energy barrier of a complex high-dimensional system (carbon nanoparticles in water) and to rank the quality of order parameters, in agreement with the committor probability. The results shed light on the entanglement between the second law, free-energy landscapes, reaction coordinates and kinetic rates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“theory and numerical experiments”、“stochastic energetics”、“molecular dynamics trajectories”。；研究对象：活化过程（activated processes）中的自由能势垒与最优反应坐标，具体体系包括简单基准系统以及复杂高维系统（水中碳纳米颗粒）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过短分子动力学轨迹上熵产生的直接计算，可以估计自由能势垒并识别活化过程的最优反应坐标，且该方法与committor概率一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过短分子动力学轨迹上熵产生的直接计算，可以估计自由能势垒并识别活化过程的最优反应坐标，且该方法与committor概率一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机能量学（stochastic energetics）分析，对从同一初始构型向平衡态弛豫的一组轨迹进行投影，并比较不同候选反应坐标上的熵产生。

papers.title: Nonlinear Hall effect in Floquet-driven monolayer 1T$'$-MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We study the nonlinear Hall effect in Floquet-driven monolayer \(1T'\)-MoS\(_2\), a low-symmetry quantum spin Hall material whose tilted Dirac bands sustain an intrinsic Berry-curvature dipole without the need for strain or trigonal warping. We show that off-resonant circularly polarized light offers a way to control both the sign and the magnitude of the nonlinear Hall response through optically induced topological phase transitions using a Floquet effective Hamiltonian and nonlinear semiclassical transport theory. We show that the anisotropic crystal symmetry enforces a selection rule in which the Berry-curvature dipole elements satisfy $D_x\equiv0$, while a finite $D_y$ originates from the intrinsic band tilt. The Berry curvature is recreated in momentum space as the Floquet drive successively inverts individual spin-valley sectors, resulting in an identical sign reversal of the nonlinear Hall conductivity and the Berry-curvature dipole at each bulk gap closing. In contrast, tuning the band tilt modifies only the magnitude of the response without changing its sign, establishing the observed sign reversal as an unambiguous transport signature of genuine Floquet topological phase transitions. We further show that the nonlinear Hall response can be controlled by the driving strength, perpendicular electric field, Fermi energy, and temperature, providing multiple experimental knobs for observation. Our findings establish the sign of the nonlinear Hall response as a universal transport fingerprint of Floquet-engineered topology and point to monolayer \(1T'\)-MoS\(_2\) as a viable platform for all-electrical detection of nonequilibrium topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用了“Floquet有效哈密顿量”和“非线性半经典输运理论”进行理论推导和计算。；研究对象：Floquet驱动下的单层1T‘-MoS₂中的非线性霍尔效应。具体体系为一种低对称性的量子自旋霍尔材料，其倾斜的狄拉克能带具有本征的贝里曲率偶极矩。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离共振圆偏振光可以通过光致拓扑相变，可逆地调控非线性霍尔响应的符号和大小。非线性霍尔响应的符号反转是Floquet拓扑相变的一个普适输运指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离共振圆偏振光可以通过光致拓扑相变，可逆地调控非线性霍尔响应的符号和大小。非线性霍尔响应的符号反转是Floquet拓扑相变的一个普适输运指纹。；创新点：1. 揭示了在无需应变或三角翘曲的本征倾斜能带体系中，非线性霍尔效应可由光场调控。2. 建立了非线性霍尔响应的符号反转作为Floquet拓扑相变的明确输运特征，区别于仅改变响应幅度的能带倾斜调控。3. 提出了通过驱动强度、垂直电场、费米能和温度等多种实验旋钮来调控该效应的方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet有效哈密顿量理论描述光驱动下的电子结构，并结合非线性半经典输运理论计算贝里曲率偶极矩和非线性霍尔电导率。

papers.title: Tuning Superconductivity by Isovalent Antimony Substitution in PrFeAs(O,F)
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of isovalent Sb substitution at the As site in fluorine-doped PrFeAs1-xSbxO0.7F0.3 (x = 0 to 1.0) through structural, Raman spectroscopy, density functional theory (DFT), transport, magnetotransport, and magnetic measurements. The superconducting transition temperature decreases gradually from ~48 K for the parent compound to ~44 K up to x = 0.3, followed by a rapid suppression at higher Sb concentrations due to increasing disorder and secondary phase formation. Raman spectroscopy and DFT reveal lattice expansion and pronounced softening of pnictogen related vibrational modes upon Sb substitution. Magnetotransport measurements up to 9 T show enhanced upper critical fields and increased vortex activation energy for moderate Sb doping, indicating stronger vortex pinning. However, the critical current density remains low because of poor intergranular connectivity. The results demonstrate a crossover from an electronically tuned superconducting state to a disorder-dominated regime in isovalently substituted iron pnictides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“structural, Raman spectroscopy, ... transport, magnetotransport, and magnetic measurements”等实验手段，并辅以“density functional theory (DFT)”计算。；研究对象：氟掺杂的PrFeAs(O,F)铁基超导体中，用等价的锑(Sb)替代砷(As)位点对超导电性的影响。具体体系为PrFeAs1-xSbxO0.7F0.3 (x = 0 到 1.0)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等价Sb替代在低掺杂浓度下（x ≤ 0.3）使超导转变温度(Tc)从约48 K缓慢降至约44 K，但在更高浓度下由于无序增加和杂相形成导致Tc快速抑制。该体系存在一个从电子调控的超导态到无序主导的态的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等价Sb替代在低掺杂浓度下（x ≤ 0.3）使超导转变温度(Tc)从约48 K缓慢降至约44 K，但在更高浓度下由于无序增加和杂相形成导致Tc快速抑制。该体系存在一个从电子调控的超导态到无序主导的态的交叉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用了结构表征、拉曼光谱、输运测量、磁输运测量（最高9 T）和磁性测量。理论上使用了密度泛函理论(DFT)计算。

papers.title: Spin-orbit torque-driven synthetic antiferromagnetic oscillator
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets offer a promising route toward robust spintronic devices because of their compensated magnetic order and exchange-enhanced spin dynamics. Here, we demonstrate a spin-orbit torque (SOT)-driven antiferromagnetic oscillator based on a nanoconstriction patterned from a synthetic antiferromagnet (SAF). Spin-rectification spectroscopy reveals electrical excitation of both acoustic and optical SAF eigenmodes, whose field and frequency dependences are quantitatively described by an antiferromagnetic resonance model. In addition to these linear eigenmodes, we observe low-field spin-rectification peaks that emerge only above a threshold DC current near the spin-flop transition. Their current-polarity-dependent sign and locking to an injected RF frequency provide electrical spin-rectification signatures consistent with current-selected chiral self-oscillatory dynamics. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the threshold excitation of SOT-driven self-oscillations and injection locking, while macrospin simulations predict stable and chaotic nonlinear dynamics within the same spin-flop region. We interpret the multi-peak, weakly RF-frequency-dependent responses as a qualitative signature of complex nonlinear dynamics. These results establish SAF nanoconstrictions as an experimentally accessible platform for studying current-driven antiferromagnetic-like oscillator dynamics and motivate future work on nonlinear spintronic devices for signal processing and reservoir-computing concepts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、spin-rectification spectroscopy、micromagnetic simulations、macrospin simulations，包含实验与模拟结合）；研究对象：基于纳米收缩结构的人造反铁磁体（SAF）中的自旋轨道矩（SOT）驱动反铁磁振荡器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SAF纳米收缩结构中实现了SOT驱动的反铁磁振荡，观测到声学模和光学模的线性激发，并在自旋翻转（spin-flop）转变附近发现了阈值电流驱动的非线性自振荡与注入锁定现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SAF纳米收缩结构中实现了SOT驱动的反铁磁振荡，观测到声学模和光学模的线性激发，并在自旋翻转（spin-flop）转变附近发现了阈值电流驱动的非线性自振荡与注入锁定现象。；创新点：首次在人工合成反铁磁（SAF）纳米收缩结构中实现SOT驱动的反铁磁振荡器，并揭示了自旋翻转区内的复杂非线性动力学（包括多峰响应和弱射频频率依赖特征），为基于反铁磁类振荡器的信号处理与储备池计算提供了实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用自旋整流谱学（spin-rectification spectroscopy）测量电激发响应；理论上使用微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）和宏自旋模拟（macrospin simulations）分别再现自振荡与注入锁定行为以及非线性动力学。

papers.title: Beyond-adiabatic flat Chern bands from a double-helix skyrmion crystal
papers.abstract: A central challenge in flat-band engineering is suppressing kinetic energy without sacrificing Berry curvature. We show that a double-helix skyrmion crystal (DHSKX)--two sublattice-resolved skyrmion textures locked at opposite helicities, obtained here as the classical ground state of a frustrated honeycomb spin model--provides such a route under double exchange. The key mechanism is a single real-space organization, phase clustering: the $π$-locked helicities expel the wave function's phase winding from the skyrmion cores, and the magnetic $C_3$ symmetry pins it into three phase-locked clusters whose distributed destructive interference cancels net transport while preserving the Berry curvature. Ordinary skyrmion crystals, even with the same symmetry, do not develop this organization. Phase clustering yields isolated flat $|C| = 1$ Chern bands over broad coupling windows, one of which surpasses the adiabatic reference in quantum geometry at intermediate coupling. In this beyond-adiabatic window, band-projected exact diagonalization gives finite-size evidence consistent with $ν= 1/3$ Laughlin-type fractional-Chern-insulator physics; the same texture also hosts a higher-Chern ($C = -2$) flat band. Built from site-resolved complex hoppings alone, the DHSKX architecture is directly programmable in topolectric, acoustic, and photonic platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：classical ground state, double exchange, band-projected exact diagonalization）；研究对象：双螺旋斯格明子晶体（DHSKX）中的平带拓扑态，具体为受挫蜂窝晶格自旋模型中的经典基态结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双螺旋斯格明子晶体通过“相位聚类”机制，在实空间中实现波函数相位的有序组织，从而产生孤立且具有|C|=1陈数的平带，并在中等耦合强度下超越绝热参考的量子几何性质，支持ν=1/3的Laughlin型分数量子陈绝缘体物理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双螺旋斯格明子晶体通过“相位聚类”机制，在实空间中实现波函数相位的有序组织，从而产生孤立且具有|C|=1陈数的平带，并在中等耦合强度下超越绝热参考的量子几何性质，支持ν=1/3的Laughlin型分数量子陈绝缘体物理。；创新点：提出一种通过实空间相位聚类（phase clustering）实现非绝热平带陈带的机制，区别于普通斯格明子晶体；该机制仅依赖位点分辨的复跃迁，可直接在拓扑电路、声学和光子平台中编程实现。
papers.method_zh: 经典自旋模型基态计算、双交换模型下的能带分析、量子几何度量、以及带投影精确对角化（band-projected exact diagonalization）。

papers.title: Correlated-Electron Theory of Triplet-Triplet Multiexciton States in Polypentacene
papers.abstract: We present correlated-electron calculations of optical spin-singlet and triplet-triplet multiexciton states in three- and four-unit pentacene oligomers as microscopic models for polypentacene. The calculations use the Pariser-Parr-Pople Hamiltonian, multiple-reference singles and doubles configuration interaction, and a molecular exciton basis that resolves Frenkel, charge-transfer, and triplet-pair (T1T1) configurations in real space. We find that the complete set of 1(T1T1) eigenstates lies in a narrow, nearly degenerate energy window near the lowest optical exciton and that no eigenstate can be identified with a single localized triplet-pair configuration. Instead, each triplet-pair eigenstate is a quantum superposition of configurations containing all accessible intertriplet separations. This electronic structure explains the perceived absence of intramolecular triplet diffusion in pentacene oligomers, polypentacene, and polytetracene solutions, while leaving open the possibility of intermolecular singlet fission in films with appreciable interchain interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：correlated-electron calculations、Pariser-Parr-Pople Hamiltonian、configuration interaction、molecular exciton basis。；研究对象：多并五苯（polypentacene）中的光学自旋单重态和三重态-三重态多激子态，具体以三单元和四单元并五苯低聚物为微观模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有1(T1T1)本征态位于一个靠近最低光学激子的窄且近乎简并的能量窗口内，且每个三重态-三重态本征态都是包含所有可及三重态间距的量子叠加态，而非局域化的单个三重态对构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有1(T1T1)本征态位于一个靠近最低光学激子的窄且近乎简并的能量窗口内，且每个三重态-三重态本征态都是包含所有可及三重态间距的量子叠加态，而非局域化的单个三重态对构型。；创新点：揭示了并五苯低聚物中三重态-三重态多激子态并非局域化的单个三重态对，而是所有可能间距的量子叠加，从而解释了在并五苯低聚物、多并五苯和多并四苯溶液中观察不到分子内三重态扩散的现象，同时为具有显著链间相互作用的薄膜中发生分子间单线态裂变留下了可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Pariser-Parr-Pople哈密顿量、多参考单双激发组态相互作用（MRSDCI）方法，以及能分辨Frenkel激子、电荷转移态和三重态对（T1T1）构型在实空间中分布的分子激子基组。

papers.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
papers.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks are promising platforms for single-electron switching, chemical sensing, and biogating devices because of their nonlinear current--voltage ($I$--$V$) characteristics arising from collective Coulomb-blockade transport. However, the mechanisms governing this macroscopic behavior remain poorly understood because experimental measurements are generally limited to the network topology and global $I$--$V$ response. To address this, we developed a graph-based Kirchhoff framework that represents a self-assembled nanonecklace network as a graph, with nodes corresponding to junctions between necklace segments and edges to the conducting segments themselves. The solver returns the active nodes, conducting subgraph, nodal potentials, and edge currents at each applied bias, while allowing the activation-voltage statistics, network density, and structural topology to be varied independently. The model reproduces the experimentally observed non-Ohmic response, $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$, and shows that this behavior emerges from the collective, staggered activation of threshold junctions and voltage-driven percolation of the conducting subgraph. Independent parameter sweeps reveal that the mean activation voltage shifts the threshold $V_T$ while leaving $ζ$ nearly unchanged, increasing network density raises $ζ$ from approximately 1.9 to 3.1 and enhances current, and topology controls the response even at fixed density and node characteristics. These trends agree qualitatively with experimental observations and establish the model as a design tool for engineering collective transport in self-assembled nanonecklace devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：graph-based Kirchhoff framework、solver、model reproduces。；研究对象：自组装金纳米项链网络（gold nanonecklace networks）中的非欧姆电子输运现象，特别是由集体库仑阻塞输运引起的非线性电流-电压特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型成功复现了实验观测到的非欧姆响应 \( I \propto (V-V_T)^\zeta \)，并揭示该行为源于阈值结的集体、交错激活以及电压驱动的导电子图渗流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型成功复现了实验观测到的非欧姆响应 \( I \propto (V-V_T)^\zeta \)，并揭示该行为源于阈值结的集体、交错激活以及电压驱动的导电子图渗流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于图的基尔霍夫框架（graph-based Kirchhoff framework），将纳米项链网络建模为图，节点对应项链段之间的结，边对应导电段。通过求解器返回每个偏压下的活跃节点、导电子图、节点电势和边电流，并独立改变激活电压统计、网络密度和结构拓扑。

papers.title: Josephson effects in the spin-triplet superconductor/altermagnet/spin-triplet superconductor junctions: the detection of the intrinsic $\bf{d}$-vector
papers.abstract: We study the Josephson effects in the spin-triplet superconductor/altermagnet/spin-triplet superconductor junctions using the Green's function method. It is found that the current-phase difference relationships in the junctions strongly depend on the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vectors in the spin-triplet superconductors and the orientation angle of the altermagnet. For the given orientation angle, the $0$-$π$ transition can be obtained when the $\bf{d}$-vector is rotated. The variations of the critical current of the junctions with the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vector, the orientation angle and the strength of altermagnetism are systematically investigated. These Josephson effects can provide the distinguishable information about the direction of the $\bf{d}$-vector. Compared to the existing research, the proposed altermagnetic Josephson junctions can effectively avoid the negative influence of the magnetic field on the $\bf{d}$-vector and can serve as a feasible scheme for the detection of the intrinsic $\bf{d}$-vector. The obtained $0$-$π$ transition in the junctions can also have potential applications in the design of quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Green's function method（格林函数方法）、研究Josephson效应（约瑟夫森效应）。；研究对象：自旋三重态超导体/交变磁体/自旋三重态超导体（spin-triplet superconductor/altermagnet/spin-triplet superconductor）三明治结中的约瑟夫森效应，以及通过该效应检测自旋三重态超导体中本征的$\bf{d}$-矢量方向。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该结的电流-相位差关系强烈依赖于自旋三重态超导体中$\bf{d}$-矢量的方向和交变磁体的取向角；通过旋转$\bf{d}$-矢量可以实现$0$-$π$转变，这些约瑟夫森效应可提供区分$\bf{d}$-矢量方向的信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该结的电流-相位差关系强烈依赖于自旋三重态超导体中$\bf{d}$-矢量的方向和交变磁体的取向角；通过旋转$\bf{d}$-矢量可以实现$0$-$π$转变，这些约瑟夫森效应可提供区分$\bf{d}$-矢量方向的信息。；创新点：与现有研究相比，该工作提出的交变磁体约瑟夫森结可以有效避免磁场对$\bf{d}$-矢量的负面影响，从而提供一种可行的检测本征$\bf{d}$-矢量的方案；同时，结中实现的$0$-$π$转变在量子器件设计中具有潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数方法（Green's function method）进行理论计算，系统研究了临界电流随$\bf{d}$-矢量方向、交变磁体取向角以及交变磁性强度的变化。

papers.title: Hybrid-order nonlinear topological phases
papers.abstract: The bulk-boundary correspondence (BBC), which relates topological invariants to boundary modes, is well understood for linear systems but remains an open question in the presence of nonlinearity, where multigap topologies make the BBC obscure and the topological description troublesome. We address this by developing an auxiliary-system formalism that enables topological classification of nonlinear-eigenvalue systems. In the two-dimension (2D) case, we show that two fixed eigenvalues can harbor first-order gapless boundary modes and second-order corner modes. Stacking this 2D system along the third dimension (3D) reveals distinct hybrid-order realizations. Under uniform stacking, the corner states in the $xy$ plane transform into hinge states along the $z$ axis, yielding a 3D second-order phase, while the gapless boundary states become side-surface states, yielding a 3D first-order phase. For dimerized stacking, these states are further confined to the two ends of the $z$ axis, yielding a 3D third-order phase, and localized at the hinges, yielding a 3D second-order phase. Our results establish a multiband bulk-boundary correspondence and identify stacking engineering as a versatile platform for exploring hybrid-order topological phases in nonlinear systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：auxiliary-system formalism、topological classification、nonlinear-eigenvalue systems。；研究对象：非线性系统中的混合阶拓扑相，具体为二维和三维非线性本征值系统中的拓扑边界态与体-边对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过发展辅助系统形式理论，实现了对非线性本征值系统的拓扑分类，揭示了二维系统中固定本征值可同时支持一阶无隙边界态和二阶角态；通过沿第三维堆叠，可分别实现三维二阶相、三维一阶相、三维三阶相和三维二阶相，建立了多带体-边对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过发展辅助系统形式理论，实现了对非线性本征值系统的拓扑分类，揭示了二维系统中固定本征值可同时支持一阶无隙边界态和二阶角态；通过沿第三维堆叠，可分别实现三维二阶相、三维一阶相、三维三阶相和三维二阶相，建立了多带体-边对应关系。；创新点：首次在非线性系统中建立多带体-边对应关系，并提出堆叠工程作为探索非线性系统中混合阶拓扑相的平台。摘要未突出说明与线性系统拓扑相的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论形式化方法：发展辅助系统形式理论（auxiliary-system formalism），用于非线性本征值系统的拓扑分类；通过均匀堆叠和二聚化堆叠两种方式构建三维系统，分析不同堆叠下边界态、角态、铰链态和侧表面态的演化。

papers.title: Beyond the Parasitic Limit: A Nanoprobing Framework for De-embedding Intrinsic Ferroelectric Properties at the Deep Sub-Micrometer Scale
papers.abstract: The continued scaling of ferroelectric devices is critical for next-generation computing architectures, yet it is fundamentally challenged by a metrological bottleneck: at the deep sub-micrometer scale, intrinsic material properties are heavily masked by extrinsic parasitic impedances and geometric fringing fields. Here, we introduce a quantitative, in-situ nanoprobing framework capable of resolving the true electrical response of ferroelectric capacitors down to 165 nm in diameter without the need for lithographic bond pads. Using 20 nm thick AlScN as a model system, we establish a non-linear 'Screened Power Law' model to decouple attofarad-level device capacitances from massive near-field probe interactions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the apparent degradation of dielectric loss at the nanoscale is a geometric dilution artifact, which we overcome through a conductance scaling analysis. Finally, we apply this framework to large-signal characterization, utilizing leakage-compensation and noise filtering protocols to extract pristine intrinsic hysteresis (C-V and J-E) loops in the discrete few-grain limit. These findings provide a universal analytical toolkit required to overcome the measurement limits of deep-submicron ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：nanoprobing framework（纳米探针框架）、in-situ（原位）、measurement（测量）、characterization（表征）。；研究对象：深亚微米尺度（直径小至165 nm）的铁电电容器，具体以20 nm厚的AlScN薄膜作为模型系统。研究其本征铁电特性（如电容、介电损耗、迟滞回线）如何被寄生效应掩盖。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种定量原位纳米探针框架，能够从巨大的近场探针寄生相互作用中解耦出attofarad（10^-18 F）级别的本征器件电容，并揭示了纳米尺度下介电损耗的表观退化实际上是一种几何稀释假象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种定量原位纳米探针框架，能够从巨大的近场探针寄生相互作用中解耦出attofarad（10^-18 F）级别的本征器件电容，并揭示了纳米尺度下介电损耗的表观退化实际上是一种几何稀释假象。；创新点：首次在无需传统光刻焊盘的情况下，实现了对深亚微米（165 nm）铁电电容器的本征电学响应定量解耦，并系统性地识别和解决了纳米尺度下寄生阻抗和边缘场对介电损耗测量的误导性影响。
papers.method_zh: 1. **实验手段**：原位纳米探针技术，无需光刻键合焊盘。2. **建模方法**：建立非线性“屏蔽幂律（Screened Power Law）”模型，用于分离器件电容与探针寄生效应。3. **分析协议**：采用电导缩放分析（conductance scaling analysis）来消除几何稀释假象；利用漏电流补偿和噪声滤波协议提取本征的C-V和J-E迟滞回线。

papers.title: Physics adapted generative AI for metal insulator transition materials under label scarcity
papers.abstract: Metal-insulator-transition (MIT) materials are promising candidates for switchable electronics, neuromorphic hardware, and reconfigurable photonics, yet experimentally verified examples remain limited and the underlying mechanisms are often complex. We argue that generative AI for MIT discovery should move beyond the search for stable crystal structures alone and instead prioritize mechanism-informed phase-transition hypotheses. A modular physics-adapted framework, combined with staged verification of phase competition, electronic contrast, transition-pathway plausibility, and control accessibility, can guide credible discovery under severe label scarcity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：generative AI、physics-adapted framework、mechanism-informed hypotheses）；研究对象：金属-绝缘体相变（MIT）材料，具体涉及相变机制、电子对比度、相竞争等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出生成式AI用于MIT材料发现时，不应仅搜索稳定晶体结构，而应优先考虑机制驱动的相变假说；通过模块化物理适配框架结合分阶段验证，可在标签稀缺条件下实现可信的材料发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出生成式AI用于MIT材料发现时，不应仅搜索稳定晶体结构，而应优先考虑机制驱动的相变假说；通过模块化物理适配框架结合分阶段验证，可在标签稀缺条件下实现可信的材料发现。；创新点：将生成式AI的应用从稳定结构搜索转向机制驱动的相变假说生成与验证，并针对MIT材料标签稀缺问题提出分阶段物理约束验证策略。
papers.method_zh: 模块化物理适配生成式AI框架，包含分阶段验证流程：相竞争分析、电子对比度评估、相变路径合理性检验、控制可及性评估。摘要未明确说明具体AI模型或计算工具。

papers.title: Nonlocal Orbital-Angular-Momentum Dichroism of Vortex Light in Strained Crystals
papers.abstract: Vortex light carries orbital angular momentum (OAM) in its transverse phase, unlike spin, which is encoded in polarization. We show that this phase cannot produce OAM dichroism in any continuously translation-invariant system, even when optical nonlocality and multipole light--matter coupling are included. Nonuniform strain in a two-dimensional Dirac material bypasses this no-go condition by supplying transverse momentum transfer through a long-wavelength pseudo-gauge field, so that the OAM dichroism factorizes into a nonlocal elasto-optic tensor and the overlap of the vortex transverse phase current with the strain field. For a micron-scale Gaussian bubble, the resonant OAM-odd conductivity reaches \(\sim10^{-3}e^2/\hbar\), within reach of differential optical measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、factorizes、reaches（理论推导与数值估计，无实验或计算细节）。；研究对象：涡旋光（携带轨道角动量）与应变二维狄拉克材料（如石墨烯类体系）的相互作用，具体关注非均匀应变下涡旋光的轨道角动量二色性现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续平移对称系统中，涡旋光的轨道角动量无法产生二色性；但在非均匀应变的二维狄拉克材料中，应变通过长波赝规范场提供横向动量转移，从而产生可观测的轨道角动量二色性，其共振电导率可达~10⁻³ e²/ħ。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续平移对称系统中，涡旋光的轨道角动量无法产生二色性；但在非均匀应变的二维狄拉克材料中，应变通过长波赝规范场提供横向动量转移，从而产生可观测的轨道角动量二色性，其共振电导率可达~10⁻³ e²/ħ。；创新点：首次证明非均匀应变可以绕过连续平移对称性对轨道角动量二色性的禁止条件，并建立了非局域弹光张量与涡旋光横向相位电流的耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于连续平移对称性论证（no-go条件），引入非局域光-物质耦合和多极展开，利用赝规范场描述非均匀应变，并计算涡旋光与应变场的重叠积分，最终给出轨道角动量奇电导率的解析因子化形式及数值估计。

papers.title: Fixed-point tensor network for compactified boson conformal field theory
papers.abstract: Fixed-point (FP) tensor networks provide a discrete spacetime representation of conformal field theories (CFTs), offering a new route toward understanding holographic duality, generalized symmetries, and even quantum gravity. In this work, we construct FP tensors for the 2D compactified boson theory at a generic compactification radius, an archetypal irrational CFT, using boundary (open-string) data with conformal boundary conditions. We show that the resulting tensors reproduce the closed-string spectrum with high accuracy and generate stable renormalization-group (RG) flows under the tensor complex renormalization algorithm. Moreover, we identify a controllable exactly marginal deformation at the level of a single tensor, enabling flows that move continuously along the $c=1$ moduli space. This framework establishes a concrete lattice-level route toward describing a broad class of 2D irrational CFTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fixed-point tensor network、conformal field theory、renormalization-group flows。；研究对象：二维紧致玻色子共形场论（2D compactified boson CFT），特别是任意紧致半径下的非有理共形场论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用边界（开弦）数据与共形边界条件构建的定点张量网络，能够高精度地再现闭弦谱，并在张量复重整化算法下产生稳定的重整化群流；同时，在单个张量层面识别出可控的精确边缘形变，使流能沿c=1模空间连续移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用边界（开弦）数据与共形边界条件构建的定点张量网络，能够高精度地再现闭弦谱，并在张量复重整化算法下产生稳定的重整化群流；同时，在单个张量层面识别出可控的精确边缘形变，使流能沿c=1模空间连续移动。；创新点：首次为一般紧致半径下的二维紧致玻色子理论（一种典型的非有理CFT）构建了定点张量网络，并在张量层面实现了沿c=1模空间的连续边缘形变。
papers.method_zh: 定点张量网络（fixed-point tensor network）方法，结合共形边界条件（conformal boundary conditions）与边界（开弦）数据，并采用张量复重整化算法（tensor complex renormalization algorithm）。

papers.title: Robustness of quantized Hall resistivity under cavity coupling at zero temperature
papers.abstract: Recent experiments have shown that strong light-matter coupling in electromagnetic cavities can modify transport properties of quantum Hall systems through the formation of Landau polaritons, prompting questions about the robustness of topological protection. While earlier theory demonstrated that the Hall conductivity can be modified at finite temperature and finite polariton lifetime (or finite broadening), experiments primarily probe the resistivity tensor. Our phenomenological model reveals an asymmetry between conductivity and resistivity in quantum Hall systems under strong light-matter interaction, showing that at zero temperature the Hall resistivity remains completely immune to cavity-induced modifications arising from polariton broadening, independent of the light-matter coupling strength. These results provide a deeper explanation for the absence of renormalization in the von Klitzing constant in experiments probing the even QH plateaus through the Hall resistivity at low temperature, and clarify the distinct roles of dissipation and strong light-matter coupling in hybrid light-matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“phenomenological model”（现象学模型）和理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子霍尔系统在电磁腔中与光强耦合形成的Landau极化子体系，具体研究零温下霍尔电阻率对腔耦合的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温下，即使存在由极化子展宽（有限寿命）引起的腔诱导修正，量子霍尔系统的霍尔电阻率仍完全免疫于这些修正，且与光-物质耦合强度无关。这解释了为何低温霍尔电阻率实验中von Klitzing常数未出现重整化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温下，即使存在由极化子展宽（有限寿命）引起的腔诱导修正，量子霍尔系统的霍尔电阻率仍完全免疫于这些修正，且与光-物质耦合强度无关。这解释了为何低温霍尔电阻率实验中von Klitzing常数未出现重整化。；创新点：首次明确指出在零温下霍尔电阻率与霍尔电导率对腔耦合的响应存在本质不对称性，澄清了耗散与强光-物质耦合在混合光-物质系统中的不同作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用现象学模型，对比分析强光-物质相互作用下量子霍尔系统的电导率与电阻率张量，揭示两者在腔耦合下的不对称行为。

papers.title: Graphene Electric Double-Layer Transistors for Enhanced-Sensitivity Label-Free Detection of Human Serum Albumin
papers.abstract: Accurate detection of human serum albumin (HSA) is essential for the early diagnosis and monitoring of renal and hepatic disorders. We present a graphene-based electrolyte-gated field-effect transistor (EGFET) for label-free, real-time quantification of HSA under non-Faradaic operation. Devices exploit the high interfacial capacitance of the electric double layer (EDL) to transduce electrostatic perturbations induced by albumin adsorption into measurable conductance modulation. Negatively charged HSA molecules induce systematic modulation of the graphene channel, producing a concentration-dependent displacement of the Dirac voltage consistent with p-type doping. To establish a molecular-level interpretation of the sensing response, Brownian Dynamics simulations show that HSA adsorbs onto graphene through multiple adsorption orientations associated with heterogeneous interfacial charge distributions and variable dipole alignments relative to the surface. Adsorption is energetically stabilized by van der Waals interactions. Analysis of transfer characteristics across concentrations ranging from 0.01 to 30mgmL-1 reveals a correlation between surface charge density and carrier transport modulation within the electric double layer. Optimized devices exhibit a limit of detection of 0.0087 mg mL-1 and a linear dynamic range extending to 10 mg mL-1. The response remains non-Faradaic under sub-volt operation with reversible and reproducible behavior. The use of an inverse-mobility analytical metric highlights the role of disorder-enhanced carrier scattering in signal amplification, enabling sensitive electrostatic detection while preserving reversible device operation. These results establish liquid-gated graphene EGFETs as a promising platform for quantitative protein sensing and provide insight into disorder-mediated transport mechanisms in graphene bioelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：We present a graphene-based... transistor, Devices exploit, Optimized devices exhibit, The response remains...）；研究对象：基于石墨烯的电解质门控场效应晶体管（EGFET）用于无标记检测人血清白蛋白（HSA）的传感体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过利用电双层的高界面电容，石墨烯EGFET能够将HSA吸附引起的静电扰动转化为可测量的电导调制，实现了对HSA的高灵敏度无标记检测，检测限低至0.0087 mg/mL。布朗动力学模拟表明，HSA通过多种吸附取向吸附在石墨烯上，并由范德华相互作用稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过利用电双层的高界面电容，石墨烯EGFET能够将HSA吸附引起的静电扰动转化为可测量的电导调制，实现了对HSA的高灵敏度无标记检测，检测限低至0.0087 mg/mL。布朗动力学模拟表明，HSA通过多种吸附取向吸附在石墨烯上，并由范德华相互作用稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：将石墨烯EGFET与布朗动力学模拟相结合，从分子层面解释了传感响应机制，并利用逆迁移率指标揭示了无序散射对信号放大的贡献，实现了在亚伏特操作电压下的可逆、可重复、高灵敏度HSA检测。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：制备了基于石墨烯的电解质门控场效应晶体管（EGFET），在非法拉第（非电化学）操作模式下，通过测量转移特性曲线（Dirac电压位移）来定量检测不同浓度（0.01至30 mg/mL）的HSA。

papers.title: From Stacking Disorder to Cubic Order: Ice Crystallization from Deeply Supercooled Water
papers.abstract: Crystallization far from equilibrium can generate morphologies that defy classical crystal habits, yet the microscopic mechanisms linking atomic-scale disorder to emergent macroscopic order remain elusive. Here we use in situ cryogenic transmission electron microscopy with a membrane-encapsulated microdroplet platform to directly visualize the freezing of deeply supercooled water at molecular resolution. We show that homogeneous nucleation produces stacking-disordered ice composed of mixed hexagonal and cubic sequences, in which cubic ice initially exists only as isolated monolayers. The gradual thickening of these cubic layers constitutes the key kinetic mechanism that governs the entire crystallization pathway. As thickening proceeds, nanoscale, defect-free cubic ice germs nucleate on the basal planes of the disordered lattice. These faceted cubic germs act as facet-registered kinetic seeds that enforce cubic twinning and sequentially multiply growth branches. This kinetic pathway reproducibly generates robust eight-branched dendrites with global cubic (octahedral) symmetry, even though each branch remains highly stacking-disordered. At later stages, latent heat release drives a crossover to the thermodynamically favored hexagonal phase; remarkably, the pre-established global cubic symmetry is retained. These results reveal how strong kinetic driving forces convert microscopic disorder into emergent macroscopic symmetry, providing a general framework for understanding and controlling rapid crystallization far from equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了“in situ cryogenic transmission electron microscopy”（原位低温透射电子显微镜）进行直接可视化观察。；研究对象：深过冷水的结晶过程，具体研究从堆垛无序冰向立方冰的转变以及枝晶生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了深过冷水均相成核时，立方冰最初以孤立单层形式存在于堆垛无序冰中，其逐渐增厚是控制整个结晶路径的关键动力学机制；随后在无序晶格基面上形成无缺陷的立方冰晶核，通过立方孪晶和分支倍增生长出具有全局立方（八面体）对称性的八枝晶，且后期潜热释放引发的六方相转变仍保留该全局对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了深过冷水均相成核时，立方冰最初以孤立单层形式存在于堆垛无序冰中，其逐渐增厚是控制整个结晶路径的关键动力学机制；随后在无序晶格基面上形成无缺陷的立方冰晶核，通过立方孪晶和分支倍增生长出具有全局立方（八面体）对称性的八枝晶，且后期潜热释放引发的六方相转变仍保留该全局对称性。；创新点：首次在分子尺度上直接观察到深过冷水均相成核中立方冰从孤立单层增厚到形成无缺陷晶核，并揭示其通过立方孪晶和分支倍增产生全局八面体对称枝晶的动力学路径，以及后期六方相转变中全局对称性保留的反直觉现象。摘要未突出说明与以往堆垛无序冰研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用膜封装微滴平台的原位低温透射电子显微镜（cryo-TEM），在分子分辨率下直接观察深过冷水的冻结过程。

papers.title: Dyna-Mat: End-to-end benchmarking of foundation machine learning interatomic potentials in finite-temperature ensembles
papers.abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are increasingly being used as drop-in replacements for first-principles calculations, enabling simulations of materials at length and time scales that were previously inaccessible. However, due to lack of ground truth data, their accuracy on structural and dynamical observables in finite thermodynamic ensembles is yet to be established. Here, we introduce Dyna-Mat-v1.0, a benchmark dataset of condensed-phase first-principles molecular dynamics trajectories designed to test foundation MLIPs at realistic finite-temperature conditions. Using this dataset, we evaluate 15 foundation MLIPs across four model tiers by comparing both single-point energy and force errors on first-principles configurations and observables generated from MLIP-driven trajectories. We find that "on average" models with lower single-point force errors also yield lower errors for structural and dynamical observables. However, there are individual systems for which low force errors lead to qualitative failures in the predicted structure. Pressure remains poorly described across most models, pointing to limitations in the density functional theory stress labels available in current large-scale training datasets. Finally, we construct an accuracy-cost Pareto frontier to identify the best trade-offs for molecular dynamics with foundation MLIPs, finding that the latest generation of cross-trained models is close to Pareto-optimal according to the accuracy metrics considered here. Overall, Dyna-Mat-v1.0 shows that end-to-end finite-temperature validation is essential for quantifying the predictive behaviour of foundation MLIPs, and provides a simple, scalable route for assessing them beyond static and harmonic benchmarks relevant to materials design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：benchmark dataset、first-principles molecular dynamics trajectories、evaluate foundation MLIPs、accuracy-cost Pareto frontier。；研究对象：凝聚态相（condensed-phase）材料在有限温度系综下的结构和动力学可观测量，以及用于模拟这些材料的15种基础机器学习原子间势（foundation MLIPs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均而言，单点力误差较低的模型在结构和动力学可观测量上的误差也较低，但存在个别体系即使力误差很低也会导致预测结构出现定性错误；大多数模型对压力的描述仍然很差，这归因于当前大规模训练数据集中密度泛函理论应力标签的局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均而言，单点力误差较低的模型在结构和动力学可观测量上的误差也较低，但存在个别体系即使力误差很低也会导致预测结构出现定性错误；大多数模型对压力的描述仍然很差，这归因于当前大规模训练数据集中密度泛函理论应力标签的局限性。；创新点：提出了一个端到端的有限温度验证基准数据集Dyna-Mat-v1.0，用于系统评估基础MLIP在真实有限温度条件下的预测行为，超越了静态和谐波基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 构建了Dyna-Mat-v1.0基准数据集，包含凝聚态相的第一性原理分子动力学轨迹；通过比较单点能量和力误差以及MLIP驱动轨迹生成的可观测量，对四个模型层级的15种基础MLIP进行评估；并构建了精度-成本帕累托前沿（accuracy-cost Pareto frontier）来识别最佳权衡。

papers.title: Evidence of length scale effect in contact electrification in conducting thin film heterostructures
papers.abstract: Contact electrification between two conducting materials is expected to exhibit length scale effect because the screening effect will diminish in conductors as a function of material dimensions. As a consequence, the interfacial charge accumulation will diffuse away from interface/surface to a critical penetration depth as a function of material dimension. This work experimentally demonstrates the length scale effect in a permalloy and degenerately doped p-Si heterostructure system due to the flexoelectricity mediated contact electrification. The contact electrification induced interlayer charge transfer is observed through the whole thickness in case of 400 nm thick p-Si samples. Whereas, the charge carrier diffuses to a depth of 51 nm from the interface in case of 2 um thick Si. The length scale effect also leads to metal-insulator transition in p-Si layers in both cases. These results present a new opportunity to tailor the physical properties in conducting materials using contact electrification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally demonstrates、observed、samples。；研究对象：导电薄膜异质结中的接触起电长度尺度效应，具体材料体系为坡莫合金（permalloy）与重掺杂p-Si构成的异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在导电材料接触起电中，由于屏蔽效应随材料尺寸变化，界面电荷积累会扩散至与材料维度相关的临界穿透深度。实验在400 nm厚p-Si中观察到整个厚度范围内的层间电荷转移，而在2 μm厚Si中电荷扩散深度仅为51 nm，且两种情况下均导致p-Si层发生金属-绝缘体转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在导电材料接触起电中，由于屏蔽效应随材料尺寸变化，界面电荷积累会扩散至与材料维度相关的临界穿透深度。实验在400 nm厚p-Si中观察到整个厚度范围内的层间电荷转移，而在2 μm厚Si中电荷扩散深度仅为51 nm，且两种情况下均导致p-Si层发生金属-绝缘体转变。；创新点：首次实验证实了由于挠曲电效应介导的接触起电在导电薄膜异质结中产生的长度尺度效应，并发现该效应可调控导电材料的物理性质（如金属-绝缘体转变）。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：通过构建坡莫合金/重掺杂p-Si异质结构，利用接触起电诱导的层间电荷转移进行观测。摘要未明确说明具体表征技术（如电输运测量、扫描探针显微镜等）。

papers.title: Emergent $\mathbb{Z}$-type topology in a quasi-one-dimensional extended QWZ model
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of zero-dimensional topological end states in nanoribbons described by the Qi-Wu-Zhang (QWZ) model and its extensions with longer-range couplings. While dimensional reduction from two to one dimension is often assumed to preserve the symmetry classification of the parent system, here an additional symmetry can emerge originating from the real-space geometry of the ribbon. This symmetry acts as a chiral symmetry, combining orbital and spatial transformations, and promotes the effective one-dimensional system from symmetry class D to class BDI. We demonstrate that the existence of such a symmetry depends both on the long and end termination of the ribbon and exhibits an even-odd effect with respect to ribbon width, revealing that the commonly studied rectangular ribbons constitute a special high-symmetry case. For the conventional QWZ model, we derive analytic expressions for the topological phase boundaries of finite-width nanoribbons and characterize the resulting hybridization-gap phases through ($\mathbb{Z}_2 $) and winding-number invariants. We further show that extended QWZ models with longer-range couplings support phases with multiple topological end states and higher winding numbers. These phases arise through distinct mechanisms, including the hybridization of multiple edge modes inherited from higher-Chern-number bulk phases. Our results demonstrate that both long and end termination can fundamentally alter the topological classification of confined Chern insulators, highlighting the interplay between crystalline geometry, emergent symmetries, and dimensional reduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、demonstrate、derive analytic expressions、characterize。；研究对象：准一维扩展QWZ模型（Qi-Wu-Zhang模型及其长程耦合扩展）中的纳米带，具体研究其零维拓扑端态的出现以及由实空间几何导致的涌现对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准一维QWZ纳米带中，由于实空间几何（纳米带的长端和端部终止方式）可以涌现出一种手征对称性，将有效一维系统的对称性从D类提升至BDI类，从而支持Z型拓扑分类，并出现多重拓扑端态和更高绕数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准一维QWZ纳米带中，由于实空间几何（纳米带的长端和端部终止方式）可以涌现出一种手征对称性，将有效一维系统的对称性从D类提升至BDI类，从而支持Z型拓扑分类，并出现多重拓扑端态和更高绕数。；创新点：揭示了纳米带的实空间几何（长端和端部终止）可以涌现出手征对称性，从而改变受限陈绝缘体的拓扑分类，打破了通常认为降维保持对称性分类的假设；发现了矩形纳米带只是高对称性的特例，并展示了长程耦合可产生多重拓扑端态的新机制（包括来自高陈数体相的多边缘模杂化）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导：基于QWZ模型及其长程耦合扩展，推导有限宽度纳米带的拓扑相边界解析表达式，利用Z₂不变量和绕数（winding number）表征杂化能隙相，并分析不同终止方式与纳米带宽度奇偶效应。

papers.title: Quantum Destabilization of Skyrmions in Centrosymmetric Frustrated Magnets
papers.abstract: We investigate the role of the spin quantum number $s$ on the stability of skyrmions in a $J_1-J_2-J_3$ centrosymmetric quantum Heisenberg model on a square lattice using the neural network quantum states method. Our results reveal that the skyrmion stability $Q$ is severely degraded when transitioning from the semiclassical regime to the extreme quantum limit ($s=1/2$), where it ultimately vanishes. We demonstrate that this destabilization is driven by quantum longitudinal fluctuations, with $Q$ exhibiting a power-law decay as a function of the reciprocal spin moment $1/s$. Notably, the extreme quantum limit ($s=1/2$) deviates drastically from this scaling behavior, exhibiting distinct physics compared to larger spin moments. Furthermore, we reveal the microscopic origin of this decay by establishing a quantitative correspondence between skyrmion stability, entanglement, and local spin magnitude: as the local second Rényi entropy (an indicator of entanglement) increases and the local spin magnitude is suppressed, the skyrmion stability vanishes linearly. This regime marks a quantum state where the skyrmion number $C$ remains as remanent geometric feature of the spin orientations, yet the skyrmion stability $Q$ vanishes due to the longitudinal suppression of the local spin magnitude. Our findings suggest that classically robust skyrmion phases in frustrated lattices are fundamentally restricted to high-spin materials, indicating that a spin moment must of at least $s = 3/2$ is required for the realization of stable, atomic-scale topological textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：neural network quantum states method（神经网络量子态方法）、quantum Heisenberg model（量子海森堡模型）。；研究对象：中心对称阻挫磁体中斯格明子的量子稳定性，具体为正方晶格上的 \( J_1-J_2-J_3 \) 中心对称量子海森堡模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 斯格明子稳定性 \( Q \) 在从半经典极限过渡到极端量子极限（\( s=1/2 \)）时严重退化直至消失，且该失稳由量子纵向涨落驱动。实现稳定的原子尺度拓扑纹理要求自旋矩至少为 \( s=3/2 \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：斯格明子稳定性 \( Q \) 在从半经典极限过渡到极端量子极限（\( s=1/2 \)）时严重退化直至消失，且该失稳由量子纵向涨落驱动。实现稳定的原子尺度拓扑纹理要求自旋矩至少为 \( s=3/2 \)。；创新点：揭示了斯格明子稳定性 \( Q \) 与自旋矩倒数 \( 1/s \) 的幂律衰减关系，并建立了斯格明子稳定性、纠缠（局部二阶Rényi熵）与局部自旋幅度之间的定量对应关系，指出在极端量子极限下斯格明子数 \( C \) 作为残留几何特征仍存在，但稳定性 \( Q \) 因局部自旋幅度的纵向抑制而消失。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经网络量子态方法（neural network quantum states method）对正方晶格上的 \( J_1-J_2-J_3 \) 中心对称量子海森堡模型进行数值模拟，分析自旋量子数 \( s \) 对斯格明子稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Computational Determination of Optimal Growth Protocols for Metastable Polymorphs
papers.abstract: The reliable growth of a desired target structure remains a central challenge for organic-inorganic interfaces. Specific interface structures can exhibit properties that are superior compared to those of other possible interface structures, but identifying growth conditions that selectively produce a given surface structure is difficult, particularly when the target structure is thermodynamically metastable. Here, we demonstrate how time-dependent temperature and pressure protocols can be optimized to promote the high-yield formation of a metastable surface polymorph. To this end, we combine kinetic Monte Carlo simulations with a parameterized nucleation-and-growth model and apply optimal control theory to predict growth recipes that maximize the yield of the desired target structure. Applying this approach to a prototypical model of an organic molecules adsorbed on a metal surface, we identify experimentally plausible protocols that guide the system through phase space while avoiding kinetic growth regimes in which formation of the thermodynamically stable structure is favored. Compared to a manually optimized three-step protocol, the optimized control trajectory increases the yield of the desired metastable phase from 73 % to 97 % for the same total protocol duration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“kinetic Monte Carlo simulations”、“optimal control theory”、“computational determination”。；研究对象：有机分子在金属表面上的亚稳态表面多晶型物的生长过程，具体为有机-无机界面中目标亚稳态结构的择优生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合动力学蒙特卡洛模拟与最优控制理论，可以优化随时间变化的温度和压力协议，从而显著提高亚稳态表面多晶型物的产率。优化后的控制轨迹可将目标亚稳态相的产率从73%提升至97%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合动力学蒙特卡洛模拟与最优控制理论，可以优化随时间变化的温度和压力协议，从而显著提高亚稳态表面多晶型物的产率。优化后的控制轨迹可将目标亚稳态相的产率从73%提升至97%。；创新点：首次将最优控制理论应用于有机-无机界面中亚稳态表面多晶型物的生长协议优化，通过设计时间依赖的温度和压力路径，主动避开热力学稳定相形成的动力学生长区间，从而大幅提升亚稳态相的产率。
papers.method_zh: 动力学蒙特卡洛模拟（kinetic Monte Carlo simulations）、参数化成核-生长模型（parameterized nucleation-and-growth model）、最优控制理论（optimal control theory）。

papers.title: Pressure-Driven Structural Transitions without a Displacive Charge-Density Wave in La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: We investigated the structural properties of bilayer nickelate La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$ as a function of pressure and temperature. At ambient conditions, we show that the material crystallizes as a monoclinic superstructure distinct from the one previously reported and close to the pseudo-orthorhombic structure of pristine La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. No signatures of satellite reflections associated with charge density wave (CDW) ordering are detected at low temperature. Upon compression, a sequence of pressure-induced structural transitions from monoclinic to orthorhombic 15 GPa and then tetragonal 21 GPa symmetry is observed. Within the superconducting dome, the quality of the X-ray diffraction data enables structural refinements enabling theoretical models to understand the emergence of superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“X-ray diffraction data”和“structural refinements”，属于实验手段。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 在压力与温度下的结构性质，特别是其晶体结构、压力诱导的结构相变以及是否存在电荷密度波（CDW）序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常压低温下未检测到与电荷密度波（CDW）有序相关的卫星反射；在压力作用下，材料依次经历从单斜到正交（约15 GPa）再到四方（约21 GPa）的结构相变，且这些相变并非由位移型电荷密度波驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常压低温下未检测到与电荷密度波（CDW）有序相关的卫星反射；在压力作用下，材料依次经历从单斜到正交（约15 GPa）再到四方（约21 GPa）的结构相变，且这些相变并非由位移型电荷密度波驱动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可指出：该工作发现 La₂SmNi₂O₇ 在常压下具有与先前报道不同的单斜超结构，且未观察到电荷密度波序，这与某些相关体系不同。
papers.method_zh: 使用X射线衍射（XRD）技术，在不同压力与温度条件下进行结构表征与精修（structural refinements）。

papers.title: Stability and equilibria of a compressible elastic membrane in Stokes flow
papers.abstract: We formulate a continuum model for a compressible lipid-bilayer membrane immersed in Stokes flow, replacing exact local area inextensibility by conservation of an areal phospholipid density. The membrane free energy combines Helfrich bending, spontaneous curvature, and a finite area-compression penalty, so that membrane tension becomes a constitutive response to lipid-density variation rather than a Lagrange multiplier enforcing local area conservation. The resulting interfacial stress includes normal elastic forces and tangential Marangoni stresses generated by lipid redistribution; these stresses arise from membrane compressibility and can produce an effective negative tension when the local lipid density exceeds its preferred value. We further derive the linear stability of circular membranes in two dimensions and spherical membranes in three dimensions under full Stokes hydrodynamic coupling. In both cases, bending stabilizes the base shape, while excess lipid density destabilizes it by favoring increased membrane area. The first instability occurs in the lowest nontrivial shape mode, m = 2 in two dimensions and j = 2 in three dimensions. Energy expansions near onset show that the two-dimensional instability is a pitchfork bifurcation, whereas the three-dimensional instability is generically transcritical because prolate and oblate perturbations are geometrically distinct. These results provide a controlled compressible extension of classical vesicle mechanics and directly connect lipid-density variation, membrane tension, hydrodynamic coupling, and shape instability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“formulate a continuum model”（建立连续介质模型）、“derive the linear stability”（推导线性稳定性）、“Energy expansions”（能量展开）等理论推导和分析关键词。；研究对象：浸没在斯托克斯流中的可压缩脂质双分子层膜。具体研究其形状稳定性与平衡态，并探讨磷脂密度变化、膜张力、流体动力学耦合与形状不稳定性之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 膜的可压缩性（通过有限面积压缩惩罚引入）会导致脂质重新分布并产生切向马兰戈尼应力，从而产生有效负张力，使膜失稳。二维圆形膜和三维球形膜的最低阶非平凡形状模式（二维m=2，三维j=2）最先失稳，且二维失稳为叉形分岔，三维失稳为跨临界分岔。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：膜的可压缩性（通过有限面积压缩惩罚引入）会导致脂质重新分布并产生切向马兰戈尼应力，从而产生有效负张力，使膜失稳。二维圆形膜和三维球形膜的最低阶非平凡形状模式（二维m=2，三维j=2）最先失稳，且二维失稳为叉形分岔，三维失稳为跨临界分岔。；创新点：该工作为经典囊泡力学提供了一个可控的可压缩性扩展。其核心创新在于用本构关系（对脂质密度变化的响应）替代拉格朗日乘子来定义膜张力，从而将膜的可压缩性、脂质密度变化、膜张力、流体动力学耦合和形状不稳定性直接联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续介质模型，用磷脂面密度守恒替代严格的局部面积不可伸缩性。膜自由能结合了Helfrich弯曲能、自发曲率和有限面积压缩惩罚项。通过分析膜界面应力（包括法向弹性力和由脂质重新分布产生的切向马兰戈尼应力），并在全斯托克斯流体动力学耦合下，推导了二维圆形膜和三维球形膜的线性稳定性，并进行了失稳点附近的能量展开分析。

papers.title: What Makes Three-Dimensional Quantum Spin Liquids Possible?
papers.abstract: Quantum spin liquids are often introduced through a low-dimensional intuition: weak coordination and strong zero-point motion frustrate conventional magnetic order. This view has shaped much of the field, but it misses another route to quantum disorder. In many frustrated magnets, the more natural starting point is not a fluctuating version of an ordered state, but a locally constrained manifold of low-energy configurations. Within such a manifold, quantum dynamics can generate an emergent gauge theory, with fractionalized excitations and collective modes absent in ordinary magnets. Here we ask why such phases can be stable in three spatial dimensions.
