We argue that three-dimensional quantum spin liquids need not be regarded as fragile exceptions to the tendency of 3D magnets to order. They can arise when local constraints suppress premature order selection, coherent tunneling processes connect the constrained manifold, and the topology of gauge defects permits a deconfined regime. For compact gauge theories, three dimensions can even reverse the usual dimensional intuition: regimes that are unstable or fine-tuned in lower dimensions may become stable over finite regions of parameter space. We organize the discussion around constraint-driven Coulomb phases, weak harmonic order-by-disorder selection, and the role of spin-orbit or multipolar interactions in generating the required microscopic dynamics. We close with experimental diagnostics, candidate materials, and open theoretical questions for three-dimensional quantum spin liquids
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：argue、discussion、emergent gauge theory、theoretical questions。；研究对象：三维量子自旋液体的稳定性机制，特别是约束驱动库仑相、弱谐波序-by-无序选择、以及自旋-轨道或多极相互作用在其中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维量子自旋液体并非脆弱的例外，当局部约束抑制过早的序选择、相干隧穿过程连接约束流形、且规范缺陷的拓扑允许退禁闭区域时，它们可以稳定存在。在三维中，紧凑规范理论的某些原本在低维不稳定或需精细调谐的区域，反而可能在参数空间中稳定存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维量子自旋液体并非脆弱的例外，当局部约束抑制过早的序选择、相干隧穿过程连接约束流形、且规范缺陷的拓扑允许退禁闭区域时，它们可以稳定存在。在三维中，紧凑规范理论的某些原本在低维不稳定或需精细调谐的区域，反而可能在参数空间中稳定存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与论证，基于约束流形、规范理论、序-by-无序机制、以及自旋-轨道/多极相互作用的微观动力学框架。

papers.title: Color Centers in Cubic Boron Nitride
papers.abstract: Cubic boron nitride (c-BN) is a wide-bandgap semiconductor (WBGS) with potential applications in both power electronics and quantum technologies. Color centers in WBGS can be used as single photon emitters and quantum sensors. Several zero phonon lines have been measured in c-BN experiment but not yet identified. To systematically probe the combinatorially complex chemical space of defects, we generate a large-scale point defect data set for c-BN. We apply density functional theory calculation implemented in a high-throughput workflow Automatic Defect Analysis and Qualification (ADAQ) to broadly screen for point defect complexes containing s- or p-elements. More than 8000 defects have been calculated in different charge and spin states. The calculated properties are stored in defect database and are then filtered to find defects with properties similar to the NV-center in diamond. More accurate calculations using hybrid functionals are then performed on a selected set of promising defects to further assess their suitability for quantum technology. In particular, we reexamined the ONVB defect which likely explains the GC-2 line. The hybrid calculations also suggest other defect candidates with bright emission, such as two carbon defects and the NaB- defect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“density functional theory calculation”、“high-throughput workflow”、“hybrid functionals”等计算模拟方法。；研究对象：立方氮化硼（c-BN）中的色心缺陷，特别是可能用于量子技术的点缺陷复合体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量计算筛选，发现ONVB缺陷很可能对应实验测得的GC-2零声子线，并提出了其他具有明亮发光特性的候选缺陷，如两种碳相关缺陷和NaB⁻缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量计算筛选，发现ONVB缺陷很可能对应实验测得的GC-2零声子线，并提出了其他具有明亮发光特性的候选缺陷，如两种碳相关缺陷和NaB⁻缺陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用高通量工作流“自动缺陷分析与鉴定”（ADAQ）进行密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，系统计算了超过8000个包含s或p族元素的点缺陷在不同电荷和自旋态下的性质，随后对筛选出的候选缺陷使用杂化泛函进行更精确的计算。

papers.title: Variance of the $SIS$ Epidemic on Networks: A Diffusion Approximation
papers.abstract: Functional laws of large numbers (FLLNs) describe the mean-field trajectory of epidemics on networks, but say nothing about the fluctuations around it. These fluctuations are governed by moments of the degree distribution not relevant at the level of the mean. A rigorous functional central limit theorem (FCLT) exists for the susceptible--infected ($SI$) process on configuration-model graphs, but no analogue exists for $SIS$, where recovery reintroduces vertices into the susceptible pool with partially known neighborhoods, breaking the clean neighborhood distribution the $SI$ derivation relies on. We develop a tractable variance approximation for Markovian $SIS$ on configuration-model graphs, combining Gleeson's approximate master equation (AME) framework with a van Kampen system-size expansion in the spirit of the $SI$ FCLT. We derive a closed drift and diffusion matrix for a reduced susceptible/$SI$-edge/$SS$-edge count vector and obtain the time-dependent covariance via the associated Langevin/Lyapunov equation. Validation against Gillespie simulation across Poisson, regular, and power-law networks shows close agreement, with deviations near the epidemic threshold and in strongly heterogeneous networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：扩散近似、主方程、系统尺寸展开、Langevin/Lyapunov方程。；研究对象：网络上的SIS（易感-感染-易感）流行病传播过程，具体研究配置模型图（configuration-model graphs）上该过程的随机波动（方差）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合Gleeson近似主方程（AME）与van Kampen系统尺寸展开，推导出SIS流行病在配置模型网络上的封闭漂移-扩散矩阵，从而获得随时间变化的协方差，该近似在Poisson、正则和幂律网络上与Gillespie模拟结果吻合良好，但在流行病阈值附近和强异质网络中偏差较大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合Gleeson近似主方程（AME）与van Kampen系统尺寸展开，推导出SIS流行病在配置模型网络上的封闭漂移-扩散矩阵，从而获得随时间变化的协方差，该近似在Poisson、正则和幂律网络上与Gillespie模拟结果吻合良好，但在流行病阈值附近和强异质网络中偏差较大。；创新点：首次为SIS过程（而非已有的SI过程）在配置模型网络上建立了可处理的方差近似方法，克服了SIS中恢复过程引入部分已知邻域、破坏SI推导中干净邻域分布的问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Gleeson近似主方程（AME）与van Kampen系统尺寸展开（类似SI过程泛函中心极限定理的思路）；推导出约化的易感态/SI边/SS边计数向量的封闭漂移和扩散矩阵，并通过关联的Langevin/Lyapunov方程求解时变协方差；验证手段：Gillespie随机模拟。

papers.title: Many-body quantum chaos in excitonic spectra from first principles
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that realistic excitonic many-body Hamiltonians obtained from first-principles GW-Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations can exhibit quantum chaos governed by random-matrix universality. Considering a prototypical van der Waals heterostructure (WS$_2$-graphene), with and without lattice disorder, we analyze their energy-resolved spectral correlations and identify a disorder-driven crossover from regular to complete chaotic dynamics. We show that while pristine samples exhibit incomplete chaos (non-ergodicity) due to an approximate valley symmetry that restricts excitonic mixing, the presence of disorder-induced electronic flat bands act as a catalyst for valley mixing to drive the system into a fully developed chaotic (ergodic) regime with reduced symmetry. Crucially, fluctuations in many-body oscillator strengths are shown to follow universal Porter-Thomas statistics, directly linking the underlying quantum chaos and experimentally accessible optical observables. Finally, by examining long-range spectral correlations, we estimate the Thouless time associated to excitonic mixing across the entire many-body bandwidth. Our results establish excitons as a highly tunable platform for probing many-body ergodicity and its spectroscopic signatures in realistic interacting 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：first-principles GW-Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations、random-matrix universality、spectral correlations。；研究对象：激子多体系统中的量子混沌现象，具体材料为WS₂-石墨烯范德瓦尔斯异质结（含与不含晶格无序）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从第一性原理GW-BSE计算得到的真实激子多体哈密顿量可表现出随机矩阵理论描述的量子混沌；无序诱导的电子平带能催化谷混合，使系统从非遍历的规则动力学转变为完全混沌的遍历态，且多体振子强度涨落服从普适的Porter-Thomas统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从第一性原理GW-BSE计算得到的真实激子多体哈密顿量可表现出随机矩阵理论描述的量子混沌；无序诱导的电子平带能催化谷混合，使系统从非遍历的规则动力学转变为完全混沌的遍历态，且多体振子强度涨落服从普适的Porter-Thomas统计。；创新点：首次在真实材料的第一性原理激子模型中证明量子混沌与随机矩阵普适性，并揭示无序诱导的电子平带作为谷混合催化剂驱动完全混沌态，同时将多体振子强度涨落与实验可观测的光学响应直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理GW-Bethe-Salpeter方程（GW-BSE）计算，构建真实激子多体哈密顿量；通过能量分辨的谱关联分析、长程谱关联（Thouless时间估计）以及振子强度统计分布研究混沌行为。

papers.title: Anomalous Structural Response of Quasi-One-Dimensional Antiferromagnetic Metal KMn6Bi5 under high pressure
papers.abstract: We report high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements on the quasi-one-dimensional (Q1D) antiferromagnetic metal KMn6Bi5 up to 12.5 GPa, revealing the detailed pressure evolution of its atomic coordination environment. We find that the lattice exhibits pronounced anisotropic compressibility-the relative changes in the a and b lattice parameters reach a/a0=0.91 and b/b0 = 0.94 at 12.5 GPa-and a distinct structural anomaly emerges near 11 GPa without any symmetry-breaking. Detailed structural analysis further uncovers an anomalous hardening of the Mn nanotubes between 5 and 11 GPa, followed by a configuration optimization of the Mn/Bi nanotubes around 11 GPa. These features correlate closely with the reported pressure-temperature phase diagram of KMn6Bi5 and compare favorably with the chemical pressure effects induced by substituting K with Na, Rb, or Cs. Our findings provide key microscopic insights into how coordination environment modulation governs the stability of electronic orders in low-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements”（高压单晶X射线衍射测量）。；研究对象：准一维反铁磁金属KMn6Bi5在高压下的原子配位环境与结构响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: KMn6Bi5在高压下表现出显著的各向异性压缩性，并在约11 GPa处出现无对称性破缺的结构异常，伴随Mn纳米管在5–11 GPa间的反常硬化及11 GPa附近的构型优化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：KMn6Bi5在高压下表现出显著的各向异性压缩性，并在约11 GPa处出现无对称性破缺的结构异常，伴随Mn纳米管在5–11 GPa间的反常硬化及11 GPa附近的构型优化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高压单晶X射线衍射测量（压力最高达12.5 GPa），结合结构精修分析原子配位环境随压力的演化。

papers.title: Enhanced hydrogen response of copper-doped TiO$_2$ synthesised by helium-assisted magnetron sputtering
papers.abstract: Cu-doped TiO$_2$ thin films for hydrogen sensing were synthesised by reactive DC magnetron sputtering in Ar/O$_2$/He mixtures, with the He fraction used as a control parameter for film growth. By combining normal-angle deposition (NAD) and glancing-angle deposition (GLAD) with post-deposition annealing, the effects of He on microstructure formation and sensor performance were examined. X-ray diffraction and electron microscopy revealed that He promotes nanostructuring, lattice expansion in as-deposited NAD films, increased porosity after annealing, and a stronger anatase character in the final oxide layers. These structural changes, which enhance the reactive surface area, lead to improved hydrogen sensing at 300\,$^\circ$C in 1~vol.\,\% H$_2$. The response of NAD films increased from 1.4 to 6.0 simply by replacing part of the argon with helium, whereas GLAD films showed only a modest increase. The observed nanostructuring is discussed in terms of a simulation-supported growth scenario involving energetic backscattered He, a reduced hammering effect, and cooling-related suppression of adatom mobility, which together favour the formation of a more open sensing layer. Helium-assisted sputtering represents a useful physical route for tailoring oxide thin films for gas-sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜合成（reactive DC magnetron sputtering）、结构表征（X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy）和性能测试（hydrogen sensing）等实验手段。；研究对象：铜掺杂二氧化钛（Cu-doped TiO₂）薄膜，用于氢气传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在溅射过程中用氦气（He）部分替代氩气（Ar），可显著促进TiO₂薄膜的纳米结构化和孔隙率增加，从而大幅提升其在300°C下对1 vol.% H₂的传感响应（NAD薄膜响应值从1.4提升至6.0）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在溅射过程中用氦气（He）部分替代氩气（Ar），可显著促进TiO₂薄膜的纳米结构化和孔隙率增加，从而大幅提升其在300°C下对1 vol.% H₂的传感响应（NAD薄膜响应值从1.4提升至6.0）。；创新点：提出并验证了氦辅助磁控溅射作为一种物理调控手段，通过调控He比例来诱导薄膜纳米结构化和孔隙率增加，从而优化氧化物薄膜的气敏性能。摘要未突出说明与已有铜掺杂TiO₂氢气传感工作的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 反应直流磁控溅射（在Ar/O₂/He混合气氛中），结合正角度沉积（NAD）和掠角沉积（GLAD）以及沉积后退火处理；结构表征采用X射线衍射和电子显微镜；传感性能测试在300°C、1 vol.% H₂条件下进行；生长机制分析辅以模拟支持。

papers.title: One-dimensional carbon nanostructures with periodic graphitic nitrogen substitution
papers.abstract: Heteroatom substitution is a powerful route to tune the chemical and electronic properties of carbon nanomaterials. In particular, replacement of an sp2 hybridized carbon atom in the graphene lattice with a nitrogen atom (denoted as graphitic nitrogen) induces substantial changes in the electronic properties. These include changes in the band structure that can influence electronic transport, and magnetism. A key requirement for applications is both the periodic and precise incorporation of the heteroatoms in extended carbon lattices. Here, we report the on-surface synthesis and characterization of two one dimensional carbon nanostructures, a polymer and a graphene nanoribbon, consisting of periodically incorporated graphitic nitrogen atoms. The on-surface reactions toward formation of the nanostructures were monitored by scanning tunneling microscopy. The bond-resolved chemical structures of the reaction intermediates and products were investigated by atomic force microscopy, which enabled atomic-scale visualization of the graphitic nitrogen sites. The electronic properties of the nanostructures were studied by scanning tunneling spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations. Our analyses revealed the presence of localized nitrogen-centered electronic states. In the gas phase where the nanostructures are in a neutral charge state, these states undergo spin polarization leading to an open-shell ground state. Upon adsorption on Au(111), the nanostructures exhibit electron transfer to the surface, which resulted in a closed-shell ground state. Our results demonstrate a straightforward and generally applicable route to synthesize graphitic nitrogen-substituted carbon nanomaterials with potential applications in spintronics, catalysis and energy storage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：on-surface synthesis, scanning tunneling microscopy, atomic force microscopy, scanning tunneling spectroscopy）；研究对象：两种一维碳纳米结构——一种聚合物和一种石墨烯纳米带，其中周期性掺入石墨型氮原子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在气相（中性电荷态）中，氮中心电子态发生自旋极化，导致开壳层基态；吸附于Au(111)表面后，电子转移至表面，导致闭壳层基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在气相（中性电荷态）中，氮中心电子态发生自旋极化，导致开壳层基态；吸附于Au(111)表面后，电子转移至表面，导致闭壳层基态。；创新点：实现了石墨型氮原子在扩展碳晶格中的周期性和精确掺入，并通过原子级成像直接可视化氮位点，揭示了电荷态依赖的自旋极化行为。
papers.method_zh: 表面合成（on-surface synthesis）、扫描隧道显微镜（STM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描隧道谱（STS）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: NanoBTE: Fast Iterative Solution of the Phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation for Nanoscale Heat Transport
papers.abstract: Nanoscale heat dissipation has become a critical challenge in advanced semiconductor devices, where phonon transport can strongly deviate from the classical Fourier description owing to boundary scattering and ballistic effects. Here, we propose NanoBTE, a deterministic finite-volume solver for the non-gray phonon Boltzmann transport equation under the relaxation-time approximation. NanoBTE supports complex two- and three-dimensional geometries, band-resolved phonon properties, discrete-ordinates angular quadrature, volumetric heat generation, and multiple phonon boundary conditions, including thermalizing, diffuse, and specular reflections. To improve the efficiency of multiscale simulations, we implement both sequential and synthetic iterative schemes, with the latter coupling the microscopic phonon transport equation to a macroscopic diffusion-type temperature equation to accelerate convergence in near-diffusive regimes. Furthermore, NanoBTE adopts a band-direction task decomposition strategy, enabling efficient MPI-based CPU parallelization and GPU acceleration of the dominant sparse transport operations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“deterministic finite-volume solver”（确定性有限体积求解器）、“simulations”（模拟）、“MPI-based CPU parallelization and GPU acceleration”（基于MPI的CPU并行化和GPU加速）。；研究对象：纳米尺度下的热输运现象，具体为半导体器件中由声子主导的热传导过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该工作旨在解决纳米尺度下声子输运偏离经典傅里叶定律的挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该工作旨在解决纳米尺度下声子输运偏离经典傅里叶定律的挑战。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的核心创新点，但可总结其技术特点：1）开发了一个支持复杂几何和多种边界条件的非灰体声子BTE确定性求解器；2）提出了耦合微观与宏观方程的合成迭代方案以加速近扩散区的收敛；3）实现了高效的能带-方向任务分解并行策略，支持CPU和GPU异构计算。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种名为NanoBTE的确定性有限体积求解器，用于在弛豫时间近似下求解非灰体声子玻尔兹曼输运方程。该方法支持复杂2D/3D几何、能带分辨的声子特性、离散纵标角求积、体积热生成以及多种声子边界条件（热化、漫反射、镜面反射）。为提高多尺度模拟效率，实现了顺序迭代和合成迭代两种方案，后者将微观声子输运方程与宏观扩散型温度方程耦合以加速近扩散区的收敛。计算上采用了能带-方向任务分解策略，支持基于MPI的CPU并行化和GPU加速。

papers.title: Data-driven multi-objective optimization for alloy recycling using factorization machines and quantum annealing
papers.abstract: Quantum annealing has the potential to provide practical quantum advantage for complex optimization tasks. Here, we present a systematic assessment of an integrated factorization-machine and quantum-annealing workflow (FM+QA) for a technologically relevant application: multi-objective Pareto optimization in metal up-cycling through alloy design. To address the non-convex nature of the Pareto front, we employ the recently proposed data-driven Tchebycheff scalarization (DDTS) scheme. Our results show that FM+QA extends the applicability of QUBO-based optimization to data-driven materials discovery problems with multiple competing objectives. In particular, we analyze the scaling behavior of the approach and compare quantum annealing with classical simulated annealing using both regular binary encoding and one-hot encoding. Finally, we provide a critical perspective on the problem sizes and encoding strategies for which quantum-annealing-based optimization may become practically beneficial in the near future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：quantum annealing, factorization machines, QUBO-based optimization, simulated annealing）；研究对象：合金回收（metal up-cycling）中的多目标帕累托优化问题，具体为通过合金设计实现多目标优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将因子分解机与量子退火结合的工作流（FM+QA）能够将基于QUBO的优化扩展到具有多个竞争目标的数据驱动材料发现问题中，并展示了其扩展行为，同时比较了量子退火与经典模拟退火在不同编码策略下的表现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将因子分解机与量子退火结合的工作流（FM+QA）能够将基于QUBO的优化扩展到具有多个竞争目标的数据驱动材料发现问题中，并展示了其扩展行为，同时比较了量子退火与经典模拟退火在不同编码策略下的表现。；创新点：首次系统评估了FM+QA工作流在合金回收这一技术相关应用中的表现，并针对问题规模和编码策略给出了量子退火可能在未来实际受益的临界视角。
papers.method_zh: 因子分解机（factorization machines）与量子退火（quantum annealing）集成工作流；采用数据驱动切比雪夫标量化（DDTS）方案处理非凸帕累托前沿；对比经典模拟退火（simulated annealing）及两种编码策略（regular binary encoding 和 one-hot encoding）。

papers.title: Effective potentials for polar molecules under non-orthogonal dual microwave fields
papers.abstract: Dual-microwave shielding has emerged as a powerful tool for stabilizing ultracold polar molecules while tuning their intermolecular interactions. However, the two microwave fields are generally not perfectly orthogonal in experiments. Such misalignment introduces an in-plane component of the linearly polarized microwave, whose frequency differs from that of the elliptically polarized field. This component prevents complete cancellation of the dipole-dipole interaction and, more critically, renders the single-molecule dressed state intrinsically time-dependent, so that the conventional time-independent scattering framework is no longer available. Here we develop a Floquet theory that yields an analytic effective potential and enables accurate scattering calculations for polar molecules in non-orthogonal dual microwave fields. We find that, though misalignment weakens the shielding moderately, inelastic losses remain strongly suppressed under experimentally relevant conditions. Meanwhile, misalignment provides additional tunability of the interaction anisotropy and strength, which has been directly applied to recent experimental observations on the gas-to-droplet transition~[Z. Shi \textit{et al}, arXiv:2508.20518 (2025)] and Fermi-surface deformation in microwave-shielded molecular gases~[S. Biswas \textit{et al}, arXiv:2602.22447]. The framework is not restricted to dual-microwave shielding and can be generalized straightforwardly to arbitrary multi-frequency driving, providing a versatile tool for manipulating ultracold polar molecules under complex microwave configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a Floquet theory”、“yields an analytic effective potential”、“enables accurate scattering calculations”，属于理论框架构建与计算分析。；研究对象：非正交双微波场中的超冷极性分子体系，具体研究微波场非正交性对分子间相互作用、屏蔽效应及散射行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非正交双微波场虽会削弱屏蔽效果，但在实验相关条件下非弹性损失仍被强烈抑制；同时，非正交性提供了额外的相互作用各向异性和强度可调性，可直接解释近期实验中观察到的气-液滴转变和费米面形变现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非正交双微波场虽会削弱屏蔽效果，但在实验相关条件下非弹性损失仍被强烈抑制；同时，非正交性提供了额外的相互作用各向异性和强度可调性，可直接解释近期实验中观察到的气-液滴转变和费米面形变现象。；创新点：首次建立了适用于非正交双微波场的Floquet理论框架，解决了传统时间无关散射理论无法处理单分子缀饰态本征时间依赖性的问题，并证明该框架可推广至任意多频驱动场景。
papers.method_zh: Floquet理论分析，推导出解析有效势，并基于此进行精确散射计算。

papers.title: Martensitic Transformation in Crystal-Amorphous Superlattices of NiTi Shape Memory Alloy
papers.abstract: Shape memory alloys (SMAs) exhibit unique thermo-mechanical properties arising from reversible martensitic transformation. Tailoring these properties through coherent second phases is effective but is often limited by the difficulty of identifying thermodynamically compatible phases. Crystal-amorphous superlattices (CAS), in which the second phase is derived from the base material itself, provide an attractive alternative. However, the influence of partial amorphization on martensitic transformation and thermo-mechanical behavior remains largely unexplored. Here, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations are used to investigate temperature- and stress-induced martensitic transformations in CAS-NiTi with different crystalline phase fractions. Partial amorphization fundamentally modifies the transformation pathway, introducing an initial continuous (second-order-like) transformation before the conventional first-order martensitic transformation. The amorphous phase also enhances transformation reversibility, reducing the thermal hysteresis from 275 K in fully crystalline NiTi to 95-110 K in CAS-NiTi. Simultaneously, the elastic modulus and the critical stress for stress-induced martensitic transformation increase by approximately 60-90 percent, depending on the crystalline fraction. These improvements originate from heterogeneous nucleation at crystal-amorphous interfaces, retained austenite that promotes the reverse transformation, and mechanical constraint imposed by the amorphous phase. These findings establish crystal-amorphous superlattices as a promising microstructural design strategy for tailoring the thermo-mechanical performance of shape memory alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“large-scale molecular dynamics simulations”（大规模分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料、体系或物理现象是：晶体-非晶超晶格（Crystal-Amorphous Superlattices, CAS）中的NiTi形状记忆合金，以及其马氏体相变和热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 部分非晶化从根本上改变了NiTi的相变路径，引入了一个类似二级相变的连续转变过程，并显著提高了相变可逆性（热滞从275 K降至95-110 K），同时使弹性模量和应力诱发马氏体相变的临界应力提高了约60-90%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：部分非晶化从根本上改变了NiTi的相变路径，引入了一个类似二级相变的连续转变过程，并显著提高了相变可逆性（热滞从275 K降至95-110 K），同时使弹性模量和应力诱发马氏体相变的临界应力提高了约60-90%。；创新点：该工作首次系统探索了部分非晶化（即晶体-非晶超晶格结构）对NiTi形状记忆合金马氏体相变和热力学行为的影响，揭示了非晶相通过异质成核、保留奥氏体和机械约束等机制来调控性能，为设计形状记忆合金的微观结构提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics, MD）模拟，研究了不同晶相分数下CAS-NiTi在温度和应力诱导下的马氏体相变。

papers.title: Finite-Time Thermodynamics of Battery Discharging: Power-Efficiency Trade-Off and Optimization
papers.abstract: Battery discharging is governed by a fundamental trade-off between output power and energy conversion efficiency due to internal dissipation. In this paper, we demonstrate that such a trade-off universally yields a parabolic envelope $P\proptoη(1-η)$. The efficiency at maximum power is exactly one half, mirroring the well-known half-Carnot limit in finite-time thermodynamics. To extend this bound into practical operational rules, we formulate a multistage constant-current discharging (MSCD) schedule subject to simultaneous real-time load demands and a global discharging deadline. Analytical resolution via the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker conditions reveals a remarkably compact optimal policy: $I_{i}^{\star}=\max(I_{i}^{-},I_{0})$. Under this rule, stages limited by external demand run exactly at their minimum required currents, while all remaining stages are elevated to a uniform baseline $I_{0}$ fixed by the deadline constraint. By tracing the dissipation--time Pareto front, we quantify how internal resistance shifts the operational boundaries and sharpens the trade-off corner. This analysis establishes a rigorous thermodynamic baseline for the scheduling layer of battery management systems, offering natural extensions to nonlinear models incorporating temperature and state-of-charge dependencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学建模（如抛物线包络线、KKT条件解析求解）、优化理论（多阶段恒流放电调度）和热力学分析（有限时间热力学、耗散-时间帕累托前沿），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：电池放电过程中的有限时间热力学行为，具体研究输出功率与能量转换效率之间的权衡关系，以及多阶段恒流放电（MSCD）调度策略。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电池放电的功率-效率权衡普遍遵循抛物线包络线 \( P \propto \eta(1-\eta) \)，且最大功率下的效率恰好为1/2，类似于有限时间热力学中的半卡诺极限。最优放电策略为 \( I_{i}^{\star}=\max(I_{i}^{-},I_{0}) \)，即受外部需求限制的阶段以最小所需电流运行，其余阶段统一提升至由截止时间约束决定的基线电流 \( I_{0} \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电池放电的功率-效率权衡普遍遵循抛物线包络线 \( P \propto \eta(1-\eta) \)，且最大功率下的效率恰好为1/2，类似于有限时间热力学中的半卡诺极限。最优放电策略为 \( I_{i}^{\star}=\max(I_{i}^{-},I_{0}) \)，即受外部需求限制的阶段以最小所需电流运行，其余阶段统一提升至由截止时间约束决定的基线电流 \( I_{0} \)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限时间热力学框架，通过数学推导建立功率-效率的抛物线关系；利用Karush–Kuhn–Tucker（KKT）条件解析求解多阶段恒流放电调度优化问题；通过耗散-时间帕累托前沿分析内阻对运行边界的影响。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Encapsulation Methods for Endohedral Doping of Single-Wall Carbon Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Single wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are promising building blocks for nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices, yet reliable and stable doping, particularly n type, remains challenging due to strong environmental sensitivity and competing extrinsic effects. Encapsulation of charge transfer molecules within the SWCNT cavity offers a promising route to stable doping while preserving the nanotubes outer surface for subsequent processing. Here, we systematically investigate the filling of arc discharge SWCNTs with the electron donor tetrathiafulvalene and electron acceptor tetracyanoquinodimethane, comparing different methods for filling, including melt filling, solution reflux, and vacuum phase sublimation. We follow the entire processing workflow from raw, unfilled powders to aqueous dispersions and employ density gradient ultracentrifugation to separate filled from empty nanotubes as well as metallic from semiconducting ones. Encapsulation efficiency and electronic modification are assessed using absorption spectroscopy, resonant Raman scattering, thermogravimetric analysis, and electron paramagnetic resonance. Finally, we introduce a complementary vacuum-phase method that removes externally adsorbed molecules without extensive solvent washing, enabling cleaner encapsulated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：systematically investigate、filling、absorption spectroscopy、Raman scattering、thermogravimetric analysis、electron paramagnetic resonance。；研究对象：单壁碳纳米管（SWCNTs）的内嵌掺杂方法，具体材料为电弧放电法制备的SWCNTs，掺杂剂为电子给体四硫富瓦烯（TTF）和电子受体四氰基对苯二醌二甲烷（TCNQ）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统比较了熔融填充、溶液回流和真空相升华三种内嵌掺杂方法，并引入了一种无需大量溶剂清洗即可去除外部吸附分子的互补真空相方法，从而获得更清洁的内嵌掺杂体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统比较了熔融填充、溶液回流和真空相升华三种内嵌掺杂方法，并引入了一种无需大量溶剂清洗即可去除外部吸附分子的互补真空相方法，从而获得更清洁的内嵌掺杂体系。；创新点：首次系统比较了三种不同内嵌掺杂方法（熔融填充、溶液回流、真空相升华）对SWCNTs的填充效果，并开发了一种新的真空相方法以简化后处理步骤、减少外部吸附分子污染。
papers.method_zh: 采用熔融填充、溶液回流和真空相升华三种方法进行内嵌填充；使用密度梯度超速离心分离填充与未填充的纳米管以及金属性与半导体性纳米管；通过吸收光谱、共振拉曼散射、热重分析和电子顺磁共振评估封装效率和电子修饰效果。

papers.title: Self-Driven Atomic Dispersion in Graphitic Layers
papers.abstract: Carbon-supported single-atom catalysts maximize metal utilization, but how metal nanoparticles transform into isolated atoms within carbon remains unclear. We show that metal nanoparticles can undergo a self-driven dispersion process under hydrocarbon oxidation conditions, transforming into single atoms that are confined in carbon matrix. Using Pt-catalysed hydrocarbon oxidation as a model, we combine operando electron microscopy, near-ambient-pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and mass spectrometry to track coupled structural and chemical evolution. Graphitic carbon grows at step edges of Pt nanoparticle, continuously reconstructing Pt surface and generating undercoordinated sites for atom release. In-situ generated CO accumulates at the metal-carbon interface, weakening bonding and facilitating self-amplified atom release and migration. Defective carbon overlayers then trap, stabilize and transport liberated atoms, while oxidative etching preserves interfacial access of reaction-gas. Similar behaviour across other metals suggests a general atomization pathway for single-atom catalyst synthesis, yielding products with electrocatalytic hydrogen production activity beyond standard commercial benchmarks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了 operando electron microscopy（原位电子显微镜）、near-ambient-pressure X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy（近常压X射线光电子能谱）和 mass spectrometry（质谱）等实验手段。；研究对象：碳负载的单原子催化剂中，金属纳米颗粒在碳基质中自驱动分散为单原子的物理化学过程。具体以铂（Pt）催化碳氢化合物氧化为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现金属纳米颗粒在碳氢化合物氧化条件下，可以经历一个自驱动的分散过程，转变为被碳基质束缚的单原子。该过程的关键在于石墨碳在Pt纳米颗粒台阶边缘生长，原位生成的CO在金属-碳界面累积，共同促进了原子的释放、迁移和稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现金属纳米颗粒在碳氢化合物氧化条件下，可以经历一个自驱动的分散过程，转变为被碳基质束缚的单原子。该过程的关键在于石墨碳在Pt纳米颗粒台阶边缘生长，原位生成的CO在金属-碳界面累积，共同促进了原子的释放、迁移和稳定。；创新点：揭示了一种金属纳米颗粒在反应条件下自驱动转变为单原子的普适性路径，并阐明了其微观机制（石墨碳生长、CO界面累积、缺陷碳层捕获等），为单原子催化剂的合成提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 结合了原位电子显微镜（operando electron microscopy）、近常压X射线光电子能谱（NAP-XPS）和质谱（mass spectrometry），用于追踪耦合的结构和化学演化过程。

papers.title: Substrate-Mediated Persistent Photodoping in WSe2/hBN Field-Effect Transistors Enabled by Defect States in SiO2
papers.abstract: Photodoping plays an important role in determining the optoelectronic response of two-dimensional semiconductor devices; however, the origin of the responsible trap states remains unclear. In this work, we investigate UV-induced photodoping in multilayer WSe2 field-effect transistors (FETs) based on WSe2/hBN heterostructures on SiO2/p-Si substrates. Wavelength-dependent measurements reveal pronounced n-type photodoping under 405 nm illumination, whereas the effect is orders of magnitude weaker under 640 nm excitation and for p-type photodoping. Furthermore, when the SiO2 layer is removed, both n-type and p-type photodoping are strongly suppressed, demonstrating that the oxide layer is essential for persistent photodoping. Analysis of defect-state distributions in amorphous SiO2, together with first-principles calculations for hBN defects, shows that the experimental observations cannot be explained by defects in hBN. Instead, the results indicate that defect states in the SiO2 substrate act as charge reservoirs that facilitate charge transfer and long-term carrier trapping. These findings highlight the dominant role of substrate-related trap states in UV-induced photodoping and photogating behavior in WSe2 FET devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验测量（波长依赖性测量、器件制备与对比实验）和第一性原理计算辅助分析，属于实验为主、计算为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：WSe₂/hBN 异质结场效应晶体管（FET）中紫外光诱导的持续光掺杂现象，重点研究 SiO₂ 衬底缺陷态对光掺杂行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SiO₂ 衬底中的缺陷态是 WSe₂/hBN FET 中紫外光诱导持续光掺杂的关键来源，而非 hBN 中的缺陷；去除 SiO₂ 层后光掺杂效应被强烈抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SiO₂ 衬底中的缺陷态是 WSe₂/hBN FET 中紫外光诱导持续光掺杂的关键来源，而非 hBN 中的缺陷；去除 SiO₂ 层后光掺杂效应被强烈抑制。；创新点：明确揭示了 SiO₂ 衬底缺陷态作为电荷库在持续光掺杂中的主导作用，排除了以往研究中常被归因的 hBN 缺陷机制。
papers.method_zh: 制备基于 SiO₂/p-Si 衬底的多层 WSe₂/hBN 异质结 FET，进行波长依赖性光掺杂测量（405 nm 与 640 nm 激发对比）；通过去除 SiO₂ 层的对照实验验证衬底作用；结合非晶 SiO₂ 缺陷态分布分析与 hBN 缺陷的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Winding charge density wave: intertwining of structural chirality and phase topology of electronic order
papers.abstract: We propose a class of chiral charge density waves (CDWs), dubbed winding CDWs, that exhibit macroscopic chirality despite a single ordering wavevector. In screw-symmetric chiral crystals, chiral phonons drive a Peierls instability that selects a definite crystal angular momentum channel, thereby endowing the CDW with an integer azimuthal phase winding dictated by the selection rule governing electron-phonon coupling. We further extend this framework to achiral crystals with discrete rotational symmetry and demonstrate that spontaneous symmetry breaking stabilizes a winding CDW with either handedness, realizing an achiral-to-chiral phase transition. Our results reveal a fundamental link between the geometry of chiral structures and the phase topology of electronic orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“提出”、“理论框架”、“论证”等理论推导性关键词，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：手性电荷密度波（chiral CDW），具体提出了一类名为“缠绕电荷密度波”（winding CDW）的新型电子有序态，涉及手性晶体与无手性晶体中的电子-声子耦合与相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性晶体中，手性声子驱动的Peierls不稳定性通过电子-声子耦合的选择定则，赋予电荷密度波一个整数方位角相位缠绕，从而在单一有序波矢下实现宏观手性；在无手性晶体中，自发对称性破缺可稳定具有任意手性的缠绕电荷密度波，实现无手性到手性的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性晶体中，手性声子驱动的Peierls不稳定性通过电子-声子耦合的选择定则，赋予电荷密度波一个整数方位角相位缠绕，从而在单一有序波矢下实现宏观手性；在无手性晶体中，自发对称性破缺可稳定具有任意手性的缠绕电荷密度波，实现无手性到手性的相变。；创新点：首次提出“缠绕电荷密度波”这一概念，揭示了手性结构的几何特性与电子有序相位拓扑之间的基本联系，并展示了在无手性晶体中通过自发对称性破缺产生手性有序的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于手性晶体中声子驱动的Peierls不稳定性，结合晶体角动量通道选择与电子-声子耦合的选择定则进行分析；并推广至具有离散旋转对称性的无手性晶体，讨论自发对称性破缺机制。

papers.title: Quantum magnetism of the spin-1 kagome-lattice antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin-1 kagome-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet using large-scale Lanczos diagonalization and the finite-temperature Lanczos method. The zero-temperature magnetization process exhibits plateaus at $m=0$, $1/3$, $7/9$, and $8/9$, where $m$ is the normalized magnetization. The $m=0$ plateau is identified as a trimer valence-bond-crystal state, while the high-field plateaus at $m=7/9$ and $8/9$ are identified as magnon crystals. In particular, the $m=8/9$ plateau corresponds to the exact localized-magnon crystal state. A smoothed zero-temperature magnetization curve constructed using the Gaussian-kernel smoothing method indicates magnetization jumps at the lower-field edge of the $m=1/3$ plateau and at the upper-field edges of the $m=7/9$ and $8/9$ plateaus. At finite temperatures, the specific heat exhibits a double-peak structure with peaks around $T/J\simeq0.1$ and $T/J\simeq1.1$, and the low-temperature peak may be related to trimer valence-bond-crystal ordering. The finite-temperature magnetization curves show that the $m=1/3$ plateau remains visible at low temperatures, whereas the high-field plateaus are rapidly smeared out by thermal effects. These results provide benchmark data for thermodynamic and high-field magnetization measurements in candidate spin-1 kagome-lattice materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large-scale Lanczos diagonalization, finite-temperature Lanczos method。；研究对象：自旋为1的kagome晶格海森堡反铁磁体（spin-1 kagome-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet）的量子磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零温磁化曲线在m=0、1/3、7/9和8/9处出现平台，其中m=0平台为三聚体价键晶体态，高场平台为磁振子晶体态；有限温比热呈现双峰结构，低场平台在低温下仍可见，而高场平台被热效应迅速抹平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零温磁化曲线在m=0、1/3、7/9和8/9处出现平台，其中m=0平台为三聚体价键晶体态，高场平台为磁振子晶体态；有限温比热呈现双峰结构，低场平台在低温下仍可见，而高场平台被热效应迅速抹平。；创新点：首次对自旋1的kagome晶格反铁磁体进行了大规模精确对角化研究，系统揭示了其零温磁化平台（包括精确局域磁振子晶体态m=8/9平台）及有限温热力学性质，为候选材料的热力学和高场磁化测量提供了基准数据。
papers.method_zh: 大规模Lanczos对角化（large-scale Lanczos diagonalization）和有限温Lanczos方法（finite-temperature Lanczos method），并采用高斯核平滑方法构建零温磁化曲线。

papers.title: Effects of Impurity Scattering on Orbital Hall Conductivity and Orbital Transport in Ru-based Alloys
papers.abstract: The role of impurity scattering in the generation and transport of orbital current remains less established than in conventional spin Hall systems. Here we investigate Ru-based nonmagnet/ferromagnet bilayers in which the impurity scattering is tuned by Cu or Ti alloying. According to SOT measurement and thickness-dependent drift-diffusion analysis, we extract the effective orbital Hall conductivity and the orbital diffusion length. We find that the orbital Hall effect in polycrystalline Ru is dominated by intrinsic mechanism that is moderately robust against weak disorder but suppressed by stronger alloy disorder. However, the orbital diffusion length remains nearly unchanged at approximately 14 nm over the investigated impurity range. This behavior indicates that orbital transport is not governed simply by an impurity scattering. Together with previous temperature-dependent measurements, our results show that static impurities and dynamic lattice disorder affect orbital transport through distinct microscopic channels. These results provide new insight into how disorder governs orbital generation and transport, and offer experimental guidance for developing high-efficient orbitronic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“SOT measurement”（自旋轨道转矩测量）和“thickness-dependent drift-diffusion analysis”（厚度依赖的漂移扩散分析），这些都是典型的实验表征和数据分析手段。；研究对象：Ru基非磁/铁磁双层膜（Ru-based nonmagnet/ferromagnet bilayers），具体研究了通过掺入Cu或Ti来调控杂质散射对轨道霍尔效应和轨道输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多晶Ru中的轨道霍尔效应主要由内禀机制主导，对弱无序具有中等鲁棒性，但会被更强的合金无序抑制；然而，轨道扩散长度（约14 nm）在所研究的杂质浓度范围内几乎保持不变，表明轨道输运并非简单地由杂质散射决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多晶Ru中的轨道霍尔效应主要由内禀机制主导，对弱无序具有中等鲁棒性，但会被更强的合金无序抑制；然而，轨道扩散长度（约14 nm）在所研究的杂质浓度范围内几乎保持不变，表明轨道输运并非简单地由杂质散射决定。；创新点：揭示了静态杂质和动态晶格无序通过不同的微观通道影响轨道输运，为理解无序如何调控轨道产生和输运提供了新见解，并为开发高效轨道电子学材料提供了实验指导。
papers.method_zh: 自旋轨道转矩（SOT）测量；厚度依赖的漂移-扩散分析（用于提取有效轨道霍尔电导率和轨道扩散长度）；通过Cu或Ti合金化来调控杂质散射。

papers.title: Chiropiezoelectric Energy Harvesting from Lattice-Handedness-Controlled Selenium Nanowires
papers.abstract: The growth of wearable electronics, soft robotics, and Internet-of-Things systems has intensified the demand for inorganic piezoelectric materials that harvest weak biomechanical energy. Advances through composition optimization, defect engineering, strain engineering, and orientation control have improved existing electromechanical responses, but have not introduced a new mechanism for enhancing piezoelectricity. Here we propose atomic chirality engineering as a design principle for inorganic piezoelectric nanomaterials. Unlike conventional strategies that modify composition or morphology, atomic chirality alters the handedness of the crystal lattice itself, adding a degree of freedom for controlling dipole alignment, electromechanical coupling, and potentially spin-dependent transport. Using atomically chiral trigonal selenium nanowires as a model system, we show that crystal handedness alone changes piezoelectric performance at identical chemical composition. Piezoresponse force microscopy resolved a consistent enantiomeric difference, with right-handed D-Se nanowires reaching a higher effective piezoelectric coefficient than their left-handed counterparts, and flexible nanogenerators and self-powered acoustic sensors built from the two enantiomers produced distinct outputs under identical deformation. This work establishes atomic chirality as a distinct route for designing piezoelectric materials, one that may extend across non-centrosymmetric inorganic semiconductors for sustainable energy harvesting and wearable sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验手段（如压电力显微镜、柔性纳米发电机、自供电声学传感器）和实验结果（如有效压电系数差异、器件输出差异）。；研究对象：原子手性控制的硒纳米线（trigonal selenium nanowires），具体研究其晶格手性（左旋与右旋）对压电能量收集性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学组成完全相同的情况下，仅通过改变晶格手性（左旋 vs 右旋）即可调控硒纳米线的压电性能：右旋（D-Se）纳米线的有效压电系数高于左旋（L-Se）纳米线，且基于两种手性构建的柔性纳米发电机和自供电声学传感器在相同形变下产生不同的输出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学组成完全相同的情况下，仅通过改变晶格手性（左旋 vs 右旋）即可调控硒纳米线的压电性能：右旋（D-Se）纳米线的有效压电系数高于左旋（L-Se）纳米线，且基于两种手性构建的柔性纳米发电机和自供电声学传感器在相同形变下产生不同的输出。；创新点：提出“原子手性工程”作为无机压电纳米材料的设计新原理，区别于传统的组分优化、缺陷工程、应变工程和取向控制等策略，首次在无机材料中证明仅通过改变晶格手性（而非化学组成或形貌）即可调控压电性能。
papers.method_zh: 压电力显微镜（PFM）测量有效压电系数；构建柔性纳米发电机和自供电声学传感器进行器件性能对比。

papers.title: Entropy density functional universality: Correlation, response, and entropic Ornstein-Zernike structure
papers.abstract: We give a comprehensive account of the recent entropy density functional theory for the equilibrium statistical mechanics of classical many-body systems (arXiv:2606.28240). The approach is formally exact and based on a joint grand potential minimization principle for the one-body density and the global pair distance distribution. These variational fields depend respectively on position and on scalar distance, which retains the low computational complexity of standard density functional theory. Correlations effects are contained in a unique excess entropy functional, which is universal across all systems with pairwise interparticle potentials. Functional differentiation yields entropic direct correlation functionals that generate entropic response and fluctuation correlation functions via coupled Ornstein-Zernike equations. Two alternative proofs are given for the existence and uniqueness of the underlying metadensity functional map, based on generalizations of either Levy's constrained search method or Mermin-Evans proof by contradiction. Simple excess entropy approximations yield the standard mean-field and second-virial excess free energy density functionals. We describe exact entropic functional line integrals, make connections to the recent one-body fluctuation profiles, and generalize the entropy approach beyond pairwise interparticle potentials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论、形式严格、泛函最小化原理、证明。；研究对象：经典多体系统的平衡态统计力学。具体研究体系为具有两体相互作用势的经典粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于熵密度泛函的、形式严格的经典多体系统平衡态统计力学理论。该理论的核心是存在一个普适的、仅依赖于两体相互作用的超额熵泛函，通过它可以从熵的视角统一描述系统的关联、响应和涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于熵密度泛函的、形式严格的经典多体系统平衡态统计力学理论。该理论的核心是存在一个普适的、仅依赖于两体相互作用的超额熵泛函，通过它可以从熵的视角统一描述系统的关联、响应和涨落。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为熵密度泛函理论。该方法基于一个联合的巨势最小化原理，变分场为单体密度和全局对距离分布。通过泛函微分得到熵直接关联泛函，并利用耦合的Ornstein-Zernike方程生成熵响应和涨落关联函数。论文还给出了元密度泛函映射存在唯一性的两种替代证明（基于Levy约束搜索方法的推广或Mermin-Evans反证法的推广）。

papers.title: When Repulsion Creates Pairing: A New Perspective on Unconventional Superconductivity
papers.abstract: Despite the repulsive Coulomb law and the Pauli statistics that do not favor bound states, attraction between electrons or holes is nevertheless possible in the context of many body interaction and of valley potential landscapes, reminiscent of exotic superconducting materials. In particular, in 1965, Kohn and Luttinger published a note revealing that the dynamical screening of the repulsive Coulomb interaction leads, under certain conditions, to an effective attraction necessary for the formation of Cooper pairs. We propose such a formalism adapted to the cuprates, where the screening arises from the superexchange dynamics of virtual holes in the oxygen orbitals of the $Cu O_2$ plane. Inspired from the Bardeen-Copper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, we can derive some predictions for the temperature-doping phase diagram (pseudo-gap, strange metal, antiferromagnetism, superconducting, and normal states) in semi-quantitative agreement with observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“propose such a formalism”“derive some predictions”，属于理论推导与模型构建。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体（cuprates），具体为CuO₂平面中氧轨道上的空穴，以及其超导配对机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在库仑排斥作用下，通过动态屏蔽效应（源于CuO₂平面中氧轨道虚拟空穴的超交换动力学）可产生有效吸引，从而形成库珀对，并由此推导出温度-掺杂相图（赝能隙、奇异金属、反铁磁、超导及正常态）与观测半定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在库仑排斥作用下，通过动态屏蔽效应（源于CuO₂平面中氧轨道虚拟空穴的超交换动力学）可产生有效吸引，从而形成库珀对，并由此推导出温度-掺杂相图（赝能隙、奇异金属、反铁磁、超导及正常态）与观测半定量一致。；创新点：将Kohn-Luttinger提出的动态屏蔽导致有效吸引的机制具体应用于铜氧化物体系，并引入氧轨道超交换动力学作为屏蔽来源，从而为铜氧化物高温超导的配对机制提供了一种新的理论视角。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kohn-Luttinger理论框架，结合BCS理论，构建了适用于铜氧化物的超导配对形式，其中屏蔽效应来源于氧轨道虚拟空穴的超交换动力学。

papers.title: Hall Shift Current and Nonlinear Anomalous Hall Effect in Gapped Dirac Fermion Systems
papers.abstract: We discuss a new mechanism for the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect in tilted two-dimensional gapped Dirac fermion systems. This mechanism originates from a side-jump displacement associated with Landau-Zener tunneling across the mass gap. In lightly doped tilted Dirac systems with a small gap, this interband mechanism can contribute to the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect in addition to the conventional intraband mechanism arising from the Berry curvature dipole. It provides a possible explanation for the nonlinear Hall effect accompanied by nonlinear longitudinal transport observed in the organic Dirac fermion system α-(ET)2I3 with an extremely small gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We discuss a new mechanism”“originates from”等理论推导和机制讨论的表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：倾斜二维有隙狄拉克费米子系统中的非线性反常霍尔效应，具体涉及有机狄拉克费米子体系α-(ET)₂I₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的非线性反常霍尔效应机制，该机制源于与跨越质量隙的朗道-齐纳隧穿相关的侧跳位移，在轻掺杂小隙倾斜狄拉克系统中，该带间机制可与传统的贝里曲率偶极子带内机制共同贡献于非线性反常霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的非线性反常霍尔效应机制，该机制源于与跨越质量隙的朗道-齐纳隧穿相关的侧跳位移，在轻掺杂小隙倾斜狄拉克系统中，该带间机制可与传统的贝里曲率偶极子带内机制共同贡献于非线性反常霍尔效应。；创新点：首次提出由Landau-Zener隧穿引起的侧跳位移作为非线性反常霍尔效应的新带间机制，为极小隙有机狄拉克体系中的非线性霍尔效应提供了可能的解释。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于带间侧跳位移机制与Landau-Zener隧穿过程的关联，并与传统贝里曲率偶极子机制进行对比。

papers.title: Thermophysical and mechanical properties of UFe$_2$ fabricated by spark plasma sintering
papers.abstract: Following the accident at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant in 2011, core meltdown produced fuel debris whose safe retrieval and management require reliable thermophysical and mechanical property data. Among the metallic phases identified in the debris, the U-Fe system is particularly important because of the abundant iron originating from in-vessel stainless steel structures. However, within this system, the high-temperature thermophysical properties of UFe$_2$ have received relatively little attention, with most prior studies focusing on its magnetic and electronic properties. To fill this data gap in the literature, we fabricated dense, nearly single-phase polycrystalline UFe$_2$ by arc melting followed by spark plasma sintering, and characterized its thermal and mechanical properties from room temperature to 1073 K. Results show that the thermal conductivity of UFe$_2$ increased monotonically from 10 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 306 K to 25 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 1073 K, surpassing those of the iron intermetallics Fe$_2$Zr and Fe$_2$B at high temperatures. In addition, UFe$_2$ is mechanically more compliant, displaying a Young's modulus $E$ of 69 GPa, a shear modulus $G$ of 24 GPa, and a Vickers hardness $H_{\mathrm{V}}$ of 5.6 GPa, all well below those of both Fe intermetallics. Consequently, during decommissioning, thermal-management and structural evaluations should take into account the comparatively high-conductivity and mechanically compliant nature of UFe$_2$ within the heterogeneous fuel debris.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabricated（制备）、characterized（表征）、arc melting（电弧熔炼）、spark plasma sintering（放电等离子烧结）。；研究对象：UFe₂金属间化合物，具体研究其热物理和力学性能，应用于核燃料碎片的安全回收与管理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UFe₂的热导率从室温到1073 K单调增加（10→25 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹），高于高温下的Fe₂Zr和Fe₂B；其力学性能（杨氏模量69 GPa、剪切模量24 GPa、维氏硬度5.6 GPa）均低于这两种铁金属间化合物，表明UFe₂具有高导热性和机械柔顺性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UFe₂的热导率从室温到1073 K单调增加（10→25 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹），高于高温下的Fe₂Zr和Fe₂B；其力学性能（杨氏模量69 GPa、剪切模量24 GPa、维氏硬度5.6 GPa）均低于这两种铁金属间化合物，表明UFe₂具有高导热性和机械柔顺性。；创新点：填补了UFe₂在高温下热物理和力学性能数据的空白，此前研究主要集中于其磁性和电子性质。
papers.method_zh: 采用电弧熔炼结合放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备致密、近单相的多晶UFe₂样品；从室温到1073 K表征其热导率、杨氏模量、剪切模量和维氏硬度。

papers.title: Electrically tunable interfacial thermal conduction via electronic structure engineering in ${Au}$/$Bi_{1-x}$$Sb_{x}$ topological insulators
papers.abstract: This work provides direct experimental evidence for the role of topological interface states in thermal conduction across a metal/topological insulator junction. It also shows that this conduction can be reversibly modulated by electrical current injection, offering a new approach toward active control of heat flow at solid-state interfaces. Specifically, the interfacial thermal conductance of ${Au}$/$Bi_{89}$$Sb_{11}$ and ${Au}$/$Bi_{87}$$Sb_{13}$ junctions demonstrates distinct temperature- and bias-dependent behavior. Both responses are attributed to carrier redistribution between topological interface and bulk band states, driven thermally by Fermi-Dirac broadening and electrically by quasi-Fermi-level shifts and WKB tunneling into nearby bulk bands. Control experiments using trivial semimetals and insulating interlayers further confirm the topological specificity of the effect. Such electrically tunable interfacial heat conduction positions interface electronic structure engineering as a promising route for active thermal management. In doing so, it lays the groundwork for a mechanically robust alternative to conventional structure-driven thermal control compatible with increasingly dense, high-power solid-state devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提供了直接的实验证据”、“控制实验”等关键词，表明该工作以实验测量为主。；研究对象：金属/拓扑绝缘体异质结中的界面热传导现象。具体材料体系为 Au/Bi₁₋ₓSbₓ 拓扑绝缘体（x=0.11 和 0.13），即 Au/Bi₈₉Sb₁₁ 和 Au/Bi₈₇Sb₁₃ 结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次提供了拓扑界面态在金属/拓扑绝缘体结热传导中起关键作用的直接实验证据，并证明通过电流注入可以可逆地调控该界面热导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次提供了拓扑界面态在金属/拓扑绝缘体结热传导中起关键作用的直接实验证据，并证明通过电流注入可以可逆地调控该界面热导。；创新点：提出并验证了通过电子结构工程（而非传统结构工程）实现主动热管理的新思路，即利用电流注入可逆调控金属/拓扑绝缘体界面的热传导，为高功率固态器件提供了一种机械鲁棒性更强的热控制替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了 Au/Bi₈₉Sb₁₁ 和 Au/Bi₈₇Sb₁₃ 结的界面热导随温度和偏压的变化行为。通过对比使用平庸半金属和绝缘插层的控制实验，确认了效应的拓扑特异性。理论归因分析涉及费米-狄拉克展宽、准费米能级移动以及WKB隧穿机制。

papers.title: Crystal structure and basic properties of dirhenate quantum materials
papers.abstract: The anhydrous divalent 3d-metal dirhenate quantum materials, M(ReO$_4$)$_2$,were synthesized using solid-state methods for M = Mn through Zn. Previously unreported Mg(ReO4)2 is also described. Their layered crystal structures, which feature an in-plane triangular lattice of M$^{2+}$, were refined using single crystal X-ray diffraction, and their optical absorption and several other physical properties were characterized. Their magnetism and heat capacity reveal long-range magnetic order at low temperatures in many of the M(ReO$_4$)$_2$ phases. Notably, many of these ordered states are sensitive to applied magnetic fields and can be readily suppressed by relatively small fields, suggesting competing magnetic interactions in a low-dimensional framework, which appear worthy of further study.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“synthesized using solid-state methods”、“refined using single crystal X-ray diffraction”、“characterized”其光学吸收和物理性质，以及“magnetism and heat capacity reveal”等实验表征手段。；研究对象：无水二价3d金属双铼酸盐量子材料，化学式为M(ReO₄)₂（M = Mn至Zn），以及此前未报道的Mg(ReO₄)₂。这些材料具有层状晶体结构，其中M²⁺离子形成面内三角晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 许多M(ReO₄)₂相在低温下表现出长程磁有序，且这些有序态对施加的磁场非常敏感，能被相对较小的磁场抑制，表明存在低维框架下的竞争磁相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：许多M(ReO₄)₂相在低温下表现出长程磁有序，且这些有序态对施加的磁场非常敏感，能被相对较小的磁场抑制，表明存在低维框架下的竞争磁相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 固相合成法（solid-state methods）、单晶X射线衍射（single crystal X-ray diffraction）进行晶体结构精修、光学吸收测量、磁化率与比热容测量（magnetism and heat capacity）。

papers.title: Twist-configured moire-moire reconstruction governs diverse commensurate double-moire phases in twisted bilayer graphene on h-BN
papers.abstract: The coexistence of multiple moire lattices in van der Waals heterostructures raises a fundamental question: how do distinct moire patterns interact and reconstruct? Here, we investigate twisted bilayer graphene (tBG) on hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN), where tBG and graphene/h-BN moire structures coexist, using conductive atomic force microscopy combined with continuum-model simulations. We show that reconstruction between these moire lattices-moire-moire reconstruction-manifests across multiple length scales, giving rise to diverse commensurate double-moire phases. Locally, the stacking registry between the two moire lattices is uniquely selected by the global twist configuration (helical or alternate), mediated by rotational relaxation of the shared graphene layer. This registry, together with twist angle and strain, governs commensurate domains from C3z-symmetric to strained symmetry-modified structures. These results establish moire-moire reconstruction as a general framework for engineering structural and electronic order -- including theoretically predicted topological flat bands below the magic angle -- in multilayer moire materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算模拟）。判断依据：使用了“导电原子力显微镜（conductive atomic force microscopy）”实验手段，并结合了“连续模型模拟（continuum-model simulations）”。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（h-BN）上的扭转双层石墨烯（tBG）体系。具体研究该体系中同时存在的两种莫尔超晶格（tBG内禀莫尔条纹与石墨烯/h-BN界面莫尔条纹）之间的相互作用与重构现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现两种莫尔晶格之间存在“莫尔-莫尔重构（moire-moire reconstruction）”，该重构由全局扭转构型（螺旋型或交替型）决定，并产生多种不同的公度双莫尔相，这些相的结构对称性可从C3z对称性变化到应变修饰的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现两种莫尔晶格之间存在“莫尔-莫尔重构（moire-moire reconstruction）”，该重构由全局扭转构型（螺旋型或交替型）决定，并产生多种不同的公度双莫尔相，这些相的结构对称性可从C3z对称性变化到应变修饰的对称性。；创新点：提出了“莫尔-莫尔重构”这一通用框架，用于理解多层莫尔材料中不同莫尔图案的相互作用，并指出该机制可工程化调控结构序和电子序，例如在魔角以下产生理论上预言的拓扑平带。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为导电原子力显微镜（cAFM），并结合连续模型模拟进行理论分析。

papers.title: Theoretical investigation of power absorbed by superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling in the presence external time-dependent perturbation
papers.abstract: The absorbed power in superconductors driven by a time-dependent external perturbation is investigated through transitions between Bogoliubov quasiparticle states. The transition matrix element contains the superconducting coherence factor, which determines the role of the gap, excitation spectrum, and external frequency in the absorption process. The formulation is applied to a Hubbard-model superconductor including correlated hopping and Rashba spin-orbit coupling. In this model, numerical calculations are used to obtain the quasiparticle energies, density of states, chemical potential, and temperature-dependent superconducting gap. The normalized absorbed power is then evaluated for different values of temperature, interaction strength, correlated hopping parameter, and spin-orbit coupling strength. The results show that the absorption response is strongly affected by the superconducting gap and by changes in the quasiparticle spectrum. Rashba spin-orbit coupling changes the density of states and therefore modifies the absorption. These results show that hopping processes, interaction strength, and spin-orbit coupling play important roles in the ultrasonic and electromagnetic absorption of superconducting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical investigation、formulation、numerical calculations。；研究对象：具有Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的超导体在时间依赖外场扰动下的功率吸收行为，具体基于Hubbard模型超导体（包含关联跳跃和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导体的吸收响应强烈依赖于超导能隙和准粒子谱的变化；Rashba自旋-轨道耦合通过改变态密度来修正吸收；跳跃过程、相互作用强度和自旋-轨道耦合对超导系统的超声和电磁吸收起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导体的吸收响应强烈依赖于超导能隙和准粒子谱的变化；Rashba自旋-轨道耦合通过改变态密度来修正吸收；跳跃过程、相互作用强度和自旋-轨道耦合对超导系统的超声和电磁吸收起重要作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov准粒子态之间的跃迁理论框架，推导包含超导相干因子的跃迁矩阵元；对包含关联跳跃和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的Hubbard模型超导体进行数值计算，获得准粒子能量、态密度、化学势和温度依赖的超导能隙，并评估不同温度、相互作用强度、关联跳跃参数和自旋-轨道耦合强度下的归一化吸收功率。

papers.title: First principles study of chalcogen vacancy effect on the optoelectronic and photocatalytic properties of transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers
papers.abstract: In working conditions, chalcogen vacancies spontaneously occur in two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) monolayers, affecting their optoelectronic and photocatalytic properties. To study how chalcogen vacancies affect such properties, we use quantum mechanical calculations considering prototypical MX$_2$ (M = Mo, W, X = S and Se) TMDCs monolayers. Structural optimisations show that M-X bond lengths about a vacancy are different compared to the bond lengths in the pristine structure. Band structure calculations reveal that the introduction of vacancies produce electronic states about the Fermi level, hence resulting in the reduction of the band gap. Work function and electrostatic potential calculations show that the introduction of vacancies induce an asymmetry in the electrostatic potential facilitating the charge separation; such feature is absent in a pristine monolayer. All the considered defective structures are capable of performing hydrogen evolution reaction, while co-catalyst is required to perform oxygen evolution reaction when used for water splitting. WS$_2$ and WSe$_2$ defective monolayers can serve as an efficient photocatalytic material for reducing CO$_2$ into useful chemical products. The presented results show that vacancy-containing TMDCs monolayers own photocatalytic capabilities compared to the pristine counterparts, thus showing that defective TMD monolayers have prospective applications and should not be regarded as flawed products to be discarded. Finally, the results might constitute guidelines for the experimental synthesis of vacancy-engineered MX$_2$ monolayers for optoelectronic devices and photocatalytic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles study”、“quantum mechanical calculations”。；研究对象：二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDCs）单层，具体为MX₂（M = Mo, W; X = S, Se）中硫族元素空位对其光电和光催化性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硫族空位会在TMDCs单层中引入费米能级附近的电子态，导致带隙减小，并在静电势中产生不对称性，有利于电荷分离。含空位的WS₂和WSe₂单层可用于光催化还原CO₂，所有缺陷结构均能进行析氢反应，但需要助催化剂才能进行析氧反应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硫族空位会在TMDCs单层中引入费米能级附近的电子态，导致带隙减小，并在静电势中产生不对称性，有利于电荷分离。含空位的WS₂和WSe₂单层可用于光催化还原CO₂，所有缺陷结构均能进行析氢反应，但需要助催化剂才能进行析氧反应。；创新点：系统揭示了硫族空位对TMDCs单层光电和光催化性能的积极影响，指出缺陷单层不应被视为废品，而是具有潜在应用价值的光催化材料，并为实验合成空位工程化的MX₂单层提供了理论指导。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的量子力学计算（具体方法如DFT，摘要未明确说明是否使用+U等修正），包括结构优化、能带结构计算、功函数和静电势分析。

papers.title: Shear and crystallization in deformable granular packings: why don't auxetics order?
papers.abstract: Shear of three-dimensional, highly compressed granular packings is simulated using a bonded particle approach that explicitly resolves elastic deformation. Varying Poisson's ratio $ν$ produces significant changes in rheology, packing structure, and grain morphology. During flow, conventional systems ($ν> 0$) readily crystallize while auxetics ($ν< 0$) resist ordering. This duality reflects the fact that conventional grains develop polyhedral-like facets but conserve volume while auxetics behave oppositely, demonstrating an unexpected interaction between elasticity, geometry, and crystallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：simulated、bonded particle approach）；研究对象：可变形颗粒堆积体在剪切作用下的结晶行为，重点研究泊松比ν对体系流变学、堆积结构和颗粒形态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统材料（ν>0）在剪切流动中容易结晶，而拉胀材料（ν<0）则抵抗有序化；这一差异源于传统颗粒形成多面体状刻面并保持体积不变，而拉胀颗粒行为相反，揭示了弹性、几何与结晶之间意想不到的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统材料（ν>0）在剪切流动中容易结晶，而拉胀材料（ν<0）则抵抗有序化；这一差异源于传统颗粒形成多面体状刻面并保持体积不变，而拉胀颗粒行为相反，揭示了弹性、几何与结晶之间意想不到的相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用键合颗粒方法（bonded particle approach）对三维高压缩颗粒堆积体进行剪切模拟，明确解析弹性变形。

papers.title: Magnetic ordering of a van der Waals material combining vastly different magnetic anisotropies
papers.abstract: Among magnetic van der Waals materials, the vanadium trihalide family exhibits unique features. In particular, VI3 contains V atoms of two different types, as two energetically close electronic occupations can coexist in real samples. These types show strikingly different magnetic anisotropy, predicted to differ by more than an order of magnitude. The combination forms a distinctive magnetic system. VI3 also displays an unusual thickness dependence: the monolayer Curie temperature (TC) is higher than that of the bulk, contrary to the expectation that interlayer coupling reinforces magnetic order. Using atomistic spin-dynamics simulations informed by first-principles calculations, we investigate the critical temperature behavior from the combined perspective of single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions. The strong anisotropy contrast significantly affects thermal stability: increasing the fraction of high-anisotropy sites raises the energy cost of transverse spin fluctuations and increases the ordering temperature. Furthermore, V-atom inhomogeneity makes the interlayer super-superexchange network spatially nonuniform, creating competing exchange pathways. This weakens coherent interlayer order while preserving robust intralayer ferromagnetic correlations, thus modifying the bulk-monolayer TC relation. Our model reproduces experimental TC values when the ratio of the two V types is close to 1:1, in agreement with two experimental methods. This supports the coexistence of two V configurations in VI3. The monolayer TC is reproduced with a slightly modified ratio, possibly linked to polaron concentration. The sensitivity of TC to this ratio suggests that the ordering temperature of VI3 can in principle be tuned over a broad range by controlling the relative occupation of the two vanadium configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：atomistic spin-dynamics simulations、first-principles calculations）；研究对象：范德华磁性材料VI₃（三碘化钒），特别是其中两种不同磁各向异性的V原子共存体系及其磁有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VI₃中两种V原子构型具有数量级差异的磁各向异性，通过调控两种构型的比例可显著改变居里温度，并解释了单层TC高于块体的反常厚度依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VI₃中两种V原子构型具有数量级差异的磁各向异性，通过调控两种构型的比例可显著改变居里温度，并解释了单层TC高于块体的反常厚度依赖关系。；创新点：揭示了两种V原子构型（磁各向异性差异超过一个数量级）共存对磁有序温度及层间/层内磁耦合的独特影响，并指出通过控制两种V构型的相对占据率可大范围调控居里温度。摘要未突出说明与实验对比的具体细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（DFT）的原子自旋动力学模拟，结合单离子各向异性和交换相互作用的分析。

papers.title: Anisotropic magnetoresistance of 2D Rashba films with in-plane Zeeman field and short-range disorder
papers.abstract: We study the dc conductivity of a continuum two-dimensional Rashba film with an in-plane Zeeman field and delta-correlated scalar disorder. Although the field deforms the two helicity Fermi contours and rotates the spin texture, it does not produce anisotropic magnetoresistance in the leading quasiclassical conductivity. The mechanism is geometric. A density Ward identity fixes the spin-vector part of the Born self-energy to the derivative of the total particle density with respect to the field. This derivative vanishes, because the total area enclosed by the two Rashba-Zeeman sheets is independent of the in-plane field. The Born self-energy is therefore scalar and field independent, and the quasiparticle lifetime stays isotropic. The same area invariance controls transport: once the leading impurity ladder reduces the current vertex to the parabolic velocity, the diagonal intraband Kubo conductivity collapses onto the two-sheet occupied area and is field independent as well. The result settles the short-range-disorder quasiclassical problem: point-like nonmagnetic impurities do not produce AMR in this model. A nonzero AMR requires physics beyond this quasiclassical short-range-disorder mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We study”“We show”“The result settles”等理论推导语言，未提及任何实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：具有面内塞曼场和短程无序的二维Rashba薄膜的直流电导率，具体研究其各向异性磁电阻（AMR）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准经典近似下，面内塞曼场不会导致各向异性磁电阻，因为两个螺旋费米面所包围的总面积与面内场无关，导致Born自能是标量且与场无关，准粒子寿命保持各向同性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准经典近似下，面内塞曼场不会导致各向异性磁电阻，因为两个螺旋费米面所包围的总面积与面内场无关，导致Born自能是标量且与场无关，准粒子寿命保持各向同性。；创新点：揭示了短程无序下AMR为零的几何机制——两个Rashba-Zeeman能带的总面积不随面内场变化，从而严格证明了点状非磁性杂质在该模型中不产生AMR，并指出产生非零AMR需要超越此准经典短程无序机制的新物理。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续二维Rashba模型，包含面内塞曼场和δ关联标量无序，通过准经典玻恩近似计算直流电导率，利用密度Ward恒等式分析自能结构，并基于杂质梯子求和约化电流顶点。

papers.title: Correlation-Induced Topological Reconstruction in a Periodically Driven Kagome Mott Insulator
papers.abstract: We study the interplay between electronic correlations and circularly polarized periodic driving in the Hubbard model on a Kagome lattice. Using Brillouin-Wigner perturbation theory, we derive an effective Floquet Hamiltonian in which the drive renormalizes the bare hopping and generates chiral nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor terms, producing repeated topological transitions and a flat band whose position is continuously tunable across the spectrum. Within slave-rotor mean-field theory, we show that the resulting Mott transition is strongly non-monotonic in the drive amplitude, yielding repeated metal-insulator transitions, and that the spinon excitations inside the Mott phase acquire a band topology distinct from that of the non-interacting Floquet bands. This correlation-driven topological reconstruction produces emergent flat-band spinon insulators inaccessible to either driving or interactions alone. Our results establish periodically driven Kagome systems as a platform for engineering correlated topological flat-band physics out of equilibrium, with proposed realizations in ultracold atomic lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Brillouin-Wigner perturbation theory、slave-rotor mean-field theory、有效Floquet哈密顿量推导。；研究对象：Kagome晶格上的Hubbard模型，在周期性圆偏振光驱动下的电子关联与拓扑相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联与周期性驱动共同作用导致Mott相变随驱动振幅呈强非单调行为，并在Mott绝缘体内部产生自旋子激发，其能带拓扑结构不同于非相互作用Floquet能带，形成驱动或相互作用单独无法实现的平带自旋子绝缘体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联与周期性驱动共同作用导致Mott相变随驱动振幅呈强非单调行为，并在Mott绝缘体内部产生自旋子激发，其能带拓扑结构不同于非相互作用Floquet能带，形成驱动或相互作用单独无法实现的平带自旋子绝缘体。；创新点：揭示了周期性驱动与强关联协同作用导致的拓扑重构，即关联驱动的拓扑重建，产生非平衡态下可调控的关联拓扑平带物理，并提议在超冷原子晶格中实现。
papers.method_zh: 采用Brillouin-Wigner微扰理论推导有效Floquet哈密顿量，结合slave-rotor平均场理论分析Mott相变与自旋子能带拓扑。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium phase transition in the Brownian Ising Model: field theory, renormalization group, and exact results
papers.abstract: We present a complete field-theoretical renormalization-group (RG) analysis of the Brownian Ising Model (BIM), in which a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ order parameter is coupled to a passive conserved density, breaking detailed balance. Using the Martin-Siggia-Rose formalism and an $ε=4-d$ expansion, we show that this density-order parameter coupling is RG-relevant below four dimensions and drives the system to a new non-equilibrium fixed point, distinct from the Ising universality class. Critical exponents are computed at lowest nontrivial order, some of which require a dedicated two-loop analysis. At large scales, the density acts as an effective noise that is white in time but long-range in space, enhancing order-parameter fluctuations and producing a negative anomalous dimension $η$. A defining feature of the new class is that the correlation and response functions acquire different anomalous dimensions, $η\neq 2 - γ/ ν$ - a direct, observable signature of fluctuation-dissipation-theorem violation at large scales that cannot occur in equilibrium. We also find a small correction-to-scaling exponent, implying large preasymptotic corrections that must be accounted for in numerical and experimental tests. We further derive a set of relations among renormalization factors that hold to all orders in perturbation theory, following from the linearity of the density dynamics and an emergent shift symmetry. These yield an exact scaling relation $ν= 2/(d+z-2)$ at the BIM fixed point and establish that the Ising universality class, as well as that of quenched diluted-Ising, is unstable in $d=3$. This establishes the BIM fixed point as the unique infrared attractor for any nonzero diffusion constant.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：field-theoretical renormalization-group (RG) analysis、Martin-Siggia-Rose formalism、ε=4-d expansion、perturbation theory。；研究对象：布朗伊辛模型（Brownian Ising Model, BIM），其中Z₂序参量与一个被动守恒密度耦合，破坏了细致平衡，属于非平衡相变体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在四维以下，密度-序参量耦合是RG相关的，驱动系统到达一个不同于伊辛普适类的新非平衡固定点；该固定点下关联函数与响应函数具有不同的反常维度，直接标志了涨落-耗散定理在大尺度上的破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在四维以下，密度-序参量耦合是RG相关的，驱动系统到达一个不同于伊辛普适类的新非平衡固定点；该固定点下关联函数与响应函数具有不同的反常维度，直接标志了涨落-耗散定理在大尺度上的破坏。；创新点：首次给出布朗伊辛模型的完整场论RG分析，发现并刻画了一个新的非平衡普适类；推导出精确标度关系ν=2/(d+z-2)，并证明在d=3时伊辛普适类及稀释伊辛普适类均不稳定，BIM固定点是唯一的红外吸引子。
papers.method_zh: 采用Martin-Siggia-Rose形式论建立场论，结合ε=4-d展开进行重整化群分析，在最低非平庸阶计算临界指数，部分指数需两圈图分析；并利用密度动力学的线性和涌现的平移对称性推导出重整化因子间的精确关系。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium coupling to a diffusing density breaks Ising universality
papers.abstract: The Ising universality class is remarkably robust to non-equilibrium perturbations, which generically flow to zero under renormalization. We show that this robustness fails when an order parameter is coupled nonreciprocally to a conserved diffusive density. Below $d_c=4$, the renormalization group flows to a fast-diffusion fixed point at which the density acts as a long-range multiplicative noise, producing a novel universality class. The non-equilibrium nature of the fixed point is manifest in the large-scale violation of the fluctuation-dissipation relations, reflected in a splitting of the scaling exponents of the two-point correlation and response functions--a measurable hallmark of non-equilibrium critical fluctuations. A two-loop calculation establishes the stability of this fixed point but yields a small correction-to-scaling exponent $ω\approx0.020$ in $d=3$, implying strong finite-size corrections. An all-orders modified Harris criterion $ν>2/(d+z-2)$ confirms that the BIM fixed point governs criticality in $d=3$, with Ising universality recovered only at $d=2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“renormalization group”（重整化群）、“two-loop calculation”（双圈计算）、“modified Harris criterion”（修正的哈里斯判据）等理论分析工具。；研究对象：非平衡统计物理中的临界现象，具体研究当伊辛序参量与非互易耦合的守恒扩散密度相互作用时，其临界行为是否仍属于伊辛普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在空间维度d<4时，非互易耦合会导致系统流向一个“快扩散固定点”，该固定点产生全新的普适类，而非传统的伊辛普适类；仅在d=2时伊辛普适类得以恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在空间维度d<4时，非互易耦合会导致系统流向一个“快扩散固定点”，该固定点产生全新的普适类，而非传统的伊辛普适类；仅在d=2时伊辛普适类得以恢复。；创新点：揭示了非互易耦合（nonreciprocal coupling）与守恒扩散密度的结合可以打破伊辛普适类对非平衡扰动的鲁棒性，并预言了可测量的非平衡临界涨落特征——两点关联函数与响应函数的标度指数分裂。
papers.method_zh: 采用重整化群分析（包括双圈计算）以及修正的哈里斯判据（all-orders modified Harris criterion）来判定固定点的稳定性与临界维度。

papers.title: High-Entropy Nitride Photocatalysts for Visible-Light Antibiotic Degradation: Structural Stability, In Situ Interfacial Visualization, and Molecular-Level Mechanistic Insights
papers.abstract: High-entropy nitrides (HENs) have emerged as a promising class of advanced materials with tunable electronic structures, high stability, and abundant active sites. The incorporation of nitrogen enhances visible-light absorption, promotes efficient charge separation, and improves structural robustness, making these materials highly suitable for photocatalytic applications. In this study, (MnFeCoNiCu)N-based HEN nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized as visible-light-assisted photocatalysts for the degradation of antibiotics, including sulfamethoxazole (SME) and tetracycline (TCL). The catalyst exhibited excellent performance, achieving 96% degradation of SME and 94% removal of TCL within 2 h of visible-light irradiation. The photocatalytic activity was systematically evaluated under varying operational parameters, including solution pH, catalyst dosage, pollutant concentration, and the presence of coexisting ions. Notably, the catalyst maintained high efficiency in real water matrices, demonstrating its practical applicability. The entropy-stabilized nitride framework exhibited negligible metal leaching, excellent thermal and structural stability as confirmed by temperature-dependent synchrotron angle-dispersive X-ray diffraction, and stable performance over multiple reuse cycles. Furthermore, in situ liquid-cell transmission electron microscopy provided real-time insight into catalyst-pollutant interactions, while complementary molecular simulations revealed the structural stability of the HEN NPs during molecular adsorption and the distinct interaction modes of the two antibiotics. Phytotoxicity tests using Vigna radiata confirmed the effective detoxification of treated solutions. Overall, this work establishes (MnFeCoNiCu)N HENs as efficient and durable visible-light-driven photocatalysts for the removal of antibiotics from complex aqueous environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：synthesized、photocatalytic activity、in situ liquid-cell transmission electron microscopy、phytotoxicity tests）；研究对象：(MnFeCoNiCu)N 高熵氮化物纳米颗粒，作为可见光催化剂用于降解抗生素（磺胺甲恶唑和四环素）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: (MnFeCoNiCu)N 高熵氮化物在可见光照射下2小时内对磺胺甲恶唑和四环素的降解率分别达到96%和94%，且在实际水环境中保持高效，具有优异的结构稳定性和可重复使用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：(MnFeCoNiCu)N 高熵氮化物在可见光照射下2小时内对磺胺甲恶唑和四环素的降解率分别达到96%和94%，且在实际水环境中保持高效，具有优异的结构稳定性和可重复使用性。；创新点：首次将(MnFeCoNiCu)N高熵氮化物应用于可见光催化抗生素降解，并结合原位液相透射电镜实时可视化催化剂-污染物界面相互作用，同时通过分子模拟揭示两种抗生素的不同吸附模式。
papers.method_zh: 实验合成（高熵氮化物纳米颗粒）、可见光催化降解实验（调控pH、催化剂用量、污染物浓度、共存离子）、温度依赖同步辐射角散X射线衍射（结构稳定性表征）、原位液相透射电子显微镜（实时观察催化剂-污染物相互作用）、分子模拟（吸附模式与结构稳定性分析）、植物毒性测试（绿豆种子）。

papers.title: Electronic theory for scanning tunneling microscopy spectra in bilayer nickelate thin films
papers.abstract: Recent Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) experiments measuring the superconducting gap features in thin films of superconducting bilayer nickelates La2PrNi2O7 at ambient pressure and compressive strain paved the way to study the Cooper-pairing models and the band-selective identification of the gap features in these systems. Here, using the realistic two-orbital bilayer model and the continuum Green's function formalism, we theoretically analyze orbital and band-selective local density of states as well as the corresponding STM spectra. We find that the multiorbital character and the spatial dependence of the Wannier functions leads to the spectra developing characteristic features depending on the position of the scanning tunneling microscope's tip. This allows for a band-resolved analysis of the superconducting coherence peaks and scattering momenta. We identify a clear path for experimental measurements to not only identify the debated incipiency of the gamma-band, but also identification of the coherence peaks' band origins via distance dependent measurements of the local density of states and its corrections through impurity scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically analyze”、“continuum Green's function formalism”。；研究对象：超导双层镍氧化物薄膜La₂PrNi₂O₇，具体研究其扫描隧道显微镜（STM）谱图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Wannier函数的多轨道特性及其空间依赖性导致STM谱图特征随针尖位置变化，从而可以实现对超导相干峰和散射动量的能带分辨分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Wannier函数的多轨道特性及其空间依赖性导致STM谱图特征随针尖位置变化，从而可以实现对超导相干峰和散射动量的能带分辨分析。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双轨道双层模型和连续格林函数形式论，理论计算轨道和能带分辨的局域态密度（LDOS）及对应的STM谱。

papers.title: Calibration of systematic distortions in quantum emitter localization microscopy for deterministic nanophotonic fabrication
papers.abstract: Quantum photonic technologies greatly benefit from quantum light emitters with high brightness, indistinguishability, and reliable polarization characteristics. Achieving optimal performance relies on the accurate localization of emitters and their deterministic integration into tailored photonic structures with nanometer-scale accuracy. Although marker-based photoluminescence imaging techniques can achieve statistical fitting uncertainties below 10 nm, the ultimate integration yield is often limited by uncorrected systematic distortions in custom cryo-optical setups that compromise metrological accuracy. Here, we present an in situ calibration protocol that uses lithographically defined gold nanodisk arrays as references to calibrate optical distortions with a Zernike vector-field model. On held-out validation patterns beyond the calibration dataset, this correction reduces the residual systematic bias to 5.3 nm with a 2D scatter of 24.6 nm across the analyzed field of view. Furthermore, we demonstrate that applying this correction to the deterministic fabrication of circular mesa structures around semiconductor quantum dots reduces the variance in emission polarization by 49%, indicating improved registration accuracy. This calibration strategy offers a practical route to high-yield deterministic integration of quantum emitters into scalable quantum photonic circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in situ calibration protocol、lithographically defined gold nanodisk arrays、Zernike vector-field model、deterministic fabrication。；研究对象：量子发射器（如半导体量子点）在纳米光子结构中的精确定位与集成，具体涉及低温光学成像系统中的系统畸变校准。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原位校准协议，利用金纳米盘阵列作为参考，将光学畸变的残余系统偏差降低至5.3 nm，并将量子点周围圆形台面结构的发射偏振方差降低49%，显著提升了量子发射器确定性集成的精度与产率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原位校准协议，利用金纳米盘阵列作为参考，将光学畸变的残余系统偏差降低至5.3 nm，并将量子点周围圆形台面结构的发射偏振方差降低49%，显著提升了量子发射器确定性集成的精度与产率。；创新点：提出了一种基于金纳米盘阵列和Zernike矢量场模型的原位畸变校准协议，能够有效校正定制低温光学系统中未被补偿的系统畸变，从而提升量子发射器集成到纳米光子结构中的计量精度与产率。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光致发光成像技术，结合光刻定义的金纳米盘阵列作为参考标记，利用Zernike矢量场模型对低温光学系统中的畸变进行原位校准，并在验证图案上评估校正效果。随后将校准方法应用于半导体量子点周围圆形台面结构的确定性制备。

papers.title: Quantum Computational Resources and Conformal Field Theory: Unifying Spins, Bosons, and Fermions
papers.abstract: Characterizing a quantum state through the lens of quantum resources provides an information-theoretic perspective on many-body systems. While quantum entanglement serves as the paradigmatic example of a quantum resource, recent studies have shown that quantum magic, a resource for universal quantum computation, can capture aspects of many-body states complementary to those described by entanglement. For instance, in spin systems, conformal field theory (CFT) analysis of the stabilizer Rényi entropy has revealed universal features of nonstabilizerness that are qualitatively distinct from entanglement. In bosonic and fermionic systems, however, a comparable formulation for their computational resource, non-Gaussianity, has yet to be established. In this work, we introduce a unified measure, the magic Rényi entropy (MRE), to quantify computational resources in spins, bosons, and fermions on an equal footing. This allows us to reveal common universal aspects of nonstabilizerness and non-Gaussianity in critical many-body states. In particular, our CFT analysis shows that the universal contribution to the MRE appears as the size-independent term determined by the Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy. We find that non-Gaussianity can continuously renormalize this universal contribution or drive a boundary phase transition through bulk-induced boundary renormalization-group flows. As a concrete demonstration, we present a detailed CFT analysis of non-Gaussianity in interacting spinless fermions described by the Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid, showing boundary transitions at the Luttinger parameters $K=1/3$ and $K=3$. We perform numerical calculations that confirm our field-theoretical predictions. These results provide a unified field-theoretical understanding of many-body magic across spins, bosons, and fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：CFT分析、场论预测、统一度量）；研究对象：量子计算资源（非稳定化能力与非高斯性）在自旋、玻色子和费米子多体系统中的统一描述，以及共形场论（CFT）对其临界态普适特征的刻画。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“魔法Rényi熵”（MRE）作为统一度量，揭示了临界多体态中非稳定化能力与非高斯性的共同普适特征，其普适贡献由Affleck-Ludwig边界熵决定，且非高斯性可通过边界重整化群流连续重整化该贡献或驱动边界相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“魔法Rényi熵”（MRE）作为统一度量，揭示了临界多体态中非稳定化能力与非高斯性的共同普适特征，其普适贡献由Affleck-Ludwig边界熵决定，且非高斯性可通过边界重整化群流连续重整化该贡献或驱动边界相变。；创新点：首次将量子计算资源（非高斯性）的CFT分析从自旋系统推广到玻色子和费米子系统，建立了统一度量MRE，并揭示了非高斯性可驱动边界相变（如Luttinger参数K=1/3和K=3处的边界转变）。
papers.method_zh: 共形场论（CFT）分析、边界重整化群方法；以Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中相互作用无自旋费米子为例进行具体CFT分析，并辅以数值计算验证。

papers.title: Energetic Protection, Monotonicity and Switching Far from Equilibrium
papers.abstract: At equilibrium, the ratio of two steady-state probabilities is a Boltzmann factor, set by a free-energy difference. Such ratios are the natural, normalization-independent readouts of both thermodynamics and information processing, and are often used as a measure of fidelity in biophysical systems. What becomes of these ratios once a system is driven from equilibrium, where the Boltzmann factor no longer holds? Representing Markov processes as graphs and their steady states as averages over a distribution on spanning trees, the \emph{arboreal distribution}, we track the ratio $π_i/π_j$ under driving along \emph{energetic edges}, where detailed balance is broken, relative to its equilibrium value. Our central finding is that a chosen ratio can stay exactly locked to its equilibrium value arbitrarily far from equilibrium, a phenomenon we call \emph{energetic protection}, whenever an algebraic equality between spanning-tree weights holds. Just as detailed balance constrains rates around cycles, energetic protection constrains weights across trees, providing a new mechanism for robustness against fluctuations in the driving force, such as variations in ATP concentration. Away from this equality, single-edge driving collapses the response onto two arboreal coefficients and forces it to be monotonic, so nonmonotonic single-edge control is impossible at any strength. With two energetic edges, protection and monotonicity combine into a \emph{thermodynamic switch} that holds a function at its equilibrium value for as long as desired and releases it sharply. Equilibrium is known for the limits it places on information processing. We show that new constraints, both no-go principles and exact invariances, survive far from equilibrium. These results reveal how the localization of energy expenditure governs the functional logic of nonequilibrium systems in physics and biology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Representing Markov processes as graphs”“averages over a distribution on spanning trees”“algebraic equality”等，均为理论推导与数学建模关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非平衡态马尔可夫过程的稳态概率比，特别是当系统被驱动远离平衡时（如通过“energetic edges”打破细致平衡），稳态概率比相对于平衡值的响应与鲁棒性。具体物理背景包括生物物理系统中的信息处理与ATP浓度波动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现稳态概率比可以在远离平衡时“锁定”于其平衡值（称为“energetic protection”），只要生成树权重满足某种代数等式；此外，单边驱动下响应是单调的，而双边驱动可构造一个“热力学开关”，使函数在平衡值上保持任意长时间后突然释放。
